    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "from datetime import datetime, timezone\n",
    "import re\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "\n",
    "PROJECT_ROOT = Path(r\"C:\\Users\\Administrator\\Desktop\\Matric-Maths-Exam-Intelligence\")\n",
    "SEG_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / \"data\" / \"interim\" / \"segmented\" / \"2021\"\n",
    "MAP_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / \"data\" / \"processed\" / \"mapped\" / \"2021\"\n",
    "MAP_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "exams = pd.read_csv(SEG_DIR / \"exam_questions_2021.csv\")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def norm(s) -> str:\n",
    "    if s is None or (isinstance(s, float) and pd.isna(s)):\n",
    "        return \"\"\n",
    "    s = str(s).lower()\n",
    "    return s.replace(\"θ\", \"theta\").replace(\"π\", \"pi\")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def map_topic_v2021(text: str, paper: str = \"\"):\n",
    "    t = norm(text)\n",
    "    paper = str(paper).upper()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Calculus — strong cues\n",
    "    if re.search(\n",
    "        r\"f'\\s*\\(|dy/dx|d/dx|derivative|differentiate|first principles|\"\n",
    "        r\"second derivative|concave|inflection|stationary|integrat|\"\n",
    "        r\"gradient of the curve|turning point.*f\\(|cubic\",\n",
    "        t,\n",
    "    ):\n",
    "        return \"Calculus\", \"symbolic\", \"D_CALC\", \"high\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Calculus — optimisation structure (P1 Q11 style)\n",
    "    if re.search(\n",
    "        r\"(cost|profit|area|volume|speed|distance).{0,60}(minimum|maximum|minimise|minimize|maximise|maximize|as low as possible|as high as possible)\"\n",
    "        r\"|(minimum|maximum|minimise|minimize).{0,60}(cost|profit|area|volume|speed)\",\n",
    "        t,\n",
    "    ):\n",
    "        return \"Calculus\", \"structural_opt\", \"D_CALC_OPT\", \"high\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Euclidean — before AG inheritance targets\n",
    "    if re.search(\n",
    "        r\"cyclic\\s*quad|cyclic quadrilateral|theorem|\"\n",
    "        r\"tangent[- ]chord|angle in (the )?semicircle|\"\n",
    "        r\"prove that|calculate.*with reasons|give reasons|\"\n",
    "        r\"euclidean|similar triangles|proportional\",\n",
    "        t,\n",
    "    ):\n",
    "        return \"Euclidean Geometry\", \"keyword\", \"D_EUCL\", \"high\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    if re.search(\n",
    "        r\"\\bsin\\b|\\bcos\\b|\\btan\\b|\\bsec\\b|\\bcosec\\b|\\bcot\\b|\"\n",
    "        r\"identit|reduction|general solution|trigonomet|theta\",\n",
    "        t,\n",
    "    ):\n",
    "        return \"Trigonometry\", \"keyword\", \"D_TRIG\", \"high\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    if re.search(\n",
    "        r\"gradient of|equation of the line|midpoint|distance formula|\"\n",
    "        r\"circle with centre|radius of|analytical|coordinates of the centre|\"\n",
    "        r\"\\bcircles?\\b|\\(x\\s*[−\\-–]\",\n",
    "        t,\n",
    "    ):\n",
    "        return \"Analytical Geometry\", \"keyword\", \"D_AGEO\", \"high\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    if re.search(\n",
    "        r\"boxplot|box-and-whisker|standard deviation|variance|ogive|\"\n",
    "        r\"histogram|quartile|interquartile|percentile|scatter\",\n",
    "        t,\n",
    "    ):\n",
    "        return \"Statistics\", \"keyword\", \"D_STAT\", \"high\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    if re.search(\n",
    "        r\"probability|independent|mutually exclusive|tree diagram|venn|p\\s*\\(|random\",\n",
    "        t,\n",
    "    ):\n",
    "        return \"Probability\", \"keyword\", \"D_PROB\", \"high\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    if re.search(\n",
    "        r\"arithmetic|geometric|sequence|series|common difference|\"\n",
    "        r\"common ratio|constant ratio|consecutive terms|sigma|\"\n",
    "        r\"\\bterm of\\b|first term\",\n",
    "        t,\n",
    "    ):\n",
    "        return \"Number Patterns & Sequences\", \"keyword\", \"D_SEQ\", \"high\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    if re.search(\n",
    "        r\"compound interest|simple interest|present value|future value|\"\n",
    "        r\"annuity|depreciation|effective rate|nominal|loan|invest\",\n",
    "        t,\n",
    "    ):\n",
    "        return \"Finance\", \"keyword\", \"D_FIN\", \"high\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    if re.search(\n",
    "        r\"parabola|hyperbola|exponential|logarithmic|asymptote|\"\n",
    "        r\"inverse function|axis of symmetry|turning point|sketch|\"\n",
    "        r\"x-intercept|y-intercept|range of|domain\",\n",
    "        t,\n",
    "    ):\n",
    "        return \"Functions & Graphs\", \"keyword\", \"D_FUNC\", \"high\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    if re.search(\n",
    "        r\"quadratic|factoris|factoriz|simultaneous|inequalit|surd|\"\n",
    "        r\"exponent|logarithm|nature of the roots|discriminant|\"\n",
    "        r\"solve for|=\\s*0|show that|determine the values of x\",\n",
    "        t,\n",
    "    ):\n",
    "        return \"Algebra & Equations\", \"keyword\", \"D_ALG\", \"high\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    if re.search(r\"[a-z0-9\\)\\]]\\s*=\\s*[a-z0-9\\-\\+]\", t) and len(t) < 80 and paper == \"P1\":\n",
    "        return \"Algebra & Equations\", \"ocr_equation\", \"D_ALG_EQ\", \"medium\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    if len(t) < 20:\n",
    "        return \"Unmapped\", \"prior_weak\", \"D_SHORT\", \"low\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    return \"Unmapped\", \"no_match\", \"D_NONE\", \"low\"\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def inherit_topic_safe(group: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:\n",
    "    known = group[group[\"topic\"] != \"Unmapped\"]\n",
    "    if known.empty:\n",
    "        return group\n",
    "    for forced in [\"Euclidean Geometry\", \"Calculus\"]:\n",
    "        hit = known[\n",
    "            (known[\"topic\"] == forced)\n",
    "            & (known[\"mapping_confidence\"].isin([\"high\", \"medium\"]))\n",
    "        ]\n",
    "        if len(hit):\n",
    "            winner = forced\n",
    "            break\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        high = known[known[\"mapping_confidence\"] == \"high\"]\n",
    "        base = high if len(high) else known\n",
    "        winner = base[\"topic\"].value_counts().index[0]\n",
    "    mask = group[\"topic\"] == \"Unmapped\"\n",
    "    group.loc[mask, \"topic\"] = winner\n",
    "    group.loc[mask, \"mapping_method\"] = \"inherited\"\n",
    "    group.loc[mask, \"rule_id\"] = \"D_INHERIT_Q_SAFE\"\n",
    "    group.loc[mask, \"mapping_confidence\"] = \"medium\"\n",
    "    return group\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "rows = []\n",
    "for _, r in exams.iterrows():\n",
    "    topic, method, rule_id, conf = map_topic_v2021(\n",
    "        r.get(\"question_text\", \"\"), r.get(\"paper\", \"\")\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    row = r.to_dict()\n",
    "    row.update({\n",
    "        \"topic\": topic,\n",
    "        \"mapping_method\": method,\n",
    "        \"rule_id\": rule_id,\n",
    "        \"mapping_confidence\": conf,\n",
    "        \"taxonomy_version\": \"v1_frozen\",\n",
    "        \"extraction_method\": \"ocr_text\",\n",
    "        \"vision_description\": None,\n",
    "        \"vision_verification_status\": None,\n",
    "        \"diagram_present\": False,\n",
    "        \"load_bearing_diagram\": False,\n",
    "        \"data_quality\": \"text_usable\",\n",
    "        \"mapped_at\": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),\n",
    "    })\n",
    "    rows.append(row)\n",
    "\n",
    "mapped = pd.DataFrame(rows)\n",
    "mapped = mapped.groupby([\"paper\", \"question_number\"], group_keys=False).apply(inherit_topic_safe)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Question-level force for known thin-OCR blocks (documented)\n",
    "FORCE = {\n",
    "    (\"P1\", 9): \"Calculus\",\n",
    "    (\"P1\", 10): \"Calculus\",\n",
    "    (\"P1\", 11): \"Calculus\",\n",
    "    (\"P2\", 9): \"Euclidean Geometry\",\n",
    "    (\"P2\", 10): \"Euclidean Geometry\",\n",
    "    (\"P2\", 11): \"Euclidean Geometry\",\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "def force_q(row):\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        key = (str(row[\"paper\"]), int(float(row[\"question_number\"])))\n",
    "    except Exception:\n",
    "        return row\n",
    "    if key in FORCE and row[\"topic\"] != FORCE[key]:\n",
    "        row[\"topic\"] = FORCE[key]\n",
    "        row[\"mapping_method\"] = \"question_force_2021\"\n",
    "        row[\"rule_id\"] = \"D_FORCE_Q\"\n",
    "        row[\"mapping_confidence\"] = \"high\"\n",
    "    return row\n",
    "\n",
    "mapped = mapped.apply(force_q, axis=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Topic counts:\")\n",
    "print(mapped[\"topic\"].value_counts())\n",
    "print()\n",
    "print(\"Calculus:\", int((mapped[\"topic\"] == \"Calculus\").sum()))\n",
    "print(\"Euclidean:\", int((mapped[\"topic\"] == \"Euclidean Geometry\").sum()))\n",
    "print(\"Coverage:\", f\"{(mapped['topic'] != 'Unmapped').mean():.1%}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "out = MAP_DIR / \"question_topic_map_2021.csv\"\n",
    "mapped.to_csv(out, index=False)\n",
    "print(\"Saved:\", out)"

    "import pdfplumber\n",
    "\n",
    "rows = []\n",
    "for name, path in SOURCES.items():\n",
    "    if not path.exists():\n",
    "        rows.append({\"year\": YEAR, \"doc\": name, \"exists\": False})\n",

    "    with pdfplumber.open(path) as pdf:\n",

    "def extract_pdfplumber(path: Path) -> str:\n",
    "    parts = []\n",
    "    with pdfplumber.open(path) as pdf:\n",
    "        for i, page in enumerate(pdf.pages, 1):\n",
    "            parts.append(f\"\\n===== Page {i} =====\\n{page.extract_text() or ''}\")\n",
    "    return \"\\n\".join(parts)\n",
    "\n",

   "source": [
    "def clean_text(t: str) -> str:\n",
    "    t = t.replace(\"\\r\", \"\\n\")\n",
    "    t = re.sub(r\"[ \\t]+\", \" \", t)\n",
    "    return re.sub(r\"\\n{3,}\", \"\\n\\n\", t)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def segment_exam(text: str, document_id: str, paper: str, year: int) -> pd.DataFrame:\n",
    "    text = clean_text(text)\n",
    "    q_pat = re.compile(r\"(?i)(?:^|\\n)\\s*QUESTION\\s*(\\d{1,2})\\b\")\n",
    "    matches = list(q_pat.finditer(text))\n",
    "    records = []\n",
    "    for i, m in enumerate(matches):\n",
    "        qnum = int(m.group(1))\n",
    "        start = m.start()\n",
    "        end = matches[i + 1].start() if i + 1 < len(matches) else len(text)\n",
    "        block = text[start:end].strip()\n",
    "        sub_pat = re.compile(\n",
    "            r\"(?m)(?P<sub>\\d+\\.\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)*)\\s+(?P<body>.*?)(?=(?:\\n\\s*\\d+\\.\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)*\\s+)|\\Z)\",\n",
    "            re.DOTALL,\n",
    "        )\n",
    "        subs = list(sub_pat.finditer(block))\n",
    "        if not subs:\n",
    "            records.append({\n",
    "                \"year\": year,\n",
    "                \"document_id\": document_id,\n",
    "                \"paper\": paper,\n",
    "                \"question_number\": qnum,\n",
    "                \"subquestion\": str(qnum),\n",
    "                \"marks\": None,\n",
    "                \"question_text\": block[:2000],\n",
    "                \"segmentation_status\": \"no_sub_markers\",\n",
    "            })\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "        for s in subs:\n",
    "            body = s.group(\"body\").strip()\n",
    "            marks = None\n",
    "            mm = re.search(r\"[\\(\\[]\\s*(\\d{1,2})\\s*[\\)\\]]\\s*$\", body)\n",
    "            if mm:\n",
    "                marks = int(mm.group(1))\n",
    "                body = body[: mm.start()].strip()\n",
    "            if marks is not None and marks > 15:\n",
    "                marks = None\n",
    "            records.append({\n",
    "                \"year\": year,\n",
    "                \"document_id\": document_id,\n",
    "                \"paper\": paper,\n",
    "                \"question_number\": qnum,\n",
    "                \"subquestion\": s.group(\"sub\").strip(),\n",
    "                \"marks\": marks,\n",
    "                \"question_text\": body[:2000],\n",
    "                \"segmentation_status\": \"ok\" if marks is not None else \"missing_marks\",\n",
    "            })\n",
    "    return pd.DataFrame(records)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "all_rows = []\n",
    "for paper, fname, did in [\n",
    "    (\"P1\", \"p1_exam.txt\", f\"{YEAR}_nov_p1_exam_maths\"),\n",
    "    (\"P2\", \"p2_exam.txt\", f\"{YEAR}_nov_p2_exam_maths\"),\n",
    "]:\n",
    "    text = (TEXT_DIR / fname).read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n",
    "    df = segment_exam(text, did, paper, YEAR)\n",
    "    print(f\"{paper}: rows={len(df)} main_q={df['question_number'].nunique()} marks_sum={df['marks'].sum(min_count=1)}\")\n",
    "    all_rows.append(df)\n",
    "\n",
    "exam_df = pd.concat(all_rows, ignore_index=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Path A schema only\n",
    "SEGMENTATION_COLUMNS = [\n",
    "    \"year\", \"document_id\", \"paper\", \"question_number\",\n",
    "    \"subquestion\", \"marks\", \"question_text\", \"segmentation_status\",\n",
    "]\n",
    "exam_df = exam_df[SEGMENTATION_COLUMNS]\n",
    "\n",
    "forbidden = {\n",
    "    \"topic\", \"subtopic\", \"skill\", \"mapping_method\", \"mapping_confidence\",\n",
    "    \"extraction_method\", \"diagram_present\", \"vision_description\",\n",
    "}\n",
    "leaked = forbidden & set(exam_df.columns)\n",
    "if leaked:\n",
    "    raise SystemExit(f\"Path A violation: {leaked}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "out = SEG_DIR / f\"exam_questions_{YEAR}.csv\"\n",

    "print(\"Wrote\", out, \"rows=\", len(exam_df))\n",

   ],
   "source": [
    "# ---- helpers ----\n",
    "\n",
    "def doc_paths(year: int) -> dict:\n",
    "    return {\n",
    "        \"p1_exam\": RAW_EXAMS / f\"{year}_nov_p1_exam_maths.pdf\",\n",
    "        \"p2_exam\": RAW_EXAMS / f\"{year}_nov_p2_exam_maths.pdf\",\n",
    "        \"p1_memo\": RAW_MEMOS / f\"{year}_nov_p1_memo_maths.pdf\",\n",
    "        \"p2_memo\": RAW_MEMOS / f\"{year}_nov_p2_memo_maths.pdf\",\n",
    "    }\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def classify_doc(path: Path) -> dict:\n",
    "    if not path.exists() or path.stat().st_size == 0:\n",
    "        return {\"exists\": False, \"ocr_required\": False, \"pages\": 0, \"chars_per_page\": 0.0}\n",
    "    with pdfplumber.open(path) as pdf:\n",
    "        n = len(pdf.pages)\n",
    "        sample = \"\"\n",
    "        for page in pdf.pages[: min(3, n)]:\n",
    "            sample += page.extract_text() or \"\"\n",
    "        cpp = len(sample) / max(1, min(3, n))\n",
    "    return {\n",
    "        \"exists\": True,\n",
    "        \"pages\": n,\n",
    "        \"chars_per_page\": round(cpp, 1),\n",
    "        \"has_text_layer\": cpp > 200,\n",
    "        \"ocr_required\": cpp <= 200,\n",
    "    }\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def extract_text_layer(path: Path) -> str:\n",
    "    parts = []\n",
    "    with pdfplumber.open(path) as pdf:\n",
    "        for i, page in enumerate(pdf.pages, 1):\n",
    "            parts.append(f\"\\n===== Page {i} =====\\n{page.extract_text() or ''}\")\n",
    "    return \"\\n\".join(parts)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def extract_with_ocr(path: Path) -> str:\n",
    "    import pytesseract\n",
    "    from pdf2image import convert_from_path\n",
    "    pytesseract.pytesseract.tesseract_cmd = TESSERACT_CMD\n",
    "    os.environ[\"TESSDATA_PREFIX\"] = TESSDATA\n",
    "    cfg = r\"--tessdata-dir \" + TESSDATA + r\" --psm 6\"\n",
    "    pages = convert_from_path(str(path), dpi=300, poppler_path=POPPLER_PATH)\n",
    "    parts = []\n",
    "    for i, img in enumerate(pages, 1):\n",
    "        t = pytesseract.image_to_string(img, lang=\"eng\", config=cfg)\n",
    "        parts.append(f\"\\n===== Page {i} =====\\n{t}\")\n",
    "    return \"\\n\".join(parts)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def clean_text(t: str) -> str:\n",
    "    t = t.replace(\"\\r\", \"\\n\")\n",
    "    t = re.sub(r\"[ \\t]+\", \" \", t)\n",
    "    return re.sub(r\"\\n{3,}\", \"\\n\\n\", t)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def segment_exam(text: str, document_id: str, paper: str, year: int) -> pd.DataFrame:\n",
    "    text = clean_text(text)\n",
    "    q_pat = re.compile(r\"(?i)(?:^|\\n)\\s*QUESTION\\s*(\\d{1,2})\\b\")\n",
    "    matches = list(q_pat.finditer(text))\n",
    "    records = []\n",
    "    for i, m in enumerate(matches):\n",
    "        qnum = int(m.group(1))\n",
    "        start = m.start()\n",
    "        end = matches[i + 1].start() if i + 1 < len(matches) else len(text)\n",
    "        block = text[start:end].strip()\n",
    "        sub_pat = re.compile(\n",
    "            r\"(?m)(?P<sub>\\d+\\.\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)*)\\s+(?P<body>.*?)(?=(?:\\n\\s*\\d+\\.\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)*\\s+)|\\Z)\",\n",
    "            re.DOTALL,\n",
    "        )\n",
    "        subs = list(sub_pat.finditer(block))\n",
    "        if not subs:\n",
    "            records.append({\n",
    "                \"year\": year, \"document_id\": document_id, \"paper\": paper,\n",
    "                \"question_number\": qnum, \"subquestion\": str(qnum),\n",
    "                \"marks\": None, \"question_text\": block[:2000],\n",
    "                \"segmentation_status\": \"no_sub_markers\",\n",
    "            })\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "        for s in subs:\n",
    "            body = s.group(\"body\").strip()\n",
    "            marks = None\n",
    "            mm = re.search(r\"[\\(\\[]\\s*(\\d{1,2})\\s*[\\)\\]]\\s*$\", body)\n",
    "            if mm:\n",
    "                marks = int(mm.group(1))\n",
    "                body = body[: mm.start()].strip()\n",
    "            if marks is not None and marks > 15:\n",
    "                marks = None\n",
    "            records.append({\n",
    "                \"year\": year, \"document_id\": document_id, \"paper\": paper,\n",
    "                \"question_number\": qnum, \"subquestion\": s.group(\"sub\").strip(),\n",
    "                \"marks\": marks, \"question_text\": body[:2000],\n",
    "                \"segmentation_status\": \"ok\" if marks is not None else \"missing_marks\",\n",
    "            })\n",
    "    return pd.DataFrame(records)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "SEGMENTATION_COLUMNS = [\n",
    "    \"year\", \"document_id\", \"paper\", \"question_number\",\n",
    "    \"subquestion\", \"marks\", \"question_text\", \"segmentation_status\",\n",
    "]\n",
    "FORBIDDEN = {\n",
    "    \"topic\", \"subtopic\", \"skill\", \"mapping_method\", \"mapping_confidence\",\n",
    "    \"extraction_method\", \"diagram_present\", \"vision_description\",\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ---- main loop ----\n",
    "\n",
    "summary_rows = []\n",
    "\n",
    "for YEAR in YEARS:\n",
    "    print(f\"\\n{'='*70}\\nYEAR {YEAR}\\n{'='*70}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    TEXT_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / \"data\" / \"interim\" / \"extracted_text\" / str(YEAR)\n",
    "    SEG_DIR  = PROJECT_ROOT / \"data\" / \"interim\" / \"segmented\" / str(YEAR)\n",
    "    PILOT_DOC = PROJECT_ROOT / \"docs\" / \"pilot\" / str(YEAR)\n",
    "    for d in (TEXT_DIR, SEG_DIR, PILOT_DOC):\n",
    "        d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "    sources = doc_paths(YEAR)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # --- classification ---\n",
    "    cls_rows = []\n",
    "    for name, path in sources.items():\n",
    "        info = classify_doc(path)\n",
    "        cls_rows.append({\"year\": YEAR, \"doc\": name, **info})\n",
    "    cls = pd.DataFrame(cls_rows)\n",
    "    cls.to_csv(TEXT_DIR / f\"ocr_classification_{YEAR}.csv\", index=False)\n",
    "    print(cls.to_string(index=False))\n",
    "\n",
    "    missing = cls.loc[~cls[\"exists\"], \"doc\"].tolist()\n",
    "    if missing:\n",
    "        print(f\"  MISSING sources for {YEAR}: {missing} — skipping year\")\n",
    "        summary_rows.append({\n",
    "            \"year\": YEAR, \"status\": \"skipped_missing_sources\",\n",
    "            \"p1_rows\": 0, \"p2_rows\": 0,\n",
    "            \"p1_marks\": 0, \"p2_marks\": 0, \"ocr_used\": False,\n",
    "        })\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "\n",
    "    # --- extraction (per doc: text-layer or OCR) ---\n",
    "    ocr_used_this_year = False\n",
    "    for name, path in sources.items():\n",
    "        need_ocr = bool(cls.loc[cls[\"doc\"] == name, \"ocr_required\"].iloc[0])\n",
    "        out = TEXT_DIR / f\"{name}.txt\"\n",
    "        if out.exists() and out.stat().st_size > 5000:\n",
    "            print(f\"  SKIP extract {name}: text already present\")\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "        if need_ocr:\n",
    "            print(f\"  OCR  {name} ...\")\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                text = extract_with_ocr(path)\n",
    "                ocr_used_this_year = True\n",
    "            except Exception as e:\n",
    "                print(f\"    OCR FAILED for {name}: {e}\")\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            print(f\"  TEXT {name} ...\")\n",
    "            text = extract_text_layer(path)\n",
    "        out.write_text(text, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    saved chars={len(text)}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    # --- segmentation ---\n",
    "    all_rows = []\n",
    "    for paper, fname, did in [\n",
    "        (\"P1\", \"p1_exam.txt\", f\"{YEAR}_nov_p1_exam_maths\"),\n",
    "        (\"P2\", \"p2_exam.txt\", f\"{YEAR}_nov_p2_exam_maths\"),\n",
    "    ]:\n",
    "        tpath = TEXT_DIR / fname\n",
    "        if not tpath.exists():\n",
    "            print(f\"  no text for {paper}; skipping\")\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "        text = tpath.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n",
    "        df = segment_exam(text, did, paper, YEAR)\n",
    "        all_rows.append(df)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if not all_rows:\n",
    "        print(f\"  {YEAR}: no segments produced\")\n",
    "        summary_rows.append({\n",
    "            \"year\": YEAR, \"status\": \"no_segments\",\n",
    "            \"p1_rows\": 0, \"p2_rows\": 0,\n",
    "            \"p1_marks\": 0, \"p2_marks\": 0, \"ocr_used\": ocr_used_this_year,\n",
    "        })\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "\n",
    "    exam_df = pd.concat(all_rows, ignore_index=True)\n",
    "    exam_df = exam_df[SEGMENTATION_COLUMNS]\n",
    "\n",
    "    leaked = FORBIDDEN & set(exam_df.columns)\n",
    "    if leaked:\n",
    "        raise SystemExit(f\"Path A violation in {YEAR}: {leaked}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    out = SEG_DIR / f\"exam_questions_{YEAR}.csv\"\n",
    "    exam_df.to_csv(out, index=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "    p1 = exam_df[exam_df[\"paper\"] == \"P1\"]\n",
    "    p2 = exam_df[exam_df[\"paper\"] == \"P2\"]\n",
    "    p1_marks = int(p1[\"marks\"].sum(min_count=1) or 0)\n",
    "    p2_marks = int(p2[\"marks\"].sum(min_count=1) or 0)\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"  P1: rows={len(p1)} main_q={p1['question_number'].nunique()} marks={p1_marks}\")\n",
    "    print(f\"  P2: rows={len(p2)} main_q={p2['question_number'].nunique()} marks={p2_marks}\")\n",
    "    print(f\"  Wrote {out}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    # --- freeze marker ---\n",
    "    marker = PILOT_DOC / \"path_a_freeze.md\"\n",
    "    marker.write_text(f\"\"\"# {YEAR} — Path A freeze\n",
    "\n",
    "Stage: extraction + segmentation only.\n",

    "import re\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "\n",
    "def clean_text(t: str) -> str:\n",
    "    t = t.replace(\"\\r\", \"\\n\")\n",
    "    t = re.sub(r\"[ \\t]+\", \" \", t)\n",
    "    return re.sub(r\"\\n{3,}\", \"\\n\\n\", t)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 24,
   "id": "15fb2d88",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def segment_exam(text: str, document_id: str, paper: str, year: int) -> pd.DataFrame:\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Segment a paper into subquestions.\n",
    "\n",
    "    Rules:\n",
    "      - Question boundaries detected by 'QUESTION <n>' headers.\n",
    "      - Subquestions detected by patterns like 1.1, 1.1.1, 1.2.3.\n",
    "      - Subquestion only accepted if its number starts with the parent question\n",
    "        number (e.g. '5.4' under Q5 kept; '2.9' under Q5 dropped).\n",
    "      - Stems (X.Y that have children X.Y.Z) are kept with status='stem',\n",
    "        not counted as questions. Their text is preserved for N04 mapping.\n",
    "      - Marks extracted from trailing (n) or [n]. Values > 15 discarded.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    text = clean_text(text)\n",
    "\n",
    "    q_pat = re.compile(r\"(?i)(?:^|\\n)\\s*QUESTION\\s*(\\d{1,2})\\b\")\n",
    "    matches = list(q_pat.finditer(text))\n",
    "\n",
    "    records = []\n",
    "\n",
    "    for i, m in enumerate(matches):\n",
    "        qnum = int(m.group(1))\n",
    "        qnum_str = str(qnum)\n",
    "        start = m.start()\n",
    "        end = matches[i + 1].start() if i + 1 < len(matches) else len(text)\n",
    "        block = text[start:end].strip()\n",
    "\n",
    "        sub_pat = re.compile(\n",
    "            r\"(?m)(?P<sub>\\d+\\.\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)*)\\s+\"\n",
    "            r\"(?P<body>.*?)\"\n",
    "            r\"(?=(?:\\n\\s*\\d+\\.\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)*\\s+)|\\Z)\",\n",
    "            re.DOTALL,\n",
    "        )\n",
    "        subs = list(sub_pat.finditer(block))\n",
    "\n",
    "        if not subs:\n",
    "            records.append({\n",
    "                \"year\": year, \"document_id\": document_id, \"paper\": paper,\n",
    "                \"question_number\": qnum, \"subquestion\": qnum_str,\n",
    "                \"marks\": None, \"question_text\": block[:2000],\n",
    "                \"segmentation_status\": \"no_sub_markers\",\n",
    "            })\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Parent-prefix filter\n",
    "        kept_subs = [\n",
    "            s for s in subs\n",
    "            if s.group(\"sub\").strip().startswith(qnum_str + \".\")\n",
    "        ]\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Stem detection: labels that have children in the same question\n",
    "        labels = [s.group(\"sub\").strip() for s in kept_subs]\n",
    "        stems = set()\n",
    "        for label in labels:\n",
    "            for other in labels:\n",
    "                if other != label and other.startswith(label + \".\"):\n",
    "                    stems.add(label)\n",
    "                    break\n",
    "\n",
    "        for s in kept_subs:\n",
    "            sub_label = s.group(\"sub\").strip()\n",
    "            body = s.group(\"body\").strip()\n",
    "\n",
    "            marks = None\n",
    "            mm = re.search(r\"[\\(\\[]\\s*(\\d{1,2})\\s*[\\)\\]]\\s*$\", body)\n",
    "            if mm:\n",
    "                candidate = int(mm.group(1))\n",
    "                if candidate <= 15:\n",
    "                    marks = candidate\n",
    "                    body = body[: mm.start()].strip()\n",
    "\n",
    "            if sub_label in stems:\n",
    "                status = \"stem\"\n",
    "            elif marks is not None:\n",
    "                status = \"ok\"\n",
    "            else:\n",
    "                status = \"missing_marks\"\n",
    "\n",
    "            records.append({\n",
    "                \"year\": year, \"document_id\": document_id, \"paper\": paper,\n",
    "                \"question_number\": qnum, \"subquestion\": sub_label,\n",
    "                \"marks\": marks, \"question_text\": body[:2000],\n",
    "                \"segmentation_status\": status,\n",
    "            })\n",
    "\n",
    "    return pd.DataFrame(records)"
   ]

    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "\n",
    "ROOT = Path(r\"C:\\Users\\Administrator\\Desktop\\Matric-Maths-Exam-Intelligence\")\n",
    "\n",
    "SEGMENTATION_COLUMNS = [\n",
    "    \"year\", \"document_id\", \"paper\", \"question_number\",\n",
    "    \"subquestion\", \"marks\", \"question_text\", \"segmentation_status\",\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "for year in [2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016, 2015, 2014]:\n",
    "    TEXT_DIR = ROOT / \"data\" / \"interim\" / \"extracted_text\" / str(year)\n",
    "    SEG_DIR  = ROOT / \"data\" / \"interim\" / \"segmented\" / str(year)\n",
    "\n",
    "    all_rows = []\n",
    "    for paper, fname, did in [\n",

    "            continue\n",

    "\n",
    "    if not all_rows:\n",

    "    exam_df = pd.concat(all_rows, ignore_index=True)\n",

    "def tokenize(text: str):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Lowercase, keep alpha tokens length >= 3, drop stopwords + math noise.\"\"\"\n",
    "    text = text.lower()\n",
    "    text = re.sub(r\"[^a-z\\s]\", \" \", text)   # keep letters only\n",
    "    tokens = text.split()\n",
    "    return [\n",
    "        t for t in tokens\n",
    "        if len(t) >= 3\n",
    "        and t not in STOPWORDS\n",
    "        and t not in MATH_NOISE\n",
    "    ]\n",
    "\n",
    "# Build token counts per row\n",
    "corpus[\"tokens\"] = corpus[\"question_text\"].apply(tokenize)\n",
    "corpus[\"n_tokens\"] = corpus[\"tokens\"].apply(len)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Global token frequency across all rows\n",
    "global_counter = Counter()\n",
    "for tokens in corpus[\"tokens\"]:\n",
    "    global_counter.update(set(tokens))  # document frequency, not term frequency\n",
    "\n",
    "raw = pd.DataFrame(\n",
    "    global_counter.most_common(),\n",
    "    columns=[\"token\", \"document_frequency\"],\n",
    ")\n",
    "raw[\"corpus_size\"] = len(corpus)\n",
    "raw[\"df_ratio\"] = (raw[\"document_frequency\"] / len(corpus)).round(4)\n",
    "\n",
    "out_raw = TAX_DIR / \"lexicon_raw_corpus.csv\"\n",
    "raw.to_csv(out_raw, index=False)\n",
    "print(f\"Unique tokens: {len(raw)}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Saved: {out_raw}\")\n",
    "print()\n",
    "print(\"Top 60 tokens by document frequency:\")\n",
    "print(raw.head(60).to_string(index=False))"
   ]

    "def seed_tokens_from_name(name: str):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Turn a CAPS subtopic name into seed tokens.\"\"\"\n",
    "    text = name.lower()\n",
    "    text = re.sub(r\"[^a-z\\s]\", \" \", text)\n",
    "    tokens = text.split()\n",
    "    return [\n",
    "        t for t in tokens\n",
    "        if len(t) >= 4\n",
    "        and t not in STOPWORDS\n",
    "        and t not in MATH_NOISE\n",
    "    ]\n",
    "\n",
    "sub[\"seed_tokens\"] = sub[\"subtopic\"].apply(seed_tokens_from_name)\n",

    "# For each subtopic, find tokens that appear most often in rows that contain\n",
    "# at least one seed token. This is the \"data-driven lexicon\" per subtopic.\n",
    "rows = []\n",
    "for _, s in sub.iterrows():\n",
    "    seeds = s[\"seed_tokens\"]\n",
    "    if not seeds:\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Find matching rows: any row whose tokens contain any seed\n",
    "    mask = corpus[\"tokens\"].apply(lambda toks: any(seed in toks for seed in seeds))\n",
    "    matched = corpus[mask]\n",
    "\n",
    "    if len(matched) == 0:\n",
    "        rows.append({\n",
    "            \"topic_id\": s[\"topic_id\"],\n",
    "            \"subtopic\": s[\"subtopic\"],\n",
    "            \"seed_tokens\": \"; \".join(seeds),\n",
    "            \"n_matched_questions\": 0,\n",
    "            \"top_cooccurring_tokens\": \"\",\n",
    "        })\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "\n",
    "    co = Counter()\n",
    "    for toks in matched[\"tokens\"]:\n",
    "        co.update(set(toks) - set(seeds))\n",
    "\n",
    "    top = [f\"{t}:{c}\" for t, c in co.most_common(15)]\n",
    "\n",
    "    rows.append({\n",
    "        \"topic_id\": s[\"topic_id\"],\n",
    "        \"subtopic\": s[\"subtopic\"],\n",
    "        \"seed_tokens\": \"; \".join(seeds),\n",
    "        \"n_matched_questions\": len(matched),\n",
    "        \"top_cooccurring_tokens\": \"; \".join(top),\n",
    "    })\n",
    "\n",
    "lex_by_sub = pd.DataFrame(rows)\n",
    "out = TAX_DIR / \"lexicon_by_subtopic.csv\"\n",

    "# Usage rules:\n",
    "#   PRIMARY    — fires on its own, assigns topic\n",
    "#   SECONDARY  — fires only if no PRIMARY matches\n",
    "#   FALLBACK   — fires only if topic already assigned by context (parent question)\n",

    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "sig[\"usage_rule\"] = sig[\"confidence\"].map(usage_map)\n",
    "sig.to_csv(TAX_DIR / \"memo_signatures_v2.csv\", index=False)\n",
    "\n",

   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "CONF_RANK = {\"high\": 3, \"medium\": 2, \"low\": 1}\n",
    "USAGE_RANK = {\"PRIMARY\": 3, \"SECONDARY\": 2, \"FALLBACK\": 1}\n",
    "\n",
    "def pick_best_signature(matches):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    From a list of signature matches, pick the one that should determine\n",
    "    the topic. Priority: PRIMARY > SECONDARY > FALLBACK, then\n",
    "    high > medium > low. Ties broken by signature_id for determinism.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    if not matches:\n",
    "        return None\n",
    "    ranked = sorted(\n",
    "        matches,\n",
    "        key=lambda m: (\n",
    "            USAGE_RANK.get(m[\"usage_rule\"], 0),\n",

    "# Cell 3c — structural rules\n",
    "\n",
    "import re\n",
    "STRUCT = [\n",
    "    (r\"first principles|dy/dx|d/dx|lim\\s*_?\\s*\\{?\\s*h\", \"CALC\", \"high\"),\n",
    "    (r\"prove that|with reasons|cyclic|semicircle\", \"EUCL\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "    (r\"common ratio|sum to infinity|geometric sequence|arithmetic sequence\", \"SEQ\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "    (r\"asymptote|hyperbola\", \"FUNC\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "    (r\"equation of the circle|centre and radius\", \"AGEO\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "    (r\"quadratic number pattern|second difference\", \"SEQ\", \"high\"),\n",
    "    (r\"cubic|turning point|concave\", \"CALC\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "def match_struct(text):\n",
    "    if not isinstance(text, str):\n",
    "        return []\n",
    "    text_lower = text.lower()\n",
    "    hits = []\n",
    "    for pattern, topic_id, conf in STRUCT:\n",
    "        if re.search(pattern, text_lower):\n",
    "            hits.append({\n",
    "                \"topic_id\": topic_id,\n",
    "                \"signature_id\": f\"STRUCT_{topic_id}\",\n",
    "                \"confidence\": conf,\n",
    "                \"usage_rule\": \"PRIMARY\",\n",
    "                \"pattern\": pattern,\n",
    "            })\n",
    "    return hits\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def map_v2_stage1(text, sig_df):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Signatures + structural rules. No lexicon yet.\"\"\"\n",
    "    if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():\n",
    "        return {\"topic_id\": None, \"method\": \"no_text\",\n",
    "                \"confidence\": None, \"signature_id\": None}\n",
    "\n",
    "    sig_hits = match_signatures(text, sig_df)\n",
    "    struct_hits = match_struct(text)\n",
    "    all_hits = sig_hits + struct_hits\n",
    "\n",
    "    best = pick_best_signature(all_hits)\n",
    "    if best:\n",
    "        return {\n",
    "            \"topic_id\": best[\"topic_id\"],\n",
    "            \"method\": \"signature\" if best[\"signature_id\"].startswith((\"STRUCT\",)) is False else \"struct\",\n",
    "            \"confidence\": best[\"confidence\"],\n",
    "            \"signature_id\": best[\"signature_id\"],\n",
    "        }\n",
    "    return {\"topic_id\": None, \"method\": \"unmapped\",\n",
    "            \"confidence\": None, \"signature_id\": None}\n",
    "    "
   ]

    "# Lexicon: parse top_cooccurring_tokens + load manual aliases if they exist\n",
    "import re\n",
    "from collections import Counter\n",
    "\n",
    "def parse_lexicon_row(s):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Parse 'token1:5; token2:3; ...' into [(token, weight), ...]\"\"\"\n",
    "    if pd.isna(s) or not s:\n",
    "        return []\n",
    "    parts = str(s).split(\";\")\n",
    "    out = []\n",
    "    for p in parts:\n",
    "        p = p.strip()\n",
    "        if \":\" in p:\n",
    "            tok, cnt = p.rsplit(\":\", 1)\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                out.append((tok.strip().lower(), int(cnt)))\n",
    "            except ValueError:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "    return out\n",
    "\n",
    "lex = pd.read_csv(TAX_DIR / \"lexicon_by_subtopic.csv\")\n",
    "lex[\"cooccur_list\"] = lex[\"top_cooccurring_tokens\"].apply(parse_lexicon_row)\n",
    "lex[\"seed_list\"] = lex[\"seed_tokens\"].apply(\n",
    "    lambda s: [t.strip().lower() for t in str(s).split(\";\") if t.strip()]\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Build token → topic weights\n",
    "token_to_topics = {}\n",
    "for _, row in lex.iterrows():\n",
    "    for tok, cnt in row[\"cooccur_list\"] + [(t, 5) for t in row[\"seed_list\"]]:\n",
    "        token_to_topics.setdefault(tok, []).append({\n",
    "            \"topic_id\": row[\"topic_id\"],\n",
    "            \"subtopic\": row[\"subtopic\"],\n",
    "            \"weight\": cnt,\n",
    "        })\n",
    "\n",

    "def map_v2_full(text, paper, sig_df, token_map):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Full cascade:\n",
    "      1. Signature + structural match (PRIMARY/SECONDARY)\n",
    "      2. Lexicon match (weighted)\n",
    "      3. Paper prior check\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():\n",
    "        return {\"topic_id\": None, \"method\": \"no_text\",\n",
    "                \"confidence\": None, \"signature_id\": None}\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Stage 1 — signatures + struct\n",
    "    sig_hits = match_signatures(text, sig_df, usage_filter={\"PRIMARY\", \"SECONDARY\"})\n",
    "    struct_hits = match_struct(text)\n",
    "    best = pick_best_signature(sig_hits + struct_hits)\n",
    "    if best:\n",
    "        topic_id = best[\"topic_id\"]\n",
    "        conf = best[\"confidence\"]\n",
    "        # Paper prior check\n",
    "        if paper == \"P1\" and topic_id in P2_OK and conf == \"low\":\n",
    "            topic_id, conf = None, None\n",
    "        elif paper == \"P2\" and topic_id in P1_OK and conf == \"low\":\n",
    "            topic_id, conf = None, None\n",
    "        if topic_id:\n",
    "            return {\"topic_id\": topic_id,\n",
    "                    \"method\": \"signature\" if not best[\"signature_id\"].startswith(\"STRUCT_\") else \"struct\",\n",
    "                    \"confidence\": conf,\n",
    "                    \"signature_id\": best[\"signature_id\"]}\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Stage 2 — lexicon\n",
    "    if token_map:\n",
    "        votes = match_lexicon(text, token_map)\n",
    "        if votes:\n",
    "            top_topic, weight = votes[0]\n",
    "            if paper == \"P1\" and top_topic in P2_OK:\n",
    "                top_topic = None\n",
    "            elif paper == \"P2\" and top_topic in P1_OK:\n",
    "                top_topic = None\n",
    "            if top_topic:\n",
    "                return {\"topic_id\": top_topic,\n",
    "                        \"method\": \"lexicon\",\n",
    "                        \"confidence\": \"medium\" if weight >= 5 else \"low\",\n",
    "                        \"signature_id\": None}\n",
    "\n",
    "    return {\"topic_id\": None, \"method\": \"unmapped\",\n",
    "            \"confidence\": None, \"signature_id\": None}\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# --- lexicon matcher (from plan Cell 12, adapted) ---\n",
    "def match_lexicon(text, token_map, min_weight=3):\n",
    "    if not isinstance(text, str):\n",
    "        return []\n",
    "    text_lower = re.sub(r\"[^a-z\\s]\", \" \", text.lower())\n",
    "    tokens = set(text_lower.split())\n",
    "    votes = Counter()\n",
    "    for tok in tokens:\n",
    "        for entry in token_map.get(tok, []):\n",
    "            if entry[\"weight\"] >= min_weight:\n",
    "                votes[entry[\"topic_id\"]] += entry[\"weight\"]\n",
    "    return votes.most_common()\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# --- Re-run 2025 P1 ---\n",
    "results = []\n",
    "for _, row in p1.iterrows():\n",
    "    r = map_v2_full(row[\"question_text\"], row[\"paper\"], sig_final, token_to_topics)\n",
    "    results.append({\n",
    "        \"subquestion\": row[\"subquestion\"],\n",
    "        \"topic_v2\": r[\"topic_id\"],\n",
    "        \"method\": r[\"method\"],\n",
    "        \"confidence\": r[\"confidence\"],\n",
    "        \"signature_id\": r[\"signature_id\"],\n",
    "    })\n",
    "\n",
    "res = pd.DataFrame(results)\n",
    "print(res.to_string(index=False))\n",
    "print()\n",
    "mapped = res[\"topic_v2\"].notna().sum()\n",
    "print(f\"Mapped: {mapped}/{len(res)} = {mapped/len(res):.1%}\")"
   ]

    "def match_lexicon(text, token_map, min_weight=3, blacklist=None):\n",
    "    if blacklist is None:\n",

    "# Restrict CALC: only fire if there is no SEQ-specific content\n",

    "def match_lexicon_clean(text, token_map, min_lift=2.5, top_n=2):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Vote using lift weights. Only fire if the top topic beats the runner-up\n",
    "    by a clear margin — prevents ties.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    if not isinstance(text, str):\n",
    "        return []\n",
    "    text_lower = re.sub(r\"[^a-z\\s]\", \" \", text.lower())\n",
    "    tokens = set(text_lower.split())\n",
    "    votes = Counter()\n",
    "    for tok in tokens:\n",
    "        for entry in token_map.get(tok, []):\n",
    "            if entry[\"weight\"] >= min_lift:\n",
    "                votes[entry[\"topic_id\"]] += entry[\"weight\"]\n",
    "    ranked = votes.most_common(top_n)\n",
    "    if not ranked:\n",
    "        return []\n",
    "    # require clear winner\n",
    "    if len(ranked) > 1 and ranked[0][1] < 1.5 * ranked[1][1]:\n",
    "        return []\n",
    "    return ranked"
   ]
  },

    "def map_v2_final(text, paper, sig_df, token_map):\n",
    "    if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():\n",
    "        return {\"topic_id\": None, \"method\": \"no_text\",\n",
    "                \"confidence\": None, \"signature_id\": None}\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Stage 1 — signature + struct\n",
    "    sig_hits = match_signatures(text, sig_df, usage_filter={\"PRIMARY\", \"SECONDARY\"})\n",
    "    struct_hits = match_struct(text)\n",
    "    best = pick_best_signature(sig_hits + struct_hits)\n",
    "    if best:\n",
    "        topic_id, conf = best[\"topic_id\"], best[\"confidence\"]\n",
    "        if paper == \"P1\" and topic_id in P2_OK and conf == \"low\":\n",
    "            topic_id, conf = None, None\n",
    "        elif paper == \"P2\" and topic_id in P1_OK and conf == \"low\":\n",
    "            topic_id, conf = None, None\n",
    "        if topic_id:\n",
    "            return {\"topic_id\": topic_id,\n",
    "                    \"method\": \"struct\" if best[\"signature_id\"].startswith(\"STRUCT_\") else \"signature\",\n",
    "                    \"confidence\": conf,\n",
    "                    \"signature_id\": best[\"signature_id\"]}\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Stage 2 — clean lexicon\n",
    "    votes = match_lexicon_clean(text, token_map)\n",
    "    if votes:\n",
    "        top_topic, weight = votes[0]\n",
    "        if paper == \"P1\" and top_topic in P2_OK:\n",
    "            return {\"topic_id\": None, \"method\": \"unmapped\",\n",
    "                    \"confidence\": None, \"signature_id\": None}\n",
    "        if paper == \"P2\" and top_topic in P1_OK:\n",
    "            return {\"topic_id\": None, \"method\": \"unmapped\",\n",
    "                    \"confidence\": None, \"signature_id\": None}\n",
    "        return {\"topic_id\": top_topic, \"method\": \"lexicon\",\n",
    "                \"confidence\": \"medium\",\n",
    "                \"signature_id\": None}\n",
    "\n",
    "    return {\"topic_id\": None, \"method\": \"unmapped\",\n",
    "            \"confidence\": None, \"signature_id\": None}\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "results = []\n",
    "for _, row in p1.iterrows():\n",
    "    r = map_v2_final(row[\"question_text\"], row[\"paper\"], sig_final, token_to_topics)\n",
    "    results.append({\n",
    "        \"subquestion\": row[\"subquestion\"],\n",
    "        \"topic_v2\": r[\"topic_id\"],\n",
    "        \"method\": r[\"method\"],\n",
    "        \"confidence\": r[\"confidence\"],\n",
    "        \"signature_id\": r[\"signature_id\"],\n",
    "    })\n",
    "\n",
    "res = pd.DataFrame(results)\n",
    "print(res.to_string(index=False))\n",

    "patches3[\"usage_rule\"] = \"PRIMARY\"\n",
    "sig_final = pd.concat([sig_final, patches3], ignore_index=True)\n",
    "sig_final = sig_final.drop_duplicates(subset=[\"signature_id\"], keep=\"first\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Signatures after SEQ patch: {len(sig_final)}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Re-run gold F1\n",
    "def norm_key(q, s):\n",
    "    q = str(q).replace(\".0\", \"\").strip()\n",
    "    s = str(s).replace(\".0\", \"\").strip()\n",
    "    return f\"{q}|{s}\"\n",
    "\n",
    "gold[\"_key\"] = gold.apply(lambda r: norm_key(r[\"question_number\"], r[\"subquestion\"]), axis=1)\n",
    "p1[\"_key\"] = p1.apply(lambda r: norm_key(r[\"question_number\"], r[\"subquestion\"]), axis=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "gold_for_join = gold.drop(columns=[\"question_text\"], errors=\"ignore\")\n",
    "joined = gold_for_join.merge(p1[[\"_key\", \"question_text\"]], on=\"_key\", how=\"left\")\n",
    "\n",
    "gm = []\n",
    "for _, row in joined.iterrows():\n",
    "    text = row.get(\"question_text\")\n",
    "    if pd.notna(text) and isinstance(text, str) and text.strip():\n",
    "        pred = map_v2_final(text, \"P1\", sig_final, token_to_topics)\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        pred = {\"topic_id\": None, \"method\": \"no_text\"}\n",
    "    gm.append({\n",
    "        \"_key\": row[\"_key\"],\n",
    "        \"topic_gold\": norm_label(row[\"topic_gold\"]),\n",
    "        \"topic_gold_v2\": v1_to_v2.get(norm_label(row[\"topic_gold\"])),\n",
    "        \"topic_v2\": pred[\"topic_id\"],\n",
    "        \"method\": pred[\"method\"],\n",
    "    })\n",
    "\n",
    "gm = pd.DataFrame(gm)\n",
    "valid = gm.dropna(subset=[\"topic_gold_v2\", \"topic_v2\"]).copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "acc = accuracy_score(valid[\"topic_gold_v2\"], valid[\"topic_v2\"])\n",
    "f1 = f1_score(valid[\"topic_gold_v2\"], valid[\"topic_v2\"], average=\"macro\", zero_division=0)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Comparable: {len(valid)}/{len(gm)}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Accuracy:   {acc:.3f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Macro-F1:   {f1:.3f}\")\n",
    "print()\n",
    "\n",
    "bad = valid[valid[\"topic_gold_v2\"] != valid[\"topic_v2\"]]\n",
    "if len(bad):\n",
    "    print(f\"Remaining mismatches ({len(bad)}):\")\n",
    "    print(bad.to_string(index=False))\n",
    "else:\n",
    "    print(\"Zero mismatches — perfect on this sample.\")"
   ]

    "# Rebuild STRUCT list from scratch so the notebook is self-contained\n",
    "import re\n",
    "\n",
    "STRUCT = [\n",
    "    (r\"first principles|dy/dx|d/dx|lim\\s*_?\\s*\\{?\\s*h\", \"CALC\", \"high\"),\n",
    "    (r\"prove that|with reasons|cyclic|semicircle\", \"EUCL\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "    (r\"common ratio|sum to infinity|geometric sequence|arithmetic sequence\", \"SEQ\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "    (r\"asymptote|hyperbola\", \"FUNC\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "    (r\"equation of the circle|centre and radius\", \"AGEO\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "    (r\"quadratic number pattern|second difference\", \"SEQ\", \"high\"),\n",
    "    (r\"cubic|turning point|concave\", \"CALC\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "    (r\"backdrop|puppet|stage|triangular sides\", \"TRIG\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "    (r\"sum_\\{|\\\\sum|sigma|lower limit\", \"SEQ\", \"high\"),\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "def match_struct(text):\n",
    "    if not isinstance(text, str):\n",
    "        return []\n",
    "    text_lower = text.lower()\n",
    "    SEQ_EXCLUSION = re.compile(r\"depth|second time|number pattern|first \\d+ seconds|between T\")\n",
    "    is_seq = bool(SEQ_EXCLUSION.search(text))\n",
    "    hits = []\n",
    "    for pattern, topic_id, conf in STRUCT:\n",
    "        if re.search(pattern, text_lower):\n",
    "            if topic_id == \"CALC\" and is_seq:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            hits.append({\n",
    "                \"topic_id\": topic_id,\n",
    "                \"signature_id\": f\"STRUCT_{topic_id}\",\n",
    "                \"confidence\": conf,\n",
    "                \"usage_rule\": \"PRIMARY\",\n",
    "                \"pattern\": pattern,\n",
    "            })\n",
    "    return hits\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"STRUCT rules: {len(STRUCT)}\")"
   ]

    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "\n",
    "ROOT = Path(r\"C:\\Users\\Administrator\\Desktop\\Matric-Maths-Exam-Intelligence\")\n",
    "SEG_DIR = ROOT / \"data\" / \"interim\" / \"segmented\"\n",
    "MAP_DIR = ROOT / \"data\" / \"processed\" / \"mapped\"\n",
    "\n",
    "PATH_A_YEARS = [2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020]\n",
    "MAPPED_YEARS = [2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025]\n",
    "\n",
    "ALL_YEARS = PATH_A_YEARS + MAPPED_YEARS\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def load_year(year):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Load a year's segmented or mapped file. Returns (df, source_tag).\"\"\"\n",
    "    path_a = SEG_DIR / str(year) / f\"exam_questions_{year}.csv\"\n",
    "    if path_a.exists():\n",
    "        return pd.read_csv(path_a), \"path_a\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    mapped_path = MAP_DIR / str(year) / f\"question_topic_map_{year}.csv\"\n",
    "    if mapped_path.exists():\n",
    "        return pd.read_csv(mapped_path), \"mapped_v1\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    return None, None\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def map_year(year):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Map every row of one year. Returns a DataFrame with v2 columns.\"\"\"\n",
    "    df, source = load_year(year)\n",
    "    if df is None:\n",
    "        print(f\"{year}: no source file — skip\")\n",
    "        return None\n",
    "\n",
    "    rows = []\n",
    "    for _, row in df.iterrows():\n",
    "        paper = row.get(\"paper\", \"P1\")\n",
    "        text = row.get(\"question_text\")\n",
    "        if pd.notna(text) and isinstance(text, str) and text.strip():\n",
    "            pred = map_v2_final(text, paper, sig_final, token_to_topics)\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            pred = {\"topic_id\": None, \"method\": \"no_text\",\n",
    "                    \"confidence\": None, \"signature_id\": None}\n",
    "\n",
    "        new_row = row.to_dict()\n",
    "        new_row[\"topic_v2\"] = pred[\"topic_id\"]\n",
    "        new_row[\"subtopic_v2\"] = None\n",
    "        new_row[\"mapping_method_v2\"] = pred[\"method\"]\n",
    "        new_row[\"mapping_confidence_v2\"] = pred[\"confidence\"]\n",
    "        new_row[\"signature_id_v2\"] = pred[\"signature_id\"]\n",
    "        new_row[\"_source\"] = source\n",
    "        rows.append(new_row)\n",
    "\n",
    "    return pd.DataFrame(rows)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Bulk mapping engine ready. Years queued: {ALL_YEARS}\")"
   ]

    "# Add to STRUCT — regex patterns that catch OCR-mangled exponents\n",
    "import re\n",
    "\n",
    "OCR_MATH_STRUCT = [\n",
    "    # Any equation with x? or x* or x^2 followed by + or - and a number → ALG\n",
    "    (r\"x[\\?\\*]\\s*[+\\-]\", \"ALG\", \"high\"),\n",
    "    (r\"x\\s*\\^\\s*2\", \"ALG\", \"high\"),\n",
    "    (r\"\\d+x[\\?\\*]\", \"ALG\", \"high\"),\n",
    "    # Inequality markers\n",
    "    (r\"<\\s*0\\b|>\\s*0\\b|≤|≥\", \"ALG\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "    # Simultaneous solve\n",
    "    (r\"solve.*simultaneous|simultaneous.*solve\", \"ALG\", \"high\"),\n",
    "    # Show that\n",
    "    (r\"show that\\s+a\\s*=|show that\\s+[a-z]\\s*=\", \"ALG\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "    # Value of k/p\n",
    "    (r\"write down the value of|determine the value of\", \"ALG\", \"low\"),\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "# Merge into STRUCT\n",
    "for pat, tid, conf in OCR_MATH_STRUCT:\n",
    "    STRUCT.append((pat, tid, conf))\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"STRUCT now has {len(STRUCT)} rules\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Rebuild match_struct (so it picks up the new rules)\n",
    "def match_struct(text):\n",
    "    if not isinstance(text, str):\n",
    "        return []\n",
    "    text_lower = text.lower()\n",
    "    SEQ_EXCLUSION = re.compile(r\"depth|second time|number pattern|first \\d+ seconds|between T\")\n",
    "    is_seq = bool(SEQ_EXCLUSION.search(text))\n",
    "    hits = []\n",
    "    for pattern, topic_id, conf in STRUCT:\n",
    "        if re.search(pattern, text_lower):\n",
    "            if topic_id == \"CALC\" and is_seq:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            hits.append({\n",
    "                \"topic_id\": topic_id,\n",
    "                \"signature_id\": f\"STRUCT_{topic_id}\",\n",
    "                \"confidence\": conf,\n",
    "                \"usage_rule\": \"PRIMARY\",\n",
    "                \"pattern\": pattern,\n",
    "            })\n",
    "    return hits"
   ]

    "# Roll back: re-map every year WITHOUT inheritance\n",
    "\n",
    "import time\n",
    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "\n",
    "ROOT = Path(r\"C:\\Users\\Administrator\\Desktop\\Matric-Maths-Exam-Intelligence\")\n",
    "MAP_DIR = ROOT / \"data\" / \"processed\" / \"mapped\"\n",
    "\n",
    "ALL_YEARS = [2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020,\n",
    "             2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025]\n",
    "\n",
    "for year in ALL_YEARS:\n",
    "    t0 = time.time()\n",
    "    p = MAP_DIR / str(year) / f\"question_topic_map_{year}_v2.csv\"\n",
    "    if not p.exists():\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "    df = pd.read_csv(p)\n",
    "\n",
    "    rows = []\n",
    "    for _, row in df.iterrows():\n",
    "        text = row.get(\"question_text\")\n",
    "        paper = row.get(\"paper\", \"P1\")\n",
    "        if pd.notna(text) and isinstance(text, str) and text.strip():\n",
    "            pred = map_v2_final(text, paper, sig_final, token_to_topics)\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            pred = {\"topic_id\": None, \"method\": \"no_text\",\n",
    "                    \"confidence\": None, \"signature_id\": None}\n",
    "        new_row = row.to_dict()\n",
    "        new_row[\"topic_v2\"] = pred[\"topic_id\"]\n",
    "        new_row[\"mapping_method_v2\"] = pred[\"method\"]\n",
    "        new_row[\"mapping_confidence_v2\"] = pred[\"confidence\"]\n",
    "        new_row[\"signature_id_v2\"] = pred[\"signature_id\"]\n",
    "        new_row[\"inherited_v2\"] = False\n",
    "        rows.append(new_row)\n",
    "\n",
    "    df_out = pd.DataFrame(rows)\n",
    "    df_out.to_csv(p, index=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "    p1 = df_out[df_out[\"paper\"] == \"P1\"]\n",
    "    p2 = df_out[df_out[\"paper\"] == \"P2\"]\n",
    "    p1_cov = p1[\"topic_v2\"].notna().sum() / len(p1) if len(p1) else 0\n",
    "    p2_cov = p2[\"topic_v2\"].notna().sum() / len(p2) if len(p2) else 0\n",
    "    print(f\"{year}: P1={p1_cov:.1%}  P2={p2_cov:.1%}  ({time.time()-t0:.1f}s)\")"
   ]

      "match_struct rebuilt with ALG/CALC exclusions\n"

   ],
   "source": [
    "import re\n",
    "\n",
    "# Global exclusion patterns\n",
    "SEQ_EXCLUSION = re.compile(r\"depth|second time|number pattern|first \\d+ seconds|between T\")\n",
    "CALC_EXCLUSION = re.compile(r\"dy/dx|d/dx|derivative|differentiat|f'|first principles|maximum height|minimum value|tangent|concave|inflection\")\n",
    "\n",
    "def match_struct(text):\n",
    "    if not isinstance(text, str):\n",
    "        return []\n",
    "    text_lower = text.lower()\n",
    "    is_seq = bool(SEQ_EXCLUSION.search(text))\n",
    "    is_calc = bool(CALC_EXCLUSION.search(text))\n",
    "    hits = []\n",
    "    for pattern, topic_id, conf in STRUCT:\n",
    "        if re.search(pattern, text_lower):\n",
    "            # CALC rules blocked when sequence-specific words present\n",
    "            if topic_id == \"CALC\" and is_seq:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            # ALG OCR rules blocked when calculus words present\n",
    "            # (8.2.1 regression: \"4x?\" inside a derivative matched ALG)\n",
    "            if topic_id == \"ALG\" and is_calc:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            hits.append({\n",
    "                \"topic_id\": topic_id,\n",
    "                \"signature_id\": f\"STRUCT_{topic_id}\",\n",
    "                \"confidence\": conf,\n",
    "                \"usage_rule\": \"PRIMARY\",\n",
    "                \"pattern\": pattern,\n",
    "            })\n",
    "    return hits\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"match_struct rebuilt with ALG/CALC exclusions\")"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "def get_parent_stem(subq, group):\n",
    "    parts = str(subq).split(\".\")\n",
    "    if len(parts) < 2:\n",
    "        return None\n",
    "    for cut in range(len(parts) - 1, 0, -1):\n",
    "        parent_label = \".\".join(parts[:cut])\n",
    "        match = group[group[\"subquestion\"].astype(str) == parent_label]\n",
    "        if len(match) > 0:\n",
    "            text = match.iloc[0].get(\"question_text\")\n",
    "            if pd.notna(text) and len(str(text).strip()) > 40:\n",
    "                return str(text).strip()\n",
    "    return None\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def map_with_corrected_inheritance(row, group):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Direct first. Parent only if direct fails.\n",
    "    Never concatenate parent + child.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    text = row.get(\"question_text\")\n",
    "    paper = row.get(\"paper\", \"P1\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 1. Direct\n",
    "    if pd.notna(text) and isinstance(text, str) and text.strip():\n",
    "        pred = map_v2_final(text, paper, sig_final, token_to_topics)\n",
    "        if pred[\"topic_id\"] is not None:\n",
    "            pred[\"inherited\"] = False\n",
    "            return pred\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 2. Parent (only if direct failed)\n",
    "    text_len = len(str(text).strip()) if pd.notna(text) else 0\n",
    "    if text_len < 60:  # only for thin children\n",
    "        parent_text = get_parent_stem(row[\"subquestion\"], group)\n",
    "        if parent_text:\n",
    "            pred = map_v2_final(parent_text, paper, sig_final, token_to_topics)\n",
    "            if pred[\"topic_id\"] is not None:\n",
    "                pred[\"inherited\"] = True\n",
    "                pred[\"inherited_from\"] = \"parent_stem\"\n",
    "                return pred\n",
    "\n",
    "    return {\"topic_id\": None, \"method\": \"unmapped\",\n",
    "            \"confidence\": None, \"signature_id\": None, \"inherited\": False}\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Corrected inheritance defined\")"
   ]

    "    text_lower = text.lower()\n",
    "    is_seq = bool(SEQ_EXCLUSION.search(text))\n",
    "    is_calc = bool(CALC_EXCLUSION.search(text))\n",
    "    hits = []\n",
    "    for pattern, topic_id, conf in STRUCT:\n",
    "        if re.search(pattern, text_lower):\n",
    "            if topic_id == \"CALC\" and is_seq:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            if topic_id == \"ALG\" and is_calc:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            hits.append({\n",
    "                \"topic_id\": topic_id,\n",
    "                \"signature_id\": f\"STRUCT_{topic_id}\",\n",
    "                \"confidence\": conf,\n",
    "                \"usage_rule\": \"PRIMARY\",\n",
    "                \"pattern\": pattern,\n",
    "            })\n",
    "    return hits\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"match_struct rebuilt with broader CALC_EXCLUSION\")"
   ]
  },

      "match_struct rebuilt with extended STRUCT\n"
     ]

   ],
   "source": [
    "import re\n",
    "\n",
    "def match_struct(text):\n",
    "    if not isinstance(text, str):\n",
    "        return []\n",
    "    text_lower = text.lower()\n",
    "    SEQ_EXCLUSION = re.compile(r\"depth|second time|number pattern|first \\d+ seconds|between T\")\n",
    "    CALC_EXCLUSION = re.compile(\n",
    "        r\"dy/dx|d/dx|derivative|differentiat|first principles\"\n",
    "        r\"|maximum height|minimum value|tangent|concave|inflection\"\n",
    "        r\"|f\\s*'|g\\s*'|h\\s*'|y\\s*'\"\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    is_seq = bool(SEQ_EXCLUSION.search(text))\n",
    "    is_calc = bool(CALC_EXCLUSION.search(text))\n",
    "    hits = []\n",
    "    for pattern, topic_id, conf in STRUCT:\n",
    "        if re.search(pattern, text_lower):\n",
    "            if topic_id == \"CALC\" and is_seq:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            if topic_id == \"ALG\" and is_calc:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            hits.append({\n",
    "                \"topic_id\": topic_id,\n",
    "                \"signature_id\": f\"STRUCT_{topic_id}\",\n",
    "                \"confidence\": conf,\n",
    "                \"usage_rule\": \"PRIMARY\",\n",
    "                \"pattern\": pattern,\n",
    "            })\n",
    "    return hits\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"match_struct rebuilt with extended STRUCT\")"
   ]

   "source": [
    "def pick_best_signature(matches):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Priority order:\n",
    "      1. STRUCT rules always beat signature rules (they are the strongest signal)\n",
    "      2. PRIMARY > SECONDARY > FALLBACK\n",
    "      3. high > medium > low confidence\n",
    "      4. signature_id (deterministic tie-break)\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    if not matches:\n",
    "        return None\n",
    "\n",
    "    def rank_key(m):\n",
    "        is_struct = 1 if str(m[\"signature_id\"]).startswith(\"STRUCT_\") else 0\n",
    "        return (\n",
    "            is_struct,                                       # STRUCT first\n",
    "            USAGE_RANK.get(m[\"usage_rule\"], 0),\n",
    "            CONF_RANK.get(m[\"confidence\"], 0),\n",
    "            str(m[\"signature_id\"]),\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "    ranked = sorted(matches, key=rank_key, reverse=True)\n",
    "    return ranked[0]\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"pick_best_signature rebuilt — STRUCT rules now always win\")"
   ]

    "gold = pd.read_csv(ROOT / \"data\" / \"processed\" / \"gold_sets\" / \"gold_2025_p1_labelled.csv\")\n",
    "def norm_key(q, s):\n",
    "    return f\"{str(q).replace('.0','').strip()}|{str(s).replace('.0','').strip()}\"\n",
    "gold[\"_key\"] = gold.apply(lambda r: norm_key(r[\"question_number\"], r[\"subquestion\"]), axis=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "p2025 = pd.read_csv(MAP_DIR / \"2025\" / \"question_topic_map_2025_v2.csv\")\n",
    "p1 = p2025[p2025[\"paper\"] == \"P1\"].copy()\n",
    "p1[\"_key\"] = p1.apply(lambda r: norm_key(r[\"question_number\"], r[\"subquestion\"]), axis=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "v1_v2_df = pd.read_csv(ROOT / \"data\" / \"processed\" / \"taxonomy\" / \"v1_to_v2_topic_map.csv\")\n",
    "def norm_label(s): return str(s).replace(\"\\xa0\", \" \").strip()\n",
    "v1_to_v2 = {norm_label(k): str(v).strip() for k, v in\n",
    "            zip(v1_v2_df[\"v1_label\"], v1_v2_df[\"v2_topic_id\"])}\n",
    "gold[\"topic_gold_v2\"] = gold[\"topic_gold\"].apply(lambda x: v1_to_v2.get(norm_label(x)))\n",
    "\n",

    "valid = joined.dropna(subset=[\"topic_gold_v2\", \"topic_v2\"])\n",
    "acc = accuracy_score(valid[\"topic_gold_v2\"], valid[\"topic_v2\"])\n",
    "f1 = f1_score(valid[\"topic_gold_v2\"], valid[\"topic_v2\"], average=\"macro\", zero_division=0)\n",
    "print(f\"Gold F1 after STRUCT-ranking fix: {f1:.3f}\")\n",

    "    )\n",
    "    return ranked[0]\n",

     "name": "stdout",

     "text": [
      "Post-processor defined\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import re\n",
    "\n",
    "# Two hard overrides based on manual paper verification.\n",
    "# These do not fight the ranking — they correct it after the fact.\n",
    "AGEO_OVERRIDE = re.compile(\n",
    "    r\"parallelogram|vertices of.*triangle|diagonals of|coordinates of\\s*t\\b\",\n",
    "    re.IGNORECASE,\n",
    ")\n",
    "CALC_OVERRIDE = re.compile(\n",
    "    r\"s'\\s*\\(\\s*t\\s*\\)|speed.*km|rate of change\",\n",
    "    re.IGNORECASE,\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "def post_process_prediction(pred, text, paper):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Targeted overrides after the signature/struct/lexicon cascade.\n",
    "    Only fires when the pattern is unambiguous.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    if pred[\"topic_id\"] is None or not isinstance(text, str):\n",
    "        return pred\n",
    "\n",
    "    # P2 Q3 (AGEO): parallelogram / vertices of / diagonals / coordinates of T\n",
    "    # FUNC and AGEO both fire on these — force AGEO on P2.\n",
    "    if paper == \"P2\" and AGEO_OVERRIDE.search(text):\n",
    "        if pred[\"topic_id\"] == \"FUNC\":\n",
    "            return {\n",
    "                \"topic_id\": \"AGEO\",\n",
    "                \"method\": \"struct\",\n",
    "                \"confidence\": \"high\",\n",
    "                \"signature_id\": \"POSTPROC_AGEO\",\n",
    "            }\n",
    "\n",
    "    # CALC: speed/rate of change — sequence lexicon sometimes wins, force CALC\n",
    "    if CALC_OVERRIDE.search(text):\n",
    "        if pred[\"topic_id\"] in (\"SEQ\", \"FUNC\", \"ALG\"):\n",
    "            return {\n",
    "                \"topic_id\": \"CALC\",\n",
    "                \"method\": \"struct\",\n",
    "                \"confidence\": \"high\",\n",
    "                \"signature_id\": \"POSTPROC_CALC\",\n",
    "            }\n",
    "\n",
    "    return pred\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def map_v2_final_v2(text, paper, sig_df, token_map):\n",
    "    \"\"\"map_v2_final with post-processor applied.\"\"\"\n",
    "    pred = map_v2_final(text, paper, sig_df, token_map)\n",
    "    pred = post_process_prediction(pred, text, paper)\n",
    "    return pred\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Post-processor defined\")"
   ]

   "source": [
    "import re\n",
    "\n",
    "# Post-processor 3: derivatives\n",
    "# If text contains a derivative marker, force CALC unless already CALC\n",
    "CALC_DERIV = re.compile(\n",
    "    r\"g\\s*['\\u2019]|f\\s*['\\u2019]|h\\s*['\\u2019]|y\\s*['\\u2019]\"\n",
    "    r\"|dy/dx|d/dx|D_x|first principles|differentiat\",\n",
    "    re.IGNORECASE,\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Post-processor 4: question-majority fallback for very thin rows\n",
    "# If the text is under 30 chars and only says \"Calculate the value of X\",\n",
    "# look at the parent question's dominant topic and use it.\n",
    "THIN_PATTERN = re.compile(\n",
    "    r\"^(calculate|determine|write down|show that)\\s+the\\s+value\\s+of\",\n",
    "    re.IGNORECASE,\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def post_process_prediction_v2(pred, text, paper, question_group=None):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Extended post-processor:\n",
    "      1. AGEO override (parallelogram / vertices) — from previous cell\n",
    "      2. CALC override (speed / rate)\n",
    "      3. CALC override (derivatives) — new\n",
    "      4. Question-majority fallback for thin rows — new\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    if not isinstance(text, str):\n",
    "        return pred\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 1. AGEO — parallelogram/vertices\n",
    "    if paper == \"P2\" and AGEO_OVERRIDE.search(text):\n",
    "        if pred[\"topic_id\"] == \"FUNC\":\n",
    "            return {\"topic_id\": \"AGEO\", \"method\": \"struct\",\n",
    "                    \"confidence\": \"high\", \"signature_id\": \"POSTPROC_AGEO\"}\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 2. CALC — speed/rate\n",
    "    if CALC_OVERRIDE.search(text):\n",
    "        if pred[\"topic_id\"] in (\"SEQ\", \"FUNC\", \"ALG\"):\n",
    "            return {\"topic_id\": \"CALC\", \"method\": \"struct\",\n",
    "                    \"confidence\": \"high\", \"signature_id\": \"POSTPROC_CALC\"}\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 3. CALC — derivatives (NEW)\n",
    "    if CALC_DERIV.search(text):\n",
    "        if pred[\"topic_id\"] in (\"ALG\", \"SEQ\", \"FUNC\", \"PROB\", \"FIN\"):\n",
    "            return {\"topic_id\": \"CALC\", \"method\": \"struct\",\n",
    "                    \"confidence\": \"high\", \"signature_id\": \"POSTPROC_CALC_DERIV\"}\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 4. Question-majority fallback for thin rows (NEW)\n",
    "    if len(text.strip()) < 40 and THIN_PATTERN.search(text.strip()):\n",
    "        if question_group is not None and len(question_group) > 0:\n",
    "            # Majority topic in this question (excluding this row's current prediction)\n",
    "            votes = question_group[\n",
    "                (question_group[\"subquestion\"].astype(str) != str(pred.get(\"_sub\", \"\"))) &\n",
    "                (question_group[\"topic_v2\"].notna())\n",
    "            ][\"topic_v2\"].value_counts()\n",
    "            if len(votes) > 0 and votes.iloc[0] >= 2:\n",
    "                return {\"topic_id\": votes.index[0], \"method\": \"question_majority\",\n",
    "                        \"confidence\": \"medium\", \"signature_id\": \"POSTPROC_MAJORITY\"}\n",
    "\n",
    "    return pred\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Extended post-processor defined\")"
   ]

   ],
   "source": [
    "import re\n",
    "\n",
    "# Rebuild the exclusion patterns — this is the version that produced 0.972\n",
    "SEQ_EXCLUSION = re.compile(\n",
    "    r\"depth|second time|number pattern|first \\d+ seconds|between T\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "CALC_EXCLUSION = re.compile(\n",
    "    r\"dy/dx|d/dx|derivative|differentiat|first principles\"\n",
    "    r\"|maximum height|minimum value|tangent|concave|inflection\"\n",
    "    r\"|f\\s*'|g\\s*'|h\\s*'|y\\s*'\"\n",
    "    r\"|\\bf\\(x\\)|\\bg\\(x\\)|\\bh\\(x\\)\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "def match_struct(text):\n",
    "    if not isinstance(text, str):\n",
    "        return []\n",
    "    text_lower = text.lower()\n",
    "    is_seq = bool(SEQ_EXCLUSION.search(text))\n",
    "    is_calc = bool(CALC_EXCLUSION.search(text))\n",
    "    hits = []\n",
    "    for pattern, topic_id, conf in STRUCT:\n",
    "        if re.search(pattern, text_lower):\n",
    "            if topic_id == \"CALC\" and is_seq:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            if topic_id == \"ALG\" and is_calc:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            hits.append({\n",
    "                \"topic_id\": topic_id,\n",
    "                \"signature_id\": f\"STRUCT_{topic_id}\",\n",
    "                \"confidence\": conf,\n",
    "                \"usage_rule\": \"PRIMARY\",\n",
    "                \"pattern\": pattern,\n",
    "            })\n",
    "    return hits\n",
    "\n",
    "# Diagnostic: verify the rules survive\n",
    "test = \"Determine g'(x) if g(x) = -3x* + 2x\"\n",
    "print(f\"Test text: {test!r}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  is_calc: {bool(CALC_EXCLUSION.search(test))}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  struct hits: {[h['topic_id'] for h in match_struct(test)]}\")"
   ]

    "lex = pd.read_csv(TAX / \"lexicon_by_subtopic.csv\")\n",

    "print(f\"  columns: {list(lex.columns)}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# parse top_cooccurring_tokens and seed_tokens to build token_to_topics\n",
    "def parse_tokens(s):\n",
    "    if pd.isna(s) or not s:\n",
    "        return []\n",
    "    out = []\n",
    "    for p in str(s).split(\";\"):\n",
    "        p = p.strip()\n",
    "        if \":\" in p:\n",
    "            tok, cnt = p.rsplit(\":\", 1)\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                out.append((tok.strip().lower(), int(cnt)))\n",
    "            except ValueError:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "    return out\n",
    "\n",
    "token_to_topics = {}\n",
    "for _, row in lex.iterrows():\n",
    "    for tok, cnt in parse_tokens(row.get(\"top_cooccurring_tokens\", \"\")):\n",
    "        token_to_topics.setdefault(tok, []).append(\n",
    "            {\"topic_id\": row[\"topic_id\"], \"subtopic\": row[\"subtopic\"], \"weight\": cnt}\n",
    "        )\n",
    "    for tok in str(row.get(\"seed_tokens\", \"\")).split(\";\"):\n",
    "        tok = tok.strip().lower()\n",
    "        if tok:\n",
    "            token_to_topics.setdefault(tok, []).append(\n",

CHAPTER 10
MATHEMATICS
The following report should be read in conjunction with the Mathematics question
papers for the NSC November 2023 examinations.
10.1 PERFORMANCE TRENDS (2019–2023)
The number of candidates who wrote the Mathematics examination in 2023 decreased by
7 718 compared to that of 2022.
There was a significant improvement in the pass rate this year. Candidates who passed at the
30% level improved from 55% in 2022 to 63,5% in 2023. There was a corresponding
improvement in the pass rate at the 40% level over the past two years from 36% to 43,6%.
The percentage of distinctions over 80% improved from 2,7% in 2022 to 3,4% in 2023. Given
the decrease in the size of the 2023 cohort, this converts into an increase in the total number
of distinctions from 7 283 to 8 909.
The various commendable intervention strategies employed by teachers, subject advisors and
provincial education departments were continued in 2023. The resourcefulness and diligence
of the above-average candidates also contributed to the overall improvement in the subject.

function refreshStat(){
  const all=document.querySelectorAll('.qq');
  let done=0;
  all.forEach(i=>{
    if(i.value.trim()!==''){
      i.classList.remove('empty');i.classList.add('ok');done++;
    } else {
      i.classList.remove('ok');i.classList.add('empty');
    }
  });
  document.getElementById('stat').textContent=done+' / '+all.length+' labelled';
}
document.addEventListener('input',e=>{if(e.target.classList.contains('qq'))refreshStat();});
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',refreshStat);

function saveJSON(){
  const out=[];
  document.querySelectorAll('.qq').forEach(i=>{
    const v=i.value.trim();
    out.push({
      year: parseInt(i.dataset.year),
      paper: parseInt(i.dataset.paper),
      page: parseInt(i.dataset.page),
      file: i.dataset.file,
      question: v===''?null:parseInt(v)
    });
  });
  const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(out,null,2)],{type:'application/json'});
  const a=document.createElement('a');
  a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  a.download='_assignments.json';
  a.click();
}
</script></body></html>

function refreshStat(){
  const all=document.querySelectorAll('.qq');let done=0;
  all.forEach(i=>{
    if(i.value.trim()!==''){i.classList.remove('empty');i.classList.add('ok');done++;}
    else{i.classList.remove('ok');i.classList.add('empty');}
  });
  document.getElementById('stat').textContent=done+' / '+all.length+' labelled';
}
document.addEventListener('input',e=>{if(e.target.classList.contains('qq'))refreshStat();});
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',refreshStat);
function saveJSON(){
  const out=[];
  document.querySelectorAll('.qq').forEach(i=>{
    const v=i.value.trim();
    out.push({year:+i.dataset.year,paper:+i.dataset.paper,page:+i.dataset.page,
              file:i.dataset.file,question:v===''?null:+v});
  });
  const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(out,null,2)],{type:'application/json'});
  const a=document.createElement('a');
  a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download='_assignments.json';a.click();
}
</script></body></html>

function refreshStat(){
  const all=document.querySelectorAll('.qq');let done=0;
  all.forEach(i=>{
    if(i.value.trim()!==''){i.classList.remove('empty');i.classList.add('ok');done++;}
    else{i.classList.remove('ok');i.classList.add('empty');}
  });
  document.getElementById('stat').textContent=done+' / '+all.length+' pages labelled';
}
document.addEventListener('input',function(e){
  if(e.target.classList.contains('qq')) refreshStat();
});
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', refreshStat);

function saveJSON(){
  const out=[];
  document.querySelectorAll('.qq').forEach(function(i){
    const v=i.value.trim();
    if(v==='') return;
    out.push({
      year:+i.dataset.year,paper:+i.dataset.paper,page:+i.dataset.page,
      file:i.dataset.file,
      questions: v.split(',').map(function(s){return parseInt(s.trim());}).filter(function(n){return !isNaN(n);})
    });
  });
  const txt = JSON.stringify(out,null,2);
  // show in an overlay textarea
  const ov = document.createElement('div');
  ov.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.9);z-index:999;padding:30px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px';
  const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
  ta.style.cssText = 'flex:1;width:100%;font:12px monospace;padding:10px;border-radius:4px;border:none';
  ta.value = txt;
  const row = document.createElement('div');
  row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center';
  const copy = document.createElement('button');
  copy.textContent = 'Copy to clipboard';
  copy.style.cssText = 'padding:10px 20px;background:#28a745;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:bold';
  copy.onclick = function(){ ta.select(); document.execCommand('copy'); copy.textContent='Copied!'; };
  const dl = document.createElement('button');
  dl.textContent = 'Download anyway';
  dl.style.cssText = 'padding:10px 20px;background:#6c757d;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:bold';
  dl.onclick = function(){
    const blob=new Blob([txt],{type:'application/json'});
    const a=document.createElement('a'); a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download='_page_map.json'; a.click();
  };
  const close = document.createElement('button');
  close.textContent = 'Close';
  close.style.cssText = 'padding:10px 20px;background:#dc3545;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:bold';
  close.onclick = function(){ ov.remove(); };
  row.appendChild(copy); row.appendChild(dl); row.appendChild(close);
  ov.appendChild(ta); ov.appendChild(row);
  document.body.appendChild(ov);
  ta.focus();
}

function zoom(src){
  const m=document.getElementById('modal');
  document.getElementById('modal-img').src=src;
  m.classList.add('on');
}
function unzoom(){
  document.getElementById('modal').classList.remove('on');
}
</script></body></html>
