   "source": [
    "priority = (\n",
    "    exp[[\"topic\", \"exposure_norm\"] + [c for c in [\"subquestion_count\", \"total_marks\", \"exposure_score\"] if c in exp.columns]]\n",
    "    .merge(diff[[\"topic\", \"error_pressure_per_exposure\", \"difficulty_norm\", \"persistence_norm\"]], on=\"topic\", how=\"outer\")\n",
    "    .merge(design[[\"topic\", \"design_norm\", \"design_marks\"]], on=\"topic\", how=\"left\")\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "priority = priority.fillna({\n",
    "    \"exposure_norm\": 0,\n",
    "    \"difficulty_norm\": 0,\n",
    "    \"persistence_norm\": 0,\n",
    "    \"design_norm\": 0.5,\n",
    "    \"error_pressure_per_exposure\": 0,\n",
    "})\n",
    "\n",
    "priority[\"priority_score\"] = (\n",
    "    WEIGHTS[\"exposure\"] * priority[\"exposure_norm\"]\n",
    "    + WEIGHTS[\"difficulty\"] * priority[\"difficulty_norm\"]\n",
    "    + WEIGHTS[\"persistence\"] * priority[\"persistence_norm\"]\n",
    "    + WEIGHTS[\"design_weight\"] * priority[\"design_norm\"]\n",
    ").round(4)\n",
    "\n",
    "def band(score):\n",
    "    if score >= 0.65:\n",
    "        return \"High\"\n",
    "    if score >= 0.40:\n",
    "        return \"Medium\"\n",
    "    return \"Lower\"\n",
    "\n",
    "priority[\"priority_band\"] = priority[\"priority_score\"].apply(band)\n",
    "priority = priority.sort_values(\"priority_score\", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "display(priority[[\n",
    "    \"topic\", \"exposure_norm\", \"difficulty_norm\", \"persistence_norm\",\n",
    "    \"design_norm\", \"priority_score\", \"priority_band\"\n",
    "]])\n",
    "\n",
    "priority.to_csv(OUT / \"priority_scores_v1.csv\", index=False)\n",
    "priority.to_csv(OUT / \"priority_bands_v1.csv\", index=False)\n",
    "print(\"Saved priority tables\")"
   ]

   "source": [
    "base_top5 = priority.head(5)[\"topic\"].tolist()\n",
    "rows = []\n",
    "\n",
    "for dim in WEIGHTS:\n",
    "    for delta in [-0.20, 0.20]:\n",
    "        shifted = WEIGHTS.copy()\n",
    "        shifted[dim] = max(0.0, shifted[dim] + delta)\n",
    "        total = sum(shifted.values())\n",
    "        shifted = {k: v / total for k, v in shifted.items()}\n",
    "\n",
    "        score = (\n",
    "            shifted[\"exposure\"] * priority[\"exposure_norm\"]\n",
    "            + shifted[\"difficulty\"] * priority[\"difficulty_norm\"]\n",
    "            + shifted[\"persistence\"] * priority[\"persistence_norm\"]\n",
    "            + shifted[\"design_weight\"] * priority[\"design_norm\"]\n",
    "        )\n",
    "        top5 = priority.assign(_s=score).nlargest(5, \"_s\")[\"topic\"].tolist()\n",
    "        rows.append({\n",
    "            \"dimension_shifted\": dim,\n",
    "            \"delta\": delta,\n",
    "            \"top5_overlap\": len(set(top5) & set(base_top5)),\n",
    "            \"top5_shifted\": \"; \".join(top5),\n",
    "        })\n",
    "\n",
    "sens = pd.DataFrame(rows)\n",
    "display(sens)\n",
    "sens.to_csv(OUT / \"priority_sensitivity_v1.csv\", index=False)\n",
    "print(\"Min top5 overlap:\", sens[\"top5_overlap\"].min(), \"/5\")"
   ]

    "DESIGN_P1 = {\n",
    "    \"Algebra & Equations\": 25,\n",
    "    \"Number Patterns & Sequences\": 25,\n",
    "    \"Functions & Graphs\": 35,\n",
    "    \"Finance\": 15,\n",
    "    \"Calculus\": 35,\n",
    "    \"Probability\": 15,\n",
    "}\n",
    "DESIGN_P2 = {\n",
    "    \"Statistics\": 20,\n",
    "    \"Analytical Geometry\": 40,\n",
    "    \"Trigonometry\": 50,\n",
    "    \"Euclidean Geometry\": 40,\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "def design_frame(d):\n",
    "    df = pd.DataFrame([{\"topic\": k, \"design_marks\": v} for k, v in d.items()])\n",
    "    mn, mx = df[\"design_marks\"].min(), df[\"design_marks\"].max()\n",
    "    df[\"design_norm\"] = (df[\"design_marks\"] - mn) / (mx - mn) if mx > mn else 0.5\n",
    "    return df\n",
    "\n",
    "design_p1 = design_frame(DESIGN_P1)\n",
    "design_p2 = design_frame(DESIGN_P2)"
   ]
  },

    "def score_paper(topic_list, design_df, label):\n",
    "    sub = priority_final[priority_final[\"topic\"].isin(topic_list)].copy()\n",
    "    sub = sub.drop(columns=[\"design_norm\", \"design_marks\"], errors=\"ignore\")\n",
    "    sub = sub.merge(design_df, on=\"topic\", how=\"left\")\n",
    "    sub[\"design_norm\"] = sub[\"design_norm\"].fillna(0.5)\n",
    "\n",
    "    sub[\"priority_score\"] = (\n",
    "        WEIGHTS[\"exposure\"] * sub[\"exposure_norm\"]\n",
    "        + WEIGHTS[\"difficulty\"] * sub[\"difficulty_norm\"]\n",
    "        + WEIGHTS[\"persistence\"] * sub[\"persistence_norm\"]\n",
    "        + WEIGHTS[\"design_weight\"] * sub[\"design_norm\"]\n",
    "    ).round(4)\n",
    "\n",
    "    sub[\"priority_band\"] = sub[\"priority_score\"].apply(band)\n",
    "    sub = sub.sort_values(\"priority_score\", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)\n",
    "    sub[\"paper\"] = label\n",
    "    return sub\n",
    "\n",
    "p1_topics = list(DESIGN_P1.keys())\n",
    "p2_topics = list(DESIGN_P2.keys())\n",
    "\n",
    "priority_p1 = score_paper(p1_topics, design_p1, \"P1\")\n",
    "priority_p2 = score_paper(p2_topics, design_p2, \"P2\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"=== PAPER 1 PRIORITY ===\")\n",
    "display(priority_p1[[\"topic\", \"exposure_norm\", \"difficulty_norm\", \"persistence_norm\", \"design_norm\", \"priority_score\", \"priority_band\"]])\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"=== PAPER 2 PRIORITY ===\")\n",
    "display(priority_p2[[\"topic\", \"exposure_norm\", \"difficulty_norm\", \"persistence_norm\", \"design_norm\", \"priority_score\", \"priority_band\"]])\n",
    "\n",
    "priority_p1.to_csv(OUT / \"priority_p1_v1.csv\", index=False)\n",
    "priority_p2.to_csv(OUT / \"priority_p2_v1.csv\", index=False)"

# Tutor Behaviour Specification v1

Generated: 2026-09-12T22:15:35.624263+00:00

## Audience
Young NSC Mathematics learner (Grade 10–12 range). No fixed age assumption.

## Core claim
Evidence-driven tutoring: DBE diagnostic errors → N06 → N07 → N08 → tutor action.

## Hard rules
{
  "R1_never_solution_first": true,
  "R2_diagnose_before_intervene": true,
  "R3_one_intervention_target": true,
  "R4_prefer_learner_reasoning": true,
  "R5_escalate_hints_gradually": true,
  "R6_retest_after_intervention": true,
  "R7_evidence_for_mastery": true,
  "R8_transfer_before_mastery": true,
  "R9_repeated_failure_remediate_not_harder": true,
  "R10_n08_trace_min_share": 0.7
}

## Hint policy
{
  "levels": {
    "H0": "Socratic prompt only",
    "H1": "Conceptual pointer",
    "H2": "Strategic operation hint",
    "H3": "One micro-step only",
    "H4": "Stepwise solution with teach-back (never dump)"
  },
  "escalation": {
    "type": "hybrid_attempt_primary",
    "attempt_map": {
      "1": "H0",
      "2": "H1",
      "3": "H2",
      "4": "H3",
      "5": "H4"
    },
    "silence_seconds_offer_hint": 90,
    "explicit_answer_request": "one_more_H2_then_stepwise_H4"
  }
}

## Mastery hierarchy
{
  "session_mastery": {
    "source": "N08",
    "correct_required": 4,
    "items_presented": 5,
    "unseen_only": true,
    "structure_type_match": true,
    "sittings_required_for_skill": 2
  },
  "skill_mastery": {
    "source": "N09",
    "min_sessions_passed": 2,
    "max_hints_on_final_session": 1,
    "no_target_misconception_recurrence": true,
    "require_transfer_item": true
  }
}

## LLM boundary
- LLM may classify free-text errors and render hint text at a rule-assigned level.
- LLM may not choose intervention, hint level, or mastery outcome.

## SA constraints
- Persist state across disconnect (load-shedding / data drop).
- Accept code-switching; respond in dominant language of learner input.
- Never shame; acknowledge frustration; reduce difficulty before continuing.

## Provenance
Every tutor event must log: session_event_id, intervention_id (or generic_fallback),
topic, misconception_id, hint_level, rule_ids_fired.

# MethodMarker Architecture — Governing Specification

*Companion to docs/spirit.md. Judged against it in every session.*

## The architectural consequence

We are not building a smarter question-answering system. We are building a
learning tutor whose knowledge compounds from learner evidence.

The engine is the foundation. The accumulated memory is the product.

## Locked principles

1. **NSC-first remains the current content boundary.** The vision is broad.
   The implementation stays South African NSC Mathematics.

2. **Diagnosis is evidence-based.** Memo -> learner work -> observed marks ->
   diagnosis. The system does not infer a missing step merely because it
   was not typed.

3. **The AI layer is genuinely part of the architecture.** The LLM is the
   mechanism for handling genuinely unexplained cases. It is not the
   defining feature and can be swapped.

4. **Discovery is persistent.** tutor_discoveries is the beginning of the
   tutor's long-term institutional memory. Evidence is preserved.

5. **Learner memory and tutor memory are different.**
   - Learner model: what do I know about Tanaka?
   - Tutor discovery store: what have I learned across learners?
   - Teacher referral layer: what should a human teacher know or act on?

6. **Presentation is not diagnosis.** Architectural boundary.

7. **The teacher remains in the loop.** Discoveries mature through
   recurrence and teacher confirmation. The learner is never blocked.

8. **Never optimise for being a better chatbot.** Every feature is judged
   against the four questions and the weekend test.

## The four questions as design constraints

Every subsystem exists to help MethodMarker answer one or more of:

1. What does this learner actually know? -> Learner model, mastery store
2. Why did this step fail? -> Step grader, diagnosis, discovery store
3. What should happen next? -> Foundational DAG, drill router, intervention log
4. Did that work? -> Outcome measurement, transfer testing, intervention effectiveness

If a subsystem does not contribute to at least one of these, it is not core.

## The Tutor Learning Engine

    OBSERVE     learner attempt captured
       ->
    DIAGNOSE    layers 1, 2, 3 in order
       ->
    INTERVENE   smallest action targeting the identified gap
       ->
    MEASURE     transfer test, days later
       ->
    LEARN       what worked, for whom, at which step (discovery)
       ->
    UPDATE      routing, rules, patterns, teaching strategy

Discovery is inside LEARN. Not the whole engine.

## The persistence contract

The critical property: a discovery exists as a first-class object even if
the LLM is swapped or removed.

    learner attempt
        ->
    Layer 1 diagnosis (deterministic)
        ->
    Layer 2 pattern search (across learners)
        ->
    if unresolved:
        Discovery event created
        ->
    LLM reasoning attached (optional, swappable)
        ->
    learner-facing explanation delivered NOW
        ->
    persistent tutor_discovery written
        ->
    future recurrence strengthens it

## The discovery record

    discovery_id          PRIMARY KEY
    pattern_description   what the tutor noticed
    example_lines         the actual learner lines that triggered it
    first_seen_at         timestamp
    last_seen_at          timestamp
    times_seen            integer, increments on recurrence
    learners_affected     list of learner_ids
    confidence            0.0 to 1.0
    llm_explanation       what the LLM said (revisable)
    promoted_to_rule      boolean
    teacher_notes         text, teacher can annotate
    status                open / confirmed / dismissed / promoted

Evidence is preserved. Two years from now, the tutor has not just
conclusions but the raw learner lines from which it learned them.

## The three stores

- **Learner model** — history, mastery, gaps, interventions. Per learner.
- **Discovery store** — patterns, recurrence, LLM reasoning, teacher feedback. Across learners.
- **Teacher referral layer** — "Here is what I am seeing and why it matters."

## Long-term architecture

    NSC Knowledge
    (memos / diagnostics / fingerprint / skills)
              |
              v
        TUTOR
        (diagnosis / teaching / drilling / reasoning)
              |
        +-----+-----+
        v           v
    Learner      Discovery
    Model        Store
        |           |
        |           v
        |     Pattern / Rule
        |     Promotion
        |           |
        +-----+-----+
              v
        Teacher Referral
        "Here is what I am seeing and why it matters."

## The first engineering step

Not the LLM. Not the generative variants. The persistence contract.

1. Schema: tutor_discoveries table with the fields above.
2. Module: src/tutor/discovery_store.py with:
   - record_discovery(learner_id, pattern_desc, example_lines, llm_explanation=None)
   - find_similar(pattern_desc) — recurrence matching
   - promote(discovery_id) — mark as promoted
   - add_teacher_note(discovery_id, note)
3. Hook: diagnosis.py calls record_discovery when layers 1 and 2 cannot
   explain the error. The LLM call is optional (behind the existing LLM
   gate). The discovery is written either way.

The LLM comes after the storage works and the hook is in place.

## The second engineering step

Once discoveries are stored, add intervention logging:

1. Schema: interventions table — discovery_id, action, applied_at, learner_id
2. Schema: outcomes table — intervention_id, measured_at, transfer_result
3. Wire into drill.py: when the tutor routes a learner to a prerequisite
   drill, log the intervention and the later outcome.

This is what makes "did that teaching actually work?" answerable.

## The test for every feature

Before building anything, ask:

1. Which of the four questions does this help answer?
2. Could another AI tutor add this in a weekend?
3. Does it strengthen the teaching archive, or is it cosmetic?

If it does not help answer a question, could be built in a weekend, or is
cosmetic, it is not core.

## The sentence to keep visible during development

"The product gets better not merely when the code improves, but when the
tutor learns something from a learner that it can use again."

That is the moat.

---

*Tanaka Peace Boanerge. ThunderMark. 2026.*

# MethodMarker Backlog — Deferred Ideas

Ideas that came up in sessions but are not in the current build.
Each has enough detail to resume without re-deriving.

---

## H. Homework-Variant Session Flow

**Idea (from session 27-29 September 2026):**
The tutor should open every session the way a human tutor does.
Not "Welcome to the tutor." A greeting, a preview, and then a gate:
does the learner have school homework to work through?

**The flow, in eight stages:**

1. **Warm greeting.** Greet the learner by name, time-of-day aware.
   *"Good evening, Tanaka."*

2. **Progress preview.** Summarise where the learner is, from the
   mastery store and recent sessions.
   *"Last time we worked on quadratic equations. Factoring is solid;
   the sign handling is where we are still shaky."*

3. **Homework gate.** Ask if the learner has homework.
   *"Do you have homework or an assignment from school you want to work through?"*

4. **Variant, not answer.** If yes, do NOT solve the homework.
   Generate a variant of it — same method, different numbers.
   The learner works the variant; the underlying skill is revealed.

5. **Step grading.** The step grader runs on the variant. Feedback
   names the exact step that broke, not the answer.

6. **PDF printable.** When the working is done, produce a PDF of
   the question, the learner's working, and the correct steps.
   The learner shows it to a teacher or parent.

7. **Recommendation.** A specific "next session, let's do X"
   recommendation is stored and feeds the next session's preview.

8. **Three-way data.**
   - Tutor: discovery store gets an event.
   - Student: mastery model updates.
   - Parent / teacher: referral layer gets an entry on recurrence.

**What exists already:**

- Step grading on variants — `step_grader.py`
- Discovery store — `tutor_discovery` table
- Warm greeting + preview — `session_open.py` (built this session)

**What is missing:**

- **Variant router.** Given an arbitrary learner-supplied question,
  identify its template and generate a fresh variant. The analogue
  library has 4,364 variants across 64 templates, so the raw material
  exists. The missing piece is the classifier: question -> template.
  This is the hardest piece and belongs in the OpenAI phase
  (LLM can classify the incoming question in one call).

- **PDF generator.** Question + working + correct working, printable.
  Self-contained. `reportlab` or similar.

- **Recommendation output surface.** The discovery store has
  effectiveness rates. The recommendation text itself is missing.

- **Parent / teacher referral surface.** Reports for external
  audiences — Phase 7.

**Design principle that must hold:**

The tutor does not give answers. It works from variants. That is
the pedagogic move that separates MethodMarker from a chatbot.

**When to build:**

Fits during the OpenAI phase — the variant router is the natural
first use of the LLM in the product, since it is a classification
task with a bounded search space.

---

## I. Health check — per-question mark totals

**Idea:** every `memo_step_marks_*.csv` row's marks should sum to
the memo's declared total for that sub-question. Miscounts have
surfaced multiple times. Automated verification would catch them
at write time.

**Pattern:**
question_id, total_marks_expected, total_marks_actual, OK?
2023_P1_Q1.1.1, 3, 3, True
2023_P1_Q1.1.2, 4, 4, True

Source of `total_marks_expected`: `question_structure.csv`
(`marks` column per sub-question).

**When to build:** next session that touches the health check.

---

## J. Health check — malformed CSV row detection

**Idea:** rows with fewer columns than the header should fail loudly
at load time, not silently break the loader. This has happened
three times in two days.

**Pattern:** at the top of `load_steps()` in `step_grader.py`,
verify `len(row) == ncols` for every row; if not, raise with the
line number.

**When to build:** next session that touches the loader.

---

## K. Presentation matcher — step-linking

**Idea:** the current presentation matcher fires rules on keywords
(`sqrt`, `d/dx`, etc.) rather than on the specific learner step
that triggered them. This causes false positives.

**Fix:** tag each presentation rule with a `trigger_step_tag` field
in the CSV, so the matcher only fires rules that correspond to the
actual step the learner just did.

**Status:** matcher disabled pending this fix. Do not re-enable
until step-linking is in place.

**When to build:** own session.

---

## L. 2020 + 2021 proofs — move to dedicated `_proofs.csv`

**Idea:** consistency. Other years (2014-2019, 2022) have EUCL
proofs in dedicated `memo_step_marks_YYYY_P2_proofs.csv` files
using `match_mode: keyword`. 2020 and 2021 have proofs in the
main CSVs using exact mode.

**Fix:** move 2020 + 2021 EUCL rows to `_proofs.csv` with
`match_mode: keyword`.

**Priority:** low. Works as-is.

**When to build:** whenever we next touch the 2020/2021 CSVs.

---

## M. Question corpus 2014-2022 — the next major phase

**Idea:** upload the 2014-2022 question papers (not the memos —
those we already have). OCR each paper. Segment into
sub-questions. Map each to a topic. Type the expected answer
from the memo.

**Output:** the step marks we typed for 2014-2022 become usable.
The drill can present questions from 12 years, not 3.

**Size:** ~4 weeks of content work, one paper per session.

**Dependency:** nothing. It is the next phase.

**When to build:** after closing Phase 5d cleanly.

---

## N. Learner timezone on the learner row

**Idea:** `session_open.greet()` already reads a `timezone` column off
the `learner` row if it exists (IANA name, e.g. `Europe/London`). The
column does not exist yet. Add it, plus a way to set it:

- `ALTER TABLE learner ADD COLUMN timezone TEXT;`
- A first-run prompt: "Which country are you in?" -> map to IANA name.
- Or infer from the learner id / signup metadata.

**Why:** so an international student gets the right time-of-day
greeting without us hard-coding SAST. SAST remains the default when
the column is null or missing.

**When to build:** small; fold into the next session that touches
`learner_store.py`.

---

## O. Warm open — banner ordering

**Idea (cosmetic, noted 29 Sep 2026):** in the CLI, the
`MatricMath CLI Tutor` banner and the `Learner: ... | store: ...`
line currently print *after* the warm-open box. They should print
*before*, so a session opens with the banner, then the greeting,
then the homework gate.

**Fix:** move the banner prints to just before the `warm_open(...)`
call in `scripts/cli_tutor.py`.

**When to build:** next session that touches `cli_tutor.py`.

---

## P. Friendly skill names in the progress preview

**Idea:** `session_open.progress_preview()` currently falls back to
`_friendly_skill()` which just drops the namespace and joins the
remaining dots. So `algebra.quadratic.solve` -> `quadratic solve`,
and `geometry.3d.length` -> `3d length`. It reads robotic.

**Fix:** a lookup table mapping skill ids to human topic names,
e.g.:

- `algebra.quadratic.solve`        -> "quadratic equations"
- `geometry.3d.length`             -> "3-D length problems"
- `trig.reduction.formulae`        -> "reduction formulae"
- `euclidean.semicircle.prove`     -> "angle in a semicircle (proof)"

Fallback: current `_friendly_skill()` behaviour if no mapping exists.

**Where to put the table:** `src/tutor/skill_names.py` (new module),
or a `skill_display_name` column on the `skill` table if one exists.

**When to build:** next session that touches `session_open.py`.

---

## Q. Tutor persona name

**Decision (29 Sep 2026):** the tutor persona is named **Tanaka**.
The name is the project author's own — this project is, in part, a
deliberate recreation of the author as a tutor.

**Where it lives:**

- `src/tutor/session_open.py` -> constant `TUTOR_NAME = "Tanaka"`.
- Banner in `scripts/cli_tutor.py` reads
  `MatricMath CLI Tutor  ·  Tanaka`.
- `_tutor_intro(learner_name)` returns `" I'm Tanaka."` on a first
  meeting, and returns `""` when the learner's first name matches
  the tutor's — so we never say "I'm Tanaka" to a learner called
  Tanaka.

**Product framing:** *MethodMarker* is the engine (the thing that
marks the method). *Tanaka* is the tutor (the voice in the CLI).
Engine name stays on the repo, README, and PDFs. Persona name is
what the learner hears.

**Open questions for a future session:**

- Should the tutor ever reintroduce itself after a long absence
  (e.g. >30 days)? Current: no. Probably fine.
- Does the persona need a surname, or a one-line bio shown once at
  first meeting? Current: no. Nice-to-have.
- Should the persona name be configurable per-deployment (e.g. for
  schools that want their own tutor name)? Current: a single
  constant. Easy to promote to config later if needed.

**When to build (extras):** only if/when needed. Core is done.

---

## R. Session-open ordering contract

**Rule (29 Sep 2026):** in `scripts/cli_tutor.py`, the session open must
follow this order:

1. `store = open_store(store_path)`
2. `show_banner(learner_id, store_path)`      # no DB access
3. `warm_open(learner_id, store)`             # reads PRE-session state
4. homework gate (input)
5. `store.load_learner(learner_id)`           # stamps last_seen
6. topic loop (`while True: pick_problem()`)

**Why:** `load_learner()` writes `last_seen`. If it runs before
`warm_open()`, a brand-new learner looks like a returning one, the
"I'm Tanaka" intro is suppressed, and the greeting says "Good to see
you again". The bug is subtle because it only shows up in the CLI —
standalone `greet()` calls (which don't touch load_learner) behave
correctly, so a unit test won't catch it.

**Also:** `warm_open()` decides `is_new` once and passes it to both
`greet()` and `progress_preview()`, so the greeting and the preview
can never disagree about whether this is a first meeting. If either
function is changed to recompute new-ness independently, that
invariant breaks.

**When to review:** any session that touches the session-open path or
`load_learner()`. Add a lint / assertion if we ever refactor main().

---

## T. Skill taxonomy granularity — 2014–2022 vs 2023–2025

**Problem (surfaced 29 Sep 2026):** `memo_step_marks_*.csv` for 2014–2022 use a
coarse skill vocabulary (`sequences.arithmetic`), while the hand-curated 2023–2025
files use a finer one (`sequences.ap.term`). Rebuilding 2023 P1 from the step
marks matches 10/50 skill_ids against the hand-curated reference. The remaining
40 use coarser ids.

**Impact:**

- **Not blocking.** Mastery still tracks; the loop's newest-first progression
  is per-topic, not per-skill; grading works.
- **Cosmetic for feedback.** Feedback names the topic correctly but not the
  specific sub-skill. `sequences.arithmetic` covers AP term, AP sum, AP
  difference — three subtly different skills collapsed into one.

**Fix (eventual):** map coarse ids to fine ids in the step-marks CSVs.

- A hand-maintained mapping CSV: `coarse_id, fine_id, evidence_pattern`.
- Derive from `method_tag` + `question_text`.
- Use the 2023 hand-curated taxonomy as canonical vocabulary, then refine
  each older year against it.

**When to build:** separate session; content work, not code work.

---

## U. Expected-answer normalization (2014–2022 machine-built)

**Problem:** machine-built `memo_answers_*.csv` produce expected answers like
`x=3 or x=-4` and `P(A and B)=1/4`. The hand-curated files use `x = 3 or x = -4`
and bare `1/4`. After whitespace strip, 24/50 match; the rest differ in
formatting convention. A few real differences also surfaced:

- `1.1.3` — ours `x=0 or x=4`, ref `x=4`. Extraneous root not rejected.
- `10.2.1` — ours missing one probability branch the ref has (0.35, 0.65).

**Fix:** a normalization pass over the machine-built files:

- Strip leading `P(...)=` prefixes.
- Normalize spacing around `=`, `<`, `>`.
- Add extraneous-root rejection logic when the question type allows.
- Compare each machine file against its memo PDF for outliers.

**When to build:** separate session, after M is live and the loop has been
observed against real learners.

---

## V. Mixed corpus — 2023–2025 hand-curated vs 2014–2022 machine-built

**Note:** 2023, 2024, 2025 files are hand-curated (higher polish). 2014–2022
are machine-built (first-pass). The corpus is now mixed.

**Decision:** keep hand-curated files as the target quality bar. Over time,
polish machine-built files toward the same standard. Do **not** replace the
hand-curated files with machine output for the sake of uniformity — the
hand-curated files are the reference, not the fallback.

**When to review:** after the first cohort of real learners has hit the
2014–2022 questions and we can see which subquestions caused friction.

---

## W. Question text quality in 2014–2022 (OCR residue)

**Note:** the `question_text_short` column in the machine-built files
inherits OCR residue from the topic maps (`3x° —2x =14` instead of
`3x^2 - 2x = 14`). This does *not* affect the drill — the drill reads its
prompt from the topic map via `question_loader.py`, not from this column.
But if a future feature ever uses `question_text_short` directly (e.g.
a printable PDF of the anchor), the OCR residue would surface.

**Fix:** a per-year OCR cleanup pass, folded in with sections T and U.

**When to build:** low priority; only if a feature needs clean text.

---

## X. Backfill P2 geometry step marks (2014–2022)

**Problem (29 Sep 2026):** step-mark completeness audit found 21 questions
missing from `memo_step_marks_*.csv`:

- 2014 P2: Q8, Q9, Q10
- 2015 P2: Q8, Q9, Q10, Q11
- 2016 P2: Q9, Q10
- 2017 P2: Q4, Q8, Q10, Q11
- 2018 P2: Q8, Q9, Q10
- 2021 P1: Q11
- 2022 P2: Q4, Q8, Q9, Q10

Every missing question is in P2 and is Analytical or Euclidean Geometry.
These are the DBE's most-reported error area — diagram_assumption errors
alone are 13.3% of all reported errors, every year.

**Impact:**

- Diagnostic attribution: ~110 of the 221 topic-level rows collapse onto
  coarse `euclidean.circle` / `analytical.circle`, because the fine skills
  can't be looked up.
- Drill: can't present these questions at all — they're missing from
  `memo_answers`.
- Variant library: no step sequence to anchor compositional geometry
  variants against.

**Fix:** extract memo PDFs for the 21 questions, type step marks in the
same format as existing `memo_step_marks_*.csv`, then re-run the M6
rebuild for affected papers.

**Size:** ~100–150 subquestions. 2–3 content sessions.

**When to build:** dedicated content session. Not on the code critical path,
but blocks fine-grained Euclidean diagnostic attribution and drill coverage.

---

## Y. LLM classification pass on the 'general' bucket and residual topic-level rows

**Problem (29 Sep 2026):** after the regex re-classification pass:

- 319 rows still have `error_class == 'general'` — real error texts the
  regexes couldn't bucket.
- 221 rows still have topic-level attribution, ~110 of which are blocked
  on backlog X, ~110 of which have genuinely ambiguous refs.

**Fix:**

1. **Error-class pass.** Send each `general` row's `error_text` to
   DeepSeek with the 6 classes (procedural / conceptual / notation /
   reading / arithmetic / presentation) as the candidate set. ~R0.05/row
   × 319 = ~R16.
2. **Attribution pass.** For rows with no subquestion_ref and no regex
   match, send the row + the topic map for that question to DeepSeek,
   ask it to pick the most likely subquestion. ~R0.05/row × 110 = ~R5.

**Total:** ~R21 to bring `general` below 5% and topic-level below 3%.

**When to build:** after backlog X lands (so the LLM isn't asked to
attribute rows whose step marks don't exist yet). One session.

---

## Z. Variant pool spec — contaminated rows

**State (29 Sep 2026):** `data/processed/tutor/variant_pool_spec.csv`
contains 148 skills, 1,645 variants targeted. Each row carries an
`attribution_quality` flag:

- `clean` — usable for generator work now.
- `mixed` — mostly clean but with some topic-level contamination.
- `coarse` — attribution is <40% subquestion-level; wait for backlog X.

**Rule:** only build generators for `clean` skills until backlog X lands.
For `coarse` skills (`euclidean.circle`, `analytical.circle`, and any
others that surface), the pool composition is directional at best and
will be recomputed after the step marks are backfilled.

**Also to note:** the current spec doesn't yet carry the fingerprint
surface (numbers, verbs, answer form, diagram presence). That's the
second axis and wraps around this spec in a later pass.

**When to review:** after backlog X, before generator work scales past
the `clean` set.

    "questions_df = pd.read_csv(question_structure_path)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Stable question_id\n",
    "def make_question_id(row):\n",
    "    qn = row.get(\"question_number\")\n",
    "    subq = row.get(\"subquestion\")\n",
    "    qn_part = f\"Q{int(qn)}\" if pd.notna(qn) else \"QNA\"\n",
    "    sub_part = str(subq) if pd.notna(subq) else \"main\"\n",
    "    return f\"{row['document_id']}__{qn_part}__{sub_part}\"\n",
    "\n",
    "questions_df[\"question_id\"] = questions_df.apply(make_question_id, axis=1)\n",

    "def map_topic(text: str):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Rule-based topic mapper.\n",
    "    Returns: topic, subtopic, method, rule_id, confidence\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    t = (text or \"\").lower()\n",
    "\n",
    "    rules = [\n",
    "        # Calculus\n",
    "        (r\"first principles|f'\\(x\\).*first|from first principles\", \"Calculus\", \"First principles\", \"symbolic_calc_fp\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"\\bf'\\(|dy/dx|derivative|differentiate|concave|turning point|optimisation|maximize|maximise|tangent to\", \"Calculus\", \"Rules of differentiation\", \"keyword_calc\", \"high\"),\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Probability\n",
    "        (r\"contingency|independent events|mutually exclusive\", \"Probability\", \"Contingency tables\", \"keyword_prob_table\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"tree diagram\", \"Probability\", \"Tree diagrams\", \"keyword_prob_tree\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"arrangements|counting principle|number of ways|permutation|combination\", \"Probability\", \"Counting principles\", \"keyword_prob_count\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"probability that|p\\(\", \"Probability\", \"Basic probability\", \"keyword_prob\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Finance\n",
    "        (r\"compound interest|accumulated amount|future value|present value|annuity|loan|repay\", \"Finance\", \"Compound interest\", \"keyword_finance\", \"high\"),\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Sequences\n",
    "        (r\"quadratic sequence|second difference\", \"Number Patterns & Sequences\", \"Quadratic sequences\", \"keyword_quad_seq\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"geometric sequence|infinite series|common ratio\", \"Number Patterns & Sequences\", \"Geometric sequences\", \"keyword_geo_seq\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"arithmetic sequence|common difference|t_?\\d\", \"Number Patterns & Sequences\", \"Arithmetic sequences\", \"keyword_arith_seq\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "        (r\"sigma|sum of the series|s_?\\d\", \"Number Patterns & Sequences\", \"Series & sigma notation\", \"keyword_series\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Functions\n",
    "        (r\"log\\s*\\(|\\blog\\b|logarithmic\", \"Functions & Graphs\", \"Logarithmic functions\", \"keyword_log\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"inverse of|f\\s*[⁻\\^-]?1|f\\^\\{\\s*-1\\s*\\}\", \"Functions & Graphs\", \"Inverse functions\", \"keyword_inverse\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"hyperbola|asymptote\", \"Functions & Graphs\", \"Hyperbola\", \"keyword_hyperbola\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "        (r\"parabola|quadratic function|axis of symmetry\", \"Functions & Graphs\", \"Quadratic functions\", \"keyword_parabola\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "        (r\"translated|translation|transformation\", \"Functions & Graphs\", \"Transformations\", \"keyword_transform\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "        (r\"domain|range|intercept|sketch the graph|draw the graph\", \"Functions & Graphs\", \"Graph interpretation\", \"keyword_graph\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Algebra\n",
    "        (r\"simultaneous|solve for x and y\", \"Algebra & Equations\", \"Simultaneous equations\", \"keyword_simultaneous\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"inequalit|>|<|≥|≤\", \"Algebra & Equations\", \"Inequalities\", \"keyword_inequality\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "        (r\"surd|√|square root\", \"Algebra & Equations\", \"Exponents & surds\", \"keyword_surd\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "        (r\"quadratic formula|factoris|factoriz|\\(.*\\)\\(.*\\)\\s*=\\s*0|solve for x\", \"Algebra & Equations\", \"Quadratic equations\", \"keyword_quadratic\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "    ]\n",
    "\n",
    "    for pattern, topic, subtopic, rule_id, conf in rules:\n",
    "        if re.search(pattern, t, flags=re.IGNORECASE):\n",
    "            return topic, subtopic, \"rule\", rule_id, conf\n",
    "\n",
    "    return \"Unmapped\", \"Unmapped\", \"rule\", \"no_match\", \"low\"\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def extract_command_verb(text: str):\n",
    "    verbs = [\n",
    "        \"calculate\", \"determine\", \"solve\", \"show\", \"prove\", \"sketch\", \"draw\",\n",
    "        \"write down\", \"describe\", \"explain\", \"hence\", \"deduce\", \"evaluate\",\n",
    "        \"simplify\", \"factorise\", \"factorize\", \"expand\"\n",
    "    ]\n",
    "    t = (text or \"\").lower()\n",
    "    for v in verbs:\n",
    "        if re.search(rf\"\\b{re.escape(v)}\\b\", t):\n",
    "            return v\n",
    "    return None"
   ]

    "def map_topic(text: str):\n",
    "    t = (text or \"\").lower()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Order matters: specific → general\n",
    "    rules = [\n",
    "        # ---------- CALCULUS (specific first) ----------\n",
    "        (r\"first principles\", \"Calculus\", \"First principles\", \"calc_fp\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"concave|f''\\(|second derivative|turning point|stationary\", \"Calculus\", \"Cubic graphs\", \"calc_cubic\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"tangent to|equation of the tangent\", \"Calculus\", \"Tangents\", \"calc_tangent\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"maximi[sz]e the volume|optimisation|optimization|maximum volume\", \"Calculus\", \"Optimisation\", \"calc_opt\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"\\bf'\\(|dy/dx|differentiate|derivative|d/dx\", \"Calculus\", \"Rules of differentiation\", \"calc_rules\", \"high\"),\n",
    "\n",
    "        # ---------- PROBABILITY ----------\n",
    "        (r\"contingency|independent events|mutually exclusive\", \"Probability\", \"Contingency tables\", \"prob_table\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"tree diagram|non-rainy|cups of coffee\", \"Probability\", \"Tree diagrams\", \"prob_tree\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"arrangements|number of possible ways|counting principle|runners can finish|permutation|combination\", \"Probability\", \"Counting principles\", \"prob_count\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"probability that|chosen at random\", \"Probability\", \"Basic probability\", \"prob_basic\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "\n",
    "        # ---------- FINANCE ----------\n",
    "        (r\"annuity|accumulated amount|monthly deposit|sinking fund\", \"Finance\", \"Annuities\", \"fin_annuity\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"repay the loan|final payment|present value|loan was granted\", \"Finance\", \"Present/future value\", \"fin_pv\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"compound interest|in 5 years' time|interest rate\", \"Finance\", \"Compound interest\", \"fin_compound\", \"high\"),\n",
    "\n",
    "        # ---------- SEQUENCES (critical fix) ----------\n",
    "        (r\"quadratic sequence|second difference|torpedo|depth of the torpedo|t_n\\s*=\\s*-n\", \"Number Patterns & Sequences\", \"Quadratic sequences\", \"seq_quad\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"geometric sequence|infinite series|common ratio|t_?25|sum of the infinite\", \"Number Patterns & Sequences\", \"Geometric sequences\", \"seq_geo\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"arithmetic sequence|common difference|difference between t_?\", \"Number Patterns & Sequences\", \"Arithmetic sequences\", \"seq_arith\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"sigma|sum of the series|s_?\\d+|lower limit\", \"Number Patterns & Sequences\", \"Series & sigma notation\", \"seq_series\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "        (r\"\\bt_?\\d+\\b|\\btₙ\\b|\\bsₙ\\b|nth term|general term\", \"Number Patterns & Sequences\", \"Arithmetic sequences\", \"seq_general\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "\n",
    "        # ---------- FUNCTIONS ----------\n",
    "        (r\"log\\s*\\(|\\blog\\b|logarithmic\", \"Functions & Graphs\", \"Logarithmic functions\", \"fn_log\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"inverse of|f\\s*[⁻\\^-]?1|f\\^\\{\\s*-1\\s*\\}|f⁻¹\", \"Functions & Graphs\", \"Inverse functions\", \"fn_inverse\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"hyperbola|horizontal asymptote\", \"Functions & Graphs\", \"Hyperbola\", \"fn_hyp\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"parabola|axis of symmetry|f\\(x\\)\\s*=\\s*-\", \"Functions & Graphs\", \"Quadratic functions\", \"fn_parab\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "        (r\"translated|translation|transformation\", \"Functions & Graphs\", \"Transformations\", \"fn_trans\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"domain of|range of|intercept|sketch the graph|draw the graph|g\\(x\\).*f\\(x\\)\", \"Functions & Graphs\", \"Graph interpretation\", \"fn_graph\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "\n",
    "        # ---------- ALGEBRA ----------\n",
    "        (r\"simultaneous|values of x and y|product of x and y\", \"Algebra & Equations\", \"Simultaneous equations\", \"alg_sim\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"inequalit|≥|≤|solve for x:\\s*\\d*x.*>\", \"Algebra & Equations\", \"Inequalities\", \"alg_ineq\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"surd|√|square root\", \"Algebra & Equations\", \"Exponents & surds\", \"alg_surd\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"2\\^x|exponential equation|·2\\^\", \"Algebra & Equations\", \"Exponents & surds\", \"alg_exp\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"quadratic formula|factoris|factoriz|\\([^\\)]+\\)\\([^\\)]+\\)\\s*=\\s*0|solve for x\", \"Algebra & Equations\", \"Quadratic equations\", \"alg_quad\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "    ]\n",
    "\n",
    "    for pattern, topic, subtopic, rule_id, conf in rules:\n",
    "        if re.search(pattern, t, flags=re.IGNORECASE):\n",
    "            return topic, subtopic, \"rule\", rule_id, conf\n",
    "\n",
    "    return \"Unmapped\", \"Unmapped\", \"rule\", \"no_match\", \"low\""

    "pred_rows = []\n",
    "for _, row in gold_df.iterrows():\n",
    "    topic, subtopic, method, rule_id, conf = map_topic(row[\"question_text\"])\n",
    "    pred_rows.append({\n",
    "        \"question_id\": row[\"question_id\"],\n",
    "        \"topic_gold\": row[\"topic_gold\"],\n",
    "        \"topic_pred\": topic,\n",
    "        \"rule_id\": rule_id,\n",
    "        \"confidence\": conf,\n",
    "        \"match_topic\": row[\"topic_gold\"] == topic,\n",
    "        \"question_text\": str(row[\"question_text\"])[:120],\n",
    "    })\n",
    "\n",
    "pred_df = pd.DataFrame(pred_rows)\n",
    "accuracy = pred_df[\"match_topic\"].mean()\n",
    "print(f\"Topic accuracy vs gold: {accuracy:.1%}\")\n",
    "print(pd.crosstab(pred_df[\"topic_gold\"], pred_df[\"topic_pred\"]))\n",
    "print(\"\\nRemaining misses:\")\n",
    "display(pred_df[~pred_df[\"match_topic\"]][\n",
    "    [\"question_id\", \"topic_gold\", \"topic_pred\", \"rule_id\", \"question_text\"]\n",
    "])"
   ]

   "source": [
    "def map_topic(text: str):\n",
    "    t = (text or \"\").lower()\n",
    "\n",
    "    rules = [\n",
    "        # ---- CALCULUS ----\n",
    "        (r\"first principles\", \"Calculus\", \"First principles\", \"calc_fp\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"concave|f''\\(|second derivative\", \"Calculus\", \"Cubic graphs\", \"calc_cubic\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"turning point|stationary point|coordinates of e\", \"Calculus\", \"Cubic graphs\", \"calc_tp\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"tangent to|equation of the tangent\", \"Calculus\", \"Tangents\", \"calc_tan\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"maximi[sz]e the volume|volume of the cylinder|optimisation|optimization\", \"Calculus\", \"Optimisation\", \"calc_opt\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"intersect f at 3 distinct points|y\\s*=\\s*-11x\", \"Calculus\", \"Cubic graphs\", \"calc_intersect\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"f\\(x\\)·f''\\(x\\)|f\\(x\\)\\s*\\*\\s*f''\\(x\\)\", \"Calculus\", \"Cubic graphs\", \"calc_product\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"\\bf'\\(|dy/dx|differentiate|derivative\", \"Calculus\", \"Rules of differentiation\", \"calc_rules\", \"high\"),\n",
    "\n",
    "        # ---- PROBABILITY ----\n",
    "        (r\"contingency|independent events|preferring juice|energy drinks\", \"Probability\", \"Contingency tables\", \"prob_table\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"tree diagram|cups of coffee|non-rainy\", \"Probability\", \"Tree diagrams\", \"prob_tree\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"runners|finish the race|arrangements|number of possible ways|counting principle\", \"Probability\", \"Counting principles\", \"prob_count\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"probability that|chosen at random\", \"Probability\", \"Basic probability\", \"prob_basic\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "\n",
    "        # ---- FINANCE ----\n",
    "        (r\"annuity|accumulated amount|1 january 2026\", \"Finance\", \"Annuities\", \"fin_ann\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"repay the loan|final payment|loan was granted|completed months\", \"Finance\", \"Present/future value\", \"fin_pv\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"compound interest|holiday cost|in 5 years\", \"Finance\", \"Compound interest\", \"fin_ci\", \"high\"),\n",
    "\n",
    "        # ---- SEQUENCES ----\n",
    "        (r\"torpedo|depth of the torpedo|quadratic sequence|t_n\\s*=\\s*-n|second difference\",\n",
    "         \"Number Patterns & Sequences\", \"Quadratic sequences\", \"seq_quad\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"geometric|infinite series|common ratio|t_?25\",\n",
    "         \"Number Patterns & Sequences\", \"Geometric sequences\", \"seq_geo\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"arithmetic|common difference|difference between t_?\",\n",
    "         \"Number Patterns & Sequences\", \"Arithmetic sequences\", \"seq_arith\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"sigma|sum of the series|lower limit|value of k\",\n",
    "         \"Number Patterns & Sequences\", \"Series & sigma notation\", \"seq_series\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "        (r\"\\bt_?\\d+\\b|\\btₙ\\b|\\bsₙ\\b|nth term|general term\",\n",
    "         \"Number Patterns & Sequences\", \"Arithmetic sequences\", \"seq_term\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "\n",
    "        # ---- FUNCTIONS ----\n",
    "        (r\"log\\s*\\(|\\blog\\b|logarithmic\", \"Functions & Graphs\", \"Logarithmic functions\", \"fn_log\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"inverse of|f⁻¹|f\\s*[⁻\\^-]?1|f\\^\\{\\s*-1\\s*\\}\", \"Functions & Graphs\", \"Inverse functions\", \"fn_inv\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"hyperbola|horizontal asymptote of f\", \"Functions & Graphs\", \"Hyperbola\", \"fn_hyp\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"parabola|axis of symmetry\", \"Functions & Graphs\", \"Quadratic functions\", \"fn_par\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "        (r\"translated|translation|transformation that g\", \"Functions & Graphs\", \"Transformations\", \"fn_tr\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"domain of|range of|g\\(x\\)\\s*≤\\s*f\\(x\\)|f\\(x\\)\\s*<\\s*6|length of mt|x-intercept of g\",\n",
    "         \"Functions & Graphs\", \"Graph interpretation\", \"fn_gi\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"draw the graph|sketch the graph|asymptotes\", \"Functions & Graphs\", \"Graph interpretation\", \"fn_sketch\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "\n",
    "        # ---- ALGEBRA ----\n",
    "        (r\"values of x and y|product of x and y|sum of 2 and y\", \"Algebra & Equations\", \"Simultaneous equations\", \"alg_sim\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\">|<|≥|≤|inequalit\", \"Algebra & Equations\", \"Inequalities\", \"alg_ineq\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"surd|√|square root\", \"Algebra & Equations\", \"Exponents & surds\", \"alg_surd\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"2\\^x|2\\^\\(|·2\\^\", \"Algebra & Equations\", \"Exponents & surds\", \"alg_exp\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"factoris|factoriz|\\([^\\)]+\\)\\([^\\)]+\\)\\s*=\\s*0|quadratic formula|solve for x\",\n",
    "         \"Algebra & Equations\", \"Quadratic equations\", \"alg_quad\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "    ]\n",
    "\n",
    "    for pattern, topic, subtopic, rule_id, conf in rules:\n",
    "        if re.search(pattern, t, flags=re.IGNORECASE):\n",
    "            return topic, subtopic, \"rule\", rule_id, conf\n",
    "\n",
    "    return \"Unmapped\", \"Unmapped\", \"rule\", \"no_match\", \"low\""
   ]

    "import re\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "\n",
    "PROJECT_ROOT = Path.cwd().parent\n",
    "QUESTIONS_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / \"data\" / \"processed\" / \"questions\"\n",
    "MAPPED_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / \"data\" / \"processed\" / \"mapped\"\n",
    "MAPPED_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "questions_df = pd.read_csv(QUESTIONS_DIR / \"question_structure.csv\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# question_id if missing\n",
    "if \"question_id\" not in questions_df.columns:\n",
    "    def make_question_id(row):\n",
    "        qn = row.get(\"question_number\")\n",
    "        subq = row.get(\"subquestion\")\n",
    "        qn_part = f\"Q{int(qn)}\" if pd.notna(qn) else \"QNA\"\n",
    "        sub_part = str(subq) if pd.notna(subq) else \"main\"\n",
    "        return f\"{row['document_id']}__{qn_part}__{sub_part}\"\n",
    "    questions_df[\"question_id\"] = questions_df.apply(make_question_id, axis=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "MANUAL_OVERRIDES = {\n",
    "    \"2025_P1_Q2.1.1\": (\"Number Patterns & Sequences\", \"Geometric sequences\", \"manual_override\", \"override_seq\", \"high\"),\n",
    "    \"2025_P1_Q4.1\": (\"Functions & Graphs\", \"Logarithmic functions\", \"manual_override\", \"override_log\", \"high\"),\n",
    "    \"2025_P1_Q4.2\": (\"Functions & Graphs\", \"Logarithmic functions\", \"manual_override\", \"override_log\", \"high\"),\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "def map_topic(text: str, question_id: str = None):\n",
    "    if question_id is not None and question_id in MANUAL_OVERRIDES:\n",
    "        return MANUAL_OVERRIDES[question_id]\n",
    "\n",
    "    t = (text or \"\").lower()\n",
    "\n",
    "    rules = [\n",
    "        # P2 first\n",
    "        (r\"trigonometr|\\bsin\\b|\\bcos\\b|\\btan\\b|sine rule|cosine rule|area rule|identity\",\n",
    "         \"Trigonometry\", \"Equations\", \"trig\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"cyclic|tangent-chord|same segment|euclidean|similar triangle|proportion|rider\",\n",
    "         \"Euclidean Geometry\", \"Circle geometry\", \"euclid\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"distance formula|midpoint|gradient|inclination|equation of the line|coordinate geometry|analytical geometry\",\n",
    "         \"Analytical Geometry\", \"Distance / midpoint / gradient\", \"anageo\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"standard deviation|box-and-whisker|box and whisker|ogive|cumulative frequency|regression|correlation|scatter plot\",\n",
    "         \"Statistics\", \"Regression / correlation\", \"stats\", \"high\"),\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Calculus\n",
    "        (r\"first principles\", \"Calculus\", \"First principles\", \"calc_fp\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"g'\\(x\\)|f'\\(x\\)|g′\\(|f′\\(|dy/dx|differentiate|derivative\",\n",
    "         \"Calculus\", \"Rules of differentiation\", \"calc_rules\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"concave|turning point|tangent to|maximi[sz]e the volume|optimisation|optimization|volume of the cylinder\",\n",
    "         \"Calculus\", \"Cubic graphs\", \"calc_more\", \"high\"),\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Probability / Finance / Sequences / Functions / Algebra\n",
    "        (r\"contingency|independent events|tree diagram|counting principle|arrangements|probability that\",\n",
    "         \"Probability\", \"Basic probability\", \"prob\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"annuity|compound interest|present value|repay the loan|accumulated amount\",\n",
    "         \"Finance\", \"Compound interest\", \"fin\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"quadratic sequence|geometric sequence|arithmetic sequence|infinite series|torpedo|common ratio|common difference|\\bt_?\\d+\",\n",
    "         \"Number Patterns & Sequences\", \"Arithmetic sequences\", \"seq\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"log\\s*\\(|\\blog\\b|inverse of|f⁻¹|hyperbola|parabola|domain of|range of|translated|asymptote\",\n",
    "         \"Functions & Graphs\", \"Graph interpretation\", \"fn\", \"high\"),\n",
    "        (r\"solve for x|factoris|factoriz|inequalit|surd|simultaneous|√\",\n",
    "         \"Algebra & Equations\", \"Quadratic equations\", \"alg\", \"medium\"),\n",
    "    ]\n",
    "\n",
    "    for pattern, topic, subtopic, rule_id, conf in rules:\n",
    "        if re.search(pattern, t, flags=re.IGNORECASE):\n",
    "            return topic, subtopic, \"rule\", rule_id, conf\n",
    "    return \"Unmapped\", \"Unmapped\", \"rule\", \"no_match\", \"low\"\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Remap all\n",
    "rows = []\n",
    "for _, row in questions_df.iterrows():\n",
    "    topic, subtopic, method, rule_id, conf = map_topic(\n",
    "        str(row.get(\"question_text\", \"\")),\n",
    "        question_id=row.get(\"question_id\")\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    d = row.to_dict()\n",
    "    d.update({\n",
    "        \"topic\": topic,\n",
    "        \"subtopic\": subtopic,\n",
    "        \"mapping_method\": method,\n",
    "        \"rule_id\": rule_id,\n",
    "        \"mapping_confidence\": conf,\n",
    "        \"taxonomy_version\": \"v1.2\",\n",
    "    })\n",
    "    rows.append(d)\n",
    "\n",
    "mapped_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)\n",
    "mapped_df.to_csv(MAPPED_DIR / \"question_topic_map_v1.csv\", index=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "exam_df = mapped_df[mapped_df[\"document_id\"].astype(str).str.contains(\"_exam_\", case=False, na=False)].copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Exam rows:\", len(exam_df))\n",
    "print(\"Exam mapped:\", int((exam_df[\"topic\"] != \"Unmapped\").sum()))\n",

    "print(\"Exam mapped %:\", round((exam_df[\"topic\"] != \"Unmapped\").mean() * 100, 1))\n",
    "print(\"\\nTopic distribution (exams):\")\n",
    "print(exam_df[\"topic\"].value_counts())"

      [K("√","cmd","\\sqrt"),K("(□)²","latex","\\left(\\right)^{2}",{auto:true,go:["Left","Left","Left"]}),
       K("θ","cmd","\\theta"),K("°","latex","^{\\circ}"),K("tan(","latex","\\tan\\left(\\right)",{go:goLeft(1)})],
    ],
    Euclidean: [
      [K("△","cmd","\\triangle"),K("∥","cmd","\\parallel"),K("⊥","cmd","\\perp"),
       K("∠","cmd","\\angle"),K("≅","cmd","\\cong"),K("∼","cmd","\\sim")],
      [K("Â","latex","\\hat{A}"),K("B̂","latex","\\hat{B}"),K("Ĉ","latex","\\hat{C}"),
       K("∴","cmd","\\therefore"),K("∵","cmd","\\because"),K("√","cmd","\\sqrt")],
      [K("sin(","latex","\\sin\\left(\\right)",{go:goLeft(1)}),K("cos(","latex","\\cos\\left(\\right)",{go:goLeft(1)}),
       K("tan(","latex","\\tan\\left(\\right)",{go:goLeft(1)})],
    ],
    Stats: [
      [K("x̄","latex","\\bar{x}"),K("σ","cmd","\\sigma"),K("n","text","n"),K("r","text","r"),K("r²","latex","r^{2}",{auto:true})],
      [K("Σ","cmd","\\sum"),K("(□)²","latex","\\left(\\right)^{2}",{auto:true,go:["Left","Left","Left"]}),
       K("√","cmd","\\sqrt"),K("E(□)","latex","E\\left(\\right)",{go:goLeft(1)}),K("P(□)","latex","P\\left(\\right)",{go:goLeft(1)})],
    ],
    Probability: [
      [K("P(□)","latex","P\\left(\\right)",{go:goLeft(1)}),K("∪","cmd","\\cup"),K("∩","cmd","\\cap"),K("'","text","'")],
      [K("nCr","cmd","\\binom"),K("!","text","!"),K("□/□","cmd","\\frac")],
    ],
    Greek: greekTab,
  };
  /* Greek is in the tab strip: place right beside ABC visually.
     ABC is an action button, so Greek sits as the last tab. */
  tabsOrder.push("Greek");

  var trigInvRow = [
    K("INV","action","__inv__"),
    K("sin⁻¹(","latex","\\sin^{-1}\\left(\\right)",{go:goLeft(1)}),
    K("cos⁻¹(","latex","\\cos^{-1}\\left(\\right)",{go:goLeft(1)}),
    K("tan⁻¹(","latex","\\tan^{-1}\\left(\\right)",{go:goLeft(1)}),
  ];
  var actions = [
    K("SPACE","action","__space__"), K("DEL","action","__del__"), K("AC","action","__clear__"),
    K("ABC","action","__abc__"), K("⏎","action","__enter__"), K("?","action","__ask__"), K("✓","action","__done__"),
  ];

  var state = {
    tab: "Algebra", abcMode: false, invMode: false, capsLock: false, abcNums: false,
    fields: [], activeIdx: -1, target: "math",
  };
  var linesEl = document.getElementById("lines");
  var tabsEl = document.getElementById("tabs");
  var kbEl = document.getElementById("kb");
  var actsEl = document.getElementById("acts");
  var resultEl = document.getElementById("result");
  var sbcEl = document.getElementById("sbc");
  var sbcWrap = document.getElementById("sbcWrap");
  var targetHint = document.getElementById("targetHint");
  var sbcWhere = document.getElementById("sbcWhere");

  function updateTargetUI() {
    if (state.target === "sbc") {
      sbcWrap.classList.add("sbc-active");
      targetHint.textContent = "Input → Ask Tanaka";
      sbcWhere.textContent = "typing here";
      sbcWhere.classList.add("on");
    } else {
      sbcWrap.classList.remove("sbc-active");
      targetHint.textContent = "Input → Working line " + (state.activeIdx >= 0 ? state.activeIdx + 1 : "1");
      sbcWhere.textContent = "tap here to type a message";
      sbcWhere.classList.remove("on");
    }
  }
  function setTarget(t) { state.target = t; updateTargetUI(); }

  function renumber() {
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(linesEl.querySelectorAll(".lrow"), function (row, i) {
      row.querySelector(".lnum").textContent = String(i + 1);
    });
  }
  function markActiveRow() {
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(linesEl.querySelectorAll(".lrow"), function (row, i) {
      row.classList.toggle("active", i === state.activeIdx);
    });
  }
  function setActive(idx, doFocus) {
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= state.fields.length) return;
    state.activeIdx = idx;
    markActiveRow();
    setTarget("math");
    if (doFocus !== false) { try { state.fields[idx].field.focus(); } catch (e) {} }
  }
  function current() {
    if (state.activeIdx < 0 || state.activeIdx >= state.fields.length) return null;
    return state.fields[state.activeIdx].field;
  }

  function addLine(focus) {
    var row = document.createElement("div");
    row.className = "lrow";
    var num = document.createElement("div");
    num.className = "lnum";
    var host = document.createElement("span");
    host.className = "mq-host";
    row.appendChild(num); row.appendChild(host);
    linesEl.appendChild(row);
    renumber();
    var idx = state.fields.length;
    var field = MQ.MathField(host, {
      spaceBehavesLikeTab: false,
      handlers: {
        enter: function () { addLine(true); },
        focus: function () { setActive(idx, false); },
      },
    });
    function selectMath(e) { setActive(idx, true); }
    row.addEventListener("mousedown", function (e) {
      setTarget("math");
      state.activeIdx = idx;
      markActiveRow();
      updateTargetUI();
    });
    row.addEventListener("click", selectMath);
    host.addEventListener("focusin", function () { setActive(idx, false); });
    state.fields.push({ field: field, host: host, row: row, idx: idx });
    if (focus !== false) setActive(idx, true);
    else markActiveRow();
    return field;
  }

  sbcEl.addEventListener("focus", function () { setTarget("sbc"); });
  sbcEl.addEventListener("click", function () { setTarget("sbc"); });
  sbcWrap.addEventListener("mousedown", function (e) {
    if (e.target === sbcEl || sbcWrap.contains(e.target)) setTarget("sbc");
  });

  function move(field, keys) {
    if (!keys) return;
    keys.forEach(function (k) { field.keystroke(k); });
  }
  function apply(field, k) {
    if (!field) return;
    if (k.type === "text") field.write(k.value);
    else if (k.type === "cmd") field.cmd(k.value);
    else if (k.type === "latex") field.write(k.value);
    else if (k.type === "seq") {
      k.value.forEach(function (op) {
        if (op.indexOf("c:") === 0) field.cmd(op.slice(2));
        else if (op.indexOf("t:") === 0) field.write(op.slice(2));
      });
    }
    if (k.go) move(field, k.go);
  }

  function insertIntoSbc(ch) {
    var el = sbcEl;
    var start = el.selectionStart, end = el.selectionEnd;
    var v = el.value;
    el.value = v.slice(0, start) + ch + v.slice(end);
    el.selectionStart = el.selectionEnd = start + ch.length;
    setTarget("sbc");
    el.focus();
  }
  function sbcBackspace() {
    var el = sbcEl;
    var start = el.selectionStart, end = el.selectionEnd;
    if (start !== end) {
      el.value = el.value.slice(0, start) + el.value.slice(end);
      el.selectionStart = el.selectionEnd = start;
    } else if (start > 0) {
      el.value = el.value.slice(0, start - 1) + el.value.slice(start);
      el.selectionStart = el.selectionEnd = start - 1;
    }
    setTarget("sbc");
    el.focus();
  }

  function handleKey(k) {
    if (k.type === "action") { doAction(k.value); return; }
    if (k.type === "phone") { handlePhone(k.value); return; }

    if (state.target === "sbc") {
      if (k.type === "text" && k.value.length === 1 && /[a-zA-Z0-9. ]/.test(k.value)) {
        insertIntoSbc(k.value);
        return;
      }
      setTarget("math");
    }
    var f = current();
    if (!f) { addLine(true); f = current(); }
    if (!f) return;
    try { f.focus(); } catch (e) {}
    apply(f, k);
  }

  function handlePhone(val) {
    if (val === "__caps__") { state.capsLock = !state.capsLock; renderKb(); return; }
    if (val === "__nums__") { state.abcNums = !state.abcNums; renderKb(); return; }
    if (val === "__del__") {
      if (state.target === "sbc") sbcBackspace();
      else { var f = current(); if (f) { try { f.focus(); } catch (e) {} f.keystroke("Backspace"); } }
      return;
    }
    if (val === "__space__") {
      if (state.target === "sbc") insertIntoSbc(" ");
      else { var f2 = current(); if (f2) { try { f2.focus(); } catch (e) {} f2.write("\\ "); } }
      return;
    }
    if (val === "__enter_sbc__") {
      if (state.target === "sbc") insertIntoSbc("\n");
      else doAction("__enter__");
      return;
    }
    if (state.target === "sbc") insertIntoSbc(val);
    else {
      var f3 = current();
      if (!f3) { addLine(true); f3 = current(); }
      if (f3) { try { f3.focus(); } catch (e) {} f3.write(val); }
    }
  }

  function doAction(id) {
    var f = current();
    switch (id) {
      case "__space__":
        if (state.target === "sbc") insertIntoSbc(" ");
        else if (f) { try { f.focus(); } catch (e) {} f.write("\\ "); }
        break;
      case "__del__":
        if (state.target === "sbc") sbcBackspace();
        else if (f) { try { f.focus(); } catch (e) {} f.keystroke("Backspace"); }
        break;
      case "__clear__":
        if (state.target === "sbc") { sbcEl.value = ""; sbcEl.focus(); }
        else {
          linesEl.innerHTML = "";
          state.fields = [];
          state.activeIdx = -1;
          resultEl.classList.remove("shown");
          addLine(true);
        }
        break;
      case "__enter__":
        if (state.target === "sbc") insertIntoSbc("\n");
        else addLine(true);
        break;
      case "__ask__": setTarget("sbc"); sbcEl.focus(); break;
      case "__abc__":
        state.abcMode = !state.abcMode;
        renderActs(); renderKb();
        break;
      case "__inv__":
        state.invMode = !state.invMode; renderKb();
        break;
      case "__done__": submit(); break;
    }
  }

  function submit() {
  var steps = [];
  state.fields.forEach(function (item) {
    var lx = item.field.latex();
    if (lx && lx.trim()) steps.push(lx.trim());
  });
  var payload = {
    learner_lines_latex: steps,
    sbc_message: sbcEl.value.trim(),
    tab_used: state.tab
  };

  resultEl.classList.add("shown");
  resultEl.innerHTML = "<div class='label'>grading…</div>";

  fetch(API_BASE + "/grade", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
  })
  .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
  .then(function (res) {
    var out = [];

    // ── 1. Mark — the headline ──
    if (res.mark && res.mark.total > 0) {
      var ok = res.mark.awarded === res.mark.total;
      var cls = ok ? "mark-full" : (res.mark.awarded === 0 ? "mark-zero" : "mark-partial");
      out.push("<div class='mark " + cls + "'>" +
               res.mark.awarded + "/" + res.mark.total + "</div>");
    } else if (res.match === "NO_MATCH") {
      out.push("<div class='mark mark-zero'>0</div>");
    }

    // ── 2. Your working ──
    if (res.your_working && res.your_working.length) {
      out.push("<div class='strip-head'>Your working</div>");
      res.your_working.forEach(function (l, i) {
        out.push("<div class='strip-line'>" + (i + 1) + ". " + l + "</div>");
      });
    }

    // ── 3. Memo expected — prefer step_diagnosis, fall back to memo_steps ──
    var sd = res.step_diagnosis || [];
    if (sd.length) {
      out.push("<div class='strip-head'>Memo expected</div>");
      sd.forEach(function (d) {
        var sym, cls;
        if (d.status === "CORRECT")      { sym = "ok"; cls = "s-ok"; }
        else if (d.status === "WRONG")   { sym = "x";  cls = "s-no"; }
        else if (d.status === "MISSING") { sym = "x";  cls = "s-no"; }
        else                             { sym = "?";  cls = "s-maybe"; }
        var line = "<div class='strip-line'>" +
                   "<span class='" + cls + "'>" + sym + "</span> " +
                   "Step " + d.step + ": " + (d.name || "");
        if (d.marks != null) {
          line += " <span class='marks'>(" + d.marks +
                  (d.marks === 1 ? " mark" : " marks") + ")</span>";
        }
        line += "</div>";
        // If the learner wrote something
        if (d.evidence) {
          line += "<div class='strip-example'>you wrote: " + d.evidence + "</div>";
        }
        // If we know what the memo wants
        if (d.expected && d.status !== "CORRECT") {
          line += "<div class='strip-example'>should be: " + d.expected + "</div>";
        }
        out.push(line);
      });
    } else if (res.memo_steps && res.memo_steps.length) {
      out.push("<div class='strip-head'>Memo expected</div>");
      res.memo_steps.forEach(function (s) {
        var sym = s.status === "MATCHED" ? "ok"
                : s.status === "NOT_MATCHED" ? "x" : "?";
        var cls = s.status === "MATCHED" ? "s-ok"
                : s.status === "NOT_MATCHED" ? "s-no" : "s-maybe";
        var line = "<div class='strip-line'>" +
                   "<span class='" + cls + "'>" + sym + "</span> " +
                   (s.desc || "");
        if (s.marks != null) {
          line += " <span class='marks'>(" + s.marks +
                  (s.marks === 1 ? " mark" : " marks") + ")</span>";
        }
        line += "</div>";
        if (s.first_form) {
          line += "<div class='strip-example'>" + s.first_form + "</div>";
        }
        out.push(line);
      });
    }

    // ── 4. Diagnosis — one concrete sentence ──
    if (res.diagnosis) {
      out.push("<div class='strip-diag'>" + res.diagnosis + "</div>");
    }

    // ── 5. Corpus context — what the DBE corpus says about this skill ──
    if (res.corpus_context) {
      var cc = res.corpus_context;
      out.push("<div class='strip-head'>What the DBE corpus says</div>");
      out.push("<div class='strip-line'>" +
               cc.total_errors + " errors on this skill across " +
               (cc.years_count || "many") + " years (" + (cc.years_span || "") + ").</div>");
      out.push("<div class='strip-line'>Top error class: <strong>" +
               cc.top_error_class + "</strong>  (" + cc.top_error_count + ")</div>");
      if (cc.sample_text) {
        out.push("<div class='strip-example'>" +
                 "DBE " + (cc.sample_year || "") + ": " +
                 cc.sample_text.slice(0, 220) + "…</div>");
      }
    }

    // ── 6. Intervention — what to do next ──
    if (res.intervention) {
      out.push("<div class='strip-head'>Suggested intervention</div>");
      out.push("<div class='strip-line'>Pattern: <strong>" +
               (res.intervention.intervention_pattern || "") + "</strong>  " +
               "<span class='marks'>(" + (res.intervention.intervention_id || "") + ")</span></div>");
    }

    // ── 7. Sibling — only after everything above ──
    if (res.sibling) {
      out.push("<div class='strip-head sibling-head'>Similar one, worked out</div>");
      out.push("<div class='strip-line'>" + (res.sibling.problem || "") + "</div>");
      (res.sibling.steps || []).forEach(function (s) {
        out.push("<div class='strip-line sibling-step'>" + s + "</div>");
      });
      if (res.sibling.note) {
        out.push("<div class='strip-note'>" + res.sibling.note + "</div>");
      }
    }

    resultEl.innerHTML = out.join("");
  })
  .catch(function (err) {
    resultEl.innerHTML = "<div class='label'>server error</div><pre>" +
                         String(err) + "</pre>";
  });
}

  function renderTabs() {
    tabsEl.innerHTML = "";
    tabsOrder.forEach(function (name) {
      var b = document.createElement("button");
      b.className = "tab" + (name === state.tab ? " active" : "");
      b.textContent = name;
      b.onclick = function () {
        state.tab = name;
        state.abcMode = false;
        state.invMode = false;
        setTarget("math");
        loadQuestion();
  renderTabs(); renderActs(); renderKb();
      };
      tabsEl.appendChild(b);
    });
  }

  function keyBtn(k, extraClass) {
    var el = document.createElement("div");
    el.className = "key" + (k.auto ? " auto" : "") + (extraClass ? " " + extraClass : "");
    if (k.value === "__inv__" && state.invMode) el.classList.add("inv-on");
    el.textContent = k.label;
    el.onmousedown = function (e) { e.preventDefault(); };
    el.onclick = function () { handleKey(k); };
    return el;
  }
  function renderRow(keys, extraClass) {
    if (!keys || !keys.length) return;
    var r = document.createElement("div");
    r.className = "row";
    r.style.gridTemplateColumns = "repeat(" + keys.length + ",1fr)";
    keys.forEach(function (k) { r.appendChild(keyBtn(k, extraClass)); });
    kbEl.appendChild(r);
  }
  function phoneKey(label, value) { return { label: label, type: "phone", value: value }; }
  function phoneBtn(label, value, cls) {
    var el = document.createElement("div");
    el.className = "key " + (cls || "phone");
    el.textContent = label;
    el.onmousedown = function (e) { e.preventDefault(); };
    el.onclick = function () {
      if (value === "__enter_sbc__") handlePhone("__enter_sbc__");
      else handlePhone(value);
    };
    return el;
  }
  function renderPhoneKeys(keys, cols) {
    var r = document.createElement("div");
    r.className = "row";
    r.style.gridTemplateColumns = cols;
    keys.forEach(function (k) { r.appendChild(keyBtn(k, "phone")); });
    kbEl.appendChild(r);
  }

  function renderPhoneAbc() {
    kbEl.innerHTML = "";
    var caps = state.capsLock;
    if (state.abcNums) {
      renderPhoneKeys("1234567890".split("").map(function(c){return phoneKey(c,c);}), "repeat(10,1fr)");
      renderPhoneKeys(["@","#","$","%","&","*","-","+","(",")"].map(function(c){return phoneKey(c,c);}), "repeat(10,1fr)");
      renderPhoneKeys(["!","\"","'",":",";","/", "?", ",", ".", "_"].map(function(c){return phoneKey(c,c);}), "repeat(10,1fr)");
      var r = document.createElement("div");
      r.className = "row";
      r.style.gridTemplateColumns = "1.2fr 1.2fr 3fr 1.2fr 1.2fr";
      r.appendChild(phoneBtn("ABC", "__nums__", "phone-fn"));
      r.appendChild(phoneBtn("⌫", "__del__", "phone-fn"));
      r.appendChild(phoneBtn("space", "__space__", "phone-fn"));
      r.appendChild(phoneBtn(".", ".", "phone"));
      r.appendChild(phoneBtn("⏎", "__enter_sbc__", "phone-fn"));
      kbEl.appendChild(r);
      return;
    }
    function letters(arr) {
      return arr.map(function (ch) {
        var L = caps ? ch.toUpperCase() : ch;
        return phoneKey(L, L);
      });
    }
    renderPhoneKeys(letters("qwertyuiop".split("")), "repeat(10,1fr)");
    renderPhoneKeys(letters("asdfghjkl".split("")), "repeat(9,1fr)");
    var r3 = document.createElement("div");
    r3.className = "row";
    r3.style.gridTemplateColumns = "1.4fr repeat(7,1fr) 1.4fr";
    r3.appendChild(phoneBtn(caps ? "CAPS" : "caps", "__caps__", "phone-fn" + (caps ? " caps-on" : "")));
    letters("zxcvbnm".split("")).forEach(function (k) { r3.appendChild(keyBtn(k, "phone")); });
    r3.appendChild(phoneBtn("⌫", "__del__", "phone-fn"));
    kbEl.appendChild(r3);
    var r4 = document.createElement("div");
    r4.className = "row";
    r4.style.gridTemplateColumns = "1.4fr 3.4fr 1.2fr 1.4fr";
    r4.appendChild(phoneBtn("123", "__nums__", "phone-fn"));
    r4.appendChild(phoneBtn("space", "__space__", "phone-fn"));
    r4.appendChild(phoneBtn(".", ".", "phone"));
    r4.appendChild(phoneBtn("⏎", "__enter_sbc__", "phone-fn"));
    kbEl.appendChild(r4);
  }

  function renderKb() {
    kbEl.innerHTML = "";
    if (state.abcMode) { renderPhoneAbc(); return; }
    renderRow(baseStructure);
    renderRow(baseOperators);
    renderRow(baseDigits);
    renderRow(baseVars);
    var rows = tabs[state.tab] || [];
    rows.forEach(function (row, idx) {
      if (state.tab === "Trig" && idx === 0) renderRow(state.invMode ? trigInvRow : row);
      else renderRow(row);
    });
  }

  function renderActs() {
    actsEl.innerHTML = "";
    actions.forEach(function (k) {
      var el = document.createElement("div");
      el.className = "act";
      if (k.value === "__done__") el.classList.add("done");
      if (k.value === "__abc__" && state.abcMode) el.classList.add("mode-on");
      el.textContent = k.label;
      el.onmousedown = function (e) { e.preventDefault(); };
      el.onclick = function () { handleKey(k); };
      actsEl.appendChild(el);
    });
  }

  renderTabs();
  renderActs();
  renderKb();
  addLine(true);
  updateTargetUI();
  loadQuestion();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

    "    import pdfplumber\n",
    "\n",
    "def extract_chapter(pdf_path, start_page, end_page):\n",
    "    pages = []\n",
    "    with pdfplumber.open(pdf_path) as pdf:\n",
    "        last = min(end_page, len(pdf.pages))\n",
    "        for i in range(start_page - 1, last):\n",
    "            text = pdf.pages[i].extract_text() or \"\"\n",
    "            pages.append({\n",
    "                \"pdf_page\": i + 1,\n",
    "                \"char_count\": len(text),\n",
    "                \"text\": text,\n",
    "            })\n",
    "    return pages\n",
    "\n",
    "extracted_summary = []\n",
    "\n",
    "for _, row in manifest_df.iterrows():\n",
    "    if not bool(row[\"verified\"]):\n",
    "        print(f\"SKIP {row['year']}: not verified\")\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "\n",
    "    pdf_path = Path(row[\"path\"])\n",

    "\n",
    "    print(f\"Extracting {row['year']} pages {start_p}-{end_p} ...\")\n",

   "source": [
    "def split_question_blocks(text: str, year: int):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Split Mathematics diagnostic chapter into QUESTION blocks.\n",
    "    Keeps DBE grain as much as possible.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    # Normalise\n",
    "    t = text.replace(\"\\r\", \"\\n\")\n",
    "    t = re.sub(r\"[ \\t]+\", \" \", t)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Split on QUESTION headings\n",
    "    pattern = re.compile(\n",
    "        r\"(?=QUESTION\\s+\\d+\\s*[:\\-])\",\n",
    "        flags=re.IGNORECASE\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    parts = pattern.split(t)\n",
    "\n",
    "    rows = []\n",
    "    for part in parts:\n",
    "        part = part.strip()\n",
    "        if not part:\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "\n",
    "        m = re.match(\n",
    "            r\"QUESTION\\s+(\\d+)\\s*[:\\-]?\\s*(.*)\",\n",
    "            part,\n",
    "            flags=re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL\n",
    "        )\n",
    "        if not m:\n",
    "            # front matter / overview before first QUESTION\n",
    "            rows.append({\n",
    "                \"year\": year,\n",
    "                \"question_number\": None,\n",
    "                \"question_title\": \"OVERVIEW\",\n",
    "                \"block_text\": part[:5000],\n",
    "            })\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "\n",
    "        qn = int(m.group(1))\n",
    "        rest = m.group(2).strip()\n",
    "        title_line = rest.split(\"\\n\", 1)[0][:120].strip()\n",
    "\n",
    "        rows.append({\n",
    "            \"year\": year,\n",
    "            \"question_number\": qn,\n",
    "            \"question_title\": title_line,\n",
    "            \"block_text\": part[:12000],\n",
    "        })\n",
    "    return rows\n",
    "\n",
    "block_rows = []\n",
    "for _, row in chapters_df.iterrows():\n",
    "    block_rows.extend(split_question_blocks(row[\"full_text\"], int(row[\"year\"])))\n",
    "\n",
    "blocks_df = pd.DataFrame(block_rows)\n",
    "print(\"Blocks:\", len(blocks_df))\n",
    "display(blocks_df.head(20))"
   ]

   "source": [
    "def extract_performance(block_text: str):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Pull explicit percentage mentions near performance language.\n",
    "    Leave null if not explicit.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    if not isinstance(block_text, str):\n",
    "        return None, None\n",
    "\n",
    "    candidates = []\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Patterns like: average of 34%, average performance was 69%, obtained 41%\n",
    "    patterns = [\n",
    "        r\"average(?:\\s+performance)?(?:\\s+was|\\s+of)?\\s+(\\d{1,3})\\s*%\",\n",
    "        r\"obtained\\s+an\\s+average\\s+of\\s+(\\d{1,3})\\s*%\",\n",
    "        r\"average\\s+was\\s+(\\d{1,3})\\s*%\",\n",
    "        r\"performance\\s+was\\s+(\\d{1,3})\\s*%\",\n",
    "        r\"\\((\\d{1,3})%\\)\",\n",
    "    ]\n",
    "\n",
    "    for pat in patterns:\n",
    "        for m in re.finditer(pat, block_text, flags=re.IGNORECASE):\n",
    "            val = int(m.group(1))\n",
    "            if 0 <= val <= 100:\n",
    "                candidates.append(val)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if not candidates:\n",
    "        return None, None\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Keep unique values; if many, store all as list-string\n",
    "    uniq = sorted(set(candidates))\n",
    "    primary = uniq[0] if len(uniq) == 1 else None\n",
    "    return primary, \";\".join(map(str, uniq))\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "perf_rows = []\n",
    "for _, r in blocks_df.iterrows():\n",
    "    primary, all_vals = extract_performance(r[\"block_text\"])\n",
    "    perf_rows.append({\n",
    "        \"year\": r[\"year\"],\n",
    "        \"question_number\": r[\"question_number\"],\n",
    "        \"question_title\": r[\"question_title\"],\n",
    "        \"avg_performance_pct\": primary,\n",
    "        \"all_pct_mentions\": all_vals,\n",
    "        \"grain\": \"question\" if pd.notna(r[\"question_number\"]) else \"overview\",\n",
    "    })\n",
    "\n",
    "performance_df = pd.DataFrame(perf_rows)\n",
    "print(\"Performance rows:\", len(performance_df))\n",
    "print(\"With numeric avg:\", performance_df[\"avg_performance_pct\"].notna().sum())\n",
    "display(performance_df.head(25))"
   ]
