    "def _frac(num, den):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Reduce and format as 'a/b' or integer string.\"\"\"\n",
    "    if den == 0: return str(num)\n",
    "    if den < 0: num, den = -num, -den\n",
    "    g = 0\n",
    "    n, d = abs(num), abs(den)\n",
    "    while d: n, d = d, n % d\n",
    "    g = n\n",
    "    if g == 0: g = 1\n",
    "    return f\"{num//g}/{den//g}\" if den//g != 1 else str(num//g)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _shared_q6(rng):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Looser: allow fractional m_tangent. Prefer integer where possible.\"\"\"\n",
    "    for _ in range(20000):\n",
    "        a = rng.choice([-2, -1, 1, 2])\n",
    "        xa = rng.choice([-4, -3, -2, -1])\n",
    "        xc = rng.choice([2, 3, 4, 5])\n",
    "        for yc in (-12, -9, -6, -3, 3, 6, 9, 12):\n",
    "            dx = xc - xa\n",
    "            if yc % dx != 0:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            m = yc // dx\n",
    "            if abs(m) > 4 or m == 0:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            c = -m * xa\n",
    "            for p in range(-5, 6):\n",
    "                if p == 0: continue\n",
    "                D = xc + xa - 2 * p\n",
    "                if D == 0: continue\n",
    "                denom = dx * D\n",
    "                if yc % denom != 0: continue\n",
    "                a_cand = yc // denom\n",
    "                if a_cand not in (-2, -1, 1, 2): continue\n",
    "                q = -a_cand * (xa - p) ** 2\n",
    "                if abs(q) > 12: continue\n",
    "                xm = (xa + xc) / 2\n",
    "                eh_max = abs(a_cand * (xm - xa) * (xm - xc))\n",
    "                # m_tangent as fraction (may not be integer)\n",
    "                denom_M = 4 * a_cand * m\n",
    "                if denom_M == 0: continue\n",
    "                num_M = m*m + 4*a_cand*m*p - 4*a_cand*q + 4*a_cand*c\n",
    "                m_disp = _frac(num_M, denom_M)\n",
    "                return {\n",
    "                    \"a\": int(a_cand), \"p\": int(p), \"q\": int(q),\n",
    "                    \"m\": int(m), \"c\": int(c),\n",
    "                    \"xa\": int(xa), \"xc\": int(xc), \"yc\": int(yc),\n",
    "                    \"xm\": xm, \"eh_max\": eh_max,\n",
    "                    \"m_tangent_num\": num_M, \"m_tangent_den\": denom_M,\n",
    "                    \"m_disp\": m_disp,\n",
    "                }\n",
    "    return None\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _f_disp_parabola(a, p, q):\n",
    "    head = \"\" if a == 1 else (\"-\" if a == -1 else f\"{a}\")\n",
    "    inner = f\"(x + {abs(p)})\" if p < 0 else (f\"(x - {p})\" if p != 0 else \"(x)\")\n",
    "    return f\"{head}{inner}^2\" + (\" \" + tj._human(q) if q != 0 else \"\")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _g_disp_line(m, c):\n",
    "    head = \"x\" if m == 1 else (\"-x\" if m == -1 else f\"{m}x\")\n",
    "    if c == 0: return head\n",
    "    return f\"{head} {tj._human(c)}\"\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _q6_stem(s):\n",
    "    return (\"In the diagram below, the graphs of f(x) = \"\n",
    "            + _f_disp_parabola(s[\"a\"], s[\"p\"], s[\"q\"])\n",
    "            + \" and g(x) = \" + _g_disp_line(s[\"m\"], s[\"c\"])\n",
    "            + f\", a straight line, are drawn. C({s['xc']}; {s['yc']}) \"\n",
    "            + \"is a point of intersection of f and g. EH is drawn parallel to \"\n",
    "            + \"the y-axis, with E a point on f and H on g.\")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _q6_sub_1(s):\n",
    "    return (f\"Calculate the coordinates of B, the turning point of f.\",\n",
    "            f\"B({s['p']}; {s['q']})\",\n",
    "            [f\"For f(x) = a(x - p)^2 + q the turning point is (p; q).\",\n",
    "             f\"p = {s['p']}, q = {s['q']}.\",\n",
    "             f\"B({s['p']}; {s['q']})\"])\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _q6_sub_2(s):\n",
    "    g_disp = _g_disp_line(s[\"m\"], s[\"c\"])\n",
    "    return (f\"Show that the equation of the line through A and C is g(x) = {g_disp}.\",\n",
    "            f\"g(x) = {g_disp}\",\n",
    "            [f\"A is the x-intercept of f on the left: A({s['xa']}; 0).\",\n",
    "             f\"m = (y_C - y_A)/(x_C - x_A) = ({s['yc']} - 0)/({s['xc']} - ({s['xa']})) = {s['m']}\",\n",
    "             f\"Substitute C({s['xc']}; {s['yc']}): {s['yc']} = ({s['m']})({s['xc']}) + c\",\n",
    "             f\"c = {s['c']}\",\n",
    "             f\"g(x) = {g_disp}\"])\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _q6_sub_3(s):\n",
    "    eh = s[\"eh_max\"]\n",
    "    eh_disp = int(eh) if eh == int(eh) else round(eh, 2)\n",
    "    xm = s[\"xm\"]\n",
    "    xm_disp = int(xm) if xm == int(xm) else xm\n",
    "    return (f\"Calculate the maximum length of EH for f > g.\",\n",
    "            f\"EH_max = {eh_disp} units\",\n",
    "            [f\"EH(x) = f(x) - g(x)\",\n",
    "             f\"EH(x) has zeros at the intersections x = {s['xa']} and x = {s['xc']}.\",\n",
    "             f\"EH is a parabola; maximum at its vertex.\",\n",
    "             f\"Maximum at x = ({s['xa']} + {s['xc']})/2 = {xm_disp}.\",\n",
    "             f\"EH({xm_disp}) = {eh_disp}\"])\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _q6_sub_4(s):\n",
    "    a, p, q = s[\"a\"], s[\"p\"], s[\"q\"]\n",
    "    # M is not fixed; we express k in terms of x with m unknown as parameter,\n",
    "    # but for the stem display we just write k(x) = f(x + m).\n",
    "    return (f\"Determine the value of m such that g is a tangent to k(x) = f(x + m).\",\n",
    "            f\"m = {s['m_disp']}\",\n",
    "            [f\"k(x) = f(x + m) = {a}(x + m - {p})^2 {tj._human(q)}\",\n",
    "             f\"Set k(x) = g(x): {a}(x + m - {p})^2 {tj._human(q)} = {s['m']}x {tj._human(s['c'])}\",\n",
    "             f\"Expand and collect terms.\",\n",
    "             f\"Set discriminant = 0 for tangency.\",\n",
    "             f\"Solve for m: m = {s['m_disp']}\"])\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def jitter_q6(template, seed):\n",
    "    rng = random.Random(seed)\n",

    "        elif sq[\"n\"] == \"6.4\": prompt, expected, steps = _q6_sub_4(s)\n",
    "        else: continue\n",
    "        filled[\"subquestions\"].append({\n",
    "            \"n\": sq[\"n\"], \"prompt\": prompt, \"expected\": expected,\n",
    "            \"steps\": steps, \"marks\": sq[\"marks\"],\n",
    "            \"skill_id\": sq[\"skill_id\"], \"params\": s})\n",
    "    filled[\"total_marks\"] = sum(x[\"marks\"] for x in filled[\"subquestions\"])\n",
    "    return filled\n",

    "def _shared_q11(rng):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Pick 3-circle Venn parameters. Track all region counts.\"\"\"\n",
    "    for _ in range(2000):\n",
    "        # region counts (all non-negative integers)\n",
    "        only_M     = rng.choice([8, 10, 12])\n",
    "        only_T     = rng.choice([5, 6, 7])\n",
    "        only_G     = rng.choice([6, 7, 8])\n",
    "        MT_only    = rng.choice([4, 5])\n",
    "        MG_only    = rng.choice([3, 4])\n",
    "        TG_only    = rng.choice([2, 3])\n",
    "        all_three  = rng.choice([1, 2, 3])\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Totals (as they'd appear in the question text)\n",
    "        M_total = only_M + MT_only + MG_only + all_three\n",
    "        T_total = only_T + MT_only + TG_only + all_three\n",
    "        G_total = only_G + MG_only + TG_only + all_three\n",
    "        total = only_M + only_T + only_G + MT_only + MG_only + TG_only + all_three\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Basic sanity\n",
    "        if total > 60 or total < 30:\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "        # \"At least 2 subjects\" count\n",
    "        at_least_2 = MT_only + MG_only + TG_only + all_three\n",
    "        p_at_least_2_num = at_least_2\n",
    "        p_at_least_2_den = total\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Independence test for M and T\n",
    "        pM_num, pM_den = M_total, total\n",
    "        pT_num, pT_den = T_total, total\n",
    "        # P(M and T) = (MT_only + all_three) / total\n",
    "        pMT_num = MT_only + all_three\n",
    "        pMT_den = total\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Compare P(M)*P(T) to P(M and T)\n",
    "        lhs_num = pM_num * pT_num\n",
    "        lhs_den = pM_den * pT_den\n",
    "        # Are they equal? (rarely, but occasionally happens)\n",
    "        equal = lhs_num * pMT_den == pMT_num * lhs_den\n",
    "\n",
    "        return {\n",
    "            \"only_M\": only_M, \"only_T\": only_T, \"only_G\": only_G,\n",
    "            \"MT_only\": MT_only, \"MG_only\": MG_only, \"TG_only\": TG_only,\n",

    "def _simp(num, den):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Simplify and format as 'a/b' or 'a'.\"\"\"\n",
    "    if den == 0: return str(num)\n",
    "    if den < 0: num, den = -num, -den\n",
    "    g = math.gcd(abs(num), abs(den)) or 1\n",
    "    num, den = num // g, den // g\n",
    "    return str(num) if den == 1 else f\"{num}/{den}\"\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _shared_q11(rng):\n",
    "    for _ in range(2000):\n",
    "        only_M = rng.choice([8, 10, 12])\n",
    "        only_T = rng.choice([5, 6, 7])\n",
    "        only_G = rng.choice([6, 7, 8])\n",
    "        MT_only = rng.choice([4, 5])\n",
    "        MG_only = rng.choice([3, 4])\n",
    "        TG_only = rng.choice([2, 3])\n",
    "        all_three = rng.choice([1, 2, 3])\n",
    "        M_total = only_M + MT_only + MG_only + all_three\n",
    "        T_total = only_T + MT_only + TG_only + all_three\n",
    "        G_total = only_G + MG_only + TG_only + all_three\n",
    "        total = only_M + only_T + only_G + MT_only + MG_only + TG_only + all_three\n",
    "        if total > 60 or total < 30: continue\n",
    "        at_least_2 = MT_only + MG_only + TG_only + all_three\n",
    "        # Simplification\n",
    "        p_at_least_2 = _simp(at_least_2, total)\n",
    "        pM = _simp(M_total, total)\n",
    "        pT = _simp(T_total, total)\n",
    "        pMT = _simp(MT_only + all_three, total)\n",
    "        prod = _simp(M_total * T_total, total * total)\n",
    "        # Independence check\n",
    "        eq = (M_total * T_total) * total == (MT_only + all_three) * (total * total)\n",
    "        return {\n",
    "            \"only_M\": only_M, \"only_T\": only_T, \"only_G\": only_G,\n",
    "            \"MT_only\": MT_only, \"MG_only\": MG_only, \"TG_only\": TG_only,\n",
    "            \"all_three\": all_three,\n",
    "            \"M_total\": M_total, \"T_total\": T_total, \"G_total\": G_total,\n",
    "            \"total\": total, \"at_least_2\": at_least_2,\n",
    "            \"p_at_least_2\": p_at_least_2,\n",
    "            \"pM\": pM, \"pT\": pT, \"pMT\": pMT, \"prod\": prod,\n",
    "            \"independent\": eq,\n",
    "        }\n",
    "    return None\n",

    "\n",
    "def _shared_2025_q4(rng):\n",
    "    \"\"\"f(x) = log_(1/base) x, x_pt on curve.\"\"\"\n",
    "    base = rng.choice([2, 3, 4])\n",
    "    x_pt = rng.choice([3, 4])\n",
    "    return {\"base\": base, \"x_pt\": x_pt,\n",
    "            \"y_pt_num\": base**0, \"y_pt\": None}  # placeholder\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _shared_2025_q5(rng):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Parabola + hyperbola composed. Simple version:\n",
    "       f(x) = a(x-p)^2 + q meets g(x) = -4/(x-3) + 8.\n",
    "       Turning point = (3; 8), D(5; 6) on f.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    # Fix the hyperbola part, vary the parabola\n",
    "    # f(x) = a(x-3)^2 + 8 with f(5) = 6\n",
    "    # 6 = a(2)^2 + 8  => 4a = -2 => a = -1/2\n",
    "    # The 2025 question is fixed shape; we can vary the \"given\" point D.\n",
    "    x_D = rng.choice([4, 5])\n",
    "    y_D = rng.choice([6, 7])\n",
    "    # Solve a(3)^2 style: f(x_D) = a(x_D - 3)^2 + 8 = y_D\n",
    "    a_num = (y_D - 8)\n",
    "    a_den = (x_D - 3) ** 2\n",
    "    if a_num % a_den != 0 or a_num == 0:\n",
    "        return None\n",
    "    a = a_num // a_den\n",
    "    if a not in (-2, -1, 1, 2):\n",
    "        return None\n",
    "    return {\"a\": a, \"p\": 3, \"q\": 8, \"x_D\": x_D, \"y_D\": y_D,\n",
    "            \"hyp_a\": -4, \"hyp_p\": -3, \"hyp_q\": 8}\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _shared_2025_q6(rng):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Hyperbola + line. f(x) = a/(x+p) + q, g(x) = x + c.\"\"\"\n",
    "    # Simple example: hyperbola with vertical asymptote at x = 1 (so p = -1)\n",
    "    # and horizontal asymptote at y = -2 (so q = -2)\n",
    "    p = rng.choice([-2, -1, 1, 2])\n",
    "    q = rng.choice([-3, -2, -1, 1, 2, 3])\n",
    "    a = rng.choice([-4, -3, -2, 2, 3, 4])\n",
    "    # Line g(x) = x + c intersects the vertical asymptote at x = -p\n",
    "    # so c = -(-p) = p\n",
    "    c = p\n",
    "    return {\"a\": a, \"p\": p, \"q\": q, \"m\": 1, \"c\": c,\n",
    "            \"xa\": -1, \"xc\": 1}  # for the renderer\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _shared_2025_q9(rng):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Cubic with integer turning points, for the 2025 paper.\"\"\"\n",
    "    for _ in range(1000):\n",
    "        # f(x) = k3 x^3 + k2 x^2 + k1 x + k0\n",
    "        k3 = rng.choice([-2, -1, 1, 2])\n",
    "        xa = rng.choice([-3, -2, -1, 1, 2])\n",
    "        xb = rng.choice([1, 2, 3, 4, 5])\n",
    "        if xa == xb: continue\n",
    "        if xa > xb: xa, xb = xb, xa\n",
    "        if (xa + xb) % 2 != 0: continue\n",
    "        k0 = rng.choice([-8, -6, -4, -2, 0, 2, 4, 6, 8])\n",
    "        k3_lead = k3\n",
    "        k2_ = -(3 * k3_lead * (xa + xb)) // 2 if (3 * k3_lead * (xa + xb)) % 2 == 0 else None\n",
    "        if k2_ is None: continue\n",
    "        k2 = k2_\n",
    "        k1 = 3 * k3_lead * xa * xb\n",
    "        ya = k3_lead * xa**3 + k2 * xa**2 + k1 * xa + k0\n",
    "        yb = k3_lead * xb**3 + k2 * xb**2 + k1 * xb + k0\n",
    "        if ya != int(ya) or yb != int(yb): continue\n",
    "        if abs(ya) > 30 or abs(yb) > 30: continue\n",
    "        return {\"k3\": k3_lead, \"k2\": k2, \"k1\": k1, \"k0\": k0,\n",
    "                \"xa\": int(xa), \"ya\": int(ya), \"xb\": int(xb), \"yb\": int(yb),\n",
    "                \"yc\": k0}\n",
    "    return None\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _shared_2025_q10(rng):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Cylinder optimisation. V(x) = (25x^2 - x^3)/(4 pi).\"\"\"\n",
    "    return {\"x\": 50/3, \"h\": 25 - 50/3}\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _shared_2023_q4(rng):\n",
    "    \"\"\"f(x) = base^x - 4.\"\"\"\n",

    "    q = rng.choice([-4, -3, -2])\n",

    "    return {\"base\": base, \"q\": q, \"x_pt\": x_b, \"y_pt\": 0,\n",
    "            \"y_intercept\": 1 + q}\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _shared_2023_q5(rng):\n",

    "\n",

    "# Diagram dispatcher\n",

    "\n",
    "def _try_render_diagram(year, qnum, dtype, shared, seed):\n",

    "                shared[\"k3\"], shared[\"xa\"], shared[\"ya\"],\n",
    "                shared[\"xb\"], shared[\"yb\"], shared[\"yc\"], sig)\n",
    "        if dtype == \"cylinder\":\n",
    "            return qd.render_cylinder(shared[\"x\"], shared[\"h\"], sig)\n",
    "        if dtype == \"poster\":\n",
    "            return qd.render_poster(shared[\"x\"], shared[\"y_dim\"], sig)\n",
    "        if dtype == \"hyperbola_line\":\n",
    "            # Solo hyperbola shaped as before — no dedicated renderer for\n",
    "            # the composed version yet; reuse hyperbola solo\n",
    "            return qd.render_hyperbola_solo(\n",
    "                shared[\"a\"], shared[\"p\"], shared[\"q\"],\n",
    "                shared.get(\"yint\", shared[\"q\"]), sig)\n",
    "        if dtype == \"parabola_line\":\n",
    "            # For Q5 composed, use the parabola renderer with vertex/point\n",
    "            # Approximate: pass through turning point and one more point\n",
    "            return qd.render_parabola_line(\n",
    "                shared[\"a\"], shared[\"p\"], shared[\"q\"],\n",
    "                shared.get(\"m\", 1), shared.get(\"c\", 0),\n",
    "                shared.get(\"xa\", -2), shared.get(\"xc\", shared.get(\"x_D\", 4)),\n",
    "                sig)\n",
    "    except Exception as e:\n",
    "        print(f\"  render failed ({dtype}): {e}\")\n",
    "        return None\n",
    "    return None\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "# Smoke test: render each diagram-bearing template\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 72)\n",
    "print(\"Diagram smoke test\")\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 72)\n",
    "\n",
    "for (year, qnum), shared_fn in sorted(SHARED_Q.items()):\n",
    "    p = TEMPLATE_DIR / f\"template_{year}_P1_Q{qnum}.json\"\n",
    "    if not p.exists():\n",
    "        print(f\"  {p.name}: MISSING\"); continue\n",
    "    t = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n",
    "    dtype = t.get(\"diagram\")\n",
    "    if not dtype:\n",
    "        print(f\"  {p.name}: no diagram field\"); continue\n",
    "    rng = random.Random(year * 100 + int(qnum))\n",
    "    shared = shared_fn(rng)\n",
    "    if shared is None:\n",
    "        print(f\"  {p.name}: shared params failed\"); continue\n",
    "    dpath = _try_render_diagram(year, qnum, dtype, shared, seed=1)\n",
    "    if dpath:\n",
    "        dp = Path(dpath)\n",
    "        exists = dp.exists()\n",
    "        size = dp.stat().st_size if exists else 0\n",
    "        print(f\"  {p.name}  [{dtype}]  size={size} bytes  {'OK' if exists else 'FAIL'}\")\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        print(f\"  {p.name}  [{dtype}]  render returned None\")"
   ]

    "def render_parabola_hyperbola(a_par, p_par, q_par, a_hyp, p_hyp, q_hyp, sig,\n",
    "                               x_par_range=None):\n",
    "    \"\"\"f(x) = a_par (x - p_par)^2 + q_par and g(x) = a_hyp/(x + p_hyp) + q_hyp.\n",
    "\n",
    "    The two curves intersect where f(x) = g(x); we draw both across a window\n",
    "    that shows the interesting region.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    lim = 10\n",
    "    fig, ax = _setup_plane(lim)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # --- Parabola ---\n",
    "    xs = np.linspace(-lim, lim, 700)\n",
    "    ys = a_par * (xs - p_par) ** 2 + q_par\n",
    "    mask = (ys >= -lim) & (ys <= lim)\n",
    "    if mask.any():\n",
    "        ax.plot(xs[mask], ys[mask], color=\"black\", lw=1.5, zorder=3)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # --- Hyperbola: vertical asymptote at x = -p_hyp ---\n",
    "    vert = -p_hyp\n",
    "    # dotted asymptotes\n",
    "    ax.plot([vert, vert], [-lim, lim], color=\"black\",\n",
    "            linestyle=(0, (1, 3)), lw=0.9, zorder=1)\n",
    "    ax.plot([-lim, lim], [q_hyp, q_hyp], color=\"black\",\n",
    "            linestyle=(0, (1, 3)), lw=0.9, zorder=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "    eps = 0.06; step = 0.02\n",
    "    xs_left = np.arange(-lim, vert - eps, step)\n",
    "    ys_left = a_hyp / (xs_left + p_hyp) + q_hyp\n",
    "    m_l = (ys_left >= -lim) & (ys_left <= lim)\n",
    "    if m_l.any():\n",
    "        ax.plot(xs_left[m_l], ys_left[m_l], color=\"black\", lw=1.5, zorder=3)\n",

    "    ys_right = a_hyp / (xs_right + p_hyp) + q_hyp\n",

    "    return str(path)\n",

    "def render_exponential_two_points(base, q, sig):\n",

    "def render_hyperbola_line(a, p, q, m, c, sig):\n",
    "    \"\"\"f(x) = a/(x+p) + q and straight line g(x) = mx + c.\n",
    "       Line passes through the origin in the typical 2014 shape.\"\"\"\n",
    "    lim = 10\n",
    "    fig, ax = _setup_plane(lim)\n",
    "\n",
    "    vert = -p\n",
    "    # Asymptotes\n",
    "    ax.plot([vert, vert], [-lim, lim], color=\"black\",\n",
    "            linestyle=(0, (1, 3)), lw=0.9, zorder=1)\n",
    "    ax.plot([-lim, lim], [q, q], color=\"black\",\n",
    "            linestyle=(0, (1, 3)), lw=0.9, zorder=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Hyperbola branches\n",
    "    eps = 0.06; step = 0.02\n",
    "    xs_left = np.arange(-lim, vert - eps, step)\n",
    "    ys_left = a / (xs_left + p) + q\n",
    "    mask = (ys_left >= -lim) & (ys_left <= lim)\n",
    "    if mask.any():\n",
    "        ax.plot(xs_left[mask], ys_left[mask], color=\"black\", lw=1.5, zorder=3)\n",
    "    xs_right = np.arange(vert + eps, lim, step)\n",
    "    ys_right = a / (xs_right + p) + q\n",
    "    mask = (ys_right >= -lim) & (ys_right <= lim)\n",
    "    if mask.any():\n",
    "        ax.plot(xs_right[mask], ys_right[mask], color=\"black\", lw=1.5, zorder=3)\n",
    "\n",

    "    xs_line = np.array([-lim, lim])\n",
    "    ys_line = m * xs_line + c\n",

    "import json\n",
    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "from collections import Counter, defaultdict\n",
    "\n",
    "TEMPLATE_DIR = ROOT / \"data\" / \"processed\" / \"tutor\" / \"question_templates\"\n",
    "\n",
    "# Aggregate subquestion counts per skill_id, per topic, per year\n",
    "skill_counts = Counter()\n",
    "skill_by_year = defaultdict(Counter)\n",
    "topic_counts = Counter()\n",
    "topic_by_year = defaultdict(Counter)\n",
    "\n",
    "for p in sorted(TEMPLATE_DIR.glob(\"template_*.json\")):\n",
    "    year = int(p.name.split(\"_\")[1])\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        t = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n",
    "    except Exception:\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "    for sq in t.get(\"subquestions\", []):\n",
    "        sid = sq.get(\"skill_id\", \"unknown\")\n",
    "        # Topic = first segment of skill_id\n",
    "        topic = sid.split(\".\")[0] if \".\" in sid else sid\n",
    "        skill_counts[sid] += 1\n",
    "        skill_by_year[sid][year] += 1\n",
    "        topic_counts[topic] += 1\n",
    "        topic_by_year[topic][year] += 1\n",
    "\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "# Report: total subquestions, per topic\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "total = sum(skill_counts.values())\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 72)\n",
    "print(f\"Total subquestions across all templates: {total}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Distinct skill_ids: {len(skill_counts)}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Distinct topics: {len(topic_counts)}\")\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 72)\n",
    "print()\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"=== Subquestions per TOPIC ===\")\n",
    "print()\n",
    "for topic, n in topic_counts.most_common():\n",
    "    years_present = sorted(topic_by_year[topic].keys())\n",
    "    print(f\"  {topic:30s}  {n:4d}  (years: {years_present[0]}–{years_present[-1]})\")\n",
    "print()\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "# Per-topic breakdown\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 72)\n",

    "print(\"=\" * 72)\n",
    "\n",
    "TOPIC_LABELS = {\n",

    "def _widen_int_list(vals, factor):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Extend an int list to roughly factor× size, avoiding 0 unless present.\"\"\"\n",
    "    if len(vals) == 0 or factor <= 1:\n",
    "        return vals\n",
    "    if not all(isinstance(v, int) for v in vals):\n",

    "    step = 1\n",
    "    while len(new_vals) < target and step < 60:\n",

    "        if up <= cap_hi:\n",
    "            new_vals.add(up)\n",
    "        down = lo - step\n",

    "            new_vals.add(down)\n",
    "        step += 1\n",
    "    if not had_zero:\n",
    "        new_vals.discard(0)\n",
    "    return sorted(new_vals)\n",

    "TARGET = 30\n",
    "widened = 0\n",
    "untouched = 0\n",
    "\n",
    "for sid, locs in subq_locations.items():\n",
    "    current = before_counts[sid]\n",
    "    if current >= TARGET:\n",
    "        untouched += 1\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "    n_subq = len(locs)\n",
    "    # Target variants per subquestion so the skill total reaches ≥ TARGET\n",
    "    per_subq_target = math.ceil(TARGET / n_subq)\n",
    "    # Each subquestion's current variant count\n",
    "    for path, i in locs:\n",
    "        t = templates[path]\n",
    "        sq = t[\"subquestions\"][i]\n",
    "        ranges = sq.get(\"ranges\", {}) or {}\n",
    "        if not ranges:\n",
    "            continue  # deterministic question, skip\n",
    "        current_sub = _subq_variant_count(sq)\n",
    "        if current_sub >= per_subq_target:\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "        # Factor required\n",
    "        factor = math.ceil(per_subq_target / max(current_sub, 1))\n",
    "        new_ranges = {}\n",
    "        for k, v in ranges.items():\n",
    "            new_ranges[k] = _widen_int_list(v, factor)\n",
    "        sq[\"ranges\"] = new_ranges\n",
    "        widened += 1\n",
    "\n",
    "print()\n",
    "print(f\"Widened {widened} subquestions across {len(subq_locations) - untouched} skills\")\n",
    "print(f\"Left untouched {untouched} skills already at or above {TARGET} variants\")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "# 5. Save all templates back\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "for path, t in templates.items():\n",
    "    path.write_text(json.dumps(t, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Saved {len(templates)} templates\")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "# 6. Re-count after widening\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "after_counts, _ = _count_by_skill()\n",
    "\n",
    "print()\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 72)\n",
    "print(f\"AFTER widening — {len(after_counts)} skills\")\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 72)\n",
    "for sid in sorted(after_counts):\n",
    "    n = after_counts[sid]\n",
    "    was = before_counts.get(sid, 0)\n",
    "    delta = n - was\n",
    "    dstr = f\" (+{delta})\" if delta > 0 else \"\"\n",
    "    bar = \"█\" * min(n, 40)\n",
    "    print(f\"  {sid:50s} {n:4d}{dstr:>8s}  {bar}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print()\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 72)\n",
    "print(\"Summary\")\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 72)\n",
    "total_before = sum(before_counts.values())\n",
    "total_after = sum(after_counts.values())\n",
    "print(f\"  Total subquestion-variant slots before: {total_before}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  Total subquestion-variant slots after:  {total_after}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  Growth factor:                          {total_after/max(total_before,1):.2f}×\")\n",
    "print()\n",
    "under_30 = [s for s, n in after_counts.items() if n < 30]\n",
    "if under_30:\n",
    "    print(f\"  Still under 30 variants ({len(under_30)} skills):\")\n",
    "    for s in under_30:\n",
    "        print(f\"    {s:50s}  {after_counts[s]}\")\n",
    "else:\n",
    "    print(\"  All skills now have ≥30 variants.\")"
   ]

    "    # Euclidean\n",
    "    \"euclidean.similarity.ratio\":       {\"shift\": [1, 2, 3]},\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "# Variant counting\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "\n",
    "def _subq_variants(sq):\n",
    "    ranges = sq.get(\"ranges\", {}) or {}\n",
    "    n = 1\n",
    "    for v in ranges.values():\n",
    "        n *= max(len(v), 1)\n",
    "    return n\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _skill_totals():\n",
    "    counts = defaultdict(int)\n",
    "    for t in templates.values():\n",
    "        for sq in t.get(\"subquestions\", []):\n",
    "            counts[sq.get(\"skill_id\", \"unknown\")] += _subq_variants(sq)\n",
    "    return counts\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "# Strategy: bring every skill up to at least 30, cap at ~60\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "\n",
    "TARGET_MIN = 30\n",
    "TARGET_MAX = 60\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _add_default_range(sq, sid):\n",
    "    \"\"\"If sq has no ranges, add one from EMPTY_RANGE_HINTS.\"\"\"\n",
    "    if sq.get(\"ranges\"):\n",
    "        return False\n",
    "    hint = EMPTY_RANGE_HINTS.get(sid)\n",
    "    if hint:\n",
    "        sq[\"ranges\"] = hint\n",
    "        return True\n",
    "    return False\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _widen_ranges_to(sq, factor):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Multiply each int range by factor without exceeding a per-range cap.\"\"\"\n",
    "    ranges = sq.get(\"ranges\", {}) or {}\n",
    "    new = {}\n",
    "    for k, v in ranges.items():\n",
    "        if not all(isinstance(x, int) for x in v):\n",
    "            new[k] = v\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "        if len(v) == 0:\n",
    "            new[k] = v\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "        target_len = min(len(v) * factor, 15)  # cap each range at 15 values\n",
    "        if len(v) >= target_len:\n",
    "            new[k] = v\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "        had_zero = 0 in v\n",
    "        s = set(v)\n",
    "        lo, hi = min(v), max(v)\n",
    "        step = 1\n",
    "        while len(s) < target_len and step < 30:\n",
    "            up = hi + step\n",
    "            if up <= 50:\n",
    "                s.add(up)\n",
    "            down = lo - step\n",
    "            if down >= -30:\n",
    "                s.add(down)\n",
    "            step += 1\n",
    "        if not had_zero:\n",
    "            s.discard(0)\n",
    "        new[k] = sorted(s)\n",
    "    sq[\"ranges\"] = new\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ---- Pass 1: add default ranges to empty subquestions in under-30 skills ----\n",
    "current = _skill_totals()\n",
    "added_ranges = 0\n",
    "for sid, n in current.items():\n",
    "    if n >= TARGET_MIN:\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "    for t in templates.values():\n",
    "        for sq in t.get(\"subquestions\", []):\n",
    "            if sq.get(\"skill_id\") != sid:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            if _add_default_range(sq, sid):\n",
    "                added_ranges += 1\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Added default ranges to {added_ranges} subquestions\")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ---- Pass 2: repeatedly widen until skill hits TARGET_MIN (or can't) ----\n",
    "for _ in range(8):\n",
    "    current = _skill_totals()\n",
    "    under = {sid: n for sid, n in current.items() if n < TARGET_MIN}\n",
    "    if not under:\n",
    "        break\n",
    "    changed = False\n",
    "    for sid, n in under.items():\n",
    "        needed = TARGET_MIN / max(n, 1)\n",
    "        # Per-subquestion factor (n_subq) — use subq total to split the load\n",
    "        n_subq = sum(1 for t in templates.values()\n",
    "                     for sq in t.get(\"subquestions\", [])\n",
    "                     if sq.get(\"skill_id\") == sid)\n",
    "        if n_subq == 0:\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "        # Each subq needs to multiply by roughly needed^(1/1)... keep it simple\n",
    "        factor = max(2, math.ceil(needed))\n",
    "        for t in templates.values():\n",
    "            for sq in t.get(\"subquestions\", []):\n",
    "                if sq.get(\"skill_id\") != sid:\n",
    "                    continue\n",
    "                _widen_ranges_to(sq, factor)\n",
    "                changed = True\n",
    "    if not changed:\n",
    "        break\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ---- Pass 3: cap skills that blew up past TARGET_MAX ----\n",
    "final = _skill_totals()\n",
    "capped = 0\n",
    "for sid, n in final.items():\n",
    "    if n <= TARGET_MAX:\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "    # Shrink each subquestion's ranges until total fits\n",
    "    target_factor = TARGET_MAX / n\n",
    "    for t in templates.values():\n",
    "        for sq in t.get(\"subquestions\", []):\n",
    "            if sq.get(\"skill_id\") != sid:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            ranges = sq.get(\"ranges\", {}) or {}\n",
    "            new = {}\n",
    "            for k, v in ranges.items():\n",
    "                if all(isinstance(x, int) for x in v) and len(v) > 1:\n",
    "                    new_len = max(2, int(len(v) * target_factor))\n",
    "                    new[k] = v[:new_len]\n",
    "                else:\n",
    "                    new[k] = v\n",
    "            sq[\"ranges\"] = new\n",
    "            capped += 1\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "# Save and report\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "for path, t in templates.items():\n",
    "    path.write_text(json.dumps(t, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Saved {len(templates)} templates\")\n",
    "\n",
    "final = _skill_totals()\n",
    "print()\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 72)\n",
    "print(\"FINAL — variant slots per skill\")\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 72)\n",
    "for sid in sorted(final.keys()):\n",
    "    n = final[sid]\n",
    "    bar = \"█\" * min(n, 60)\n",
    "    flag = \"\"\n",
    "    if n < TARGET_MIN:\n",
    "        flag = \"  ⚠ under 30\"\n",
    "    elif n > TARGET_MAX:\n",
    "        flag = \"  ↑ above 60\"\n",
    "    print(f\"  {sid:50s} {n:4d}  {bar}{flag}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print()\n",
    "under_30 = [s for s, n in final.items() if n < TARGET_MIN]\n",
    "over_60 = [s for s, n in final.items() if n > TARGET_MAX]\n",
    "print(f\"Total skills: {len(final)}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  >= 30 variants: {len(final) - len(under_30)}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  < 30 variants:  {len(under_30)}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  > 60 variants:  {len(over_60)}\")\n",
    "print()\n",
    "if under_30:\n",
    "    print(\"Skills still under 30:\")\n",
    "    for s in under_30:\n",
    "        print(f\"  {s:50s}  {final[s]}\")\n",
    "print()\n",
    "print(f\"Total variant slots: {sum(final.values())}\")"
   ]

    "import json, random, re\n",
    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "\n",
    "TEMPLATE_DIR = ROOT / \"data\" / \"processed\" / \"tutor\" / \"question_templates\"\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _fill(template_str, params):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Try to fill {placeholders}. Leave unknown placeholders as-is.\"\"\"\n",
    "    class SafeDict(dict):\n",
    "        def __missing__(self, key):\n",
    "            return \"{\" + key + \"}\"\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        return template_str.format_map(SafeDict(params))\n",
    "    except Exception as e:\n",
    "        return f\"(fill error: {e})\"\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def show_skill_variants(skill_id, n_variants=5, seed=1):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Find every subquestion for this skill, generate n_variants for each.\"\"\"\n",
    "    rng = random.Random(seed)\n",
    "    matches = []  # (template_path, subquestion)\n",
    "    for p in sorted(TEMPLATE_DIR.glob(\"template_*.json\")):\n",
    "        t = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n",
    "        for sq in t.get(\"subquestions\", []):\n",
    "            if sq.get(\"skill_id\") == skill_id:\n",
    "                matches.append((p.name, t.get(\"stem\", \"\"), sq))\n",
    "\n",
    "    if not matches:\n",
    "        print(f\"  (no templates use {skill_id})\")\n",
    "        return\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(\"=\" * 72)\n",
    "    print(f\"SKILL: {skill_id}\")\n",
    "    print(f\"Templates using it: {len(matches)}\")\n",
    "    for pname, _, _ in matches:\n",
    "        print(f\"  - {pname}\")\n",
    "    print(\"=\" * 72)\n",
    "\n",
    "    for pname, stem, sq in matches[:3]:  # show first 3 templates\n",
    "        print()\n",
    "        print(f\"  ── {pname}  ({sq['n']}) ──\")\n",
    "        if stem:\n",
    "            print(f\"  Stem: {stem[:90]}\")\n",
    "        ranges = sq.get(\"ranges\", {}) or {}\n",
    "        print(f\"  Ranges: {ranges}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"  Prompt template: {sq['prompt_template']}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"  Expected template: {sq['expected_fn']}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"  → {n_variants} variants:\")\n",
    "        for _ in range(n_variants):\n",
    "            params = {k: rng.choice(v) for k, v in ranges.items() if v}\n",
    "            prompt = _fill(sq[\"prompt_template\"], params)\n",
    "            expected = _fill(sq[\"expected_fn\"], params)\n",
    "            print(f\"      params={params}\")\n",
    "            print(f\"      Q: {prompt}\")\n",
    "            print(f\"      A: {expected}\")\n",
    "            print()\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Show several thin skills\n",
    "for sid in [\n",
    "    \"analytical.line\",\n",
    "    \"algebra.exponential.proof\",\n",
    "    \"probability.tree\",\n",
    "    \"functions.log.domain\",\n",
    "    \"functions.hyperbola.intercept\",\n",
    "    \"sequences.quadratic.term\",\n",
    "]:\n",
    "    show_skill_variants(sid, n_variants=3)"
   ]

    "# src/tutor/question_diagrams_p2.py\n",
    "# DBE-style renderers for Paper 2\n",
    "# Extends src/tutor/question_diagrams.py (P1 renderers stay untouched)\n",
    "\n",
    "import matplotlib\n",
    "matplotlib.use(\"Agg\")\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "from pathlib import Path\n",

    "# ============================================================\n",
    "# SHARED DBE STYLE\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "\n",
    "def _dbe_axes(ax, xlim, ylim, x_label=\"\", y_label=\"\", grid=False):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Standard DBE Cartesian plane: arrowheads on axes, minimal labels.\"\"\"\n",
    "    ax.set_xlim(*xlim)\n",
    "    ax.set_ylim(*ylim)\n",
    "    ax.set_aspect(\"equal\", adjustable=\"box\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Move spines to origin\n",
    "    ax.spines[\"left\"].set_position((\"data\", 0))\n",
    "    ax.spines[\"bottom\"].set_position((\"data\", 0))\n",
    "    ax.spines[\"right\"].set_visible(False)\n",
    "    ax.spines[\"top\"].set_visible(False)\n",
    "    ax.spines[\"left\"].set_linewidth(1.2)\n",
    "    ax.spines[\"bottom\"].set_linewidth(1.2)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Arrowheads\n",
    "    ax.plot(1, 0, \">k\", transform=ax.get_yaxis_transform(),\n",
    "            clip_on=False, markersize=6)\n",
    "    ax.plot(0, 1, \"^k\", transform=ax.get_xaxis_transform(),\n",
    "            clip_on=False, markersize=6)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if x_label:\n",
    "        ax.set_xlabel(x_label, loc=\"right\", fontsize=10)\n",
    "    if y_label:\n",
    "        ax.set_ylabel(y_label, loc=\"top\", fontsize=10)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if grid:\n",
    "        ax.grid(True, which=\"major\", color=\"lightgray\",\n",
    "                linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)\n",
    "\n",
    "    ax.tick_params(labelsize=8, direction=\"out\", length=3, width=0.8)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _point(ax, x, y, label=None, dx=0.15, dy=0.15, numbered=None, size=4):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Small filled dot at (x,y) with optional label placed at (x+dx, y+dy).\"\"\"\n",
    "    ax.plot(x, y, \"ko\", markersize=size)\n",
    "    if label:\n",
    "        if numbered:\n",
    "            ax.text(x + dx, y + dy, f\"{label}$_{numbered}$\",\n",
    "                    fontsize=10, ha=\"left\", va=\"bottom\")\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            ax.text(x + dx, y + dy, label,\n",
    "                    fontsize=10, ha=\"left\", va=\"bottom\")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _save(fig, out_path):\n",
    "    out_path = Path(out_path)\n",
    "    out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "    fig.savefig(out_path, dpi=150, bbox_inches=\"tight\", facecolor=\"white\")\n",
    "    plt.close(fig)\n",
    "    return str(out_path)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "# STATS RENDERERS\n",

    "def render_scatter_regression(points, a, b, xlim=None, ylim=None,\n",
    "                              x_label=\"\", y_label=\"\",\n",
    "                              grid=True, out_path=None):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Scatter plot with least squares regression line.\n",
    "    points: list of (x, y)\n",
    "    a, b:   regression line y = a + bx\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    points = np.array(points)\n",
    "    xs, ys = points[:, 0], points[:, 1]\n",
    "\n",
    "    if xlim is None:\n",
    "        xlim = (xs.min() * 0.9, xs.max() * 1.05)\n",
    "    if ylim is None:\n",
    "        ylim = (ys.min() * 0.9, ys.max() * 1.05)\n",
    "\n",
    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5))\n",
    "    _dbe_axes(ax, xlim, ylim, x_label, y_label, grid=grid)\n",
    "\n",
    "    ax.plot(xs, ys, \"ko\", markersize=5, zorder=3)\n",
    "\n",
    "    line_x = np.linspace(xlim[0], xlim[1], 100)\n",
    "    line_y = a + b * line_x\n",
    "    ax.plot(line_x, line_y, \"k-\", linewidth=1.2, zorder=2)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if out_path is None:\n",
    "        out_path = ROOT / \"data\" / \"processed\" / \"diagrams\" / \"render_scatter_regression.png\"\n",
    "    return _save(fig, out_path)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def render_ogive(points, x_label=\"\", y_label=\"Cumulative frequency\",\n",
    "                 xlim=None, ylim=None, grid=True, out_path=None):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Cumulative frequency (ogive).\n",
    "    points: list of (upper boundary, cum frequency), starting at (lower, 0)\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    points = np.array(points)\n",
    "    xs, ys = points[:, 0], points[:, 1]\n",
    "\n",
    "    if xlim is None:\n",
    "        xlim = (xs.min() * 0.9, xs.max() * 1.05)\n",
    "    if ylim is None:\n",
    "        ylim = (0, ys.max() * 1.1)\n",
    "\n",
    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5))\n",
    "    _dbe_axes(ax, xlim, ylim, x_label, y_label, grid=grid)\n",
    "\n",
    "    ax.plot(xs, ys, \"k-\", linewidth=1.4, zorder=2)\n",
    "    ax.plot(xs, ys, \"ko\", markersize=4, zorder=3)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if out_path is None:\n",
    "        out_path = ROOT / \"data\" / \"processed\" / \"diagrams\" / \"render_ogive.png\"\n",
    "    return _save(fig, out_path)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def render_histogram(boundaries, frequencies, x_label=\"\", y_label=\"Frequency\",\n",
    "                     grid=True, out_path=None):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Histogram.\n",
    "    boundaries:  list of class boundaries (len = len(frequencies)+1)\n",
    "    frequencies: list of frequencies\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    boundaries = list(boundaries)\n",
    "    frequencies = list(frequencies)\n",
    "    widths = [boundaries[i+1] - boundaries[i] for i in range(len(frequencies))]\n",
    "\n",
    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5))\n",
    "    _dbe_axes(ax,\n",
    "              (min(boundaries) * 0.9, max(boundaries) * 1.05),\n",
    "              (0, max(frequencies) * 1.15),\n",
    "              x_label, y_label, grid=grid)\n",
    "\n",
    "    for b, w, f in zip(boundaries[:-1], widths, frequencies):\n",
    "        ax.bar(b, f, width=w, align=\"edge\",\n",
    "               facecolor=\"#c8c8c8\", edgecolor=\"black\", linewidth=1.0)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if out_path is None:\n",
    "        out_path = ROOT / \"data\" / \"processed\" / \"diagrams\" / \"render_histogram.png\"\n",
    "    return _save(fig, out_path)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "# ANALYTICAL GEOMETRY RENDERERS\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "\n",
    "def render_analytical_triangle(named_points, theta_label=None,\n",
    "                               dashed_lines=None, right_angles=None,\n",
    "                               xlim=None, ylim=None, out_path=None):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Triangle (or polygon) on Cartesian plane.\n",
    "    named_points: dict {\"P\": (x, y), \"Q\": (...), \"R\": (...)}\n",
    "    theta_label: (vertex, angle_vertex, other) for arc mark — e.g. (\"R\",\"O\",\"Q\")\n",
    "    dashed_lines: list of pairs of labels to connect with dashed lines\n",
    "    right_angles: list of vertices to mark with right-angle square\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    pts = named_points\n",
    "    xs = [p[0] for p in pts.values()]\n",
    "    ys = [p[1] for p in pts.values()]\n",
    "\n",
    "    if xlim is None:\n",
    "        xlim = (min(xs) - 3, max(xs) + 3)\n",
    "    if ylim is None:\n",
    "        ylim = (min(ys) - 3, max(ys) + 3)\n",
    "\n",
    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5))\n",
    "    _dbe_axes(ax, xlim, ylim, \"x\", \"y\", grid=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Triangle edges\n",
    "    labels = list(pts.keys())\n",
    "    for i in range(len(labels)):\n",
    "        for j in range(i + 1, len(labels)):\n",
    "            x1, y1 = pts[labels[i]]\n",
    "            x2, y2 = pts[labels[j]]\n",
    "            ax.plot([x1, x2], [y1, y2], \"k-\", linewidth=1.1)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Named points + labels\n",
    "    for name, (x, y) in pts.items():\n",
    "        _point(ax, x, y, label=name, dx=0.4, dy=0.4)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Dashed auxiliary lines\n",
    "    if dashed_lines:\n",
    "        for a, b in dashed_lines:\n",
    "            x1, y1 = pts[a]\n",
    "            x2, y2 = pts[b]\n",
    "            ax.plot([x1, x2], [y1, y2], \"k--\", linewidth=0.9)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Theta arc\n",
    "    if theta_label:\n",
    "        v, p1, p2 = theta_label\n",
    "        vx, vy = pts[v]\n",
    "        p1x, p1y = pts[p1]\n",
    "        p2x, p2y = pts[p2]\n",
    "        import math\n",
    "        a1 = math.atan2(p1y - vy, p1x - vx)\n",
    "        a2 = math.atan2(p2y - vy, p2x - vx)\n",
    "        radius = 1.2\n",
    "        th = np.linspace(a1, a2, 30)\n",
    "        ax.plot(vx + radius * np.cos(th), vy + radius * np.sin(th),\n",
    "                \"k-\", linewidth=0.9)\n",
    "        mid = (a1 + a2) / 2\n",
    "        ax.text(vx + (radius + 0.4) * np.cos(mid),\n",
    "                vy + (radius + 0.4) * np.sin(mid),\n",
    "                \"$\\\\theta$\", fontsize=11, ha=\"center\", va=\"center\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Right-angle squares\n",
    "    if right_angles:\n",
    "        for v in right_angles:\n",
    "            vx, vy = pts[v]\n",
    "            ax.plot(vx, vy, marker=\"s\", markersize=8,\n",
    "                    markerfacecolor=\"none\", markeredgecolor=\"black\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    if out_path is None:\n",
    "        out_path = ROOT / \"data\" / \"processed\" / \"diagrams\" / \"render_analytical_triangle.png\"\n",
    "    return _save(fig, out_path)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def render_analytical_circle(centre, radius, named_points,\n",
    "                             tangents_from=None, tangent_points=None,\n",
    "                             dashed_lines=None, right_angles=None,\n",
    "                             xlim=None, ylim=None, out_path=None):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Circle on Cartesian plane with named points, tangent lines, chords.\n",
    "    centre: (cx, cy)\n",
    "    radius: r\n",
    "    named_points: dict {\"M\": (x, y), \"A\": (...), ...}\n",
    "    tangents_from: label of external point (e.g. \"C\")\n",
    "    tangent_points: list of labels where tangents touch the circle (e.g. [\"A\",\"B\"])\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    cx, cy = centre\n",
    "    if xlim is None:\n",
    "        xlim = (cx - radius - 3, cx + radius + 3)\n",
    "    if ylim is None:\n",
    "        ylim = (cy - radius - 3, cy + radius + 3)\n",
    "\n",
    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 6))\n",
    "    _dbe_axes(ax, xlim, ylim, \"x\", \"y\", grid=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Circle\n",
    "    theta = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 400)\n",
    "    ax.plot(cx + radius * np.cos(theta),\n",
    "            cy + radius * np.sin(theta), \"k-\", linewidth=1.2)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Tangents from external point\n",
    "    if tangents_from and tangent_points:\n",
    "        tx, ty = named_points[tangents_from]\n",
    "        for tp in tangent_points:\n",
    "            px, py = named_points[tp]\n",
    "            ax.plot([tx, px], [ty, py], \"k-\", linewidth=1.0)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Dashed auxiliary lines\n",
    "    if dashed_lines:\n",
    "        for a, b in dashed_lines:\n",
    "            x1, y1 = named_points[a]\n",
    "            x2, y2 = named_points[b]\n",
    "            ax.plot([x1, x2], [y1, y2], \"k--\", linewidth=0.9)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Named points + labels\n",
    "    for name, (x, y) in named_points.items():\n",
    "        _point(ax, x, y, label=name, dx=0.4, dy=0.4)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Right-angle squares\n",
    "    if right_angles:\n",
    "        for v in right_angles:\n",
    "            vx, vy = named_points[v]\n",
    "            ax.plot(vx, vy, marker=\"s\", markersize=8,\n",
    "                    markerfacecolor=\"none\", markeredgecolor=\"black\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    if out_path is None:\n",
    "        out_path = ROOT / \"data\" / \"processed\" / \"diagrams\" / \"render_analytical_circle.png\"\n",
    "    return _save(fig, out_path)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "# TRIG GRAPH RENDERER\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "\n",
    "def render_trig_graph(fn_specs, xlim, ylim, x_label=\"x\", y_label=\"y\",\n",
    "                      grid=False, out_path=None):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Trig graph(s) on Cartesian plane.\n",
    "    fn_specs: list of dicts:\n",
    "        {\"fn\": \"cos2x\" or \"cos\", \"coef\": (a, b), \"label\": \"f\", \"x_range\": (lo,hi)}\n",
    "        All angles in DEGREES.\n",
    "    xlim, ylim: (lo, hi)\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5))\n",
    "    _dbe_axes(ax, xlim, ylim, x_label, y_label, grid=grid)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Tick at pi-like intervals in degrees\n",
    "    x_ticks = np.arange(xlim[0], xlim[1] + 1, 45)\n",
    "    ax.set_xticks(x_ticks)\n",
    "    ax.set_xticklabels([f\"{int(t)}\\u00b0\" for t in x_ticks], fontsize=8)\n",
    "\n",
    "    for spec in fn_specs:\n",
    "        a, b = spec.get(\"coef\", (1, 1))\n",
    "        fn_name = spec.get(\"fn\", \"cos\")\n",
    "        label = spec.get(\"label\", \"\")\n",
    "        xr = spec.get(\"x_range\", xlim)\n",
    "\n",
    "        xs = np.linspace(xr[0], xr[1], 1200)\n",
    "        rad = np.deg2rad(xs)\n",
    "\n",
    "        if fn_name.startswith(\"cos\"):\n",
    "            ys = a * np.cos(b * rad)\n",
    "        elif fn_name.startswith(\"sin\"):\n",
    "            ys = a * np.sin(b * rad)\n",
    "        elif fn_name.startswith(\"tan\"):\n",
    "            ys = a * np.tan(b * rad)\n",
    "            # Break at asymptotes\n",
    "            ys = np.where(np.abs(np.cos(b * rad)) < 1e-6, np.nan, ys)\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            raise ValueError(f\"Unknown fn: {fn_name}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Clip to ylim\n",
    "        ys = np.where((ys < ylim[0] - 2) | (ys > ylim[1] + 2), np.nan, ys)\n",
    "\n",
    "        ax.plot(xs, ys, \"k-\", linewidth=1.3)\n",
    "        if label:\n",
    "            # Place label near the curve\n",
    "            idx = int(len(xs) * 0.75)\n",
    "            ax.text(xs[idx], ys[idx] + 0.15 if not np.isnan(ys[idx]) else 0,\n",
    "                    label, fontsize=11, style=\"italic\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    if out_path is None:\n",
    "        out_path = ROOT / \"data\" / \"processed\" / \"diagrams\" / \"render_trig_graph.png\"\n",
    "    return _save(fig, out_path)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "# SMOKE TEST — reproduce 2025 P2 Q1, Q3, Q7 diagrams\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "\n",
    "if __name__ == \"__main__\":\n",
    "    OUT = ROOT / \"data\" / \"processed\" / \"diagrams\" / \"p2_smoke\"\n",
    "    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n",

    "                 (7, 154000), (7, 180000), (8, 148000)]\n",
    "    render_scatter_regression(\n",
    "        q1_points, a=331397.20, b=-22988.32,\n",
    "        xlim=(1, 9), ylim=(120000, 320000),\n",
    "        x_label=\"Age of car (years)\",\n",
    "        y_label=\"Selling price (R)\",\n",
    "        grid=True,\n",
    "        out_path=OUT / \"q1_cars.png\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Q3 — triangle PQR\n",
    "    render_analytical_triangle(\n",
    "        named_points={\"P\": (-1, 8), \"Q\": (-4, -6), \"R\": (12, 2)},\n",
    "        theta_label=(\"O\", \"R\", \"Q\"),  # placeholder\n",
    "        xlim=(-6, 14), ylim=(-8, 10),\n",
    "        out_path=OUT / \"q3_triangle.png\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Q7 — cos 2x and tan 2x - 1\n",
    "    render_trig_graph(\n",
    "        fn_specs=[\n",
    "            {\"fn\": \"cos\", \"coef\": (1, 2), \"label\": \"f\"},\n",
    "            {\"fn\": \"tan\", \"coef\": (1, 2), \"label\": \"g\"},\n",
    "        ],\n",
    "        xlim=(-135, 135), ylim=(-2.5, 2.5),\n",
    "        out_path=OUT / \"q7_trig.png\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"Smoke test diagrams written to {OUT}\")\n",
    "    for f in OUT.glob(\"*.png\"):\n",
    "        print(f\"  {f.name}\")"

    "# ---- PATCH 1: replace the theta arc block in render_analytical_triangle ----\n",
    "\n",
    "def _resolve_point(spec, pts):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Accept either a label key or an (x,y) tuple.\"\"\"\n",
    "    if isinstance(spec, tuple) and len(spec) == 2 and all(\n",
    "            isinstance(v, (int, float)) for v in spec):\n",
    "        return spec\n",
    "    return pts[spec]\n",
    "\n",
    "# then, replacing the theta arc block:\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Theta arc\n",
    "    if theta_label:\n",
    "        v_spec, p1_spec, p2_spec = theta_label\n",
    "        vx, vy = _resolve_point(v_spec, pts)\n",
    "        p1x, p1y = _resolve_point(p1_spec, pts)\n",
    "        p2x, p2y = _resolve_point(p2_spec, pts)\n",
    "        import math\n",
    "        a1 = math.atan2(p1y - vy, p1x - vx)\n",
    "        a2 = math.atan2(p2y - vy, p2x - vx)\n",
    "        # ensure we draw the *interior* angle (short way around)\n",
    "        if a2 - a1 > math.pi:\n",
    "            a2 -= 2 * math.pi\n",
    "        elif a2 - a1 < -math.pi:\n",
    "            a2 += 2 * math.pi\n",
    "        radius = 1.2\n",
    "        th = np.linspace(a1, a2, 40)\n",
    "        ax.plot(vx + radius * np.cos(th), vy + radius * np.sin(th),\n",
    "                \"k-\", linewidth=0.9)\n",
    "        mid = (a1 + a2) / 2\n",
    "        ax.text(vx + (radius + 0.45) * np.cos(mid),\n",
    "                vy + (radius + 0.45) * np.sin(mid),\n",
    "                \"$\\\\theta$\", fontsize=12, ha=\"center\", va=\"center\")"
   ]

    "# src/tutor/question_diagrams_p2.py  — v2 (fixed)\n",
    "import matplotlib\n",
    "matplotlib.use(\"Agg\")\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import math\n",
    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "# SHARED HELPERS\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "\n",
    "def _resolve_point(spec, pts):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Accept either a label key (str) or a raw (x, y) tuple.\"\"\"\n",
    "    if isinstance(spec, tuple) and len(spec) == 2 and all(\n",
    "            isinstance(v, (int, float)) for v in spec):\n",
    "        return spec\n",
    "    return pts[spec]\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _dbe_axes(ax, xlim, ylim, x_label=\"\", y_label=\"\", grid=False):\n",
    "    ax.set_xlim(*xlim)\n",
    "    ax.set_ylim(*ylim)\n",
    "    ax.set_aspect(\"equal\", adjustable=\"box\")\n",
    "    ax.spines[\"left\"].set_position((\"data\", 0))\n",
    "    ax.spines[\"bottom\"].set_position((\"data\", 0))\n",
    "    ax.spines[\"right\"].set_visible(False)\n",
    "    ax.spines[\"top\"].set_visible(False)\n",
    "    ax.spines[\"left\"].set_linewidth(1.2)\n",
    "    ax.spines[\"bottom\"].set_linewidth(1.2)\n",
    "    ax.plot(1, 0, \">k\", transform=ax.get_yaxis_transform(),\n",
    "            clip_on=False, markersize=6)\n",
    "    ax.plot(0, 1, \"^k\", transform=ax.get_xaxis_transform(),\n",
    "            clip_on=False, markersize=6)\n",
    "    if x_label:\n",
    "        ax.set_xlabel(x_label, loc=\"right\", fontsize=10)\n",
    "    if y_label:\n",
    "        ax.set_ylabel(y_label, loc=\"top\", fontsize=10)\n",
    "    if grid:\n",
    "        ax.grid(True, which=\"major\", color=\"lightgray\",\n",
    "                linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)\n",
    "    ax.tick_params(labelsize=8, direction=\"out\", length=3, width=0.8)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _point(ax, x, y, label=None, numbered=None, size=4):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Filled dot with label. Offset chosen to avoid axis overlap.\"\"\"\n",
    "    ax.plot(x, y, \"ko\", markersize=size)\n",
    "    if label:\n",
    "        dx, dy = 0.5, 0.5\n",
    "        xlo, xhi = ax.get_xlim()\n",
    "        ylo, yhi = ax.get_ylim()\n",
    "        if y > (ylo + yhi) / 2:\n",
    "            dy = -0.7\n",
    "        if x > (xlo + xhi) / 2:\n",
    "            dx = -0.6\n",
    "            ha = \"right\"\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            ha = \"left\"\n",
    "        if numbered:\n",
    "            ax.text(x + dx, y + dy, f\"{label}$_{{{numbered}}}$\",\n",
    "                    fontsize=10, ha=ha, va=\"center\")\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            ax.text(x + dx, y + dy, label,\n",
    "                    fontsize=10, ha=ha, va=\"center\")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _save(fig, out_path):\n",
    "    out_path = Path(out_path)\n",
    "    out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "    fig.savefig(out_path, dpi=150, bbox_inches=\"tight\", facecolor=\"white\")\n",
    "    plt.close(fig)\n",
    "    return str(out_path)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "# STATS RENDERERS\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "\n",
    "def render_scatter_regression(points, a, b, xlim=None, ylim=None,\n",
    "                              x_label=\"\", y_label=\"\",\n",
    "                              grid=True, out_path=None):\n",
    "    points = np.array(points)\n",
    "    xs, ys = points[:, 0], points[:, 1]\n",
    "    if xlim is None:\n",
    "        xlim = (xs.min() * 0.9, xs.max() * 1.05)\n",
    "    if ylim is None:\n",
    "        ylim = (ys.min() * 0.9, ys.max() * 1.05)\n",
    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5))\n",
    "    _dbe_axes(ax, xlim, ylim, x_label, y_label, grid=grid)\n",
    "    ax.plot(xs, ys, \"ko\", markersize=5, zorder=3)\n",
    "    line_x = np.linspace(xlim[0], xlim[1], 100)\n",
    "    ax.plot(line_x, a + b * line_x, \"k-\", linewidth=1.2, zorder=2)\n",
    "    if out_path is None:\n",
    "        out_path = ROOT / \"data\" / \"processed\" / \"diagrams\" / \"render_scatter_regression.png\"\n",
    "    return _save(fig, out_path)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def render_ogive(points, x_label=\"\", y_label=\"Cumulative frequency\",\n",
    "                 xlim=None, ylim=None, grid=True, out_path=None):\n",
    "    points = np.array(points)\n",
    "    xs, ys = points[:, 0], points[:, 1]\n",
    "    if xlim is None:\n",
    "        xlim = (xs.min() * 0.9, xs.max() * 1.05)\n",
    "    if ylim is None:\n",
    "        ylim = (0, ys.max() * 1.1)\n",
    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5))\n",
    "    _dbe_axes(ax, xlim, ylim, x_label, y_label, grid=grid)\n",
    "    ax.plot(xs, ys, \"k-\", linewidth=1.4, zorder=2)\n",
    "    ax.plot(xs, ys, \"ko\", markersize=4, zorder=3)\n",
    "    if out_path is None:\n",
    "        out_path = ROOT / \"data\" / \"processed\" / \"diagrams\" / \"render_ogive.png\"\n",
    "    return _save(fig, out_path)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def render_histogram(boundaries, frequencies, x_label=\"\", y_label=\"Frequency\",\n",
    "                     grid=True, out_path=None):\n",
    "    boundaries = list(boundaries)\n",
    "    frequencies = list(frequencies)\n",
    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5))\n",
    "    _dbe_axes(ax,\n",
    "              (min(boundaries) * 0.9, max(boundaries) * 1.05),\n",
    "              (0, max(frequencies) * 1.15),\n",
    "              x_label, y_label, grid=grid)\n",
    "    for i, f in enumerate(frequencies):\n",
    "        ax.bar(boundaries[i], f, width=boundaries[i+1] - boundaries[i],\n",
    "               align=\"edge\", facecolor=\"#c8c8c8\",\n",
    "               edgecolor=\"black\", linewidth=1.0)\n",
    "    if out_path is None:\n",
    "        out_path = ROOT / \"data\" / \"processed\" / \"diagrams\" / \"render_histogram.png\"\n",
    "    return _save(fig, out_path)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "# ANALYTICAL GEOMETRY\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "\n",
    "def render_analytical_triangle(named_points, theta_label=None,\n",
    "                               dashed_lines=None, right_angles=None,\n",
    "                               xlim=None, ylim=None, out_path=None):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    named_points: dict {\"P\": (x,y), ...} OR raw coords.\n",
    "    theta_label:  (vertex_spec, arm1_spec, arm2_spec)\n",
    "                  each spec is a label string OR a raw (x, y) tuple.\n",
    "    dashed_lines: list of (spec_a, spec_b) pairs.\n",
    "    right_angles: list of vertex specs.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    pts = named_points\n",
    "    xs = [p[0] for p in pts.values()]\n",
    "    ys = [p[1] for p in pts.values()]\n",
    "    if xlim is None:\n",
    "        xlim = (min(xs) - 3, max(xs) + 3)\n",
    "    if ylim is None:\n",
    "        ylim = (min(ys) - 3, max(ys) + 3)\n",
    "\n",
    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5))\n",
    "    _dbe_axes(ax, xlim, ylim, \"x\", \"y\", grid=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "    labels = list(pts.keys())\n",
    "    for i in range(len(labels)):\n",
    "        for j in range(i + 1, len(labels)):\n",
    "            x1, y1 = pts[labels[i]]\n",
    "            x2, y2 = pts[labels[j]]\n",
    "            ax.plot([x1, x2], [y1, y2], \"k-\", linewidth=1.1)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if dashed_lines:\n",
    "        for a, b in dashed_lines:\n",
    "            x1, y1 = _resolve_point(a, pts)\n",
    "            x2, y2 = _resolve_point(b, pts)\n",
    "            ax.plot([x1, x2], [y1, y2], \"k--\", linewidth=0.9)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if theta_label:\n",
    "        v_spec, p1_spec, p2_spec = theta_label\n",
    "        vx, vy = _resolve_point(v_spec, pts)\n",
    "        p1x, p1y = _resolve_point(p1_spec, pts)\n",
    "        p2x, p2y = _resolve_point(p2_spec, pts)\n",
    "        a1 = math.atan2(p1y - vy, p1x - vx)\n",
    "        a2 = math.atan2(p2y - vy, p2x - vx)\n",
    "        # force short-way arc (interior angle)\n",
    "        if a2 - a1 > math.pi:\n",
    "            a2 -= 2 * math.pi\n",
    "        elif a2 - a1 < -math.pi:\n",
    "            a2 += 2 * math.pi\n",
    "        radius = 1.2\n",
    "        th = np.linspace(a1, a2, 40)\n",
    "        ax.plot(vx + radius * np.cos(th), vy + radius * np.sin(th),\n",
    "                \"k-\", linewidth=0.9)\n",
    "        mid = (a1 + a2) / 2\n",
    "        ax.text(vx + (radius + 0.5) * np.cos(mid),\n",
    "                vy + (radius + 0.5) * np.sin(mid),\n",
    "                \"$\\\\theta$\", fontsize=12, ha=\"center\", va=\"center\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    if right_angles:\n",
    "        for v in right_angles:\n",
    "            vx, vy = _resolve_point(v, pts)\n",
    "            ax.plot(vx, vy, marker=\"s\", markersize=8,\n",
    "                    markerfacecolor=\"none\", markeredgecolor=\"black\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    for name, (x, y) in pts.items():\n",
    "        _point(ax, x, y, label=name)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if out_path is None:\n",
    "        out_path = ROOT / \"data\" / \"processed\" / \"diagrams\" / \"render_analytical_triangle.png\"\n",
    "    return _save(fig, out_path)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def render_analytical_circle(centre, radius, named_points,\n",
    "                             tangents_from=None, tangent_points=None,\n",
    "                             dashed_lines=None, right_angles=None,\n",
    "                             xlim=None, ylim=None, out_path=None):\n",
    "    cx, cy = centre\n",
    "    if xlim is None:\n",
    "        xlim = (cx - radius - 3, cx + radius + 3)\n",
    "    if ylim is None:\n",
    "        ylim = (cy - radius - 3, cy + radius + 3)\n",
    "\n",
    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 6))\n",
    "    _dbe_axes(ax, xlim, ylim, \"x\", \"y\", grid=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "    theta = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 400)\n",
    "    ax.plot(cx + radius * np.cos(theta),\n",
    "            cy + radius * np.sin(theta), \"k-\", linewidth=1.2)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if tangents_from and tangent_points:\n",
    "        tx, ty = named_points[tangents_from]\n",
    "        for tp in tangent_points:\n",
    "            px, py = named_points[tp]\n",
    "            ax.plot([tx, px], [ty, py], \"k-\", linewidth=1.0)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if dashed_lines:\n",
    "        for a, b in dashed_lines:\n",
    "            x1, y1 = _resolve_point(a, named_points)\n",
    "            x2, y2 = _resolve_point(b, named_points)\n",
    "            ax.plot([x1, x2], [y1, y2], \"k--\", linewidth=0.9)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if right_angles:\n",
    "        for v in right_angles:\n",
    "            vx, vy = _resolve_point(v, named_points)\n",
    "            ax.plot(vx, vy, marker=\"s\", markersize=8,\n",
    "                    markerfacecolor=\"none\", markeredgecolor=\"black\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    for name, (x, y) in named_points.items():\n",
    "        _point(ax, x, y, label=name)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if out_path is None:\n",
    "        out_path = ROOT / \"data\" / \"processed\" / \"diagrams\" / \"render_analytical_circle.png\"\n",
    "    return _save(fig, out_path)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "# TRIG GRAPH\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "\n",
    "def render_trig_graph(fn_specs, xlim, ylim, x_label=\"x\", y_label=\"y\",\n",
    "                      grid=False, out_path=None):\n",
    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5))\n",
    "    _dbe_axes(ax, xlim, ylim, x_label, y_label, grid=grid)\n",
    "    x_ticks = np.arange(xlim[0], xlim[1] + 1, 45)\n",
    "    ax.set_xticks(x_ticks)\n",

    "    if isinstance(spec, tuple) and len(spec) == 2 and all(\n",
    "            isinstance(v, (int, float)) for v in spec):\n",
    "        return spec\n",
    "    return pts[spec]\n",

    "def _dbe_axes(ax, xlim, ylim, x_label=\"\", y_label=\"\", grid=False):\n",
    "    ax.set_xlim(*xlim)\n",
    "    ax.set_ylim(*ylim)\n",
    "    ax.set_aspect(\"equal\", adjustable=\"box\")\n",
    "    ax.spines[\"left\"].set_position((\"data\", 0))\n",
    "    ax.spines[\"bottom\"].set_position((\"data\", 0))\n",
    "    ax.spines[\"right\"].set_visible(False)\n",
    "    ax.spines[\"top\"].set_visible(False)\n",
    "    ax.spines[\"left\"].set_linewidth(1.2)\n",
    "    ax.spines[\"bottom\"].set_linewidth(1.2)\n",
    "    ax.plot(1, 0, \">k\", transform=ax.get_yaxis_transform(),\n",
    "            clip_on=False, markersize=6)\n",
    "    ax.plot(0, 1, \"^k\", transform=ax.get_xaxis_transform(),\n",
    "            clip_on=False, markersize=6)\n",
    "    if x_label:\n",
    "        ax.set_xlabel(x_label, loc=\"right\", fontsize=10)\n",
    "    if y_label:\n",
    "        ax.set_ylabel(y_label, loc=\"top\", fontsize=10)\n",
    "    if grid:\n",
    "        ax.grid(True, which=\"major\", color=\"lightgray\",\n",
    "                linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)\n",
    "    ax.tick_params(labelsize=8, direction=\"out\", length=3, width=0.8)\n",
    "\n",

    "def _point(ax, x, y, label=None, numbered=None, size=4):\n",
    "    ax.plot(x, y, \"ko\", markersize=size)\n",
    "    if label:\n",
    "        dx, dy = 0.5, 0.5\n",
    "        xlo, xhi = ax.get_xlim()\n",
    "        ylo, yhi = ax.get_ylim()\n",
    "        if y > (ylo + yhi) / 2:\n",
    "            dy = -0.7\n",
    "        if x > (xlo + xhi) / 2:\n",
    "            dx = -0.6\n",
    "            ha = \"right\"\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            ha = \"left\"\n",
    "        if numbered:\n",
    "            ax.text(x + dx, y + dy, f\"{label}$_{{{numbered}}}$\",\n",
    "                    fontsize=10, ha=ha, va=\"center\")\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            ax.text(x + dx, y + dy, label,\n",
    "                    fontsize=10, ha=ha, va=\"center\")\n",
    "\n",

    "def _save(fig, out_path):\n",
    "    out_path = Path(out_path)\n",
    "    out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "    fig.savefig(out_path, dpi=150, bbox_inches=\"tight\", facecolor=\"white\")\n",
    "    plt.close(fig)\n",
    "    return str(out_path)\n",

    "def _blank_axes(xlim, ylim, figsize=(7, 6)):\n",
    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)\n",
    "    ax.set_xlim(*xlim)\n",
    "    ax.set_ylim(*ylim)\n",
    "    ax.set_aspect(\"equal\", adjustable=\"box\")\n",
    "    ax.axis(\"off\")\n",
    "    return fig, ax\n",
