    "# ---- Embedded layout ----\n",
    "A(\"<script>\")\n",
    "A(f\"const LAYOUT = {json.dumps(KEYBOARD, ensure_ascii=False)};\")\n",
    "A(\"\"\"\n",
    "const state = {\n",
    "  activeTab: LAYOUT.tabs_order[0],\n",
    "  collapsed: false,\n",
    "};\n",
    "\n",
    "// ---------- render working text ----------\n",
    "const textEl = document.getElementById('text');\n",
    "const numsEl = document.getElementById('nums');\n",
    "const stepCountEl = document.getElementById('stepCount');\n",
    "\n",
    "function refreshNumbers() {\n",
    "  const lines = textEl.innerText.split('\\\\n');\n",
    "  numsEl.innerHTML = lines.map((_, i) => `<div>${i + 1}</div>`).join('');\n",
    "  const n = lines.length;\n",
    "  stepCountEl.textContent = n === 1 && lines[0] === ''\n",
    "    ? '0 steps' : `${n} step${n === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;\n",
    "}\n",
    "textEl.addEventListener('input', refreshNumbers);\n",
    "refreshNumbers();\n",
    "\n",
    "// ---------- insert helpers ----------\n",
    "function getCaretContext() {\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return { before: '', after: '' };\n",
    "  const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "  const pre = r.cloneRange();\n",
    "  pre.selectNodeContents(textEl);\n",
    "  pre.setEnd(r.startContainer, r.startOffset);\n",
    "  const before = pre.toString();\n",
    "  const post = r.cloneRange();\n",
    "  post.selectNodeContents(textEl);\n",
    "  post.setStart(r.endContainer, r.endOffset);\n",
    "  const after = post.toString();\n",
    "  return { before, after };\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "function insertAtCaret(str, opts) {\n",
    "  opts = opts || {};\n",
    "  textEl.focus();\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return;\n",
    "  const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "  r.deleteContents();\n",
    "  const node = document.createTextNode(str);\n",
    "  r.insertNode(node);\n",
    "  r.setStartAfter(node);\n",
    "  r.setEndAfter(node);\n",
    "  sel.removeAllRanges();\n",
    "  sel.addRange(r);\n",
    "  refreshNumbers();\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "function smartInsert(key) {\n",
    "  const { before, after } = getCaretContext();\n",
    "  let ins = key.i;\n",
    "\n",
    "  // smart spacing: if 'sp' flag, ensure spaces on both sides\n",
    "  if (key.sp) {\n",
    "    const needLead = before.length > 0 && !/\\\\s$/.test(before);\n",
    "    const needTrail = after.length > 0 && !/^\\\\s/.test(after);\n",
    "    ins = (needLead ? ' ' : '') + ins.trim() + (needTrail ? ' ' : '');\n",
    "  }\n",
    "\n",
    "  // trail-only (semicolon)\n",
    "  if (key.trail) {\n",
    "    ins = ins; // already has trailing space\n",
    "  }\n",
    "\n",
    "  insertAtCaret(ins);\n",
    "\n",
    "  // if 'skip' is 1, move cursor inside the parens\n",
    "  if (key.skip === 1 && key.i.includes('()')) {\n",
    "    // Move cursor back one char (past the ')')\n",
    "    const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "    if (sel.rangeCount) {\n",
    "      const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "      const newR = r.cloneRange();\n",
    "      // Shift selection left one character\n",
    "      if (newR.startContainer.nodeType === 3 && newR.startOffset > 0) {\n",
    "        newR.setStart(newR.startContainer, newR.startOffset - 1);\n",
    "        newR.collapse(true);\n",
    "        sel.removeAllRanges();\n",
    "        sel.addRange(newR);\n",
    "      }\n",
    "    }\n",
    "  }\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "// ---------- render tabs ----------\n",
    "const tabsEl = document.getElementById('tabs');\n",
    "LAYOUT.tabs_order.forEach(name => {\n",
    "  const b = document.createElement('button');\n",
    "  b.className = 'tab' + (name === state.activeTab ? ' active' : '');\n",
    "  b.textContent = name;\n",
    "  b.onclick = () => {\n",
    "    state.activeTab = name;\n",
    "    document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t =>\n",
    "      t.classList.toggle('active', t.textContent === name));\n",
    "    renderGrid();\n",
    "  };\n",
    "  tabsEl.appendChild(b);\n",
    "});\n",
    "\n",
    "// ---------- render grid ----------\n",
    "const gridEl = document.getElementById('grid');\n",
    "function renderGrid() {\n",
    "  const rows = LAYOUT.tabs[state.activeTab] || [];\n",
    "  gridEl.innerHTML = '';\n",
    "  const cols = Math.max(...rows.map(r => r.length));\n",
    "  rows.forEach(row => {\n",
    "    const r = document.createElement('div');\n",
    "    r.className = 'row';\n",
    "    r.style.gridTemplateColumns = `repeat(${cols}, 1fr)`;\n",
    "    row.forEach(key => {\n",
    "      const k = document.createElement('div');\n",
    "      k.className = 'key' + (\n",
    "        ['=', 'or', '\\\\u21d2', '\\\\u2234'].includes(key.l) ? ' accent' : '');\n",
    "      k.textContent = key.l;\n",
    "      k.onclick = () => smartInsert(key);\n",
    "      r.appendChild(k);\n",
    "    });\n",
    "    // pad if fewer cols than max\n",
    "    for (let i = row.length; i < cols; i++) {\n",
    "      const ph = document.createElement('div');\n",
    "      r.appendChild(ph);\n",
    "    }\n",
    "    gridEl.appendChild(r);\n",
    "  });\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "// ---------- number row ----------\n",
    "const numrowEl = document.getElementById('numrow');\n",
    "LAYOUT.always_visible.digits.forEach(d => {\n",
    "  const k = document.createElement('div');\n",
    "  k.className = 'key';\n",
    "  k.textContent = d;\n",
    "  k.onclick = () => smartInsert({ l: d, i: d === '(-)' ? '(-)' : d });\n",
    "  numrowEl.appendChild(k);\n",
    "});\n",
    "\n",
    "// ---------- actions ----------\n",
    "document.querySelectorAll('.action').forEach(a => {\n",
    "  a.onclick = () => {\n",
    "    const act = a.dataset.action;\n",
    "    if (act === 'backspace') {\n",
    "      textEl.focus();\n",
    "      document.execCommand('delete');\n",
    "      refreshNumbers();\n",
    "    } else if (act === 'newline') {\n",
    "      insertAtCaret('\\\\n');\n",
    "    } else if (act === 'done') {\n",
    "      submit();\n",
    "    } else if (act === 'collapse') {\n",
    "      state.collapsed = !state.collapsed;\n",
    "      gridEl.classList.toggle('collapsed', state.collapsed);\n",
    "      a.innerHTML = state.collapsed ? '&#9650; Expand' : '&#9660; Collapse';\n",
    "    }\n",
    "  };\n",
    "});\n",
    "\n",
    "// ---------- submit ----------\n",
    "const resultEl = document.getElementById('result');\n",
    "function submit() {\n",
    "  const lines = textEl.innerText\n",
    "    .split('\\\\n')\n",
    "    .map(l => l.trim())\n",
    "    .filter(l => l.length > 0);\n",
    "\n",
    "  // Expand /cmds into tokens (mirror of Python slash_commands.py)\n",
    "  const CMD = {\n",
    "    or: ' or ', then: ' \\\\u2234 ', because: ' \\\\u2235 ',\n",
    "    implies: ' \\\\u21d2 ', iff: ' \\\\u21d4 ',\n",
    "    sqrt: 'sqrt', cbrt: 'cbrt', pi: 'pi',\n",
    "    theta: 'theta', alpha: 'alpha', beta: 'beta',\n",
    "    deg: 'deg', pm: '+/-',\n",
    "    le: '<=', ge: '>=', ne: '!=',\n",
    "    in: ' in ', R: 'R', sum: 'sum', inf: 'inf',\n",
    "    dy: 'dy/dx', dx: 'd/dx', lim: 'lim', to: '->',\n",
    "    angle: 'angle ', tri: 'triangle ',\n",
    "    para: 'parallel ', perp: 'perp ',\n",
    "  };\n",
    "  const expand = s => s.replace(/([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)(?![A-Za-z0-9_])/g,\n",
    "    (m, name) => CMD[name] || m);\n",
    "\n",
    "  const expanded = lines.map(l =>\n",
    "    l.replace(/\\\\/([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)/g, (m, name) => CMD[name] || m));\n",
    "\n",
    "  const payload = {\n",
    "    learner_lines: expanded,\n",
    "    tab_used: state.activeTab,\n",
    "    steps: expanded.length,\n",
    "  };\n",
    "\n",
    "  resultEl.classList.add('shown');\n",
    "  resultEl.innerHTML = `\n",
    "    <div class='label'>submitted to step_grader</div>\n",
    "    <pre>${JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)}</pre>\n",
    "  `;\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "// focus working on load\n",
    "textEl.focus();\n",
    "renderGrid();\n",
    "\"\"\")\n",
    "A(\"</script>\")\n",
    "\n",
    "A(\"</body>\")\n",
    "A(\"</html>\")\n",
    "\n",
    "HTML_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "HTML_PATH.write_text(\"\\n\".join(HTML), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n",
    "print(f\"  ✓ {HTML_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)}\")\n",
    "print(f\"    {HTML_PATH.stat().st_size:,} bytes\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print()\n",

      "========================================================================\n",
      "MethodKeyboard.ipynb — RENDERED VIEW\n",
      "========================================================================\n",
      "\n",
      "# MethodKeyboard\n",
      "\n",
      "The working surface. An on-screen keyboard for NSC Mathematics\n",
      "learners who type instead of write.\n",
      "\n",
      "Not a calculator. Not a CAS. Not handwriting.\n",
      "\n",
      "A South African keyboard for SA exam method - built so the memo\n",
      "notation comes out the way the DBE prints it.\n",
      "\n",
      "────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n",
      "\n",
      "## Why a keyboard, not a calculator\n",
      "\n",
      "The soul of MethodMarker is *grade the working, not the answer*.\n",
      "A calculator computes. The learner needs to **type method**.\n",
      "\n",
      "Two separate surfaces:\n",
      "\n",
      "| Surface | What it does | When |\n",
      "|---|---|---|\n",
      "| **MethodKeyboard** | Types working line-by-line | Always (this notebook) |\n",
      "| Scientific calculator | Evaluates numbers | Optional side panel (later, if at all) |\n",
      "\n",
      "The keyboard is the entry point to step_grader. No keyboard, no\n",
      "typed method, no way for a phone/tablet learner to use MethodMarker.\n",
      "This is the pilot's hard prerequisite.\n",
      "\n",
      "────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n",
      "\n",
      "## The learner contract\n",
      "\n",
      "**Three freedoms**\n",
      "\n",
      "1. **Expand / collapse at will.** Some learners want the working\n",
      "   area big; some want the keyboard big. They choose. Setting persists\n",
      "   across questions in a sitting.\n",
      "2. **No line cap.** Write as many method lines as the question\n",
      "   demands. A quadratic takes 3. A Euclidean proof takes 10. Both\n",
      "   are fine. The `3 steps` counter is informative, not a ceiling.\n",
      "3. **Optional tab auto-switch.** When a learner enters a calculus\n",
      "   drill, should the keyboard jump to the Calculus tab? Only if they\n",
      "   opt in. Default off - manual tab selection.\n",
      "\n",
      "**Four locks (non-negotiable)**\n",
      "\n",
      "1. **One line = one method step.** Press Enter -> new line. This is\n",
      "   what makes learner_lines map cleanly to step_grader.\n",
      "2. **Keyboard never computes.** No `=` key that evaluates. The `=`\n",
      "   key inserts ` = `.\n",
      "3. **`or` is one key.** NSC memos write `x = -4 or x = 3`, never\n",
      "   `x = -4, x = 3`. This single decision prevents an entire class\n",
      "   of grading failures.\n",
      "4. **Done submits.** Not solve. Not check. The learner types,\n",
      "   the learner submits, the grader grades.\n",
      "\n",
      "────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n",
      "\n",
      "## The notation the keyboard must produce\n",
      "\n",
      "Extracted from the memo CSVs already in the corpus. These are the\n",
      "symbols the DBE actually prints - not what a textbook preference\n",
      "would dictate.\n",
      "\n",
      "**Universal (all tabs)**\n",
      "`=` `or` `=>` `<=>` `therefore` `because` `;` `( )`\n",
      "\n",
      "**Semicolon, not comma** - SA writes `A(1; 9)`, not `A(1, 9)`.\n",
      "This is non-negotiable for coordinates and lists.\n",
      "\n",
      "**Algebra-specific**\n",
      "`x y a b c n k` `x^2` `x^n` `x^-1` `sqrt` `cbrt` `nth root` `+-` `< > <= >= !=`\n",
      "`a/b` `|x|` `Sigma` `in` `R`\n",
      "\n",
      "**Calculus-specific**\n",
      "`dy/dx` `d/dx` `d2y/dx2` `D_x[ ]` `f'(x)` `f''(x)`\n",
      "`lim` `->` `x->inf` `h->0` `inf` `e` `ln` `log` `Delta`\n",
      "\n",
      "**No integral sign** - CAPS P1 is differentiation only. The soul spec forbids it.\n",
      "\n",
      "**Trig-specific**\n",
      "`sin cos tan` `arcsin arccos arctan`\n",
      "`theta alpha beta gamma` `pi` `deg` `rad` `2theta` `half theta` `sin^2 cos^2 tan^2`\n",
      "\n",
      "**Stats-specific**\n",
      "`x-bar` `sigma` `sigma^2` `Sigma Sigma x Sigma x2` `n N` `x_i f_i`\n",
      "`Q1 Q2 Q3` `min max` `P( )` `P(A)` `A|B` `union` `intersect`\n",
      "\n",
      "**Geometry-specific**\n",
      "`angle` `triangle` `parallel` `perp` `cong` `similar`\n",
      "`A-hat B-hat C-hat` (angle with hat)\n",
      "`arc AB` `chord` `tan` `rad`\n",
      "Reason keywords insert as plain text: `vert opp angles`, `alt angles`,\n",
      "`co-int angles`, `tan chord`, `angle at centre` etc.\n",
      "\n",
      "────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n",
      "\n",
      "## The six tabs\n",
      "\n",
      "| Tab | Visible in | Purpose |\n",
      "|---|---|---|\n",
      "| **Algebra** | P1 default | Solve, factorise, inequality, simultaneous |\n",
      "| **Calculus** | P1 | First principles, derivatives, tangents, cubic |\n",
      "| **Trig** | P1 + P2 | Identities, equations, general solution |\n",
      "| **Stats** | P1 + P2 | Mean, SD, regression, ogive, probability |\n",
      "| **Geometry** | P2 | Euclidean, analytical circle, proofs |\n",
      "| **Greek** | Fallback | alpha beta gamma theta lambda pi sigma phi omega |\n",
      "\n",
      "**Tab auto-switch mapping** (when learner opts in):\n",
      "\n",
      "| Skill prefix | Tab |\n",
      "|---|---|\n",
      "| `calculus.*` | Calculus |\n",
      "| `trig.*` | Trig |\n",
      "| `stats.*` / `probability.*` | Stats |\n",
      "| `geometry.*` / `analytical.*` | Geometry |\n",
      "| `algebra.*` / `sequences.*` / `functions.*` / `finance.*` | Algebra |\n",
      "\n",
      "────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n",
      "\n",
      "## Behaviour rules\n",
      "\n",
      "**Line model**\n",
      "- Enter -> new line, cursor at line start of the next one\n",
      "- Backspace on empty line -> deletes the line, cursor back to previous\n",
      "- Multi-line working area, one memo step per line\n",
      "- learner_lines = [\"(x+4)(x-3)=0\", \"x+4=0 or x-3=0\", \"x=-4 or x=3\"]\n",
      "\n",
      "**Insert semantics**\n",
      "- Most keys insert with a leading and trailing space if surrounded\n",
      "  by alphanumeric characters (prevents `x+4=0` becoming `x +4=0`)\n",
      "- `or` always inserts as ` or ` (space both sides)\n",
      "- `=>`, `<=>`, `therefore`, `because` insert as ` X ` (space both sides)\n",
      "- `;` inserts as `; ` (trailing space only - coordinates use trailing)\n",
      "- `sin(` `cos(` `tan(` - the `(` is part of the key\n",
      "- `sqrt` inserts `sqrt(` - cursor inside\n",
      "\n",
      "**Tab switching**\n",
      "- Manual tap always works\n",
      "- Auto-switch (when enabled): on question start, tab matches skill prefix\n",
      "- Manual override during a question sticks until the next question\n",
      "\n",
      "**Keyboard mode**\n",
      "- `ABC` key toggles letter input for geometry reasons\n",
      "- Letters on the ABC layer insert plain text\n",
      "- Digits always visible on the number row - never hidden by ABC\n",
      "\n",
      "**What the keyboard does NOT do**\n",
      "- No `=` that evaluates\n",
      "- No `solve` key\n",
      "- No history / recall that recomputes\n",
      "- No import from calculator\n",
      "\n",
      "────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n",
      "\n",
      "## Wireframe (phone portrait)\n",
      "\n",
      "```\n",
      "+-----------------------------------------+\n",

      "+-----------------------------------------+\n",
      "|  Working                    3 steps     |\n",
      "|                                         |\n",

      "|  3  x=-4 or x=3|                        |\n",
      "|                                         |\n",

      "+-----------------------------------------+\n",

      "+-----------------------------------------+\n",
      "```\n",
      "\n",
      "The `Collapse` control on the bottom-right toggles the symbol grid\n",

      "\n",

      "\n",
      "## Output contract\n",
      "\n",
      "The keyboard produces, on Done:\n",
      "\n",

      "    \"x+4=0 or x-3=0\",\n",
      "    \"x=-4 or x=3\",\n",
      "]\n",
      "```\n",
      "\n",
      "Same shape as the CLI's `_collect_working`. Same shape `step_grader`\n",
      "and `math_grader` already consume. **No interface change** - the\n",
      "keyboard is just a different producer.\n",
      "\n",
      "## Integration with the drill\n",
      "\n",
      "The drill's existing call site:\n",
      "\n",
      "```python\n",
      "submission = _collect_working(i, SITTING_SIZE)\n",
      "```\n",
      "\n",
      "On web/mobile, `_collect_working` renders the keyboard, waits for\n",
      "Done, and returns `learner_lines`-wrapped working. Same downstream\n",
      "pipeline:\n",
      "\n",
      "```\n",
      "keyboard -> learner_lines -> math_grader -> step_grader -> feedback\n",
      "```\n",
      "\n",
      "Nothing else in the drill changes.\n",
      "\n",
      "────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n",
      "\n",
      "## MVP vs full build\n",
      "\n",
      "**MVP (ship first)**\n",
      "- Digits, `.`, `(-)`, `+ - x /`, `( )`, `=`\n",
      "- Backspace, New Line, Done, ABC, Collapse\n",
      "- **Algebra tab** (all 30 keys)\n",
      "- **Trig tab** (all 24 keys)\n",

      "\n",

      "\n",
      "## Open questions\n",
      "\n",
      "1. **Cursor tracking.** Does the keyboard need to support mid-line\n",
      "   insertion (edit line 2 after line 3 is written)? Probably yes for\n",
      "   proofs, but adds complexity. Defer to full build.\n",
      "2. **Bilingual.** SA has English + Afrikaans papers. Learners may\n",
      "   switch. Do we ship EN-only first, or both?\n",
      "3. **Reason shortlist.** Geometry proofs have a fixed vocabulary of\n",

    "# 2. Convert to standalone HTML for browser viewing\n",

    "# ============================================================\n",

    "# Tiny markdown → html (headings, tables, code fences, bold, inline code)\n",
    "def md_to_html(md_text):\n",
    "    lines = md_text.splitlines()\n",
    "    out = []\n",
    "    in_code = False\n",
    "    in_table = False\n",
    "    table_rows = []\n",
    "\n",
    "    def close_table():\n",
    "        nonlocal in_table, table_rows\n",
    "        if not in_table:\n",
    "            return\n",
    "        html = [\"<table>\"]\n",
    "        for i, row in enumerate(table_rows):\n",
    "            tag = \"th\" if i == 0 else \"td\"\n",
    "            html.append(\"<tr>\")\n",
    "            for cell in row:\n",
    "                html.append(f\"<{tag}>{cell}</{tag}>\")\n",
    "            html.append(\"</tr>\")\n",
    "        html.append(\"</table>\")\n",
    "        out.append(\"\".join(html))\n",
    "        in_table = False\n",
    "        table_rows = []\n",
    "\n",
    "    for line in lines:\n",
    "        if line.startswith(\"```\"):\n",
    "            if in_code:\n",
    "                out.append(\"</pre>\")\n",
    "                in_code = False\n",
    "            else:\n",
    "                out.append(\"<pre>\")\n",
    "                in_code = True\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "        if in_code:\n",
    "            out.append(escape(line))\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "        # table rows\n",
    "        if line.strip().startswith(\"|\") and line.strip().endswith(\"|\"):\n",
    "            cells = [c.strip() for c in line.strip().strip(\"|\").split(\"|\")]\n",
    "            if all(set(c) <= set(\"- :\") for c in cells):\n",
    "                continue  # separator row\n",
    "            table_rows.append([escape(c) for c in cells])\n",
    "            in_table = True\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            close_table()\n",
    "        if not line.strip():\n",
    "            out.append(\"\")\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "        # headings\n",
    "        if line.startswith(\"# \"):\n",
    "            out.append(f\"<h1>{escape(line[2:])}</h1>\")\n",
    "        elif line.startswith(\"## \"):\n",
    "            out.append(f\"<h2>{escape(line[3:])}</h2>\")\n",
    "        elif line.startswith(\"### \"):\n",
    "            out.append(f\"<h3>{escape(line[4:])}</h3>\")\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            # inline code + bold\n",
    "            import re\n",
    "            line = re.sub(r\"`([^`]+)`\", r\"<code>\\1</code>\", escape(line))\n",
    "            line = re.sub(r\"\\*\\*([^*]+)\\*\\*\", r\"<strong>\\1</strong>\", line)\n",
    "            out.append(f\"<p>{line}</p>\")\n",
    "    close_table()\n",
    "    if in_code:\n",
    "        out.append(\"</pre>\")\n",
    "    return \"\\n\".join(out)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "body_parts = []\n",
    "for cell in cells:\n",
    "    src = \"\".join(cell.get(\"source\", []))\n",
    "    ctype = cell.get(\"cell_type\")\n",
    "    if ctype == \"markdown\":\n",
    "        body_parts.append(md_to_html(src))\n",
    "    elif ctype == \"code\":\n",
    "        body_parts.append(\"<pre class='code'>\" + escape(src) + \"</pre>\")\n",
    "\n",
    "body = \"\\n\".join(body_parts)\n",
    "\n",
    "HTML = f\"\"\"<!doctype html>\n",

    "  const n = lines.length;\n",

    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return { before: '', after: '' };\n",
    "  const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "  const pre = r.cloneRange(); pre.selectNodeContents(textEl);\n",
    "  pre.setEnd(r.startContainer, r.startOffset);\n",
    "  const before = pre.toString();\n",
    "  const post = r.cloneRange(); post.selectNodeContents(textEl);\n",
    "  post.setStart(r.endContainer, r.endOffset);\n",
    "  const after = post.toString();\n",
    "  return { before, after };\n",
    "}\n",

    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return;\n",
    "  const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "  r.deleteContents();\n",
    "  const node = document.createTextNode(str);\n",
    "  r.insertNode(node);\n",
    "  r.setStartAfter(node);\n",
    "  r.setEndAfter(node);\n",
    "  sel.removeAllRanges();\n",
    "  sel.addRange(r);\n",
    "  refreshNumbers();\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "function smartInsert(key) {\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__back__') {\n",
    "    textEl.focus();\n",
    "    document.execCommand('delete');\n",
    "    refreshNumbers();\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__newline__') { insertAtCaret('\\n'); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__done__')    { submit(); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__collapse__') {\n",
    "    state.collapsed = !state.collapsed;\n",
    "    document.getElementById('grid').classList.toggle('collapsed', state.collapsed);\n",
    "    document.getElementById('basegrid').classList.toggle('collapsed', state.collapsed);\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  const { before, after } = getCaretContext();\n",
    "  let ins = key.i;\n",
    "  if (key.sp) {\n",
    "    const needLead  = before.length > 0 && !/\\s$/.test(before);\n",
    "    const needTrail = after.length  > 0 && !/^\\s/.test(after);\n",
    "    ins = (needLead ? ' ' : '') + ins.trim() + (needTrail ? ' ' : '');\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  insertAtCaret(ins);\n",
    "  if (key.skip === 1 && key.i === '()') {\n",
    "    const sel = window.getSelection();\n",

    "      k.onclick = () => smartInsert(key);\n",

    "    });\n",

    "const CMD = {\n",
    "  or: ' or ', then: ' ∴ ', because: ' ∵ ',\n",
    "  implies: ' ⇒ ', iff: ' ⇔ ',\n",
    "  sqrt: 'sqrt', cbrt: 'cbrt', pi: 'pi',\n",

    "const numsEl = document.getElementById('nums');\n",
    "const stepCountEl = document.getElementById('stepCount');\n",
    "\n",
    "// Display char -> engine token mapping (subset; engine conversion only\n",
    "// touches symbols the grader expects as ASCII)\n",
    "const TO_ENGINE = {\n",
    "  \"θ\":\"theta\",\"α\":\"alpha\",\"β\":\"beta\",\"γ\":\"gamma\",\"δ\":\"delta\",\"ε\":\"epsilon\",\n",
    "  \"λ\":\"lambda\",\"μ\":\"mu\",\"π\":\"pi\",\"ρ\":\"rho\",\"σ\":\"sigma\",\"τ\":\"tau\",\"φ\":\"phi\",\n",
    "  \"ψ\":\"psi\",\"ω\":\"omega\",\n",

    "  \"≤\":\"<=\",\"≥\":\">=\",\"≠\":\"!=\",\"±\":\"+/-\",\"≈\":\"approx\",\n",
    "  \"×\":\" x \",\"÷\":\" / \",\n",
    "  \"⇒\":\" => \",\"⇔\":\" <=> \",\"∴\":\" therefore \",\"∵\":\" because \",\n",
    "  \"→\":\"->\",\"∞\":\"inf\",\"∈\":\" in \",\"ℝ\":\"R\",\n",

    "  \"≅\":\"cong \",\"∼\":\"similar \",\n",
    "  \"Â\":\"A^\",\"B̂\":\"B^\",\"Ĉ\":\"C^\",\"D̂\":\"D^\",\"Ê\":\"E^\",\"F̂\":\"F^\",\n",
    "  \"x̄\":\"xbar\",\"σ²\":\"sigma^2\",\n",

    "};\n",
    "\n",
    "function toEngine(text) {\n",
    "  let out = text;\n",
    "  // Longest symbols first to avoid conflicts\n",
    "  const syms = Object.keys(TO_ENGINE).sort((a,b) => b.length - a.length);\n",
    "  for (const s of syms) {\n",
    "    out = out.split(s).join(TO_ENGINE[s]);\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  return out;\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "function refreshNumbers() {\n",
    "  const lines = textEl.innerText.split(\"\\n\");\n",
    "  numsEl.innerHTML = lines.map((_, i) => `<div>${i + 1}</div>`).join(\"\");\n",
    "  const n = lines.length;\n",
    "  stepCountEl.textContent = (n === 1 && lines[0] === \"\")\n",
    "    ? \"0 steps\" : `${n} step${n === 1 ? \"\" : \"s\"}`;\n",
    "}\n",
    "textEl.addEventListener(\"input\", refreshNumbers);\n",
    "refreshNumbers();\n",
    "\n",
    "function getCaretContext() {\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return { before: \"\", after: \"\" };\n",
    "  const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "  const pre = r.cloneRange(); pre.selectNodeContents(textEl);\n",
    "  pre.setEnd(r.startContainer, r.startOffset);\n",
    "  const before = pre.toString();\n",
    "  const post = r.cloneRange(); post.selectNodeContents(textEl);\n",
    "  post.setStart(r.endContainer, r.endOffset);\n",
    "  const after = post.toString();\n",
    "  return { before, after };\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "function insertAtCaret(str) {\n",
    "  textEl.focus();\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return;\n",
    "  const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "  r.deleteContents();\n",
    "  const node = document.createTextNode(str);\n",
    "  r.insertNode(node);\n",
    "  r.setStartAfter(node);\n",
    "  r.setEndAfter(node);\n",
    "  sel.removeAllRanges();\n",
    "  sel.addRange(r);\n",
    "  refreshNumbers();\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "function smartInsert(key) {\n",
    "  if (key.e === \"__back__\") {\n",
    "    textEl.focus();\n",
    "    document.execCommand(\"delete\");\n",
    "    refreshNumbers();\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (key.e === \"__newline__\") { insertAtCaret(\"\\n\"); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.e === \"__done__\")    { submit(); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.e === \"__abc__\") {\n",
    "    state.abcMode = !state.abcMode;\n",
    "    renderGrid();\n",
    "    renderBase();\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (key.e === \"__collapse__\") {\n",
    "    state.collapsed = !state.collapsed;\n",
    "    document.getElementById(\"grid\").classList.toggle(\"collapsed\", state.collapsed);\n",
    "    document.getElementById(\"basegrid\").classList.toggle(\"collapsed\", state.collapsed);\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  const { before, after } = getCaretContext();\n",
    "  let ins = key.d;\n",
    "  if (key.sp) {\n",
    "    const needLead  = before.length > 0 && !/\\s$/.test(before);\n",
    "    const needTrail = after.length  > 0 && !/^\\s/.test(after);\n",
    "    ins = (needLead ? \" \" : \"\") + ins.trim() + (needTrail ? \" \" : \"\");\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  insertAtCaret(ins);\n",
    "  if (key.skip === 1 && key.d === \"()\") {\n",
    "    const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "    if (sel.rangeCount) {\n",
    "      const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "      if (r.startContainer.nodeType === 3 && r.startOffset > 0) {\n",
    "        const nr = r.cloneRange();\n",
    "        nr.setStart(nr.startContainer, nr.startOffset - 1);\n",
    "        nr.collapse(true);\n",
    "        sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(nr);\n",
    "      }\n",
    "    }\n",
    "  }\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "// ---------- tabs ----------\n",
    "const tabsEl = document.getElementById(\"tabs\");\n",
    "LAYOUT.tabs_order.forEach(name => {\n",
    "  const b = document.createElement(\"button\");\n",
    "  b.className = \"tab\" + (name === state.activeTab ? \" active\" : \"\");\n",
    "  b.textContent = name;\n",
    "  b.onclick = () => {\n",
    "    state.activeTab = name;\n",
    "    document.querySelectorAll(\".tab\").forEach(t =>\n",
    "      t.classList.toggle(\"active\", t.textContent === name));\n",
    "    renderGrid();\n",
    "  };\n",
    "  tabsEl.appendChild(b);\n",
    "});\n",
    "\n",
    "// ---------- tab grid ----------\n",
    "const gridEl = document.getElementById(\"grid\");\n",
    "function renderGrid() {\n",
    "  if (state.abcMode) {\n",
    "    // ABC mode — render QWERTY letters in the grid\n",
    "    gridEl.innerHTML = \"\";\n",
    "    const rows = LAYOUT.base_layer.abc || [];\n",
    "    const cols = Math.max(...rows.map(r => r.length));\n",
    "    rows.forEach(row => {\n",
    "      const r = document.createElement(\"div\");\n",
    "      r.className = \"row\";\n",
    "      r.style.gridTemplateColumns = `repeat(${cols}, 1fr)`;\n",
    "      row.forEach(key => {\n",
    "        const k = document.createElement(\"div\");\n",
    "        k.className = \"key\";\n",
    "        k.textContent = key.l;\n",
    "        k.onclick = () => smartInsert(key);\n",
    "        r.appendChild(k);\n",
    "      });\n",
    "      for (let i = row.length; i < cols; i++) r.appendChild(document.createElement(\"div\"));\n",
    "      gridEl.appendChild(r);\n",
    "    });\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  const rows = LAYOUT.tabs[state.activeTab] || [];\n",
    "  gridEl.innerHTML = \"\";\n",
    "  const cols = Math.max(...rows.map(r => r.length));\n",
    "  rows.forEach(row => {\n",
    "    const r = document.createElement(\"div\");\n",
    "    r.className = \"row\";\n",
    "    r.style.gridTemplateColumns = `repeat(${cols}, 1fr)`;\n",
    "    row.forEach(key => {\n",
    "      const k = document.createElement(\"div\");\n",
    "      const accent = [\"or\",\"=\",\"⇒\",\"∴\",\"∵\"].includes(key.l) ? \" accent\" : \"\";\n",
    "      k.className = \"key\" + accent;\n",
    "      k.textContent = key.l;\n",
    "      k.onclick = () => smartInsert(key);\n",
    "      r.appendChild(k);\n",
    "    });\n",
    "    for (let i = row.length; i < cols; i++) r.appendChild(document.createElement(\"div\"));\n",
    "    gridEl.appendChild(r);\n",
    "  });\n",

    "  const container = document.getElementById(\"basegrid\");\n",
    "  container.innerHTML = \"\";\n",
    "\n",
    "  const layout = [\n",

    "// ---------- submit ----------\n",
    "const resultEl = document.getElementById(\"result\");\n",
    "const CMD = {\n",
    "  or: \" or \", then: \" ∴ \", because: \" ∵ \",\n",
    "  implies: \" ⇒ \", iff: \" ⇔ \",\n",
    "  sqrt: \"sqrt\", cbrt: \"cbrt\", pi: \"pi\",\n",
    "  theta: \"theta\", alpha: \"alpha\", beta: \"beta\",\n",
    "  deg: \"deg\", pm: \"+/-\",\n",

    "  angle: \"angle \", tri: \"triangle \",\n",
    "  para: \"parallel \", perp: \"perp \",\n",
    "};\n",
    "\n",
    "function submit() {\n",
    "  const rawLines = textEl.innerText.split(\"\\n\").map(l => l.trim()).filter(l => l.length);\n",
    "  // 1. slash-command expansion\n",
    "  const slashExpanded = rawLines.map(l =>\n",
    "    l.replace(/\\/([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)/g, (m, name) => CMD[name] || m));\n",
    "  // 2. symbol → engine token expansion\n",
    "  const engineLines = slashExpanded.map(toEngine);\n",
    "\n",
    "  const payload = {\n",
    "    learner_lines: engineLines,\n",
    "    display_lines: slashExpanded,\n",
    "    tab_used: state.activeTab,\n",
    "    steps: engineLines.length,\n",
    "  };\n",
    "  resultEl.classList.add(\"shown\");\n",
    "  resultEl.innerHTML =\n",
    "    \"<div class='label'>submitted to step_grader</div>\" +\n",
    "    \"<pre>\" + JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2) + \"</pre>\";\n",

    "const TO_ENGINE = {\n",
    "  \"θ\":\"theta\",\"α\":\"alpha\",\"β\":\"beta\",\"γ\":\"gamma\",\"δ\":\"delta\",\"ε\":\"epsilon\",\n",
    "  \"λ\":\"lambda\",\"μ\":\"mu\",\"π\":\"pi\",\"ρ\":\"rho\",\"σ\":\"sigma\",\"τ\":\"tau\",\"φ\":\"phi\",\n",
    "  \"ψ\":\"psi\",\"ω\":\"omega\",\n",

    "  \"≤\":\"<=\",\"≥\":\">=\",\"≠\":\"!=\",\"±\":\"+/-\",\"≈\":\"approx\",\n",
    "  \"×\":\" x \",\"÷\":\" / \",\n",
    "  \"⇒\":\" => \",\"⇔\":\" <=> \",\"∴\":\" therefore \",\"∵\":\" because \",\n",

    "function toEngine(text) {\n",
    "  let out = text;\n",
    "  const syms = Object.keys(TO_ENGINE).sort((a,b) => b.length - a.length);\n",
    "  for (const s of syms) out = out.split(s).join(TO_ENGINE[s]);\n",
    "  return out;\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "function refreshNumbers() {\n",
    "  const lines = textEl.innerText.split(\"\\n\");\n",
    "  numsEl.innerHTML = lines.map((_, i) => `<div>${i + 1}</div>`).join(\"\");\n",
    "  const n = lines.length;\n",
    "  stepCountEl.textContent = (n === 1 && lines[0] === \"\")\n",
    "    ? \"0 steps\" : `${n} step${n === 1 ? \"\" : \"s\"}`;\n",
    "}\n",
    "textEl.addEventListener(\"input\", refreshNumbers);\n",
    "refreshNumbers();\n",
    "\n",
    "function getCaretContext() {\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return { before: \"\", after: \"\" };\n",
    "  const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "  const pre = r.cloneRange(); pre.selectNodeContents(textEl);\n",
    "  pre.setEnd(r.startContainer, r.startOffset);\n",
    "  const before = pre.toString();\n",
    "  const post = r.cloneRange(); post.selectNodeContents(textEl);\n",
    "  post.setStart(r.endContainer, r.endOffset);\n",
    "  const after = post.toString();\n",
    "  return { before, after };\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "function insertAtCaret(str) {\n",
    "  textEl.focus();\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return;\n",
    "  const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "  r.deleteContents();\n",
    "  const node = document.createTextNode(str);\n",
    "  r.insertNode(node);\n",
    "  r.setStartAfter(node);\n",
    "  r.setEndAfter(node);\n",
    "  sel.removeAllRanges();\n",
    "  sel.addRange(r);\n",
    "  refreshNumbers();\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "function smartInsert(key) {\n",
    "  if (key.e === \"__back__\") {\n",
    "    textEl.focus();\n",
    "    document.execCommand(\"delete\");\n",
    "    refreshNumbers();\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (key.e === \"__newline__\") { insertAtCaret(\"\\n\"); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.e === \"__done__\")    { submit(); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.e === \"__abc__\") {\n",
    "    state.abcMode = !state.abcMode;\n",
    "    renderGrid();\n",
    "    renderBase();\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (key.e === \"__collapse__\") {\n",
    "    state.collapsed = !state.collapsed;\n",
    "    document.getElementById(\"grid\").classList.toggle(\"collapsed\", state.collapsed);\n",
    "    document.getElementById(\"basegrid\").classList.toggle(\"collapsed\", state.collapsed);\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  const { before, after } = getCaretContext();\n",
    "  let ins = key.d;\n",
    "  if (key.sp) {\n",
    "    const needLead  = before.length > 0 && !/\\s$/.test(before);\n",
    "    const needTrail = after.length  > 0 && !/^\\s/.test(after);\n",
    "    ins = (needLead ? \" \" : \"\") + ins.trim() + (needTrail ? \" \" : \"\");\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  insertAtCaret(ins);\n",
    "  if (key.skip === 1 && key.d === \"()\") {\n",
    "    const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "    if (sel.rangeCount) {\n",
    "      const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "      if (r.startContainer.nodeType === 3 && r.startOffset > 0) {\n",
    "        const nr = r.cloneRange();\n",
    "        nr.setStart(nr.startContainer, nr.startOffset - 1);\n",
    "        nr.collapse(true);\n",
    "        sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(nr);\n",
    "      }\n",
    "    }\n",
    "  }\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "// ---------- tabs ----------\n",
    "const tabsEl = document.getElementById(\"tabs\");\n",
    "LAYOUT.tabs_order.forEach(name => {\n",
    "  const b = document.createElement(\"button\");\n",
    "  b.className = \"tab\" + (name === state.activeTab ? \" active\" : \"\");\n",
    "  b.textContent = name;\n",
    "  b.onclick = () => {\n",
    "    state.activeTab = name;\n",
    "    document.querySelectorAll(\".tab\").forEach(t =>\n",
    "      t.classList.toggle(\"active\", t.textContent === name));\n",
    "    renderGrid();\n",
    "  };\n",
    "  tabsEl.appendChild(b);\n",
    "});\n",
    "\n",
    "// ---------- grid ----------\n",
    "const gridEl = document.getElementById(\"grid\");\n",
    "function renderGrid() {\n",
    "  if (state.abcMode) {\n",
    "    gridEl.innerHTML = \"\";\n",
    "    const rows = LAYOUT.base_layer.abc || [];\n",
    "    const cols = Math.max(...rows.map(r => r.length));\n",
    "    rows.forEach(row => {\n",
    "      const r = document.createElement(\"div\");\n",
    "      r.className = \"row\";\n",
    "      r.style.gridTemplateColumns = `repeat(${cols}, 1fr)`;\n",
    "      row.forEach(key => {\n",
    "        const k = document.createElement(\"div\");\n",
    "        k.className = \"key\";\n",
    "        k.textContent = key.l;\n",
    "        k.onclick = () => smartInsert(key);\n",
    "        r.appendChild(k);\n",
    "      });\n",
    "      for (let i = row.length; i < cols; i++)\n",
    "        r.appendChild(document.createElement(\"div\"));\n",
    "      gridEl.appendChild(r);\n",
    "    });\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  const rows = LAYOUT.tabs[state.activeTab] || [];\n",
    "  gridEl.innerHTML = \"\";\n",
    "  const cols = Math.max(...rows.map(r => r.length));\n",
    "  rows.forEach(row => {\n",
    "    const r = document.createElement(\"div\");\n",
    "    r.className = \"row\";\n",
    "    r.style.gridTemplateColumns = `repeat(${cols}, 1fr)`;\n",
    "    row.forEach(key => {\n",
    "      const k = document.createElement(\"div\");\n",
    "      const accent = [\"or\",\"=\",\"⇒\",\"∴\",\"∵\"].includes(key.l) ? \" accent\" : \"\";\n",
    "      const small = key.l.length > 4 ? \" small\" : \"\";\n",
    "      k.className = \"key\" + accent + small;\n",
    "      k.textContent = key.l;\n",
    "      k.onclick = () => smartInsert(key);\n",
    "      r.appendChild(k);\n",
    "    });\n",

    "      r.appendChild(document.createElement(\"div\"));\n",
    "    gridEl.appendChild(r);\n",
    "  });\n",

    "  const b = LAYOUT.base_layer;\n",

    "// ---------- submit ----------\n",
    "const resultEl = document.getElementById(\"result\");\n",
    "const CMD = {\n",
    "  or: \" or \", then: \" ∴ \", because: \" ∵ \",\n",

    "  const rawLines = textEl.innerText.split(\"\\n\").map(l => l.trim()).filter(l => l.length);\n",
    "  const slashExpanded = rawLines.map(l =>\n",

    "    learner_lines: engineLines,\n",
    "    display_lines: slashExpanded,\n",
    "    tab_used: state.activeTab,\n",
    "    steps: engineLines.length,\n",
    "  };\n",
    "  resultEl.classList.add(\"shown\");\n",
    "  resultEl.innerHTML =\n",
    "    \"<div class='label'>submitted to step_grader</div>\" +\n",
    "    \"<pre>\" + JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2) + \"</pre>\";\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",

    "renderGrid();\n",
    "renderBase();\n",

    "  const pre = r.cloneRange(); pre.selectNodeContents(textEl);\n",
    "  pre.setEnd(r.startContainer, r.startOffset);\n",
    "  const before = pre.toString();\n",
    "  const post = r.cloneRange(); post.selectNodeContents(textEl);\n",
    "  post.setStart(r.endContainer, r.endOffset);\n",
    "  const after = post.toString();\n",

    "function insertAtCaret(str) {\n",
    "  textEl.focus();\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return;\n",
    "  const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "  r.deleteContents();\n",

    "  r.insertNode(node);\n",
    "  r.setStartAfter(node);\n",
    "  r.setEndAfter(node);\n",
    "  sel.removeAllRanges();\n",
    "  sel.addRange(r);\n",
    "  refreshNumbers();\n",
    "}\n",

    "function moveCursorBack(n) {\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount || n <= 0) return;\n",
    "  const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "  if (r.startContainer.nodeType === 3 && r.startOffset >= n) {\n",

    "    nr.collapse(true);\n",
    "    sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(nr);\n",
    "  }\n",
    "}\n",

    "// Find next \"()\" pair after the cursor and jump inside\n",
    "function jumpToNextParens() {\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return;\n",
    "  const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "  const full = textEl.innerText;\n",
    "  // get current character offset\n",
    "  const pre = r.cloneRange();\n",
    "  pre.selectNodeContents(textEl);\n",
    "  pre.setEnd(r.startContainer, r.startOffset);\n",
    "  const offset = pre.toString().length;\n",
    "  // find next '()' after offset\n",
    "  const idx = full.indexOf(\"()\", offset + 1);\n",
    "  if (idx < 0) return;\n",
    "  // set cursor inside the parens (idx+1)\n",
    "  const walker = document.createTreeWalker(textEl, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);\n",
    "  let pos = 0, targetNode = null, targetOffset = 0;\n",
    "  while (walker.nextNode()) {\n",
    "    const len = walker.currentNode.textContent.length;\n",
    "    if (pos + len >= idx + 1) {\n",
    "      targetNode = walker.currentNode;\n",
    "      targetOffset = idx + 1 - pos;\n",
    "      break;\n",
    "    }\n",
    "    pos += len;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (targetNode) {\n",
    "    const nr = document.createRange();\n",
    "    nr.setStart(targetNode, targetOffset);\n",
    "    nr.collapse(true);\n",
    "    sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(nr);\n",
    "  }\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "function smartInsert(key) {\n",
    "  if (key.e === \"__back__\") {\n",
    "    textEl.focus();\n",
    "    document.execCommand(\"delete\");\n",
    "    refreshNumbers();\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (key.e === \"__newline__\") { insertAtCaret(\"\\n\"); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.e === \"__done__\")    { submit(); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.e === \"__abc__\") {\n",
    "    state.abcMode = !state.abcMode;\n",
    "    renderGrid();\n",
    "    renderBase();\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (key.e === \"__collapse__\") {\n",
    "    state.collapsed = !state.collapsed;\n",
    "    document.getElementById(\"grid\").classList.toggle(\"collapsed\", state.collapsed);\n",
    "    document.getElementById(\"basegrid\").classList.toggle(\"collapsed\", state.collapsed);\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (key.e === \"__tab__\") { jumpToNextParens(); return; }\n",
    "  const { before, after } = getCaretContext();\n",
    "  let ins = key.d;\n",

    "const TO_ENGINE = {\n",
    "  \"θ\":\"theta\",\"α\":\"alpha\",\"β\":\"beta\",\"γ\":\"gamma\",\"δ\":\"delta\",\"ε\":\"epsilon\",\n",
    "  \"λ\":\"lambda\",\"μ\":\"mu\",\"π\":\"pi\",\"ρ\":\"rho\",\"σ\":\"sigma\",\"τ\":\"tau\",\"φ\":\"phi\",\n",
    "  \"ψ\":\"psi\",\"ω\":\"omega\",\n",
    "  \"Σ\":\"sum\",\"∑\":\"sum\",\"Δ\":\"Delta\",\"Ω\":\"Omega\",\n",
    "  \"√\":\"sqrt\",\"∛\":\"cbrt\",\"ⁿ√\":\"nroot\",\n",
    "  \"≤\":\"<=\",\"≥\":\">=\",\"≠\":\"!=\",\"±\":\"+/-\",\"≈\":\"approx\",\n",
    "  \"×\":\" x \",\"÷\":\" / \",\n",
    "  \"⇒\":\" => \",\"⇔\":\" <=> \",\"∴\":\" therefore \",\"∵\":\" because \",\n",

    "  \"sin⁻¹\":\"asin\",\"cos⁻¹\":\"acos\",\"tan⁻¹\":\"atan\",\n",
    "  \"Tₙ\":\"Tn\",\"Sₙ\":\"Sn\",\n",
    "};\n",
    "\n",
    "function toEngine(text) {\n",
    "  let out = text;\n",
    "  const syms = Object.keys(TO_ENGINE).sort((a,b) => b.length - a.length);\n",
    "  for (const s of syms) out = out.split(s).join(TO_ENGINE[s]);\n",
    "  return out;\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "function refreshNumbers() {\n",
    "  const lines = textEl.innerText.split(\"\\n\");\n",
    "  numsEl.innerHTML = lines.map((_, i) => `<div>${i + 1}</div>`).join(\"\");\n",
    "  const n = lines.length;\n",
    "  stepCountEl.textContent = (n === 1 && lines[0] === \"\")\n",
    "    ? \"0 steps\" : `${n} step${n === 1 ? \"\" : \"s\"}`;\n",
    "}\n",
    "textEl.addEventListener(\"input\", refreshNumbers);\n",
    "refreshNumbers();\n",
    "\n",
    "function getCaretContext() {\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return { before: \"\", after: \"\" };\n",
    "  const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "  const pre = r.cloneRange(); pre.selectNodeContents(textEl);\n",
    "  pre.setEnd(r.startContainer, r.startOffset);\n",
    "  const before = pre.toString();\n",
    "  const post = r.cloneRange(); post.selectNodeContents(textEl);\n",
    "  post.setStart(r.endContainer, r.endOffset);\n",
    "  const after = post.toString();\n",
    "  return { before, after };\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "function insertAtCaret(str) {\n",
    "  textEl.focus();\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return;\n",
    "  const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "  r.deleteContents();\n",
    "  const node = document.createTextNode(str);\n",
    "  r.insertNode(node);\n",
    "  r.setStartAfter(node);\n",
    "  r.setEndAfter(node);\n",
    "  sel.removeAllRanges();\n",
    "  sel.addRange(r);\n",
    "  refreshNumbers();\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "function moveCursorBack(n) {\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount || n <= 0) return;\n",
    "  const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "  if (r.startContainer.nodeType === 3 && r.startOffset >= n) {\n",
    "    const nr = r.cloneRange();\n",
    "    nr.setStart(nr.startContainer, nr.startOffset - n);\n",
    "    nr.collapse(true);\n",
    "    sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(nr);\n",
    "  }\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "function smartInsert(key) {\n",
    "  if (key.e === \"__back__\") {\n",
    "    textEl.focus();\n",
    "    document.execCommand(\"delete\");\n",
    "    refreshNumbers();\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (key.e === \"__newline__\") { insertAtCaret(\"\\n\"); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.e === \"__done__\")    { submit(); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.e === \"__abc__\") {\n",
    "    state.abcMode = !state.abcMode;\n",
    "    renderGrid();\n",
    "    renderBase();\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (key.e === \"__collapse__\") {\n",
    "    state.collapsed = !state.collapsed;\n",
    "    document.getElementById(\"grid\").classList.toggle(\"collapsed\", state.collapsed);\n",
    "    document.getElementById(\"basegrid\").classList.toggle(\"collapsed\", state.collapsed);\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  \n",
    "  // Handle skip logic for fractions/exponents\n",
    "  const { before, after } = getCaretContext();\n",
    "  let ins = key.d;\n",
    "  if (key.sp) {\n",
    "    const needLead  = before.length > 0 && !/\\s$/.test(before);\n",
    "    const needTrail = after.length  > 0 && !/^\\s/.test(after);\n",
    "    ins = (needLead ? \" \" : \"\") + ins.trim() + (needTrail ? \" \" : \"\");\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  \n",
    "  if (key.skip === 4 && key.d === \"()/()\") {\n",
    "      // Special handling for fraction to place cursor in numerator\n",
    "      insertAtCaret(\"()/()\");\n",
    "      moveCursorBack(4);\n",
    "  } else {\n",
    "      insertAtCaret(ins);\n",
    "      if (typeof key.skip === \"number\" && key.skip > 0) {\n",
    "        moveCursorBack(key.skip);\n",
    "      }\n",
    "  }\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "// ---------- tabs ----------\n",
    "const tabsEl = document.getElementById(\"tabs\");\n",
    "LAYOUT.tabs_order.forEach(name => {\n",
    "  const b = document.createElement(\"button\");\n",
    "  b.className = \"tab\" + (name === state.activeTab ? \" active\" : \"\");\n",
    "  b.textContent = name;\n",
    "  b.onclick = () => {\n",
    "    state.activeTab = name;\n",
    "    document.querySelectorAll(\".tab\").forEach(t =>\n",
    "      t.classList.toggle(\"active\", t.textContent === name));\n",
    "    renderGrid();\n",
    "  };\n",
    "  tabsEl.appendChild(b);\n",
    "});\n",
    "\n",
    "// ---------- grid ----------\n",
    "const gridEl = document.getElementById(\"grid\");\n",
    "function renderGrid() {\n",
    "  if (state.abcMode) {\n",
    "    gridEl.innerHTML = \"\";\n",
    "    const rows = LAYOUT.base_layer.abc || [];\n",
    "    const cols = Math.max(...rows.map(r => r.length));\n",
    "    rows.forEach(row => {\n",

    "        k.textContent = key.l;\n",
    "        k.onclick = () => smartInsert(key);\n",
    "        r.appendChild(k);\n",
    "      });\n",
    "      for (let i = row.length; i < cols; i++)\n",
    "        r.appendChild(document.createElement(\"div\"));\n",

    "      const small = key.l.length > 4 ? \" small\" : \"\";\n",

    "  textEl.focus();\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return;\n",
    "  const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "  r.deleteContents();\n",
    "  \n",
    "  const temp = document.createElement('div');\n",
    "  temp.innerHTML = htmlStr;\n",
    "  \n",
    "  while (temp.firstChild) {\n",
    "    r.insertNode(temp.firstChild);\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  \n",
    "  // Find the first contenteditable element inside the inserted HTML\n",
    "  const firstEditable = temp.querySelector('[contenteditable=\"true\"]');\n",
    "  if (firstEditable) {\n",
    "    const nr = document.createRange();\n",
    "    nr.selectNodeContents(firstEditable);\n",
    "    nr.collapse(true);\n",
    "    sel.removeAllRanges();\n",
    "    sel.addRange(nr);\n",
    "  } else {\n",
    "    r.collapse(false);\n",
    "    sel.removeAllRanges();\n",
    "    sel.addRange(r);\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  refreshNumbers();\n",
    "}\n",

    "function smartInsert(key) {\n",
    "  if (key.e === \"__back__\") {\n",
    "    textEl.focus();\n",
    "    document.execCommand(\"delete\");\n",
    "    refreshNumbers();\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (key.e === \"__newline__\") { insertAtCaret(\"<br>\"); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.e === \"__done__\")    { submit(); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.e === \"__abc__\") {\n",
    "    state.abcMode = !state.abcMode;\n",
    "    renderBase();\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (key.e === \"__collapse__\") {\n",

    "    document.getElementById(\"basegrid\").classList.toggle(\"collapsed\", state.collapsed);\n",

    "  \n",
    "  if (key.h) {\n",
    "    insertAtCaret(key.h);\n",

    "  }\n",

    "      const small = key.l.length > 4 ? \" small\" : \"\";\n",

    "\n",
    "<script>\n",
    "const LAYOUT = __LAYOUT__;\n",
    "const state = { tab: LAYOUT.tabs_order[0] };\n",
    "\n",
    "/* ---------- line-based editor ---------- */\n",
    "const linesEl = document.getElementById('lines');\n",
    "\n",
    "function addLine(html, focus) {\n",
    "  const row = document.createElement('div');\n",
    "  row.className = 'lrow';\n",
    "  const num = document.createElement('div');\n",
    "  num.className = 'lnum';\n",
    "  const body = document.createElement('div');\n",
    "  body.className = 'lbody';\n",
    "  body.contentEditable = 'true';\n",
    "  body.spellcheck = false;\n",
    "  if (html) body.innerHTML = html;\n",
    "  row.appendChild(num); row.appendChild(body);\n",
    "  linesEl.appendChild(row);\n",
    "  renumber();\n",
    "  if (focus) {\n",
    "    placeCursorIn(body, false);\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  return body;\n",
    "}\n",
    "function renumber(){\n",
    "  [...linesEl.querySelectorAll('.lrow')].forEach((r,i)=>{\n",
    "    r.querySelector('.lnum').textContent = i+1;\n",
    "  });\n",
    "}\n",
    "function placeCursorIn(el, atEnd) {\n",
    "  el.focus();\n",
    "  const r = document.createRange();\n",
    "  r.selectNodeContents(el);\n",
    "  r.collapse(!atEnd);\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(r);\n",
    "}\n",
    "function activeLine() {\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return null;\n",
    "  let n = sel.getRangeAt(0).startContainer;\n",
    "  while (n && n !== linesEl) {\n",
    "    if (n.classList && n.classList.contains('lbody')) return n;\n",
    "    n = n.parentNode;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  return null;\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "/* Backspace at start of a line → merge with previous */\n",
    "/* Enter → new line below, split if cursor mid-line */\n",
    "linesEl.addEventListener('keydown', e => {\n",
    "  const line = e.target.closest('.lbody'); if (!line) return;\n",
    "\n",
    "  if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {\n",
    "    e.preventDefault();\n",
    "    const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "    const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "    // split content at cursor\n",
    "    const after = r.cloneRange();\n",
    "    after.selectNodeContents(line);\n",
    "    after.setStart(r.endContainer, r.endOffset);\n",
    "    const rest = after.extractContents();\n",
    "    const newBody = addLine('', true);\n",
    "    // put rest content into new line\n",
    "    while (rest.firstChild) newBody.insertBefore(rest.firstChild, newBody.firstChild);\n",
    "    placeCursorIn(newBody, false);\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "\n",
    "  if (e.key === 'Backspace') {\n",
    "    const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "    const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "    if (!r.collapsed) return;\n",
    "    // is the cursor at the very start of this line?\n",
    "    const probe = r.cloneRange(); probe.selectNodeContents(line);\n",
    "    probe.setEnd(r.startContainer, r.startOffset);\n",
    "    if (probe.toString().length !== 0) return;\n",
    "    if (line.textContent.length === 0 || probe.toString().length === 0) {\n",
    "      const prev = line.closest('.lrow').previousElementSibling;\n",
    "      if (prev) {\n",
    "        e.preventDefault();\n",
    "        const prevBody = prev.querySelector('.lbody');\n",
    "        // move contents of this line into prev line\n",
    "        while (line.firstChild) prevBody.appendChild(line.firstChild);\n",
    "        line.closest('.lrow').remove();\n",
    "        placeCursorIn(prevBody, true);\n",
    "        renumber();\n",
    "      } else if (line.textContent.length === 0) {\n",
    "        e.preventDefault();\n",
    "      }\n",
    "    }\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "\n",
    "  /* Up/Down at boundary → move between lines */\n",
    "  if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {\n",
    "    const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "    const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "    const probe = r.cloneRange(); probe.selectNodeContents(line);\n",
    "    probe.setEnd(r.startContainer, r.startOffset);\n",
    "    if (probe.toString().length === 0) {\n",
    "      const prev = line.closest('.lrow').previousElementSibling;\n",
    "      if (prev) { e.preventDefault(); placeCursorIn(prev.querySelector('.lbody'), true); }\n",
    "    }\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {\n",
    "    const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "    const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "    const probe = r.cloneRange(); probe.selectNodeContents(line);\n",
    "    probe.setStart(r.endContainer, r.endOffset);\n",
    "    if (probe.toString().length === 0) {\n",
    "      const next = line.closest('.lrow').nextElementSibling;\n",
    "      if (next) { e.preventDefault(); placeCursorIn(next.querySelector('.lbody'), false); }\n",
    "    }\n",
    "  }\n",
    "});\n",
    "\n",
    "/* ---------- insertion ---------- */\n",
    "function insertAtCursor(html) {\n",
    "  const line = activeLine();\n",
    "  if (!line) {\n",
    "    // no active line → create one and insert\n",
    "    const b = addLine('', true);\n",
    "    b.innerHTML = html;\n",
    "    placeCursorInFirstField(b);\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return;\n",
    "  const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "  r.deleteContents();\n",
    "\n",
    "  const tmp = document.createElement('div');\n",
    "  tmp.innerHTML = html;\n",
    "  const last = tmp.lastChild;\n",
    "  while (tmp.firstChild) r.insertNode(tmp.firstChild);\n",
    "\n",
    "  // focus first .cur field in the inserted content\n",
    "  if (last && last.querySelector) {\n",
    "    const cur = last.querySelector('.cur');\n",
    "    if (cur) {\n",
    "      const nr = document.createRange();\n",
    "      nr.selectNodeContents(cur);\n",
    "      nr.collapse(true);\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(nr);\n",
    "      return;\n",
    "    }\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  // else just put cursor at end of the insertion\n",
    "  const nr = document.createRange();\n",
    "  nr.setStartAfter(last);\n",
    "  nr.collapse(true);\n",
    "  sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(nr);\n",
    "}\n",
    "function placeCursorInFirstField(el) {\n",
    "  const cur = el.querySelector('.cur');\n",
    "  if (cur) { const r=document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(cur); r.collapse(true);\n",
    "    const s=window.getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r); }\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "/* ---------- key handlers ---------- */\n",
    "function handleKey(key) {\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__del__')   { document.execCommand('delete'); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__clear__') { linesEl.innerHTML=''; addLine('', true); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__enter__') { const line=activeLine()||addLine('',false);\n",
    "                               const nb=addLine('', true); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__ask__')   { document.getElementById('sbc').focus(); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__done__')  { submit(); return; }\n",
    "  insertAtCursor(key.i);\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "/* ---------- tabs ---------- */\n",
    "const tabsEl = document.getElementById('tabs');\n",
    "LAYOUT.tabs_order.forEach(name => {\n",
    "  const b = document.createElement('button');\n",
    "  b.className = 'tab' + (name === state.tab ? ' active' : '');\n",
    "  b.textContent = name;\n",
    "  b.onclick = () => {\n",
    "    state.tab = name;\n",
    "    document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t =>\n",
    "      t.classList.toggle('active', t.textContent === name));\n",
    "    renderGrid();\n",
    "  };\n",
    "  tabsEl.appendChild(b);\n",
    "});\n",
    "\n",
    "/* ---------- key grid + base row ---------- */\n",
    "const gridEl = document.getElementById('grid');\n",
    "function makeKeyBtn(key) {\n",
    "  const el = document.createElement('div');\n",
    "  el.className = 'key';\n",
    "  if (key.ic) el.innerHTML = key.ic;\n",
    "  else el.textContent = key.k;\n",
    "  el.onclick = () => handleKey(key);\n",
    "  return el;\n",
    "}\n",
    "function renderGrid() {\n",
    "  gridEl.innerHTML = '';\n",
    "  const rows = LAYOUT.tabs[state.tab] || [];\n",
    "  const cols = Math.max(...rows.map(r => r.length));\n",
    "  // base layer first\n",
    "  const baseLayout = [\n",
    "    LAYOUT.base_layer.variables,\n",
    "    LAYOUT.base_layer.digits,\n",
    "    LAYOUT.base_layer.operators,\n",
    "  ];\n",
    "  baseLayout.forEach(keys => {\n",
    "    const r = document.createElement('div');\n",
    "    r.className='row';\n",
    "    r.style.gridTemplateColumns = `repeat(${keys.length},1fr)`;\n",
    "    keys.forEach(k => r.appendChild(makeKeyBtn(k)));\n",
    "    gridEl.appendChild(r);\n",
    "  });\n",
    "  // then tab-specific rows\n",
    "  rows.forEach(row => {\n",
    "    const r = document.createElement('div');\n",
    "    r.className='row';\n",
    "    r.style.gridTemplateColumns = `repeat(${cols},1fr)`;\n",
    "    row.forEach(k => r.appendChild(makeKeyBtn(k)));\n",
    "    for (let i=row.length;i<cols;i++) r.appendChild(document.createElement('div'));\n",

    ".mq-qf{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:0 3px;\n",

    "\n",
    "/* ────── result strip ────── */\n",
    ".result{padding:8px 14px;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;\n",
    "  font-family:'SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;font-size:10px;line-height:1.5;\n",
    "  max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .25s ease;flex:none}\n",
    ".result.shown{max-height:240px;overflow-y:auto}\n",
    ".result .label{color:#9ab;margin-bottom:4px}\n",
    ".result pre{margin:0;color:#cfe2ff;white-space:pre-wrap}\n",
    "\n",
    "/* ────── phone tweaks ────── */\n",
    "@media (max-width:480px){\n",
    "  .work{max-height:clamp(100px,22vh,180px)}\n",
    "  .lbody{font-size:15px}\n",
    "  .kb{padding:6px}\n",
    "  .row{gap:4px}\n",
    "  .key{min-height:38px;border-radius:6px}\n",
    "  .topbar{padding:8px 12px}\n",
    "}\n",
    "@media (min-width:1025px){\n",
    "  .work{max-height:260px}\n",
    "}\n",
    "</style></head><body>\n",
    "\n",
    "<div class=\"app\">\n",
    "\n",
    "  <div class=\"topbar\">\n",
    "    <div class=\"logo\">M</div>\n",
    "    <div><div class=\"brand\">MethodMarker</div>\n",
    "    <div class=\"tag\">Better Methods. Higher Marks.</div></div>\n",
    "  </div>\n",
    "\n",
    "  <div class=\"work\">\n",
    "    <div class=\"work-head\">\n",
    "      <span>&#9998; Working</span>\n",
    "      <span class=\"hint\">tap a line · ⏎ new step · ⌫ at start merges up</span>\n",
    "    </div>\n",
    "    <div class=\"lines\" id=\"lines\"></div>\n",
    "  </div>\n",
    "\n",
    "  <div class=\"sbc\">\n",
    "    <div class=\"sbc-head\"><span class=\"dot\"></span>\n",
    "      Ask Tanaka — where did you get stuck?</div>\n",
    "    <textarea id=\"sbc\" rows=\"1\"\n",
    "      placeholder=\"e.g. I did step 2 but I don't understand why the sign flips\"></textarea>\n",
    "  </div>\n",
    "\n",
    "  <div class=\"tabs\" id=\"tabs\"></div>\n",
    "  <div class=\"kb-scroll\"><div class=\"kb\" id=\"kb\"></div></div>\n",
    "  <div class=\"acts\" id=\"acts\"></div>\n",
    "  <div class=\"result\" id=\"result\"></div>\n",
    "</div>\n",
    "\n",
    "<script>\n",
    "const LAYOUT = __LAYOUT__;\n",
    "const state = { tab: LAYOUT.tabs_order[0] };\n",
    "\n",
    "/* ═══════════ line editor ═══════════ */\n",
    "const linesEl = document.getElementById('lines');\n",
    "\n",
    "function addLine(html, focus){\n",
    "  const row = document.createElement('div'); row.className='lrow';\n",
    "  const n = document.createElement('div'); n.className='lnum';\n",
    "  const b = document.createElement('div'); b.className='lbody';\n",
    "  b.contentEditable='true'; b.spellcheck=false;\n",
    "  if (html) b.innerHTML = html;\n",
    "  row.appendChild(n); row.appendChild(b);\n",
    "  linesEl.appendChild(row);\n",
    "  renumber();\n",
    "  if (focus) focusStart(b);\n",
    "  return b;\n",
    "}\n",
    "function renumber(){\n",
    "  [...linesEl.querySelectorAll('.lrow')].forEach((r,i)=>{\n",
    "    r.querySelector('.lnum').textContent = i+1;\n",
    "  });\n",
    "}\n",
    "function focusStart(el){\n",
    "  el.focus();\n",
    "  const first = el.querySelector('.slot');\n",
    "  const r = document.createRange();\n",
    "  if (first) r.selectNodeContents(first);\n",
    "  else { r.selectNodeContents(el); r.collapse(false); }\n",
    "  r.collapse(true);\n",
    "  const s = window.getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r);\n",
    "}\n",
    "function activeLine(){\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return null;\n",
    "  let n = sel.getRangeAt(0).startContainer;\n",
    "  while (n && n !== linesEl){\n",
    "    if (n.classList && n.classList.contains('lbody')) return n;\n",
    "    n = n.parentNode;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  return null;\n",
    "}\n",
    "function currentSlot(){\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return null;\n",
    "  let n = sel.getRangeAt(0).startContainer;\n",
    "  if (n.nodeType === 3) n = n.parentNode;\n",
    "  return n.closest ? n.closest('.slot') : null;\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "/* Enter → new line (split). Backspace at line start → merge up. Tab → next slot. */\n",
    "linesEl.addEventListener('keydown', e => {\n",
    "  const line = e.target.closest('.lbody'); if (!line) return;\n",
    "\n",
    "  if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey){\n",
    "    e.preventDefault();\n",
    "    const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "    const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "    const after = r.cloneRange();\n",
    "    after.selectNodeContents(line);\n",
    "    after.setStart(r.endContainer, r.endOffset);\n",
    "    const rest = after.extractContents();\n",
    "    const nb = addLine('', false);\n",
    "    while (rest.firstChild) nb.insertBefore(rest.firstChild, nb.firstChild);\n",
    "    focusStart(nb);\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "\n",
    "  if (e.key === 'Tab'){\n",
    "    e.preventDefault();\n",
    "    const slot = currentSlot();\n",
    "    if (!slot) return;\n",
    "    const struct = slot.closest('.mq-frac,.mq-exp,.mq-sqrt,.mq-sum,.mq-log,.mq-paren,.mq-qf');\n",
    "    if (!struct) return;\n",
    "    const slots = [...struct.querySelectorAll('.slot')];\n",
    "    const i = slots.indexOf(slot);\n",
    "    const next = slots[i+1];\n",
    "    const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "    if (next){\n",
    "      const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(next); r.collapse(true);\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(r);\n",
    "    } else {\n",
    "      const r = document.createRange(); r.setStartAfter(struct); r.collapse(true);\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(r);\n",
    "    }\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "\n",
    "  if (e.key === 'Backspace'){\n",
    "    const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "    const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "    if (!r.collapsed) return;\n",
    "    const probe = r.cloneRange(); probe.selectNodeContents(line);\n",
    "    probe.setEnd(r.startContainer, r.startOffset);\n",
    "    if (probe.toString().length !== 0) return;\n",
    "    const prev = line.closest('.lrow').previousElementSibling;\n",
    "    if (prev){\n",
    "      e.preventDefault();\n",
    "      const pb = prev.querySelector('.lbody');\n",
    "      while (line.firstChild) pb.appendChild(line.firstChild);\n",
    "      line.closest('.lrow').remove();\n",
    "      focusStart(pb);\n",
    "      renumber();\n",
    "    } else if (!line.textContent.trim()){\n",
    "      e.preventDefault();\n",
    "    }\n",
    "  }\n",
    "});\n",
    "\n",
    "/* ═══════════ insertion ═══════════ */\n",
    "function insertAtCursor(html){\n",
    "  let line = activeLine();\n",
    "  if (!line) line = addLine('', true);\n",
    "  line.focus();\n",
    "\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return;\n",
    "  const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "  r.deleteContents();\n",
    "\n",
    "  const tmp = document.createElement('span');\n",
    "  tmp.innerHTML = html;\n",
    "  const nodes = [...tmp.childNodes];\n",
    "  if (!nodes.length) return;\n",
    "\n",
    "  nodes.forEach(n => r.insertNode(n));\n",
    "  const last = nodes[nodes.length - 1];\n",
    "\n",
    "  /* focus first .cur slot inside what we just inserted */\n",
    "  let target = null;\n",
    "  if (last.nodeType === 1){\n",
    "    target = last.querySelector('.slot.cur') || last.querySelector('.slot');\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (!target && last.previousSibling && last.previousSibling.nodeType === 1){\n",
    "    target = last.previousSibling.querySelector &&\n",
    "             last.previousSibling.querySelector('.slot');\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (target){\n",
    "    const nr = document.createRange();\n",
    "    nr.selectNodeContents(target); nr.collapse(true);\n",
    "    sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(nr);\n",
    "  } else {\n",
    "    const nr = document.createRange();\n",
    "    nr.setStartAfter(last); nr.collapse(true);\n",
    "    sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(nr);\n",
    "  }\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "/* ═══════════ key handling ═══════════ */\n",
    "function handleKey(key){\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__del__')   { document.execCommand('delete'); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__clear__') { linesEl.innerHTML=''; addLine('', true); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__enter__') { addLine('', true); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__ask__')   { document.getElementById('sbc').focus(); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__done__')  { submit(); return; }\n",
    "  insertAtCursor(key.i);\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "/* ═══════════ tabs ═══════════ */\n",
    "const tabsEl = document.getElementById('tabs');\n",
    "LAYOUT.tabs_order.forEach(name => {\n",
    "  const b = document.createElement('button');\n",
    "  b.className = 'tab' + (name === state.tab ? ' active' : '');\n",
    "  b.textContent = name;\n",
    "  b.onclick = () => {\n",
    "    state.tab = name;\n",
    "    document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t =>\n",
    "      t.classList.toggle('active', t.textContent === name));\n",
    "    renderKb();\n",
    "  };\n",
    "  tabsEl.appendChild(b);\n",
    "});\n",
    "\n",
    "/* ═══════════ key grid ═══════════ */\n",
    "const kbEl = document.getElementById('kb');\n",
    "function keyBtn(key){\n",
    "  const el = document.createElement('div');\n",
    "  el.className = 'key';\n",
    "  if (key.ic) el.innerHTML = key.ic;\n",
    "  else el.textContent = key.l;\n",
    "  el.onclick = () => handleKey(key);\n",
    "  return el;\n",
    "}\n",
    "function renderKb(){\n",
    "  kbEl.innerHTML = '';\n",
    "\n",
    "  /* base layer rows (always) */\n",
    "  const baseRows = [\n",
    "    LAYOUT.base.structure,\n",
    "    LAYOUT.base.operators,\n",
    "    LAYOUT.base.digits,\n",
    "    LAYOUT.base.variables,\n",
    "  ];\n",
    "  baseRows.forEach(keys => {\n",
    "    const r = document.createElement('div'); r.className='row';\n",
    "    r.style.gridTemplateColumns = `repeat(${keys.length},1fr)`;\n",
    "    keys.forEach(k => r.appendChild(keyBtn(k)));\n",
    "    kbEl.appendChild(r);\n",
    "  });\n",
    "\n",
    "  /* tab-specific rows */\n",
    "  const rows = LAYOUT.tabs[state.tab] || [];\n",
    "  rows.forEach(row => {\n",
    "    const r = document.createElement('div'); r.className='row';\n",
    "    r.style.gridTemplateColumns = `repeat(${row.length},1fr)`;\n",
    "    row.forEach(k => r.appendChild(keyBtn(k)));\n",
    "    kbEl.appendChild(r);\n",
    "  });\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "/* ═══════════ actions ═══════════ */\n",
    "const actsEl = document.getElementById('acts');\n",
