    "</style></head><body>\n",
    "\n",
    "<div class=\"app\">\n",
    "\n",
    "  <div class=\"topbar\">\n",
    "    <div class=\"logo\">M</div>\n",
    "    <div><div class=\"brand\">MethodMarker</div>\n",
    "    <div class=\"tag\">Better Methods. Higher Marks.</div></div>\n",
    "  </div>\n",
    "\n",
    "  <div class=\"work\">\n",
    "    <div class=\"work-head\">\n",
    "      <span>&#9998; Working</span>\n",
    "      <span class=\"hint\">tap a line · ⏎ new step · ⌫ at start merges up</span>\n",
    "    </div>\n",
    "    <div class=\"lines\" id=\"lines\"></div>\n",
    "  </div>\n",
    "\n",
    "  <div class=\"sbc\">\n",
    "    <div class=\"sbc-head\"><span class=\"dot\"></span>\n",
    "      Ask Tanaka — where did you get stuck?</div>\n",
    "    <textarea id=\"sbc\" rows=\"1\"\n",
    "      placeholder=\"e.g. I did step 2 but I don't understand why the sign flips\"></textarea>\n",
    "  </div>\n",
    "\n",
    "  <div class=\"tabs\" id=\"tabs\"></div>\n",
    "  <div class=\"kb-scroll\"><div class=\"kb\" id=\"kb\"></div></div>\n",
    "  <div class=\"acts\" id=\"acts\"></div>\n",
    "  <div class=\"result\" id=\"result\"></div>\n",
    "</div>\n",
    "\n",
    "<script>\n",
    "const LAYOUT = __LAYOUT__;\n",
    "const state = { tab: LAYOUT.tabs_order[0], abcMode: false };\n",
    "\n",
    "/* ═══════════ line editor ═══════════ */\n",
    "const linesEl = document.getElementById('lines');\n",
    "\n",
    "function addLine(html, focus){\n",
    "  const row = document.createElement('div'); row.className='lrow';\n",
    "  const n = document.createElement('div'); n.className='lnum';\n",
    "  const b = document.createElement('div'); b.className='lbody';\n",
    "  b.contentEditable='true'; b.spellcheck=false;\n",
    "  if (html) b.innerHTML = html;\n",
    "  row.appendChild(n); row.appendChild(b);\n",
    "  linesEl.appendChild(row);\n",
    "  renumber();\n",
    "  if (focus) focusStart(b);\n",
    "  return b;\n",
    "}\n",
    "function renumber(){\n",
    "  [...linesEl.querySelectorAll('.lrow')].forEach((r,i)=>{\n",
    "    r.querySelector('.lnum').textContent = i+1;\n",
    "  });\n",
    "}\n",
    "function focusStart(el){\n",
    "  el.focus();\n",
    "  const first = el.querySelector('.slot');\n",
    "  const r = document.createRange();\n",
    "  if (first) r.selectNodeContents(first);\n",
    "  else { r.selectNodeContents(el); r.collapse(false); }\n",
    "  r.collapse(true);\n",
    "  const s = window.getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r);\n",
    "}\n",
    "function activeLine(){\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return null;\n",
    "  let n = sel.getRangeAt(0).startContainer;\n",
    "  while (n && n !== linesEl){\n",
    "    if (n.classList && n.classList.contains('lbody')) return n;\n",
    "    n = n.parentNode;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  return null;\n",
    "}\n",
    "function currentSlot(){\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return null;\n",
    "  let n = sel.getRangeAt(0).startContainer;\n",
    "  if (n.nodeType === 3) n = n.parentNode;\n",
    "  return n.closest ? n.closest('.slot') : null;\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "/* ═══════════ backspace — direct, callable from key or button ═══════════ */\n",
    "function doBackspace(){\n",
    "  let line = activeLine();\n",
    "  if (!line){\n",
    "    const all = linesEl.querySelectorAll('.lbody');\n",
    "    if (all.length){\n",
    "      line = all[all.length-1];\n",
    "      line.focus();\n",
    "      const r = document.createRange();\n",
    "      r.selectNodeContents(line); r.collapse(false);\n",
    "      const s = window.getSelection();\n",
    "      s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r);\n",
    "    } else {\n",
    "      return;\n",
    "    }\n",
    "  }\n",
    "\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return;\n",
    "  const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "\n",
    "  if (!r.collapsed){\n",
    "    r.deleteContents();\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "\n",
    "  const slot = currentSlot();\n",
    "  if (slot){\n",
    "    const slotText = slot.textContent.replace(/\\u200B/g,'');\n",
    "    const probe = r.cloneRange(); probe.selectNodeContents(slot);\n",
    "    probe.setEnd(r.startContainer, r.startOffset);\n",
    "    const before = probe.toString().replace(/\\u200B/g,'');\n",
    "    if (slotText.length === 0 || before.length === 0){\n",
    "      const struct = slot.closest(\n",
    "        '.mq-frac,.mq-exp,.mq-sqrt,.mq-sum,.mq-log,.mq-paren,.mq-qf'\n",
    "      ) || slot;\n",
    "      const after = document.createRange();\n",
    "      after.setStartAfter(struct); after.collapse(true);\n",
    "      struct.remove();\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(after);\n",
    "      return;\n",
    "    }\n",
    "    deleteCharBefore(r);\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "\n",
    "  const probe = r.cloneRange(); probe.selectNodeContents(line);\n",
    "  probe.setEnd(r.startContainer, r.startOffset);\n",
    "  if (probe.toString().length === 0){\n",
    "    const prev = line.closest('.lrow').previousElementSibling;\n",
    "    if (prev){\n",
    "      const pb = prev.querySelector('.lbody');\n",
    "      while (line.firstChild) pb.appendChild(line.firstChild);\n",
    "      line.closest('.lrow').remove();\n",
    "      focusStart(pb);\n",
    "      renumber();\n",
    "      return;\n",
    "    }\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  deleteCharBefore(r);\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "function deleteCharBefore(r){\n",
    "  const node = r.startContainer;\n",
    "  const offset = r.startOffset;\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "\n",
    "  if (node.nodeType === 3 && offset > 0){\n",
    "    node.deleteData(offset - 1, 1);\n",
    "    const nr = document.createRange();\n",
    "    nr.setStart(node, offset - 1); nr.collapse(true);\n",
    "    sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(nr);\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "\n",
    "  if (node.nodeType === 3 && offset === 0){\n",
    "    let prev = node.previousSibling;\n",
    "    while (prev && prev.nodeType !== 3 && !prev.textContent){\n",
    "      prev = prev.previousSibling;\n",
    "    }\n",
    "    if (prev){\n",
    "      const after = document.createRange();\n",
    "      after.setStartAfter(prev); after.collapse(true);\n",
    "      prev.remove();\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(after);\n",
    "    }\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "\n",
    "  if (node.nodeType === 1){\n",
    "    let leaf = node;\n",
    "    while (leaf.lastChild && leaf.nodeType === 1) leaf = leaf.lastChild;\n",
    "    if (leaf.nodeType === 3){\n",
    "      const nr = document.createRange();\n",
    "      nr.setStart(leaf, Math.max(0, leaf.textContent.length - 1));\n",
    "      nr.collapse(true);\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(nr);\n",
    "      doBackspace();\n",
    "    } else if (leaf.previousSibling){\n",
    "      const after = document.createRange();\n",
    "      after.setStartAfter(leaf.previousSibling); after.collapse(true);\n",
    "      leaf.previousSibling.remove();\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(after);\n",
    "    }\n",
    "  }\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "/* ═══════════ line keydown ═══════════ */\n",
    "linesEl.addEventListener('keydown', e => {\n",
    "  const line = e.target.closest('.lbody'); if (!line) return;\n",
    "\n",
    "  if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey){\n",
    "    e.preventDefault();\n",
    "    const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "    const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "    const after = r.cloneRange();\n",
    "    after.selectNodeContents(line);\n",
    "    after.setStart(r.endContainer, r.endOffset);\n",
    "    const rest = after.extractContents();\n",
    "    const nb = addLine('', false);\n",
    "    while (rest.firstChild) nb.insertBefore(rest.firstChild, nb.firstChild);\n",
    "    focusStart(nb);\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "\n",
    "  if (e.key === 'Tab'){\n",
    "    e.preventDefault();\n",
    "    const slot = currentSlot();\n",
    "    if (!slot){\n",
    "      const r = document.createRange();\n",
    "      r.selectNodeContents(line); r.collapse(false);\n",
    "      const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(r);\n",
    "      return;\n",
    "    }\n",
    "    const struct = slot.closest('.mq-frac,.mq-exp,.mq-sqrt,.mq-sum,.mq-log,.mq-paren,.mq-qf');\n",
    "    if (!struct) return;\n",
    "    const slots = [...struct.querySelectorAll('.slot')];\n",
    "    const i = slots.indexOf(slot);\n",
    "    const next = slots[i+1];\n",
    "    const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "    if (next){\n",
    "      const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(next); r.collapse(true);\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(r);\n",
    "    } else {\n",
    "      const r = document.createRange(); r.setStartAfter(struct); r.collapse(true);\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(r);\n",
    "    }\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "\n",
    "  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight'){\n",
    "    const slot = currentSlot();\n",
    "    if (!slot) return;\n",
    "    const struct = slot.closest('.mq-frac,.mq-exp,.mq-sqrt,.mq-sum,.mq-log,.mq-paren,.mq-qf');\n",
    "    if (!struct) return;\n",
    "    const slots = [...struct.querySelectorAll('.slot')];\n",
    "    if (slots.indexOf(slot) !== slots.length - 1) return;\n",
    "    e.preventDefault();\n",
    "    const r = document.createRange();\n",
    "    r.setStartAfter(struct); r.collapse(true);\n",
    "    const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "    sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(r);\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "\n",
    "  if (e.key === 'Backspace'){\n",
    "    e.preventDefault();\n",
    "    doBackspace();\n",
    "  }\n",
    "});\n",
    "\n",
    "/* ═══════════ insertion ═══════════ */\n",
    "function insertAtCursor(html){\n",
    "  let line = activeLine();\n",
    "  if (!line){\n",
    "    const all = linesEl.querySelectorAll('.lbody');\n",
    "    line = all.length ? all[all.length-1] : addLine('', true);\n",
    "    line.focus();\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  line.focus();\n",
    "\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return;\n",
    "  const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "  r.deleteContents();\n",
    "\n",
    "  const tmp = document.createElement('span');\n",
    "  tmp.innerHTML = html;\n",
    "  const nodes = [...tmp.childNodes];\n",
    "  if (!nodes.length) return;\n",
    "\n",
    "  const inside = currentSlot();\n",
    "  if (inside){\n",
    "    while (tmp.firstChild) inside.appendChild(tmp.firstChild);\n",
    "    const nested = inside.querySelector('.slot.cur') || inside.querySelector('.slot');\n",
    "    if (nested){\n",
    "      const nr = document.createRange(); nr.selectNodeContents(nested); nr.collapse(true);\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(nr);\n",
    "    }\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "\n",
    "  nodes.forEach(n => r.insertNode(n));\n",
    "  const last = nodes[nodes.length - 1];\n",
    "\n",
    "  let target = null;\n",
    "  if (last.nodeType === 1){\n",
    "    target = last.querySelector('.slot.cur') || last.querySelector('.slot');\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (target){\n",
    "    const nr = document.createRange();\n",
    "    nr.selectNodeContents(target); nr.collapse(true);\n",
    "    sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(nr);\n",
    "  } else {\n",
    "    const nr = document.createRange();\n",
    "    nr.setStartAfter(last); nr.collapse(true);\n",
    "    sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(nr);\n",
    "  }\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "/* ═══════════ key handling ═══════════ */\n",
    "function handleKey(key){\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__abc__'){\n",
    "    state.abcMode = !state.abcMode;\n",
    "    document.querySelectorAll('.act').forEach(a => {\n",
    "      if (a.textContent === 'ABC') a.classList.toggle('active-mode', state.abcMode);\n",
    "    });\n",
    "    renderKb();\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__del__'){ doBackspace(); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__clear__') { linesEl.innerHTML=''; addLine('', true); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__enter__') { addLine('', true); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__ask__')   { document.getElementById('sbc').focus(); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__done__')  { submit(); return; }\n",
    "  insertAtCursor(key.i);\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "/* ═══════════ tabs ═══════════ */\n",
    "const tabsEl = document.getElementById('tabs');\n",
    "LAYOUT.tabs_order.forEach(name => {\n",
    "  const b = document.createElement('button');\n",
    "  b.className = 'tab' + (name === state.tab ? ' active' : '');\n",
    "  b.textContent = name;\n",
    "  b.onclick = () => {\n",
    "    state.tab = name;\n",
    "    state.abcMode = false;\n",
    "    document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t =>\n",
    "      t.classList.toggle('active', t.textContent === name));\n",
    "    document.querySelectorAll('.act').forEach(a => {\n",

    "      placeholder=\"e.g. I did step 2 but I don't understand why the sign flips\"></textarea>\n",
    "  </div>\n",
    "\n",
    "  <div class=\"tabs\" id=\"tabs\"></div>\n",
    "  <div class=\"kb-scroll\"><div class=\"kb\" id=\"kb\"></div></div>\n",
    "  <div class=\"acts\" id=\"acts\"></div>\n",
    "  <div class=\"result\" id=\"result\"></div>\n",
    "</div>\n",
    "\n",
    "<script>\n",
    "const LAYOUT = __LAYOUT__;\n",
    "const state = { tab: LAYOUT.tabs_order[0], abcMode: false };\n",
    "\n",
    "/* ═══════════ line editor ═══════════ */\n",
    "const linesEl = document.getElementById('lines');\n",
    "\n",
    "function addLine(html, focus){\n",
    "  const row = document.createElement('div'); row.className='lrow';\n",
    "  const n = document.createElement('div'); n.className='lnum';\n",
    "  const b = document.createElement('div'); b.className='lbody';\n",
    "  b.contentEditable='true'; b.spellcheck=false;\n",
    "  if (html) b.innerHTML = html;\n",
    "  row.appendChild(n); row.appendChild(b);\n",
    "  linesEl.appendChild(row);\n",
    "  renumber();\n",
    "  if (focus) focusStart(b);\n",
    "  return b;\n",
    "}\n",
    "function renumber(){\n",
    "  [...linesEl.querySelectorAll('.lrow')].forEach((r,i)=>{\n",
    "    r.querySelector('.lnum').textContent = i+1;\n",
    "  });\n",
    "}\n",
    "function focusStart(el){\n",
    "  el.focus();\n",
    "  const first = el.querySelector('.slot');\n",
    "  const r = document.createRange();\n",
    "  if (first) r.selectNodeContents(first);\n",
    "  else { r.selectNodeContents(el); r.collapse(false); }\n",
    "  r.collapse(true);\n",
    "  const s = window.getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r);\n",
    "}\n",
    "function activeLine(){\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return null;\n",
    "  let n = sel.getRangeAt(0).startContainer;\n",
    "  while (n && n !== linesEl){\n",
    "    if (n.classList && n.classList.contains('lbody')) return n;\n",
    "    n = n.parentNode;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  return null;\n",
    "}\n",
    "function currentSlot(){\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return null;\n",
    "  let n = sel.getRangeAt(0).startContainer;\n",
    "  if (n.nodeType === 3) n = n.parentNode;\n",
    "  return n.closest ? n.closest('.slot') : null;\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "/* ═══════════ backspace — direct, callable from key or button ═══════════ */\n",
    "function doBackspace(){\n",
    "  let line = activeLine();\n",
    "  if (!line){\n",
    "    const all = linesEl.querySelectorAll('.lbody');\n",
    "    if (all.length){\n",
    "      line = all[all.length-1];\n",
    "      line.focus();\n",
    "      const r = document.createRange();\n",
    "      r.selectNodeContents(line); r.collapse(false);\n",
    "      const s = window.getSelection();\n",
    "      s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r);\n",
    "    } else {\n",
    "      return;\n",
    "    }\n",
    "  }\n",
    "\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return;\n",
    "  const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "\n",
    "  if (!r.collapsed){\n",
    "    r.deleteContents();\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "\n",
    "  const slot = currentSlot();\n",
    "  if (slot){\n",
    "    const slotText = slot.textContent.replace(/\\u200B/g,'');\n",
    "    const probe = r.cloneRange(); probe.selectNodeContents(slot);\n",
    "    probe.setEnd(r.startContainer, r.startOffset);\n",
    "    const before = probe.toString().replace(/\\u200B/g,'');\n",
    "    if (slotText.length === 0 || before.length === 0){\n",
    "      const struct = slot.closest(\n",
    "        '.mq-frac,.mq-exp,.mq-sqrt,.mq-sum,.mq-log,.mq-paren,.mq-qf'\n",
    "      ) || slot;\n",
    "      const after = document.createRange();\n",
    "      after.setStartAfter(struct); after.collapse(true);\n",
    "      struct.remove();\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(after);\n",
    "      return;\n",
    "    }\n",
    "    deleteCharBefore(r);\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "\n",
    "  const probe = r.cloneRange(); probe.selectNodeContents(line);\n",
    "  probe.setEnd(r.startContainer, r.startOffset);\n",
    "  if (probe.toString().length === 0){\n",
    "    const prev = line.closest('.lrow').previousElementSibling;\n",
    "    if (prev){\n",
    "      const pb = prev.querySelector('.lbody');\n",
    "      while (line.firstChild) pb.appendChild(line.firstChild);\n",
    "      line.closest('.lrow').remove();\n",
    "      focusStart(pb);\n",
    "      renumber();\n",
    "      return;\n",
    "    }\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  deleteCharBefore(r);\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "function deleteCharBefore(r){\n",
    "  const node = r.startContainer;\n",
    "  const offset = r.startOffset;\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "\n",
    "  if (node.nodeType === 3 && offset > 0){\n",
    "    node.deleteData(offset - 1, 1);\n",
    "    const nr = document.createRange();\n",
    "    nr.setStart(node, offset - 1); nr.collapse(true);\n",
    "    sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(nr);\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "\n",
    "  if (node.nodeType === 3 && offset === 0){\n",
    "    let prev = node.previousSibling;\n",
    "    while (prev && prev.nodeType !== 3 && !prev.textContent){\n",
    "      prev = prev.previousSibling;\n",
    "    }\n",
    "    if (prev){\n",
    "      const after = document.createRange();\n",
    "      after.setStartAfter(prev); after.collapse(true);\n",
    "      prev.remove();\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(after);\n",
    "    }\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "\n",
    "  if (node.nodeType === 1){\n",
    "    let leaf = node;\n",
    "    while (leaf.lastChild && leaf.nodeType === 1) leaf = leaf.lastChild;\n",
    "    if (leaf.nodeType === 3){\n",
    "      const nr = document.createRange();\n",
    "      nr.setStart(leaf, Math.max(0, leaf.textContent.length - 1));\n",
    "      nr.collapse(true);\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(nr);\n",
    "      doBackspace();\n",
    "    } else if (leaf.previousSibling){\n",
    "      const after = document.createRange();\n",
    "      after.setStartAfter(leaf.previousSibling); after.collapse(true);\n",
    "      leaf.previousSibling.remove();\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(after);\n",
    "    }\n",
    "  }\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "/* ═══════════ line keydown ═══════════ */\n",
    "linesEl.addEventListener('keydown', e => {\n",
    "  const line = e.target.closest('.lbody'); if (!line) return;\n",
    "\n",
    "  if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey){\n",
    "    e.preventDefault();\n",
    "    const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "    const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "    const after = r.cloneRange();\n",
    "    after.selectNodeContents(line);\n",
    "    after.setStart(r.endContainer, r.endOffset);\n",
    "    const rest = after.extractContents();\n",
    "    const nb = addLine('', false);\n",
    "    while (rest.firstChild) nb.insertBefore(rest.firstChild, nb.firstChild);\n",
    "    focusStart(nb);\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "\n",
    "  if (e.key === 'Tab'){\n",
    "    e.preventDefault();\n",
    "    const slot = currentSlot();\n",
    "    if (!slot){\n",
    "      const r = document.createRange();\n",
    "      r.selectNodeContents(line); r.collapse(false);\n",
    "      const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(r);\n",
    "      return;\n",
    "    }\n",
    "    const struct = slot.closest('.mq-frac,.mq-exp,.mq-sqrt,.mq-sum,.mq-log,.mq-paren,.mq-qf');\n",
    "    if (!struct) return;\n",
    "    const slots = [...struct.querySelectorAll('.slot')];\n",
    "    const i = slots.indexOf(slot);\n",
    "    const next = slots[i+1];\n",
    "    const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "    if (next){\n",
    "      const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(next); r.collapse(true);\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(r);\n",
    "    } else {\n",
    "      const r = document.createRange(); r.setStartAfter(struct); r.collapse(true);\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(r);\n",
    "    }\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "\n",
    "  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight'){\n",
    "    const slot = currentSlot();\n",
    "    if (!slot) return;\n",
    "    const struct = slot.closest('.mq-frac,.mq-exp,.mq-sqrt,.mq-sum,.mq-log,.mq-paren,.mq-qf');\n",
    "    if (!struct) return;\n",
    "    const slots = [...struct.querySelectorAll('.slot')];\n",
    "    if (slots.indexOf(slot) !== slots.length - 1) return;\n",
    "    e.preventDefault();\n",
    "    const r = document.createRange();\n",
    "    r.setStartAfter(struct); r.collapse(true);\n",
    "    const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "    sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(r);\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "\n",
    "  if (e.key === 'Backspace'){\n",
    "    e.preventDefault();\n",
    "    doBackspace();\n",
    "  }\n",
    "});\n",
    "\n",
    "/* ═══════════ insertion ═══════════ */\n",
    "function insertAtCursor(html){\n",
    "  let line = activeLine();\n",
    "  if (!line){\n",
    "    const all = linesEl.querySelectorAll('.lbody');\n",
    "    line = all.length ? all[all.length-1] : addLine('', true);\n",
    "    line.focus();\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  line.focus();\n",
    "\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return;\n",
    "  const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "  r.deleteContents();\n",
    "\n",
    "  const tmp = document.createElement('span');\n",
    "  tmp.innerHTML = html;\n",
    "  const nodes = [...tmp.childNodes];\n",
    "  if (!nodes.length) return;\n",
    "\n",
    "  const inside = currentSlot();\n",
    "  if (inside){\n",
    "    while (tmp.firstChild) inside.appendChild(tmp.firstChild);\n",
    "    const nested = inside.querySelector('.slot.cur') || inside.querySelector('.slot');\n",
    "    if (nested){\n",
    "      const nr = document.createRange(); nr.selectNodeContents(nested); nr.collapse(true);\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(nr);\n",
    "    }\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "\n",
    "  nodes.forEach(n => r.insertNode(n));\n",
    "  const last = nodes[nodes.length - 1];\n",
    "\n",
    "  let target = null;\n",
    "  if (last.nodeType === 1){\n",
    "    target = last.querySelector('.slot.cur') || last.querySelector('.slot');\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (target){\n",
    "    const nr = document.createRange();\n",

    "\n",
    "<script>\n",
    "const LAYOUT = __LAYOUT__;\n",
    "const state = { tab: LAYOUT.tabs_order[0], abcMode: false, invMode: false };\n",
    "\n",
    "const linesEl = document.getElementById('lines');\n",
    "function addLine(html, focus){\n",
    "  const row = document.createElement('div'); row.className='lrow';\n",
    "  const n = document.createElement('div'); n.className='lnum';\n",
    "  const b = document.createElement('div'); b.className='lbody';\n",
    "  b.contentEditable='true'; b.spellcheck=false;\n",
    "  if (html) b.innerHTML = html;\n",
    "  row.appendChild(n); row.appendChild(b);\n",
    "  linesEl.appendChild(row);\n",
    "  renumber();\n",
    "  if (focus) focusStart(b);\n",
    "  return b;\n",
    "}\n",
    "function renumber(){\n",
    "  [...linesEl.querySelectorAll('.lrow')].forEach((r,i)=>{\n",
    "    r.querySelector('.lnum').textContent = i+1;\n",
    "  });\n",
    "}\n",
    "function focusStart(el){\n",
    "  el.focus();\n",
    "  const first = el.querySelector('.slot');\n",
    "  const r = document.createRange();\n",
    "  if (first) r.selectNodeContents(first);\n",
    "  else { r.selectNodeContents(el); r.collapse(false); }\n",
    "  r.collapse(true);\n",
    "  const s = window.getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r);\n",
    "}\n",
    "function activeLine(){\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return null;\n",
    "  let n = sel.getRangeAt(0).startContainer;\n",
    "  while (n && n !== linesEl){\n",
    "    if (n.classList && n.classList.contains('lbody')) return n;\n",
    "    n = n.parentNode;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  return null;\n",
    "}\n",
    "function currentSlot(){\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return null;\n",
    "  let n = sel.getRangeAt(0).startContainer;\n",
    "  if (n.nodeType === 3) n = n.parentNode;\n",
    "  return n.closest ? n.closest('.slot') : null;\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "function doBackspace(){\n",
    "  let line = activeLine();\n",
    "  if (!line){\n",
    "    const all = linesEl.querySelectorAll('.lbody');\n",
    "    if (all.length){\n",
    "      line = all[all.length-1];\n",
    "      line.focus();\n",
    "      const r = document.createRange();\n",
    "      r.selectNodeContents(line); r.collapse(false);\n",
    "      const s = window.getSelection();\n",
    "      s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r);\n",
    "    } else return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return;\n",
    "  const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "  if (!r.collapsed){ r.deleteContents(); return; }\n",
    "\n",
    "  const slot = currentSlot();\n",
    "  if (slot){\n",
    "    const slotText = slot.textContent.replace(/\\u200B/g,'');\n",
    "    const probe = r.cloneRange(); probe.selectNodeContents(slot);\n",
    "    probe.setEnd(r.startContainer, r.startOffset);\n",
    "    const before = probe.toString().replace(/\\u200B/g,'');\n",
    "    if (slotText.length === 0 || before.length === 0){\n",
    "      const struct = slot.closest(\n",
    "        '.mq-frac,.mq-exp,.mq-sqrt,.mq-sum,.mq-log,.mq-paren,.mq-qf'\n",
    "      ) || slot;\n",
    "      const after = document.createRange();\n",
    "      after.setStartAfter(struct); after.collapse(true);\n",
    "      struct.remove();\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(after);\n",
    "      return;\n",
    "    }\n",
    "    deleteCharBefore(r); return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "\n",
    "  const probe = r.cloneRange(); probe.selectNodeContents(line);\n",
    "  probe.setEnd(r.startContainer, r.startOffset);\n",
    "  if (probe.toString().length === 0){\n",
    "    const prev = line.closest('.lrow').previousElementSibling;\n",
    "    if (prev){\n",
    "      const pb = prev.querySelector('.lbody');\n",
    "      while (line.firstChild) pb.appendChild(line.firstChild);\n",
    "      line.closest('.lrow').remove();\n",
    "      focusStart(pb);\n",
    "      renumber();\n",
    "      return;\n",
    "    }\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  deleteCharBefore(r);\n",
    "}\n",
    "function deleteCharBefore(r){\n",
    "  const node = r.startContainer;\n",
    "  const offset = r.startOffset;\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (node.nodeType === 3 && offset > 0){\n",
    "    node.deleteData(offset - 1, 1);\n",
    "    const nr = document.createRange();\n",
    "    nr.setStart(node, offset - 1); nr.collapse(true);\n",
    "    sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(nr);\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (node.nodeType === 3 && offset === 0){\n",
    "    let prev = node.previousSibling;\n",
    "    while (prev && prev.nodeType !== 3 && !prev.textContent){\n",
    "      prev = prev.previousSibling;\n",
    "    }\n",
    "    if (prev){\n",
    "      const after = document.createRange();\n",
    "      after.setStartAfter(prev); after.collapse(true);\n",
    "      prev.remove();\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(after);\n",
    "    }\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (node.nodeType === 1){\n",
    "    let leaf = node;\n",
    "    while (leaf.lastChild && leaf.nodeType === 1) leaf = leaf.lastChild;\n",
    "    if (leaf.nodeType === 3){\n",
    "      const nr = document.createRange();\n",
    "      nr.setStart(leaf, Math.max(0, leaf.textContent.length - 1));\n",
    "      nr.collapse(true);\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(nr);\n",
    "      doBackspace();\n",
    "    } else if (leaf.previousSibling){\n",
    "      const after = document.createRange();\n",
    "      after.setStartAfter(leaf.previousSibling); after.collapse(true);\n",
    "      leaf.previousSibling.remove();\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(after);\n",
    "    }\n",
    "  }\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "linesEl.addEventListener('keydown', e => {\n",
    "  const line = e.target.closest('.lbody'); if (!line) return;\n",
    "  if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey){\n",
    "    e.preventDefault();\n",
    "    const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "    const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "    const after = r.cloneRange();\n",
    "    after.selectNodeContents(line);\n",
    "    after.setStart(r.endContainer, r.endOffset);\n",
    "    const rest = after.extractContents();\n",
    "    const nb = addLine('', false);\n",
    "    while (rest.firstChild) nb.insertBefore(rest.firstChild, nb.firstChild);\n",
    "    focusStart(nb);\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (e.key === 'Tab'){\n",
    "    e.preventDefault();\n",
    "    const slot = currentSlot();\n",
    "    if (!slot){\n",
    "      const r = document.createRange();\n",
    "      r.selectNodeContents(line); r.collapse(false);\n",
    "      const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(r);\n",
    "      return;\n",
    "    }\n",
    "    const struct = slot.closest('.mq-frac,.mq-exp,.mq-sqrt,.mq-sum,.mq-log,.mq-paren,.mq-qf');\n",
    "    if (!struct) return;\n",
    "    const slots = [...struct.querySelectorAll('.slot')];\n",
    "    const i = slots.indexOf(slot);\n",
    "    const next = slots[i+1];\n",
    "    const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "    if (next){\n",
    "      const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(next); r.collapse(true);\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(r);\n",
    "    } else {\n",
    "      const r = document.createRange(); r.setStartAfter(struct); r.collapse(true);\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(r);\n",
    "    }\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight'){\n",
    "    const slot = currentSlot();\n",
    "    if (!slot) return;\n",
    "    const struct = slot.closest('.mq-frac,.mq-exp,.mq-sqrt,.mq-sum,.mq-log,.mq-paren,.mq-qf');\n",
    "    if (!struct) return;\n",
    "    const slots = [...struct.querySelectorAll('.slot')];\n",
    "    if (slots.indexOf(slot) !== slots.length - 1) return;\n",
    "    e.preventDefault();\n",
    "    const r = document.createRange();\n",
    "    r.setStartAfter(struct); r.collapse(true);\n",
    "    const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "    sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(r);\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (e.key === 'Backspace'){ e.preventDefault(); doBackspace(); }\n",
    "});\n",
    "\n",
    "function insertAtCursor(html){\n",
    "  let line = activeLine();\n",
    "  if (!line){\n",
    "    const all = linesEl.querySelectorAll('.lbody');\n",
    "    line = all.length ? all[all.length-1] : addLine('', true);\n",
    "    line.focus();\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  line.focus();\n",
    "  const sel = window.getSelection();\n",
    "  if (!sel.rangeCount) return;\n",
    "  const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);\n",
    "  r.deleteContents();\n",
    "\n",
    "  const tmp = document.createElement('span');\n",
    "  tmp.innerHTML = html;\n",
    "  const nodes = [...tmp.childNodes];\n",
    "  if (!nodes.length) return;\n",
    "\n",
    "  const inside = currentSlot();\n",
    "  if (inside){\n",
    "    while (tmp.firstChild) inside.appendChild(tmp.firstChild);\n",
    "    const nested = inside.querySelector('.slot.cur') || inside.querySelector('.slot');\n",
    "    if (nested){\n",
    "      const nr = document.createRange(); nr.selectNodeContents(nested); nr.collapse(true);\n",
    "      sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(nr);\n",
    "    }\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  nodes.forEach(n => r.insertNode(n));\n",
    "  const last = nodes[nodes.length - 1];\n",
    "  let target = null;\n",
    "  if (last.nodeType === 1){\n",
    "    target = last.querySelector('.slot.cur') || last.querySelector('.slot');\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (target){\n",
    "    const nr = document.createRange();\n",
    "    nr.selectNodeContents(target); nr.collapse(true);\n",
    "    sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(nr);\n",
    "  } else {\n",
    "    const nr = document.createRange();\n",
    "    nr.setStartAfter(last); nr.collapse(true);\n",
    "    sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(nr);\n",
    "  }\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "function handleKey(key){\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__abc__'){\n",
    "    state.abcMode = !state.abcMode;\n",
    "    document.querySelectorAll('.act').forEach(a => {\n",
    "      if (a.textContent === 'ABC') a.classList.toggle('active-mode', state.abcMode);\n",
    "    });\n",
    "    renderKb();\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__inv__'){\n",
    "    state.invMode = !state.invMode;\n",
    "    renderKb();\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__space__'){ insertAtCursor(\" \"); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__del__'){ doBackspace(); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__clear__') { linesEl.innerHTML=''; addLine('', true); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__enter__') { addLine('', true); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__ask__')   { document.getElementById('sbc').focus(); return; }\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__done__')  { submit(); return; }\n",
    "  insertAtCursor(key.i);\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "const tabsEl = document.getElementById('tabs');\n",
    "LAYOUT.tabs_order.forEach(name => {\n",
    "  const b = document.createElement('button');\n",
    "  b.className = 'tab' + (name === state.tab ? ' active' : '');\n",
    "  b.textContent = name;\n",
    "  b.onclick = () => {\n",
    "    state.tab = name;\n",
    "    state.abcMode = false;\n",
    "    state.invMode = false;\n",
    "    document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t =>\n",
    "      t.classList.toggle('active', t.textContent === name));\n",
    "    document.querySelectorAll('.act').forEach(a => {\n",
    "      if (a.textContent === 'ABC') a.classList.remove('active-mode');\n",
    "    });\n",
    "    renderKb();\n",
    "  };\n",
    "  tabsEl.appendChild(b);\n",
    "});\n",
    "\n",
    "const kbEl = document.getElementById('kb');\n",
    "function keyBtn(key){\n",
    "  const el = document.createElement('div');\n",
    "  el.className = 'key';\n",
    "  if (key.i === '__inv__' && state.invMode) el.classList.add('inv-active');\n",
    "  if (key.ic) el.innerHTML = key.ic;\n",
    "  else el.textContent = key.l;\n",
    "  el.onclick = () => handleKey(key);\n",
    "  return el;\n",
    "}\n",
    "function renderRow(keys){\n",
    "  const r = document.createElement('div'); r.className='row';\n",
    "  r.style.gridTemplateColumns = `repeat(${keys.length},1fr)`;\n",
    "  keys.forEach(k => r.appendChild(keyBtn(k)));\n",
    "  kbEl.appendChild(r);\n",
    "}\n",
    "function renderKb(){\n",
    "  kbEl.innerHTML = '';\n",
    "  if (state.abcMode){\n",
    "    (LAYOUT.base.abc || []).forEach(row => renderRow(row));\n",
    "    return;\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  renderRow(LAYOUT.base.structure);\n",
    "  renderRow(LAYOUT.base.operators);\n",
    "  renderRow(LAYOUT.base.digits);\n",
    "  renderRow(LAYOUT.base.variables);\n",
    "  const rows = LAYOUT.tabs[state.tab] || [];\n",
    "  rows.forEach(row => {\n",
    "    if (state.tab === 'Trig' && row === LAYOUT.trig_default){\n",
    "      renderRow(state.invMode ? LAYOUT.trig_inverse : LAYOUT.trig_default);\n",
    "    } else {\n",
    "      renderRow(row);\n",
    "    }\n",
    "  });\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "const actsEl = document.getElementById('acts');\n",
    "LAYOUT.base.actions.forEach(k => {\n",
    "  const el = document.createElement('div');\n",
    "  el.className = 'act' + (k.i === '__done__' ? ' done' : '');\n",
    "  el.textContent = k.l;\n",
    "  el.onclick = () => handleKey(k);\n",
    "  actsEl.appendChild(el);\n",
    "});\n",
    "\n",
    "const resultEl = document.getElementById('result');\n",
    "function submit(){\n",
    "  const steps = [...linesEl.querySelectorAll('.lbody')]\n",
    "    .map(b => b.innerText.replace(/\\u200B/g,'').trim())\n",
    "    .filter(s => s.length);\n",
    "  const payload = {\n",
    "    steps:        steps,\n",
    "    step_count:   steps.length,\n",
    "    sbc_message:  document.getElementById('sbc').value.trim(),\n",
    "    tab_used:     state.tab,\n",
    "  };\n",
    "  resultEl.classList.add('shown');\n",
    "  resultEl.innerHTML =\n",
    "    \"<div class='label'>submitted to step_grader + intervention log</div>\"+\n",
    "    \"<pre>\"+JSON.stringify(payload,null,2)+\"</pre>\";\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "addLine('', true);\n",
    "renderKb();\n",
    "</script>\n",
    "</body></html>\n",
    "\"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "html = HTML_TPL.replace(\"__LAYOUT__\", json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False))\n",
    "HTML_PATH.write_text(html, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n",
    "print(f\"  ✓ {HTML_PATH.name} written ({HTML_PATH.stat().st_size:,} bytes)\")\n",
    "webbrowser.open(HTML_PATH.as_uri())\n",
    "print(\"  → opened in browser\")\n",
    "print()\n",
    "print(\"  v18: keyboard restored to working state\")"
   ]
  }

      [K("(1+i)ⁿ","latex","\\left(1+i\\right)^{}",{auto:true,go:goLeft(1)}),
       K("(1−i)ⁿ","latex","\\left(1-i\\right)^{}",{auto:true,go:goLeft(1)}),
       K("(□)ⁿ","latex","\\left(\\right)^{}",{go:["Left","Left","Left"]}),K("□/□","cmd","\\frac")],
    ],
    Analytical: [
      [K("(□;□)","latex","\\left(;\\right)",{go:["Left","Left"]}),
       K("x₁","latex","x_{1}"),K("y₁","latex","y_{1}"),K("x₂","latex","x_{2}"),K("y₂","latex","y_{2}")],
      [K("√","cmd","\\sqrt"),K("(□)²","latex","\\left(\\right)^{2}",{auto:true,go:["Left","Left","Left"]}),
       K("θ","cmd","\\theta"),K("°","latex","^{\\circ}"),K("tan(","latex","\\tan\\left(\\right)",{go:goLeft(1)})],
    ],
    Euclidean: [
      [K("△","cmd","\\triangle"),K("∥","cmd","\\parallel"),K("⊥","cmd","\\perp"),
       K("∠","cmd","\\angle"),K("≅","cmd","\\cong"),K("∼","cmd","\\sim")],
      [K("Â","latex","\\hat{A}"),K("B̂","latex","\\hat{B}"),K("Ĉ","latex","\\hat{C}"),
       K("∴","cmd","\\therefore"),K("∵","cmd","\\because"),K("√","cmd","\\sqrt")],
      [K("sin(","latex","\\sin\\left(\\right)",{go:goLeft(1)}),K("cos(","latex","\\cos\\left(\\right)",{go:goLeft(1)}),
       K("tan(","latex","\\tan\\left(\\right)",{go:goLeft(1)})],
    ],
    Stats: [
      [K("x̄","latex","\\bar{x}"),K("σ","cmd","\\sigma"),K("n","text","n"),K("r","text","r"),K("r²","latex","r^{2}",{auto:true})],
      [K("Σ","cmd","\\sum"),K("(□)²","latex","\\left(\\right)^{2}",{auto:true,go:["Left","Left","Left"]}),
       K("√","cmd","\\sqrt"),K("E(□)","latex","E\\left(\\right)",{go:goLeft(1)}),K("P(□)","latex","P\\left(\\right)",{go:goLeft(1)})],
    ],
    Probability: [
      [K("P(□)","latex","P\\left(\\right)",{go:goLeft(1)}),K("∪","cmd","\\cup"),K("∩","cmd","\\cap"),K("'","text","'")],
      [K("nCr","cmd","\\binom"),K("!","text","!"),K("□/□","cmd","\\frac")],
    ],
  };
  var trigInvRow = [
    K("INV","action","__inv__"),
    K("sin⁻¹(","latex","\\sin^{-1}\\left(\\right)",{go:goLeft(1)}),
    K("cos⁻¹(","latex","\\cos^{-1}\\left(\\right)",{go:goLeft(1)}),
    K("tan⁻¹(","latex","\\tan^{-1}\\left(\\right)",{go:goLeft(1)}),
  ];
  var actions = [
    K("SPACE","action","__space__"), K("DEL","action","__del__"), K("AC","action","__clear__"),
    K("ABC","action","__abc__"), K("⏎","action","__enter__"), K("?","action","__ask__"), K("✓","action","__done__"),
  ];

  /* target: "math" | "sbc" — explicit, not guessed from focus alone after key mousedown */
  var state = {
    tab: "Algebra", abcMode: false, invMode: false, capsLock: false, abcNums: false,
    fields: [], activeIdx: -1, target: "math",
  };
  var linesEl = document.getElementById("lines");
  var tabsEl = document.getElementById("tabs");
  var kbEl = document.getElementById("kb");
  var actsEl = document.getElementById("acts");
  var resultEl = document.getElementById("result");
  var sbcEl = document.getElementById("sbc");
  var sbcWrap = document.getElementById("sbcWrap");
  var targetHint = document.getElementById("targetHint");
  var sbcWhere = document.getElementById("sbcWhere");

  function updateTargetUI() {
    if (state.target === "sbc") {
      sbcWrap.classList.add("sbc-active");
      targetHint.textContent = "Input → Ask Tanaka";
      sbcWhere.textContent = "typing here";
      sbcWhere.classList.add("on");
    } else {
      sbcWrap.classList.remove("sbc-active");
      targetHint.textContent = "Input → Working line " + (state.activeIdx >= 0 ? state.activeIdx + 1 : "1");
      sbcWhere.textContent = "tap here to type a message";
      sbcWhere.classList.remove("on");
    }
  }

  function setTarget(t) {
    state.target = t;
    updateTargetUI();
  }

  function renumber() {
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(linesEl.querySelectorAll(".lrow"), function (row, i) {
      row.querySelector(".lnum").textContent = String(i + 1);
    });
  }
  function markActiveRow() {
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(linesEl.querySelectorAll(".lrow"), function (row, i) {
      row.classList.toggle("active", i === state.activeIdx);
    });
  }
  function setActive(idx, doFocus) {
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= state.fields.length) return;
    state.activeIdx = idx;
    markActiveRow();
    setTarget("math");
    if (doFocus !== false) {
      try { state.fields[idx].field.focus(); } catch (e) {}
    }
  }
  function current() {
    if (state.activeIdx < 0 || state.activeIdx >= state.fields.length) return null;
    return state.fields[state.activeIdx].field;
  }

  function addLine(focus) {
    var row = document.createElement("div");
    row.className = "lrow";
    var num = document.createElement("div");
    num.className = "lnum";
    var host = document.createElement("span");
    host.className = "mq-host";
    row.appendChild(num);
    row.appendChild(host);
    linesEl.appendChild(row);
    renumber();
    var idx = state.fields.length;
    var field = MQ.MathField(host, {
      spaceBehavesLikeTab: false,
      handlers: {
        enter: function () { addLine(true); },
        focus: function () { setActive(idx, false); },
      },
    });
    function selectMath(e) {
      setActive(idx, true);
    }
    row.addEventListener("mousedown", function (e) {
      setTarget("math");
      state.activeIdx = idx;
      markActiveRow();
      updateTargetUI();
    });
    row.addEventListener("click", selectMath);
    host.addEventListener("focusin", function () {
      setActive(idx, false);
    });
    state.fields.push({ field: field, host: host, row: row, idx: idx });
    if (focus !== false) setActive(idx, true);
    else markActiveRow();
    return field;
  }

  /* SBC focus → target sbc */
  sbcEl.addEventListener("focus", function () { setTarget("sbc"); });
  sbcEl.addEventListener("click", function () { setTarget("sbc"); });
  sbcWrap.addEventListener("mousedown", function (e) {
    /* clicking the Ask Tanaka area selects it */
    if (e.target === sbcEl || sbcWrap.contains(e.target)) {
      setTarget("sbc");
    }
  });

  function move(field, keys) {
    if (!keys) return;
    keys.forEach(function (k) { field.keystroke(k); });
  }
  function apply(field, k) {
    if (!field) return;
    if (k.type === "text") field.write(k.value);
    else if (k.type === "cmd") field.cmd(k.value);
    else if (k.type === "latex") field.write(k.value);
    else if (k.type === "seq") {
      k.value.forEach(function (op) {
        if (op.indexOf("c:") === 0) field.cmd(op.slice(2));
        else if (op.indexOf("t:") === 0) field.write(op.slice(2));
      });
    }
    if (k.go) move(field, k.go);
  }

  function insertIntoSbc(ch) {
    var el = sbcEl;
    var start = el.selectionStart, end = el.selectionEnd;
    var v = el.value;
    el.value = v.slice(0, start) + ch + v.slice(end);
    el.selectionStart = el.selectionEnd = start + ch.length;
    /* keep target sbc; refocus without stealing next key */
    setTarget("sbc");
    el.focus();
  }
  function sbcBackspace() {
    var el = sbcEl;
    var start = el.selectionStart, end = el.selectionEnd;
    if (start !== end) {
      el.value = el.value.slice(0, start) + el.value.slice(end);
      el.selectionStart = el.selectionEnd = start;
    } else if (start > 0) {
      el.value = el.value.slice(0, start - 1) + el.value.slice(start);
      el.selectionStart = el.selectionEnd = start - 1;
    }
    setTarget("sbc");
    el.focus();
  }

  function handleKey(k) {
    if (k.type === "action") { doAction(k.value); return; }
    if (k.type === "phone") { handlePhone(k.value); return; }

    /* Math structures only apply to working area */
    if (state.target === "sbc") {
      /* switch hint: math keys while on sbc go to math if it's a structure? 
         User asked: when on ask tanaka, type stays there. So only plain text/phone to sbc.
         Structure keys switch to math so fraction etc. still work. */
      if (k.type === "text" && k.value.length === 1 && /[a-zA-Z0-9. ]/.test(k.value)) {
        insertIntoSbc(k.value);
        return;
      }
      /* structural math key → jump to working */
      setTarget("math");
    }
    var f = current();
    if (!f) { addLine(true); f = current(); }
    if (!f) return;
    try { f.focus(); } catch (e) {}
    apply(f, k);
  }

  function handlePhone(val) {
    if (val === "__caps__") {
      state.capsLock = !state.capsLock;
      renderKb();
      return;
    }
    if (val === "__nums__") {
      state.abcNums = !state.abcNums;
      renderKb();
      return;
    }
    if (val === "__del__") {
      if (state.target === "sbc") sbcBackspace();
      else {
        var f = current();
        if (f) { try { f.focus(); } catch (e) {} f.keystroke("Backspace"); }
      }
      return;
    }
    if (val === "__space__") {
      if (state.target === "sbc") insertIntoSbc(" ");
      else {
        var f2 = current();
        if (f2) { try { f2.focus(); } catch (e) {} f2.write("\\ "); }
      }
      return;
    }
    if (val === "__enter_sbc__") {
      if (state.target === "sbc") insertIntoSbc("\n");
      else doAction("__enter__");
      return;
    }
    /* letter / digit */
    if (state.target === "sbc") insertIntoSbc(val);
    else {
      var f3 = current();
      if (!f3) { addLine(true); f3 = current(); }
      if (f3) { try { f3.focus(); } catch (e) {} f3.write(val); }
    }
  }

  function doAction(id) {
    var f = current();
    switch (id) {
      case "__space__":
        if (state.target === "sbc") insertIntoSbc(" ");
        else if (f) { try { f.focus(); } catch (e) {} f.write("\\ "); }
        break;
      case "__del__":
        if (state.target === "sbc") sbcBackspace();
        else if (f) { try { f.focus(); } catch (e) {} f.keystroke("Backspace"); }
        break;
      case "__clear__":
        if (state.target === "sbc") {
          sbcEl.value = "";
          sbcEl.focus();
        } else {
          linesEl.innerHTML = "";
          state.fields = [];
          state.activeIdx = -1;
          resultEl.classList.remove("shown");
          addLine(true);
        }
        break;
      case "__enter__":
        if (state.target === "sbc") insertIntoSbc("\n");
        else addLine(true);
        break;
      case "__ask__":
        setTarget("sbc");
        sbcEl.focus();
        break;
      case "__abc__":
        state.abcMode = !state.abcMode;
        /* Do NOT force SBC — user chooses by tapping Working or Ask Tanaka */
        renderActs();
        renderKb();
        break;
      case "__inv__":
        state.invMode = !state.invMode;
        renderKb();
        break;
      case "__done__":
        submit();
        break;
    }
  }

  function submit() {
    var steps = [];
    state.fields.forEach(function (item) {
      var lx = item.field.latex();
      if (lx && lx.trim()) steps.push(lx.trim());
    });
    var payload = {
      learner_lines_latex: steps,
      step_count: steps.length,
      sbc_message: sbcEl.value.trim(),
      tab_used: state.tab,
    };
    resultEl.classList.add("shown");
    resultEl.innerHTML =
      "<div class='label'>Payload for step_grader</div>" +
      "<pre>" + JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2) + "</pre>";
  }

  function renderTabs() {
    tabsEl.innerHTML = "";
    tabsOrder.forEach(function (name) {
      var b = document.createElement("button");
      b.className = "tab" + (name === state.tab ? " active" : "");
      b.textContent = name;
      b.onclick = function () {
        state.tab = name;
        state.abcMode = false;
        state.invMode = false;
        setTarget("math");
        renderTabs();
        renderActs();
        renderKb();
      };
      tabsEl.appendChild(b);
    });
  }

  function keyBtn(k, extraClass) {
    var el = document.createElement("div");
    el.className = "key" + (k.auto ? " auto" : "") + (extraClass ? " " + extraClass : "");
    if (k.value === "__inv__" && state.invMode) el.classList.add("inv-on");
    el.textContent = k.label;
    el.onmousedown = function (e) { e.preventDefault(); };
    el.onclick = function () { handleKey(k); };
    return el;
  }
  function renderRow(keys, extraClass) {
    if (!keys || !keys.length) return;
    var r = document.createElement("div");
    r.className = "row";
    r.style.gridTemplateColumns = "repeat(" + keys.length + ",1fr)";
    keys.forEach(function (k) { r.appendChild(keyBtn(k, extraClass)); });
    kbEl.appendChild(r);
  }

  function phoneKey(label, value) {
    return { label: label, type: "phone", value: value };
  }
  function phoneBtn(label, value, cls) {
    var el = document.createElement("div");
    el.className = "key " + (cls || "phone");
    el.textContent = label;
    el.onmousedown = function (e) { e.preventDefault(); };
    el.onclick = function () {
      if (value === "__enter_sbc__") handlePhone("__enter_sbc__");
      else handlePhone(value);
    };
    return el;
  }
  function renderPhoneKeys(keys, cols) {
    var r = document.createElement("div");
    r.className = "row";
    r.style.gridTemplateColumns = cols;
    keys.forEach(function (k) { r.appendChild(keyBtn(k, "phone")); });
    kbEl.appendChild(r);
  }

  function renderPhoneAbc() {
    kbEl.innerHTML = "";
    var caps = state.capsLock;
    if (state.abcNums) {
      renderPhoneKeys("1234567890".split("").map(function(c){return phoneKey(c,c);}), "repeat(10,1fr)");
      renderPhoneKeys(["@","#","$","%","&","*","-","+","(",")"].map(function(c){return phoneKey(c,c);}), "repeat(10,1fr)");
      renderPhoneKeys(["!","\"","'",":",";","/", "?", ",", ".", "_"].map(function(c){return phoneKey(c,c);}), "repeat(10,1fr)");
      var r = document.createElement("div");
      r.className = "row";
      r.style.gridTemplateColumns = "1.2fr 1.2fr 3fr 1.2fr 1.2fr";
      r.appendChild(phoneBtn("ABC", "__nums__", "phone-fn"));
      r.appendChild(phoneBtn("⌫", "__del__", "phone-fn"));
      r.appendChild(phoneBtn("space", "__space__", "phone-fn"));
      r.appendChild(phoneBtn(".", ".", "phone"));
      r.appendChild(phoneBtn("⏎", "__enter_sbc__", "phone-fn"));
      kbEl.appendChild(r);
      return;
    }
    function letters(arr) {
      return arr.map(function (ch) {
        var L = caps ? ch.toUpperCase() : ch;
        return phoneKey(L, L);
      });
    }
    renderPhoneKeys(letters("qwertyuiop".split("")), "repeat(10,1fr)");
    renderPhoneKeys(letters("asdfghjkl".split("")), "repeat(9,1fr)");
    var r3 = document.createElement("div");
    r3.className = "row";
    r3.style.gridTemplateColumns = "1.4fr repeat(7,1fr) 1.4fr";
    r3.appendChild(phoneBtn(caps ? "CAPS" : "caps", "__caps__", "phone-fn" + (caps ? " caps-on" : "")));
    letters("zxcvbnm".split("")).forEach(function (k) { r3.appendChild(keyBtn(k, "phone")); });
    r3.appendChild(phoneBtn("⌫", "__del__", "phone-fn"));
    kbEl.appendChild(r3);
    var r4 = document.createElement("div");
    r4.className = "row";
    r4.style.gridTemplateColumns = "1.4fr 3.4fr 1.2fr 1.4fr";
    r4.appendChild(phoneBtn("123", "__nums__", "phone-fn"));
    r4.appendChild(phoneBtn("space", "__space__", "phone-fn"));
    r4.appendChild(phoneBtn(".", ".", "phone"));
    r4.appendChild(phoneBtn("⏎", "__enter_sbc__", "phone-fn"));
    kbEl.appendChild(r4);
  }

  function renderKb() {
    kbEl.innerHTML = "";
    if (state.abcMode) { renderPhoneAbc(); return; }
    renderRow(baseStructure);
    renderRow(baseOperators);
    renderRow(baseDigits);
    renderRow(baseVars);
    var rows = tabs[state.tab] || [];
    rows.forEach(function (row, idx) {
      if (state.tab === "Trig" && idx === 0) renderRow(state.invMode ? trigInvRow : row);
      else renderRow(row);
    });
  }

  function renderActs() {
    actsEl.innerHTML = "";
    actions.forEach(function (k) {
      var el = document.createElement("div");
      el.className = "act";
      if (k.value === "__done__") el.classList.add("done");
      if (k.value === "__abc__" && state.abcMode) el.classList.add("mode-on");
      el.textContent = k.label;
      el.onmousedown = function (e) { e.preventDefault(); };
      el.onclick = function () { handleKey(k); };
      actsEl.appendChild(el);
    });
  }

  renderTabs();
  renderActs();
  renderKb();
  addLine(true);
  updateTargetUI();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

﻿"""
Second-person hints keyed on misconception_id.

These are used when the diagnosis has fired and the tutor knows exactly
what went wrong. The hint speaks to the learner, about the maths, not
about the learner.

Levels:
    H1  - conceptual hint, names the concept
    H2  - strategic hint, suggests the operation
    H3  - micro-step, one concrete move

Salt-checked. All second person. All rooted in the specific error.
"""

HINTS = {
    "M_SIGN_ERROR_FACTORISATION": {
        "H1": "One of your roots has the wrong sign. Look at each factor — what value of x makes it zero?",
        "H2": "For a factor like (x + 5), the root is the value that makes the whole bracket zero. Try setting it equal to zero and solving.",
        "H3": "Set x + 5 = 0. That gives x = -5, not x = +5.",
    },
    "M_FACTORISATION_INCOMPLETE": {
        "H1": "You wrote the factors. What is the next step once you have them?",
        "H2": "When a product equals zero, each factor can equal zero on its own.",
        "H3": "Set each factor equal to zero on its own line: first (x - 2) = 0, then (x - 3) = 0.",
    },
    "M_TP_COORD_CONFUSION": {
        "H1": "Which coordinate of the turning point sets the range — the x or the y?",
        "H2": "The range describes the y-values, so you need the y-coordinate of the turning point.",
        "H3": "If the turning point is at (h; k), the range starts at y = k.",
    },
    "M_REDUCTION_SIGN": {
        "H1": "Which quadrant does this angle sit in? Check the sign before simplifying.",
        "H2": "Use the CAST diagram. In the second quadrant, only sin is positive.",
        "H3": "For sin(180 - x): 180 - x is in the second quadrant, and sin is positive there. So sin(180 - x) = sin x.",
    },
    "M_DIAGRAM_ASSUMPTION": {
        "H1": "You used a property of the diagram. Was it given, or did you assume it?",
        "H2": "In a proof, only given information can be used. Anything else must be proved.",
        "H3": "Write the given first. Then show each step and cite the theorem or reason.",
    },
    "M_MISSING_THEOREM_CITATION": {
        "H1": "You reached the correct statement. Where is the reason?",
        "H2": "Every statement in a Euclidean proof needs a reason in brackets.",
        "H3": "Write the theorem's name next to each statement, e.g. (angle in semicircle).",
    },
    "M_ASYMPTOTE_CONFUSION": {
        "H1": "Which asymptote is horizontal and which is vertical?",
        "H2": "The vertical asymptote comes from the denominator of the fraction.",
        "H3": "Set the denominator equal to zero to find the vertical asymptote; the constant added is the horizontal one.",
    },
    "M_IDENTITY_MISAPPLY": {
        "H1": "Which Pythagorean identity applies here — sin²+cos²=1?",
        "H2": "Write the identity on its own line first, then substitute.",
        "H3": "sin²x + cos²x = 1. Rearrange if needed, then substitute.",
    },
    "M_CHAIN_RULE_DROP": {
        "H1": "You differentiated the outer part. What about the inside?",
        "H2": "The chain rule: derivative of the outer times derivative of the inner.",
        "H3": "For (2x + 1)³: outer derivative 3(2x + 1)² times inner derivative 2, giving 6(2x + 1)².",
    },
    "M_GP_COMMON_RATIO": {
        "H1": "Which formula did you use — arithmetic or geometric?",
        "H2": "For a GP the term is a·r^(n-1), not a + (n-1)d.",
        "H3": "Set the exponent to (n - 1), not n. So T_n = a·r^(n-1).",
    },
    "M_BOXPLOT_IQR": {
        "H1": "Which quartiles did you use for the IQR?",
        "H2": "IQR is Q3 minus Q1, not the range.",
        "H3": "Subtract the lower quartile from the upper quartile: Q3 - Q1.",
    },
    "M_SIMILARITY_RATIO": {
        "H1": "Which direction is the ratio — big to small, or small to big?",
        "H2": "The ratio uses corresponding sides. Match the vertices first.",
        "H3": "Write the ratio as (image side) : (object side), then solve for the unknown.",
    },
}


def get_hint(misconception_id, hint_level):
    """Return the second-person hint for a misconception at a level, or None."""
    entry = HINTS.get(misconception_id)
    if not entry:
        return None
    return entry.get(hint_level)

    "\n",
    "\"The tutor has to learn from the student errors also and to be able to\n",
    "reteach those things and make corrections. A teacher learns from the\n",
    "student and that becomes information to the teacher and a lesson to the\n",
    "teacher. The tutor has to learn and create new solutions. The tutor is\n",
    "human. The tutor should have a report of what it is learning and\n",
    "discovering and what to teach. Its recommendations as time goes are far\n",
    "richer than what the DBE is providing because it is working as a database\n",
    "with students intently. That is why it is a tool that other teachers who\n",
    "are human can use.\"\n",
    "\n",
    "## What MethodMarker is\n",
    "\n",
    "Not a tutor that explains mathematics to learners.\n",
    "A tutor that **observes how this particular learner thinks**, identifies the\n",
    "exact breakdown, reconstructs the missing foundation, tests whether the\n",
    "repair worked, remembers the result, and changes how it teaches that learner.\n",
    "\n",
    "The intelligence is not the ability to converse.\n",
    "It is the ability to accumulate a memory of teaching.\n",
    "\n",
    "## The four questions\n",
    "\n",
    "Every feature, every session, every decision is judged by whether it\n",
    "improves MethodMarker\\'s ability to answer:\n",
    "\n",
    "1. **What does this learner actually know?**\n",
    "   Not what they claim. What the evidence demonstrates.\n",
    "\n",
    "2. **Why did this learner fail this particular step?**\n",
    "   Not \"you made a mistake\" but \"this failure is consistent with X, and\n",
    "   the evidence for that reading is Y.\"\n",
    "\n",
    "3. **What should happen next?**\n",
    "   Not \"here is another explanation\" but \"given this learner\\'s history,\n",
    "   prerequisite structure, and previous intervention outcomes, this is the\n",
    "   next appropriate teaching action.\"\n",
    "\n",
    "4. **Did that teaching actually work?**\n",
    "   Transfer. Not immediate performance. The killer question. If MethodMarker\n",
    "   cannot answer this, it is not truly learning.\n",
    "\n",
    "## The three learners\n",
    "\n",
    "- **The student** learns mathematics.\n",
    "- **The tutor** learns how to teach mathematics.\n",
    "- **The teacher** learns from the tutor.\n",
    "\n",
    "One flywheel. Each turn makes the others stronger.\n",
    "\n",
    "## The four pillars\n",
    "\n",
    "1. **Diagnosis per question.** Every question has a diagnosis report: what\n",
    "   the memo wanted per step, what the learner showed, what mark was earned,\n",
    "   what was lost, why. Backed by the DBE 12-year reports and memo mark\n",
    "   schemes. Never a verdict without evidence.\n",
    "\n",
    "2. **Fix the foundation, not the symptom.** When a learner fails a Grade 12\n",
    "   step, the tutor walks the prerequisite chain to find the first broken\n",
    "   link, and offers the drill that fixes the actual gap.\n",
    "\n",
    "3. **Teach the way the examiner thinks.** Every presentation rule cites a\n",
    "   specific DBE finding. Every piece of advice tied to a specific step.\n",
    "\n",
    "4. **Set problems the way the examiner sets them.** Variants constrained\n",
    "   by the fingerprint: number preferences, phrasing voice, mark shapes,\n",
    "   answer forms. Practice that transfers because it is the exam\\'s flavour.\n",
    "\n",
    "## The Tutor Learning Engine\n",
    "\n",
    "Not a discovery mechanism. A learning system.\n",
    "\n",
    "    OBSERVE     the learner\\'s actual working\n",
    "       ->\n",
    "    DIAGNOSE    which exact step broke, and why\n",
    "       ->\n",
    "    INTERVENE   the smallest action that might repair it\n",
    "       ->\n",
    "    MEASURE     did the repair transfer, days later\n",
    "       ->\n",
    "    LEARN       what worked, for whom, at which step\n",
    "       ->\n",
    "    UPDATE      how the tutor teaches next time\n",
    "\n",
    "Discovery happens inside LEARN. It is one phase, not the system.\n",
    "\n",
    "The LLM is one cognitive instrument inside this system. Not the system\n",
    "itself. If the LLM is swapped tomorrow, the learning engine continues.\n",
    "\n",
    "## Two outputs per session\n",
    "\n",
    "**To the learner, now:** whatever diagnosis the tutor can produce at\n",
    "whatever confidence. Help at the point of need. The learner does not wait\n",
    "for validation.\n",
    "\n",
    "**To the teacher, over time:** a referral, not analytics. \"Across your 27\n",
    "students, 14 are making the same sign error this week. Here is what I would\n",
    "reteach.\"\n",
    "\n",
    "## The student model\n",
    "\n",
    "Every learner has a name and a profile. Their history. Their pattern. Their\n",
    "personal model. When Tanaka opens the tutor tomorrow, it remembers Tanaka.\n",
    "\n",
    "## The weekend test\n",
    "\n",
    "Every proposed feature is judged by one question:\n",
    "\n",
    "*Could another AI tutor add this in a weekend and become essentially the\n",
    "same product?*\n",
    "\n",
    "If yes, it is not our moat.\n",
    "\n",
    "- LLM chat: no moat\n",
    "- Voice tutor: no moat\n",
    "- Generated worksheets: no moat\n",
    "- Generic hints: no moat\n",
    "- Fancy dashboard: no moat\n",
    "- AI explanations: no moat\n",
    "\n",
    "But:\n",
    "\n",
    "- Three years of learner trajectories showing which misconceptions occur\n",
    "  at which NSC steps, which prerequisite failures cause them, which\n",
    "  interventions repair them, which interventions transfer, which persist,\n",
    "  and which teachers confirmed those findings.\n",
    "\n",
    "That is extremely difficult to reproduce. That is the archive. That is the\n",
    "moat.\n",
    "\n",
    "## The rules that protect the spirit\n",
    "\n",
    "1. Never show a verdict without evidence.\n",
    "2. The LLM is a thinking instrument, not the system. It can be swapped.\n",
    "3. Presentation and diagnosis are different layers. Never conflated.\n",
    "4. Every discovery is logged and permanent. Evidence preserved.\n",
    "5. The teacher can always override.\n",
    "6. The student is known by name, not by number.\n",
    "7. Help is delivered at the moment of need.\n",
    "8. Never optimise for being a better chatbot.\n",
    "\n",
    "## What must never be lost\n",
    "\n",
    "1. The tutor develops a **memory of teaching**, not just a knowledge of maths.\n",
    "2. Two outputs per session: help the learner now, refer to the teacher over time.\n",
    "3. The student is known by name. Per-learner, over time, at the point of need.\n",
    "4. Interventions are measured for **transfer**, not just immediate improvement.\n",
    "5. The teacher is a partner, not a customer.\n",
    "6. Presentation and diagnosis are different layers.\n",
    "7. I am recreating myself. One teacher, many classrooms. The tutor is me, multiplied.\n",
    "8. The moat is the accumulated teaching archive. Not the engine.\n",
    "\n",
    "## The sentence to keep visible during development\n",
    "\n",
    "\"The product gets better not merely when the code improves, but when the\n",
    "tutor learns something from a learner that it can use again.\"\n",
    "\n",

    "arch = '''# MethodMarker Architecture — Governing Specification\n",
    "\n",
    "*Companion to docs/spirit.md. Judged against it in every session.*\n",
    "\n",
    "## The architectural consequence\n",
    "\n",
    "We are not building a smarter question-answering system. We are building a\n",
    "learning tutor whose knowledge compounds from learner evidence.\n",
    "\n",
    "The engine is the foundation. The accumulated memory is the product.\n",
    "\n",
    "## Locked principles\n",
    "\n",
    "1. **NSC-first remains the current content boundary.** The vision is broad.\n",
    "   The implementation stays South African NSC Mathematics.\n",
    "\n",
    "2. **Diagnosis is evidence-based.** Memo -> learner work -> observed marks ->\n",
    "   diagnosis. The system does not infer a missing step merely because it\n",
    "   was not typed.\n",
    "\n",
    "3. **The AI layer is genuinely part of the architecture.** The LLM is the\n",
    "   mechanism for handling genuinely unexplained cases. It is not the\n",
    "   defining feature and can be swapped.\n",
    "\n",
    "4. **Discovery is persistent.** tutor_discoveries is the beginning of the\n",
    "   tutor\\'s long-term institutional memory. Evidence is preserved.\n",
    "\n",
    "5. **Learner memory and tutor memory are different.**\n",
    "   - Learner model: what do I know about Tanaka?\n",
    "   - Tutor discovery store: what have I learned across learners?\n",
    "   - Teacher referral layer: what should a human teacher know or act on?\n",
    "\n",
    "6. **Presentation is not diagnosis.** Architectural boundary.\n",
    "\n",
    "7. **The teacher remains in the loop.** Discoveries mature through\n",
    "   recurrence and teacher confirmation. The learner is never blocked.\n",
    "\n",
    "8. **Never optimise for being a better chatbot.** Every feature is judged\n",
    "   against the four questions and the weekend test.\n",
    "\n",
    "## The four questions as design constraints\n",
    "\n",
    "Every subsystem exists to help MethodMarker answer one or more of:\n",
    "\n",
    "1. What does this learner actually know? -> Learner model, mastery store\n",
    "2. Why did this step fail? -> Step grader, diagnosis, discovery store\n",
    "3. What should happen next? -> Foundational DAG, drill router, intervention log\n",
    "4. Did that work? -> Outcome measurement, transfer testing, intervention effectiveness\n",
    "\n",
    "If a subsystem does not contribute to at least one of these, it is not core.\n",
    "\n",
    "## The Tutor Learning Engine\n",
    "\n",
    "    OBSERVE     learner attempt captured\n",
    "       ->\n",
    "    DIAGNOSE    layers 1, 2, 3 in order\n",
    "       ->\n",
    "    INTERVENE   smallest action targeting the identified gap\n",
    "       ->\n",
    "    MEASURE     transfer test, days later\n",
    "       ->\n",
    "    LEARN       what worked, for whom, at which step (discovery)\n",
    "       ->\n",
    "    UPDATE      routing, rules, patterns, teaching strategy\n",
    "\n",
    "Discovery is inside LEARN. Not the whole engine.\n",
    "\n",
    "## The persistence contract\n",
    "\n",
    "The critical property: a discovery exists as a first-class object even if\n",

    "    learner attempt\n",
    "        ->\n",
    "    Layer 1 diagnosis (deterministic)\n",

    "    if unresolved:\n",
    "        Discovery event created\n",
    "        ->\n",
    "    LLM reasoning attached (optional, swappable)\n",
    "        ->\n",
    "    learner-facing explanation delivered NOW\n",
    "        ->\n",
    "    persistent tutor_discovery written\n",
    "        ->\n",
    "    future recurrence strengthens it\n",
    "\n",

    "\n",
    "Evidence is preserved. Two years from now, the tutor has not just\n",

    "        s = re.sub(r\"\\\\s+\", \"\", s)\n",
    "        s = s.replace(\",\", \"or\")\n",
    "        parts.append(s)\n",
    "    return \" | \".join(parts)\n",

    "            \" confidence, skill_id, question_id, expected_answer, \"\n",

    "            (\n",

   "source": [
    "ds_path = ROOT / \"src\" / \"tutor\" / \"discovery_store.py\"\n",
    "src = ds_path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# 1. Add helpers for signal/verdict/confidence computation\n",
    "helpers = '''\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "# Signal model — tutor decides on its own evidence\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "\n",
    "# Signal names — each one is a fact the tutor knows, not an opinion.\n",
    "# Additional signals can be added without breaking existing records.\n",
    "SIGNAL_DEFAULTS = {\n",
    "    \"answer_wrong\": False,            # math_grader said NO_MATCH\n",
    "    \"steps_missing\": [],              # list of step indices NOT_MATCHED\n",
    "    \"n08_match\": None,                # misconception_id from N08 library\n",
    "    \"dbe_rule_match\": None,           # PR_* rule id from DBE diagnostic reports\n",
    "    \"llm_explanation\": None,          # free text, from LLM cognitive instrument\n",
    "    \"recurrence_count\": 1,            # how many times this pattern has been seen\n",
    "    \"learners_affected\": [],          # learner_ids\n",
    "    \"cross_skill\": False,             # same pattern seen on different skills\n",
    "    \"successful_intervention\": None,  # True / False / None after transfer test\n",
    "    \"teacher_note\": None,             # teacher's context if given\n",
    "    \"teacher_endorsed\": False,        # teacher added a boost\n",
    "    \"teacher_dismissed\": False,       # teacher flagged as noise\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Weights — how much each signal contributes to confidence.\n",
    "# Tunable. None required. This is the tutor's own math.\n",
    "SIGNAL_WEIGHTS = {\n",
    "    \"answer_wrong\": 0.15,\n",
    "    \"steps_missing\": 0.10,\n",
    "    \"n08_match\": 0.25,\n",
    "    \"dbe_rule_match\": 0.20,\n",
    "    \"llm_certainty\": 0.15,\n",
    "    \"recurrence_per_occurrence\": 0.05,   # capped at 0.30\n",
    "    \"recurrence_cap\": 0.30,\n",
    "    \"cross_skill\": 0.10,\n",
    "    \"successful_intervention\": 0.20,\n",
    "    \"teacher_endorsed\": 0.15,\n",
    "    \"teacher_dismissed\": -0.50,\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def compute_confidence(signals: dict) -> float:\n",
    "    \"\"\"Compute confidence from evidence signals. Never exceeds 1.0, never below 0.0.\"\"\"\n",
    "    score = 0.0\n",
    "    if signals.get(\"answer_wrong\"):\n",
    "        score += SIGNAL_WEIGHTS[\"answer_wrong\"]\n",
    "    if signals.get(\"steps_missing\"):\n",
    "        score += SIGNAL_WEIGHTS[\"steps_missing\"]\n",
    "    if signals.get(\"n08_match\"):\n",
    "        score += SIGNAL_WEIGHTS[\"n08_match\"]\n",
    "    if signals.get(\"dbe_rule_match\"):\n",
    "        score += SIGNAL_WEIGHTS[\"dbe_rule_match\"]\n",
    "    llm_cert = signals.get(\"llm_certainty\")\n",
    "    if isinstance(llm_cert, (int, float)):\n",
    "        score += SIGNAL_WEIGHTS[\"llm_certainty\"] * float(llm_cert)\n",
    "    rec = int(signals.get(\"recurrence_count\", 1))\n",
    "    score += min(SIGNAL_WEIGHTS[\"recurrence_cap\"],\n",
    "                 (rec - 1) * SIGNAL_WEIGHTS[\"recurrence_per_occurrence\"])\n",
    "    if signals.get(\"cross_skill\"):\n",
    "        score += SIGNAL_WEIGHTS[\"cross_skill\"]\n",
    "    if signals.get(\"successful_intervention\") is True:\n",
    "        score += SIGNAL_WEIGHTS[\"successful_intervention\"]\n",
    "    if signals.get(\"teacher_endorsed\"):\n",
    "        score += SIGNAL_WEIGHTS[\"teacher_endorsed\"]\n",
    "    if signals.get(\"teacher_dismissed\"):\n",
    "        score += SIGNAL_WEIGHTS[\"teacher_dismissed\"]\n",
    "    return max(0.0, min(1.0, score))\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def derive_status(confidence: float, signals: dict) -> str:\n",
    "    \"\"\"The tutor decides its own status. Teacher is one signal, not a gate.\"\"\"\n",
    "    if signals.get(\"teacher_dismissed\"):\n",
    "        return \"teacher_dismissed\"\n",
    "    if signals.get(\"promoted_to_rule\"):\n",
    "        return \"promoted\"\n",
    "    if signals.get(\"teacher_endorsed\"):\n",
    "        return \"teacher_endorsed\"\n",
    "    if confidence >= 0.55:\n",
    "        return \"established\"\n",
    "    if int(signals.get(\"recurrence_count\", 1)) >= 3:\n",
    "        return \"recurring\"\n",
    "    return \"noticed\"\n",
    "'''\n",
    "\n",
    "# Append helpers to end of file\n",

    "        self,\n",
    "        learner_id: str,\n",
    "        skill_id: str,\n",
    "        question_id: str,\n",
    "        learner_lines: list[str],\n",
    "        expected_answer: str,\n",
    "        session_id: Optional[str] = None,\n",
    "        n08_match: Optional[str] = None,\n",

    "        llm_explanation: Optional[str] = None,\n",
    "        llm_certainty: Optional[float] = None,\n",
    "    ) -> str:\n",
    "        \"\"\"Record an unresolved case. Returns the discovery_id.\n",
    "\n",
    "        The tutor decides errors on its own evidence: memo, math grader,\n",
    "        N08 library, DBE reports, recurrence, LLM reasoning. Teacher\n",

      "    MATRICMATH_LLM_URL     - OpenAI-compatible endpoint\n",
      "                             (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions\n",
      "                              or http://localhost:11434/v1/chat/completions)\n",

      "    MATRICMATH_LLM_MODEL   - model name (default: gpt-4o-mini)\n",
      "    MATRICMATH_LLM_TIMEOUT - seconds (default: 8)\n",
      "    MATRICMATH_LLM_OFF     - set to \"1\" to force disable\n",

      "\n",
      "\n",
      "def is_enabled() -> bool:\n",
      "    if os.environ.get(\"MATRICMATH_LLM_OFF\") == \"1\":\n",

      "    return bool(os.environ.get(\"MATRICMATH_LLM_URL\"))\n",

      "    try:\n",
