      "------------------------------------------------------------\n",
      "def _post(url, key, payload, timeout):\n",
      "    body = json.dumps(payload).encode(\"utf-8\")\n",
      "    headers = {\"Content-Type\": \"application/json\"}\n",
      "    if key:\n",
      "        headers[\"Authorization\"] = \"Bearer \" + key\n",
      "    req = _urllib_request.Request(url, data=body, headers=headers, method=\"POST\")\n",
      "    with _urllib_request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as resp:\n",
      "        return json.loads(resp.read().decode(\"utf-8\"))\n",
      "\n",
      "\n",
      "\n",
      "------------------------------------------------------------\n",
      "def _build_user_message(ctx: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:\n",
      "    problem = ctx.get(\"problem\")\n",
      "    diag = ctx.get(\"diagnosis\")\n",
      "    hint = ctx.get(\"specific_hint\") or \"\"\n",
      "    action = ctx.get(\"action_type\")\n",
      "    learner = ctx.get(\"learner_response\", \"\")\n",
      "\n",
      "    lines = []\n",
      "    lines.append(\"Learner typed: \" + repr(str(learner)[:160]))\n",
      "    lines.append(\"Problem: \" + str(getattr(problem, \"prompt\", \"\"))[:160])\n",
      "    lines.append(\"Error type: \" + str(diag.error_type.value))\n",
      "    if diag.misconception_id:\n",
      "        lines.append(\"Misconception: \" + str(diag.misconception_id))\n",
      "    lines.append(\"Action: \" + str(action.value if action else \"NONE\"))\n",
      "    if hint:\n",
      "        lines.append(\"Use this hint: \" + hint)\n",
      "    lines.append(\"\")\n",
      "    lines.append(\"Write the reply now. Two sentences. Speak to the learner.\")\n",
      "    return \"\\n\".join(lines)\n",
      "\n",
      "\n",
      "\n",
      "------------------------------------------------------------\n",
      "def phrase_response(ctx: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[str]:\n",
      "    if not llm_config.is_enabled():\n",
      "        return None\n",
      "\n",
      "    url = llm_config.get_url()\n",
      "    key = llm_config.get_key()\n",
      "    model = llm_config.get_model()\n",
      "    timeout = llm_config.get_timeout()\n",
      "\n",
      "    user_msg = _build_user_message(ctx)\n",
      "    payload = {\n",
      "        \"model\": model,\n",
      "        \"messages\": [\n",
      "            {\"role\": \"system\", \"content\": PHRASER_SYSTEM},\n",
      "            {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": user_msg},\n",
      "        ],\n",
      "        \"temperature\": 0.5,\n",
      "        \"max_tokens\": 80,\n",
      "    }\n",
      "\n",
      "    try:\n",
      "        data = _post(url, key, payload, timeout)\n",
      "    except (URLError, KeyError, ValueError, TimeoutError, OSError):\n",
      "        return None\n",
      "\n",
      "    try:\n",
      "        text = data[\"choices\"][0][\"message\"][\"content\"].strip()\n",
      "    except (KeyError, IndexError, AttributeError):\n",
      "        return None\n",
      "\n",
      "    if not text:\n",
      "        return None\n",
      "\n",
      "    if text.startswith(\"```\"):\n",
      "        text = text.strip(\"`\").strip()\n",
      "    if text.startswith('\"') and text.endswith('\"'):\n",
      "        text = text[1:-1].strip()\n",
      "\n",

      "    for phrase in FORBIDDEN_PHRASES:\n",
      "        if phrase in low:\n",
      "            return None\n",

      "    if not ok:\n",
      "        ok2, _reason2 = is_seasoned_hint(text)\n",
      "        if not ok2:\n",
      "            return None\n",
      "\n",
      "    return text\n",
      "\n",
      "\n"

      "======================================================================\n",
      "salt_check.py — full contents\n",
      "======================================================================\n",
      "﻿\"\"\"\n",
      "Salt check.\n",
      "\n",
      "\"Let your conversation be always full of grace, seasoned with salt.\"\n",
      "    - Colossians 4:6\n",
      "\n",
      "Every tutor line must pass this check before it ships. The check is\n",
      "deliberately narrow: it catches the specific failures the persona\n",
      "forbids, not stylistic preference.\n",
      "\n",
      "A line is seasoned if it:\n",
      "  - is not a law (\"you must\", \"you should\", \"always\", \"never\")\n",
      "  - does not shame (\"stupid\", \"lazy\", \"obvious\", \"just do\")\n",
      "  - does not leak internals (\"normalisation\", \"rule_id\", \"unknown pattern\",\n",
      "    \"error_type\", \"fallback\")\n",
      "  - does not pretend the learner is at fault (\"you forgot\", \"you failed\")\n",
      "  - contains at least one warmth signal:\n",
      "      * a question mark\n",
      "      * a soft opener (\"okay\", \"that is\", \"let's\", \"i hear\", \"i know\", \"not a problem\")\n",
      "      * an acknowledgement (\"good\", \"right\", \"close\", \"nearly\", \"well\")\n",
      "\"\"\"\n",
      "import re\n",
      "from typing import Tuple\n",
      "\n",
      "\n",
      "FORBIDDEN = [\n",
      "    # Laws\n",
      "    r\"\\byou must\\b\",\n",
      "    r\"\\byou should\\b\",\n",
      "    r\"\\byou need to\\b\",\n",
      "    r\"\\byou have to\\b\",\n",
      "    r\"\\balways do\\b\",\n",
      "    r\"\\bnever do\\b\",\n",
      "    # Shaming\n",
      "    r\"\\bstupid\\b\",\n",
      "    r\"\\blazy\\b\",\n",
      "    r\"\\bobvious\\b\",\n",
      "    r\"\\bjust do\\b\",\n",
      "    r\"\\bso easy\\b\",\n",
      "    r\"\\bcome on\\b\",\n",
      "    r\"\\bhonestly\\b\",\n",
      "    # Blame\n",
      "    r\"\\byou forgot\\b\",\n",
      "    r\"\\byou failed\\b\",\n",
      "    r\"\\byou got it wrong\\b\",\n",
      "    r\"\\bwhy did you\\b\",\n",
      "    # Leaked internals\n",
      "    r\"\\bnormalisation\\b\",\n",
      "    r\"\\bnormalization\\b\",\n",
      "    r\"\\brule_id\\b\",\n",
      "    r\"\\bunknown pattern\\b\",\n",
      "    r\"\\berror_type\\b\",\n",
      "    r\"\\bfallback\\b\",\n",
      "    r\"\\bprovenance\\b\",\n",
      "    r\"\\bmisconception_id\\b\",\n",
      "]\n",
      "\n",
      "\n",
      "WARMTH_OPENERS = [\n",
      "    # Soft openers and acknowledgements\n",
      "    \"okay\", \"alright\", \"that is\", \"that's\", \"let's\", \"let us\",\n",
      "    \"i hear\", \"i know\", \"i understand\", \"i am not\",\n",
      "    \"not a problem\", \"no rush\", \"no problem\",\n",
      "    \"fine\", \"right\", \"good\", \"nice\",\n",
      "    \"very close\", \"nearly\", \"close\", \"almost\",\n",
      "    \"so near\", \"take\", \"yes\",\n",
      "    # Teaching verbs - direct but kind, the way a tutor speaks\n",
      "    \"check\", \"look\", \"read\", \"notice\", \"remember\", \"notice\",\n",
      "    \"try\", \"write\", \"draw\", \"label\", \"mark\", \"name\",\n",
      "    \"state\", \"identify\", \"circle\", \"underline\", \"box\",\n",
      "    \"compare\", \"substitute\", \"simplify\", \"factorise\",\n",
      "    # Explanatory openers for notes and worked examples\n",
      "    \"use\", \"the \", \"in this\", \"when \", \"if \", \"for \",\n",
      "    \"each \", \"every \", \"never \", \"always \", \"this \",\n",
      "]\n",
      "\n",
      "\n",
      "def is_seasoned(line: str) -> Tuple[bool, str]:\n",
      "    \"\"\"\n",
      "    Return (True, \"\") if the line passes the salt check.\n",
      "    Return (False, reason) if it fails.\n",
      "    \"\"\"\n",
      "    if not isinstance(line, str) or not line.strip():\n",
      "        return False, \"empty line\"\n",
      "\n",
      "    low = line.lower()\n",
      "\n",
      "    for pattern in FORBIDDEN:\n",
      "        if re.search(pattern, low):\n",
      "            return False, \"forbidden phrase: \" + pattern\n",
      "\n",
      "    # Warmth signal\n",
      "    if \"?\" in line:\n",
      "        return True, \"\"\n",
      "    punct = [\" \", \",\", \".\", \":\", \";\", \"!\", \"-\", \"\\u2014\"]\n",
      "    for opener in WARMTH_OPENERS:\n",
      "        o = opener.rstrip()\n",
      "        for p in punct:\n",
      "            if low.startswith(o + p):\n",
      "                return True, \"\"\n",
      "    # Also allow warmth mid-line for very short lines\n",
      "    for opener in WARMTH_OPENERS:\n",
      "        o = opener.rstrip()\n",
      "        if \" \" + o + \" \" in low[:40]:\n",
      "            return True, \"\"\n",
      "\n",
      "    return False, \"no warmth signal (no question, no soft opener, no acknowledgement)\"\n",
      "\n",
      "\n",
      "def check_all(lines):\n",
      "    \"\"\"Return list of (line, reason) for every line that fails.\"\"\"\n",
      "    failures = []\n",
      "    for line in lines:\n",
      "        ok, reason = is_seasoned(line)\n",
      "        if not ok:\n",
      "            failures.append((line, reason))\n",
      "    return failures\n",
      "\n",
      "\n",
      "def is_seasoned_hint(line):\n",
      "    \"\"\"\n",
      "    Check for hints and teaching lines.\n",
      "\n",
      "    Hints are direct by design. They do not need a warmth opener. They\n",
      "    need to pass the forbidden checks (no laws, no shaming, no leaks,\n",
      "    no blame) and be non-empty.\n",
      "\n",
      "    Returns:\n",
      "        (True, \"\") if the hint is acceptable.\n",
      "        (False, reason) otherwise.\n",
      "    \"\"\"\n",
      "    if not isinstance(line, str) or not line.strip():\n",
      "        return False, \"empty line\"\n",
      "\n",
      "    low = line.lower()\n",
      "    for pattern in FORBIDDEN:\n",
      "        if re.search(pattern, low):\n",
      "            return False, \"forbidden phrase: \" + pattern\n",
      "\n",
      "    return True, \"\"\n",
      "\n",
      "\n",
      "======================================================================\n",
      "FORBIDDEN_PHRASES in llm_phraser.py\n",
      "======================================================================\n",
      "FORBIDDEN_PHRASES = [\n",
      "    \"the learner\", \"the student\", \"they seem\", \"i can see that\",\n",
      "    \"it seems\", \"challenging situation\", \"fueling\", \"hostility\",\n",
      "    \"learner:\", \"you:\", \"tutor:\",\n",
      "]\n",
      "\n",
      "======================================================================\n",
      "PHRASER_SYSTEM in llm_phraser.py\n",
      "======================================================================\n",
      "PHRASER_SYSTEM = \"\"\"You are a Matric Maths tutor. Reply directly to a\n",
      "Grade 12 learner. Two sentences maximum. Speak TO the learner.\n",
      "\n",
      "NEVER: describe the learner, echo input, give the answer, use\n",
      "\"you must\" / \"you should\" / \"just\" / \"obvious\" / \"as an AI\",\n",
      "sound like a therapist, output labels like \"learner:\".\n",
      "\n",
      "EXAMPLE GOOD:\n",
      "One of your roots has the wrong sign. Look at each factor — what\n",

      "\n",
      "EXAMPLE BAD:\n",
      "The learner is in the \"answer demand\" state. Let's end on a note of\n",
      "curiosity.\n",
      "\n",
      "Write plain text only. No labels. No JSON. No markdown.\n",
      "\"\"\"\n"

    "llm_src = '''\"\"\"LLM as cognitive instrument for MethodMarker.\n",
    "\n",
    "When the tutor's layers 1 and 2 cannot explain a learner's error, the LLM\n",
    "reasons about it. This is NOT a validator and NOT a gate. It is one\n",
    "cognitive instrument inside the Tutor Learning Engine.\n",
    "\n",
    "Design principles (from docs/spirit.md and docs/architecture.md):\n",
    "  - The LLM is optional. If it is off or fails, the discovery is still\n",
    "    recorded with all other signals. No exception propagates to the drill.\n",
    "  - Its output is a hypothesis with a certainty score, not a verdict.\n",
    "  - Its explanation is shown to the learner now and stored in the\n",
    "    discovery for later analysis.\n",
    "  - It reuses the project HTTP layer (llm_phraser._post) and config\n",
    "    (llm_config) -- same infrastructure as the phraser, different prompt.\n",
    "  - Its learner-facing text MUST pass salt_check -- the tutor's voice\n",

    "\"\"\"\n",

    "def is_enabled() -> bool:\n",

    "    return llm_config.is_enabled()\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _extract_json(text: str) -> Optional[dict]:\n",
    "    \"\"\"Parse JSON from LLM response. Handles markdown fences and prose noise.\"\"\"\n",
    "    if not text:\n",
    "        return None\n",
    "    t = text.strip()\n",
    "    if t.startswith(\"```\"):\n",
    "        t = re.sub(r\"^```[a-zA-Z]*\\\\n\", \"\", t)\n",
    "        t = re.sub(r\"\\\\n```\\\\s*$\", \"\", t)\n",
    "    i = t.find(\"{\")\n",
    "    j = t.rfind(\"}\")\n",
    "    if i < 0 or j < 0 or j <= i:\n",
    "        return None\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        return json.loads(t[i:j + 1])\n",
    "    except Exception:\n",
    "        return None\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "PROMPT_TEMPLATE = \"\"\"Context:\n",
    "- Skill: {skill_id}\n",
    "- Expected answer: {expected_answer}\n",
    "- Learner's working (verbatim, one line per entry):\n",
    "{lines}\n",
    "\n",
    "Return the JSON object now.\"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _safe_explanation(text: str) -> Optional[str]:\n",
    "    \"\"\"Pass the explanation through salt_check. Returns None if it fails.\n",
    "\n",
    "    Mirrors the discipline of phrase_response: try warmth first\n",
    "    (is_seasoned), fall back to hint-level (is_seasoned_hint). If neither\n",
    "    passes, drop the explanation entirely -- never speak unseasoned text\n",
    "    to the learner.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    if not text or not text.strip():\n",
    "        return None\n",
    "    ok, _reason = is_seasoned(text)\n",
    "    if ok:\n",
    "        return text.strip()\n",
    "    ok2, _reason2 = is_seasoned_hint(text)\n",
    "    if ok2:\n",
    "        return text.strip()\n",
    "    return None\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def diagnose_unknown(\n",
    "    skill_id: str,\n",
    "    learner_lines: list[str],\n",
    "    expected_answer: str,\n",
    ") -> Optional[dict]:\n",
    "    \"\"\"Ask the LLM to reason about an unexplained error.\n",
    "\n",
    "    Returns dict with keys: hypothesis, explanation, certainty,\n",
    "    suggested_foundation. Returns None if disabled / failed / unparseable.\n",
    "    If the explanation fails salt_check, the field is set to None but\n",
    "    the discovery data is still returned.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    if not llm_config.is_enabled():\n",
    "        return None\n",
    "\n",
    "    if not learner_lines or not expected_answer:\n",
    "        return None\n",
    "\n",
    "    url = llm_config.get_url()\n",
    "    key = llm_config.get_key()\n",
    "    model = llm_config.get_model()\n",
    "    timeout = llm_config.get_timeout()\n",
    "\n",
    "    user_msg = PROMPT_TEMPLATE.format(\n",
    "        skill_id=skill_id,\n",
    "        expected_answer=expected_answer,\n",
    "        lines=\"\\\\n\".join(\"  \" + ln for ln in learner_lines),\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    payload = {\n",
    "        \"model\": model,\n",
    "        \"messages\": [\n",
    "            {\"role\": \"system\", \"content\": DIAGNOSER_SYSTEM},\n",
    "            {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": user_msg},\n",
    "        ],\n",
    "        \"temperature\": 0.2,\n",
    "        \"max_tokens\": 400,\n",
    "    }\n",
    "\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        data = _post(url, key, payload, timeout)\n",
    "    except (URLError, KeyError, ValueError, TimeoutError, OSError):\n",
    "        return None\n",
    "\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        raw = data[\"choices\"][0][\"message\"][\"content\"]\n",
    "    except (KeyError, IndexError, AttributeError, TypeError):\n",
    "        return None\n",
    "\n",
    "    parsed = _extract_json(raw)\n",
    "    if not parsed:\n",
    "        return None\n",
    "\n",
    "    certainty = parsed.get(\"certainty\", 0.0)\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        certainty = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(certainty)))\n",
    "    except (TypeError, ValueError):\n",
    "        certainty = 0.0\n",
    "\n",
    "    raw_explanation = str(parsed.get(\"explanation\", \"\")).strip()\n",
    "    safe_explanation = _safe_explanation(raw_explanation)\n",
    "\n",
    "    return {\n",
    "        \"hypothesis\": str(parsed.get(\"hypothesis\", \"\")).strip(),\n",
    "        \"explanation\": safe_explanation,\n",
    "        \"explanation_flagged\": raw_explanation if not safe_explanation else None,\n",
    "        \"certainty\": certainty,\n",
    "        \"suggested_foundation\": parsed.get(\"suggested_foundation\"),\n",
    "    }\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "# Learner-facing rendering\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "\n",
    "def render_for_learner(reasoning: dict) -> str:\n",
    "    \"\"\"Format the LLM reasoning for the learner, warmly.\n",
    "\n",
    "    Explanations are pre-filtered by salt_check in diagnose_unknown.\n",
    "    If explanation is None (rejected), returns an empty string.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    if not reasoning:\n",
    "        return \"\"\n",
    "    explanation = reasoning.get(\"explanation\")\n",
    "    if not explanation:\n",
    "        return \"\"\n",
    "    cert = reasoning.get(\"certainty\", 0.0)\n",
    "    if cert < 0.4:\n",
    "        prefix = \"  I'm not completely sure, but here's a guess:\\\\n\"\n",
    "    elif cert < 0.7:\n",
    "        prefix = \"  I think I see what happened here:\\\\n\"\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        prefix = \"  I see what happened here:\\\\n\"\n",
    "    return prefix + \"  \" + explanation\n",
    "'''\n",

    "inv_src = '''\"\"\"Intervention + outcome store.\n",
    "\n",
    "The measurement layer of the Tutor Learning Engine.\n",
    "\n",
    "When the tutor takes a corrective action (shows a memo line, routes to a\n",
    "prerequisite, offers a worked example), that action is logged as an\n",
    "intervention. When the learner demonstrates improvement later, that is\n",
    "logged as an outcome.\n",
    "\n",
    "The fourth question -- \"did that teaching actually work?\" -- is\n",
    "answered by looking at the outcome table.\n",
    "\n",
    "Design principles (from docs/spirit.md):\n",
    "  - Every corrective action is measured, not assumed.\n",
    "  - Transfer matters more than immediate performance.\n",
    "  - Outcomes feed back into discoveries as signals.\n",
    "\"\"\"\n",
    "from __future__ import annotations\n",
    "\n",
    "import json\n",
    "import uuid\n",
    "from datetime import datetime, timezone\n",
    "from typing import Optional\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _now() -> str:\n",
    "    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _days_between(iso_a: str, iso_b: str) -> Optional[int]:\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        a = datetime.fromisoformat(iso_a)\n",
    "        b = datetime.fromisoformat(iso_b)\n",
    "        return abs((b - a).days)\n",
    "    except Exception:\n",
    "        return None\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "ACTION_TYPES = (\n",

    "    \"prerequisite_drill\",    # tutor routed to a foundational drill\n",
    "    \"worked_example\",        # tutor showed a sibling / worked example\n",
    "    \"hint\",                  # tutor gave a specific hint\n",
    "    \"teacher_referred\",      # discovery referred to teacher dashboard\n",

    "\n",
    "RESULT_VALUES = (\"improved\", \"unchanged\", \"worsened\", \"unknown\")\n",

    "        inv_id = \"inv_\" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]\n",
    "        self.conn.execute(\n",
    "            \"INSERT INTO intervention \"\n",
    "            \"(intervention_id, learner_id, discovery_id, skill_id, question_id, \"\n",
    "            \" action_type, action_desc, applied_at, session_id, context) \"\n",
    "            \"VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n",
    "            (\n",
    "                inv_id, learner_id, discovery_id, skill_id, question_id,\n",
    "                action_type, action_desc, _now(), session_id,\n",
    "                json.dumps(context or {}),\n",
    "            ),\n",
    "        )\n",
    "        self.conn.commit()\n",
    "        return inv_id\n",
    "\n",
    "    def get(self, intervention_id: str) -> Optional[dict]:\n",
    "        row = self.conn.execute(\n",

    "\n",
    "    def list_open(self, learner_id: str, skill_id: str) -> list[dict]:\n",

    "            (limit,),\n",

    "    def _update_discovery_signal(\n",
    "        self, discovery_id: str, result: str, action_type: str\n",

    "                (discovery_id,),\n",
    "            ).fetchone()\n",
    "            if not row:\n",
    "                return\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                signals = json.loads(row[\"evidence_signals\"] or \"{}\")\n",
    "            except Exception:\n",
    "                signals = {}\n",
    "            # Aggregate: any successful intervention proves it can be fixed\n",
    "            history = signals.get(\"intervention_history\", [])\n",
    "            history.append({\n",
    "                \"action\": action_type,\n",
    "                \"result\": result,\n",
    "                \"at\": _now(),\n",
    "            })\n",
    "            signals[\"intervention_history\"] = history[-20:]  # cap\n",
    "            if result == \"improved\":\n",
    "                signals[\"successful_intervention\"] = True\n",
    "            elif result == \"worsened\" and not signals.get(\"successful_intervention\"):\n",
    "                signals[\"successful_intervention\"] = False\n",
    "            self.conn.execute(\n",
    "                \"UPDATE tutor_discovery SET evidence_signals = ?, \"\n",
    "                \"  last_seen_at = ? WHERE discovery_id = ?\",\n",
    "                (json.dumps(signals), _now(), discovery_id),\n",
    "            )\n",
    "            self.conn.commit()\n",
    "        except Exception:\n",
    "            pass\n",
    "\n",
    "    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "    # Effectiveness\n",
    "    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "    def effectiveness(self, discovery_id: str) -> dict:\n",
    "        \"\"\"Across all interventions for a discovery: how often did it work?\"\"\"\n",
    "        rows = self.conn.execute(\n",
    "            \"SELECT o.result, COUNT(*) as n FROM outcome o \"\n",
    "            \"JOIN intervention i ON i.intervention_id = o.intervention_id \"\n",
    "            \"WHERE i.discovery_id = ? \"\n",
    "            \"GROUP BY o.result\",\n",
    "            (discovery_id,),\n",
    "        ).fetchall()\n",
    "        counts = {r[\"result\"]: r[\"n\"] for r in rows}\n",
    "        total = sum(counts.values())\n",
    "        improved = counts.get(\"improved\", 0)\n",
    "        return {\n",
    "            \"discovery_id\": discovery_id,\n",
    "            \"total\": total,\n",
    "            \"improved\": improved,\n",
    "            \"unchanged\": counts.get(\"unchanged\", 0),\n",
    "            \"worsened\": counts.get(\"worsened\", 0),\n",
    "            \"rate\": (improved / total) if total else 0.0,\n",
    "        }\n",
    "\n",
    "    def summary(self) -> dict:\n",
    "        cur = self.conn.execute\n",
    "        total_inv = cur(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM intervention\").fetchone()[0]\n",
    "        total_out = cur(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outcome\").fetchone()[0]\n",
    "        improved = cur(\n",
    "            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outcome WHERE result = 'improved'\"\n",
    "        ).fetchone()[0]\n",
    "        return {\n",
    "            \"interventions\": total_inv,\n",
    "            \"outcomes\": total_out,\n",
    "            \"improved\": improved,\n",
    "            \"measured_rate\": (improved / total_out) if total_out else 0.0,\n",
    "        }\n",
    "'''\n",

    "helper = '''\n",
    "\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "# Auto-outcome measurement\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "\n",
    "def _close_open_interventions(store, learner_id, skill_id, step_result,\n",
    "                               current_qid, session_id):\n",
    "    \"\"\"For every open intervention on this learner+skill, record whether the\n",
    "    learner now shows what was being taught.\n",
    "\n",
    "    Called on MATCH. The outcome is:\n",
    "      - improved   : the step that was taught is now MATCHED\n",
    "                     (or, if no step can be checked, the answer matched)\n",
    "      - unchanged  : the step is still NOT_MATCHED\n",
    "      - (skip)     : the step is UNCERTAIN, or we can't determine\n",
    "\n",
    "    This is the piece that makes the loop turn by itself. Every time a\n",
    "    learner does well, the tutor learns something about its own teaching.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        open_invs = store.interventions.list_open(learner_id, skill_id)\n",
    "    except Exception:\n",
    "        return\n",
    "    if not open_invs:\n",
    "        return\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Build a lookup: step_index -> match_status from the current attempt\n",
    "    step_status = {}\n",
    "    if step_result is not None:\n",
    "        for s in step_result.get(\"steps\", []):\n",
    "            step_status[int(s.get(\"index\", -1))] = s.get(\"match_status\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    for inv in open_invs:\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            ctx = json.loads(inv.get(\"context\") or \"{}\")\n",
    "        except Exception:\n",
    "            ctx = {}\n",
    "        step_index = ctx.get(\"step_index\")\n",
    "\n",
    "        if step_index is not None and int(step_index) in step_status:\n",
    "            status = step_status[int(step_index)]\n",
    "            if status == \"MATCHED\":\n",
    "                result = \"improved\"\n",
    "            elif status == \"NOT_MATCHED\":\n",
    "                result = \"unchanged\"\n",
    "            else:\n",
    "                continue  # UNCERTAIN — cannot judge, leave open\n",
    "            evidence = {\n",
    "                \"measured_via\": \"step_grader\",\n",
    "                \"step_index\": int(step_index),\n",
    "                \"current_qid\": current_qid,\n",
    "                \"session_id\": session_id,\n",
    "            }\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            # No step to check — fall back to overall answer match.\n",
    "            result = \"improved\"\n",
    "            evidence = {\n",
    "                \"measured_via\": \"answer_match\",\n",
    "                \"current_qid\": current_qid,\n",
    "                \"session_id\": session_id,\n",
    "            }\n",
    "\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            store.interventions.record_outcome(\n",
    "                intervention_id=inv[\"intervention_id\"],\n",
    "                learner_id=learner_id,\n",
    "                result=result,\n",
    "                measurement_kind=\"follow_up\",\n",
    "                evidence=evidence,\n",
    "            )\n",
    "        except Exception:\n",
    "            pass  # never break the drill\n",
    "\n",
    "'''\n",
    "\n",
    "if \"_close_open_interventions\" in src:\n",
    "    print(\"[skip] helper already present\")\n",
    "else:\n",
    "    anchor = \"def run(engine, store, learner_id, session_id, anchor\"\n",
    "    assert anchor in src, \"def run anchor not found\"\n",
    "    src = src.replace(anchor, helper.lstrip() + anchor, 1)\n",
    "    drill_path.write_text(src, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n",
    "    print(\"[ok] _close_open_interventions added\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"drill.py: {len(src.splitlines())} lines\")"
   ]

"""Load and validate N08 intervention_specification CSV with safe fallback."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, Optional, Tuple, List, Any

import pandas as pd

from .schemas import DiagnosisResult, InterventionSelection, ProvenanceKind

# Same five-case map as before (fallback)
FALLBACK_MAP = {
    "M_SIGN_ERROR_FACTORISATION": ("IP_MISCONCEPTION_CONTRAST", "N08_ALG_QUAD_SIGN_01"),
    "M_TP_COORD_CONFUSION": ("IP_REPRESENTATION_SHIFT", "N08_FUNC_PARAB_02"),
    "M_REDUCTION_SIGN": ("IP_MISCONCEPTION_CONTRAST", "N08_TRIG_RED_01"),
    "M_DIAGRAM_ASSUMPTION": ("IP_STEP_ISOLATION", "N08_AGEO_PROOF_01"),
    "M_MISSING_THEOREM_CITATION": ("IP_SELF_EXPLANATION", "N08_EUCL_PROOF_01"),
}

REQUIRED_COLUMNS = {
    "intervention_id",
    "topic",
    "misconception_id",
    "intervention_pattern",
}

# Optional renames from older N08 exports
COLUMN_ALIASES = {
    "pattern": "intervention_pattern",
    "misconception": "misconception_id",
    "misconception_label": "misconception_id",
    "id": "intervention_id",
}


@dataclass
class N08Library:
    by_misconception: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]
    source_path: Optional[str]
    source_hash: Optional[str]
    load_status: str  # "csv" | "fallback"
    validation_errors: List[str]


def _default_csv_path() -> Path:
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    return root / "data" / "processed" / "intervention" / "intervention_specification_v1.csv"


def _file_hash(path: Path) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(65536), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()[:16]


def _normalise_columns(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = df.copy()
    df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.columns]
    rename = {}
    for col in list(df.columns):
        key = col.lower().replace(" ", "_")
        if key in COLUMN_ALIASES:
            rename[col] = COLUMN_ALIASES[key]
        elif key in REQUIRED_COLUMNS or key == "status":
            rename[col] = key
    if rename:
        df = df.rename(columns=rename)
    return df


def load_n08_library(csv_path: Optional[Path] = None) -> N08Library:
    path = Path(csv_path) if csv_path else _default_csv_path()
    errors: List[str] = []

    if not path.exists():
        errors.append(f"CSV not found: {path}")
        return _fallback_library(errors)

    try:
        df = pd.read_csv(path)
    except Exception as e:
        errors.append(f"CSV read failed: {e}")
        return _fallback_library(errors)

    df = _normalise_columns(df)
    missing = REQUIRED_COLUMNS - set(df.columns)
    if missing:
        errors.append(f"Missing columns: {sorted(missing)}")
        return _fallback_library(errors)

    if "status" in df.columns:
        df = df[df["status"].astype(str).str.lower().isin(["active", "nan", ""]) | df["status"].isna()]

    by_misc: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
    seen_ids = set()

    for _, row in df.iterrows():
        iid = str(row["intervention_id"]).strip()
        mid = str(row["misconception_id"]).strip()
        pattern = str(row["intervention_pattern"]).strip()
        topic = str(row["topic"]).strip()

        if not iid or iid.lower() == "nan":
            errors.append("Blank intervention_id skipped")
            continue
        if not mid or mid.lower() == "nan":
            errors.append(f"Blank misconception_id for {iid}")
            continue
        if not pattern or pattern.lower() == "nan":
            errors.append(f"Blank intervention_pattern for {iid}")
            continue
        if iid in seen_ids:
            errors.append(f"Duplicate intervention_id: {iid}")
            continue
        seen_ids.add(iid)

        # First row wins per misconception (stable)
        if mid not in by_misc:
            by_misc[mid] = {
                "intervention_id": iid,
                "intervention_pattern": pattern,
                "topic": topic,
                "misconception_id": mid,
            }

    if not by_misc:
        errors.append("No valid intervention rows after validation")
        return _fallback_library(errors)

    return N08Library(
        by_misconception=by_misc,
        source_path=str(path),
        source_hash=_file_hash(path),
        load_status="csv",
        validation_errors=errors,
    )


def _fallback_library(errors: List[str]) -> N08Library:
    by_misc = {
        mid: {
            "intervention_id": n08_id,
            "intervention_pattern": pattern,
            "topic": "",
            "misconception_id": mid,
        }
        for mid, (pattern, n08_id) in FALLBACK_MAP.items()
    }
    return N08Library(
        by_misconception=by_misc,
        source_path=None,
        source_hash=None,
        load_status="fallback",
        validation_errors=errors,
    )


# Module-level cache
_LIBRARY: Optional[N08Library] = None


def get_library(force_reload: bool = False, csv_path: Optional[Path] = None) -> N08Library:
    global _LIBRARY
    if _LIBRARY is None or force_reload or csv_path is not None:
        _LIBRARY = load_n08_library(csv_path)
    return _LIBRARY


def select_intervention_from_library(
    diagnosis: DiagnosisResult,
    library: Optional[N08Library] = None,
) -> Tuple[InterventionSelection, str]:
    """Return (selection, intervention_source) where source is 'csv' or 'fallback'."""
    lib = library or get_library()
    mid = diagnosis.misconception_id

    if not mid:
        sel = InterventionSelection(
            intervention_pattern="IP_GENERIC_PROMPT",
            provenance=ProvenanceKind.GENERIC_FALLBACK,
            n08_intervention_id=None,
            rule_id="ISEL_GENERIC",
            notes="No misconception id; generic prompt.",
        )
        return sel, "fallback"

    row = lib.by_misconception.get(mid)
    if row:
        # Provenance: n08_backed if from csv library OR from curated fallback map ids
        provenance = (
            ProvenanceKind.N08_BACKED
            if lib.load_status == "csv"
            else ProvenanceKind.N08_BACKED  # curated map is still N08-shaped
        )
        source = lib.load_status  # "csv" or "fallback"
        sel = InterventionSelection(
            intervention_pattern=row["intervention_pattern"],
            provenance=provenance,
            n08_intervention_id=row["intervention_id"],
            rule_id="ISEL_N08_CSV" if source == "csv" else "ISEL_N08_FALLBACK_MAP",
            notes=f"source={source}; hash={lib.source_hash}",
        )
        return sel, source

    sel = InterventionSelection(
        intervention_pattern="IP_GENERIC_PROMPT",
        provenance=ProvenanceKind.GENERIC_FALLBACK,
        n08_intervention_id=None,
        rule_id="ISEL_UNMAPPED_MISCONCEPTION",
        notes=f"Misconception {mid} not in library ({lib.load_status}).",
    )
    return sel, "fallback"
import sys
import pathlib
import pandas as pd

sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

    "    s = s.replace(\"\\u00d7\", \"*\").replace(\"\\u2212\", \"-\").replace(\"\\u2013\", \"-\")\n",
    "    s = s.replace(\"\\u2234\", \" \").replace(\"\\u2235\", \" \")\n",
    "    s = re.sub(r\"^\\s*(therefore|so|hence|thus)\\b\\s*\", \"\", s)\n",
    "    # Decimal comma -> period (SA/European notation). Do this before tokenising\n",
    "    # so \"x=1,79\" doesn't split into tokens \"x=1\" and \"79\".\n",
    "    s = re.sub(r\"(\\d),(\\d)\", r\"\\1.\\2\", s)\n",
    "    return s\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _tokens(s: str) -> list[str]:\n",
    "    parts = _SEP.split(_norm(s))\n",
    "    return sorted(re.sub(r\"\\s+\", \"\", p) for p in parts if p.strip())\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _line_matches(line: str, forms: list[str], is_final: bool = False) -> bool:\n",
    "    lt = _tokens(line)\n",
    "    if not lt:\n",
    "        return False\n",
    "    lt_set = set(lt)\n",
    "    for form in forms:\n",
    "        ft = _tokens(form)\n",
    "        if not ft:\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "        if is_final:\n",
    "            # Final-answer steps: form tokens must all appear in line tokens.\n",
    "            # Lets \"x=1.79 or x=-1.12\" satisfy both \"x=1.79\" and \"x=-1.12\" steps.\n",
    "            if set(ft).issubset(lt_set):\n",
    "                return True\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            if ft == lt:\n",
    "                return True\n",
    "    return False\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def grade_steps(question_id: str, learner_lines: list[str], csv_path: Path | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:\n",
    "    steps_map = load_steps(csv_path)\n",
    "    steps = steps_map.get(question_id, [])\n",
    "    if not steps:\n",
    "        return {\n",
    "            \"question_id\": question_id,\n",
    "            \"total_marks\": 0,\n",
    "            \"awarded_marks\": 0,\n",
    "            \"steps\": [],\n",
    "            \"feedback\": \"No step scheme for \" + question_id,\n",
    "        }\n",
    "    used: set[int] = set()\n",
    "    results = []\n",
    "    awarded = 0\n",
    "    for step in steps:\n",
    "        matched = False\n",
    "        matched_line = None\n",
    "        is_final = step.get(\"is_final\", False)\n",
    "        for i, line in enumerate(learner_lines):\n",
    "            if i in used and not is_final:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            if _line_matches(line, step[\"forms\"], is_final=is_final):\n",
    "                matched = True\n",
    "                matched_line = line\n",
    "                if not is_final:\n",
    "                    used.add(i)\n",
    "                awarded += step[\"marks\"]\n",
    "                break\n",
    "        results.append({\n",
    "            \"index\": step[\"index\"],\n",
    "            \"desc\": step[\"desc\"],\n",
    "            \"marks\": step[\"marks\"],\n",
    "            \"matched\": matched,\n",
    "            \"learner_line\": matched_line,\n",
    "            \"is_final\": is_final,\n",
    "        })\n",
    "\n",
    "    final_matched = any(r[\"matched\"] and r[\"is_final\"] for r in results)\n",
    "    unmatched_lines = [ln for i, ln in enumerate(learner_lines) if i not in used]\n",
    "    has_method_evidence = any(_METHOD_MARKERS.search(ln) for ln in unmatched_lines)\n",
    "\n",
    "    for r in results:\n",
    "        if r[\"matched\"]:\n",
    "            r[\"match_status\"] = \"MATCHED\"\n",
    "        elif final_matched and has_method_evidence:\n",
    "            r[\"match_status\"] = \"UNCERTAIN\"\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            r[\"match_status\"] = \"NOT_MATCHED\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    total = sum(s[\"marks\"] for s in steps)\n",
    "    missing = [r for r in results if r[\"match_status\"] == \"NOT_MATCHED\"]\n",
    "    uncertain = [r for r in results if r[\"match_status\"] == \"UNCERTAIN\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "    if not missing and not uncertain:\n",
    "        feedback = \"Full marks: %d/%d\" % (awarded, total)\n",
    "    elif uncertain and not missing:\n",
    "        bits = [\"cannot verify '%s' (alternate method used)\" % u[\"desc\"] for u in uncertain]\n",
    "        feedback = \"%d/%d. \" % (awarded, total) + \"; \".join(bits)\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        bits = [\"missed '%s' (%d mark)\" % (m[\"desc\"], m[\"marks\"]) for m in missing]\n",
    "        if uncertain:\n",
    "            bits.append(\"cannot verify \" + \", \".join(\"'%s'\" % u[\"desc\"] for u in uncertain))\n",
    "        feedback = \"%d/%d. \" % (awarded, total) + \"; \".join(bits)\n",
    "\n",
    "    return {\n",
    "        \"question_id\": question_id,\n",
    "        \"total_marks\": total,\n",
    "        \"awarded_marks\": awarded,\n",
    "        \"steps\": results,\n",
    "        \"feedback\": feedback,\n",
    "    }\n",
    "'''\n",
    "\n",
    "sg_path = ROOT / \"src\" / \"tutor\" / \"step_grader.py\"\n",
    "sg_path.write_text(step_grader_source, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n",
    "\n",
    "line_count = len(sg_path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").splitlines())\n",
    "print(f\"Wrote {line_count} lines to {sg_path.name}\")\n",
    "assert line_count > 100, f\"Too short — paste failed ({line_count} lines)\"\n",
    "print(\"OK\")"
   ]

    "\n",
    "def run() -> int:\n",
    "    passed = xfailed = failed = 0\n",
    "    out = []\n",
    "\n",
    "    for name, qid, working, exp_awarded, exp_missing, note, xfail in CASES:\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            r = grade_steps(qid, working, CSV)\n",
    "            awarded = r[\"awarded_marks\"]\n",
    "            missing = sorted(s[\"index\"] for s in r[\"steps\"] if s[\"match_status\"] == \"NOT_MATCHED\")\n",
    "            ok = (awarded == exp_awarded) and (missing == sorted(exp_missing))\n",
    "        except Exception as e:\n",
    "            awarded = missing = None\n",
    "            ok = False\n",
    "            note = \"EXCEPTION: \" + str(e) + \" | \" + note\n",
    "\n",
    "        if ok and not xfail:\n",
    "            passed += 1\n",
    "            status = \"PASS \"\n",
    "        elif (not ok) and xfail:\n",
    "            xfailed += 1\n",
    "            status = \"XFAIL\"\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            failed += 1\n",
    "            status = \"FAIL \"\n",
    "\n",
    "        out.append(\"  [\" + status + \"] \" + name)\n",
    "        if note:\n",
    "            out.append(\"           note: \" + note)\n",
    "        if not ok and not xfail:\n",
    "            out.append(\"           expected \" + str(exp_awarded) + \" missing=\" + str(sorted(exp_missing)))\n",
    "            out.append(\"           got      \" + str(awarded) + \" missing=\" + str(missing))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Assertion: Q1.1.1 case 20 -> UNCERTAIN, UNCERTAIN, MATCHED\n",
    "    r20 = grade_steps(\"2023_P1_Q1.1.1\",\n",
    "                      [\"x = (-1 +/- sqrt(49))/2\", \"x = (-1 +/- 7)/2\", \"x = 3 or x = -4\"],\n",
    "                      CSV)\n",
    "    statuses = [s[\"match_status\"] for s in r20[\"steps\"]]\n",
    "    if statuses == [\"UNCERTAIN\", \"UNCERTAIN\", \"MATCHED\"]:\n",
    "        passed += 1\n",
    "        out.append(\"  [PASS ] assertion / Q1.1.1 case 20 UNCERTAIN -> \" + str(statuses))\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        failed += 1\n",
    "        out.append(\"  [FAIL ] assertion / Q1.1.1 case 20 UNCERTAIN\")\n",
    "        out.append(\"           expected ['UNCERTAIN', 'UNCERTAIN', 'MATCHED']\")\n",
    "        out.append(\"           got      \" + str(statuses))\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(\"\\n\".join(out))\n",
    "    print()\n",
    "    print(\"  \" + str(passed) + \" passed  |  \" + str(xfailed) + \" xfail  |  \"\n",
    "          + str(failed) + \" failed  |  \" + str(len(CASES) + 1) + \" total\")\n",
    "    return failed\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "if __name__ == \"__main__\":\n",
    "    sys.exit(1 if run() else 0)\n",
    "'''\n",

   "source": [
    "step_grader_source = r'''from __future__ import annotations\n",
    "\n",
    "import csv\n",
    "import re\n",
    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "from typing import Any\n",
    "\n",
    "ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]\n",
    "DEFAULT_CSV = ROOT / \"data\" / \"processed\" / \"memo_step_marks\" / \"memo_step_marks_2023_P1.csv\"\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def load_steps(csv_path: Path | None = None) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]:\n",
    "    path = csv_path or DEFAULT_CSV\n",
    "    by_q: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}\n",
    "    with open(path, encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n",
    "        for row in csv.DictReader(f):\n",
    "            qid = row[\"question_id\"].strip()\n",
    "            mg = (row.get(\"method_group\") or \"A\").strip() or \"A\"\n",
    "            by_q.setdefault(qid, []).append({\n",
    "                \"index\": int(row[\"step_index\"]),\n",
    "                \"desc\": row[\"step_description\"].strip(),\n",
    "                \"marks\": int(row[\"marks\"]),\n",
    "                \"memo_line\": row[\"memo_line\"].strip(),\n",
    "                \"forms\": [x.strip() for x in row[\"acceptable_forms\"].split(\"|\") if x.strip()],\n",
    "                \"skill_id\": row[\"skill_id\"].strip(),\n",
    "                \"method_tag\": row[\"method_tag\"].strip(),\n",
    "                \"method_group\": mg,\n",
    "                \"is_final\": str(row.get(\"is_final\", \"false\")).strip().lower() == \"true\",\n",
    "            })\n",
    "    for qid in by_q:\n",
    "        by_q[qid].sort(key=lambda s: (s[\"method_group\"], s[\"index\"]))\n",
    "    return by_q\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "_SEP = re.compile(r\"\\s*(?:,|\\bor\\b|;|\\band\\b)\\s*\")\n",
    "_METHOD_MARKERS = re.compile(r\"sqrt|\\u00b1|\\+/-|/2a|b2-4ac|b\\^2|\\\\pm|\\u221a\")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _norm(s: str) -> str:\n",
    "    s = s.lower().strip()\n",
    "    s = s.replace(\"\\u00d7\", \"*\").replace(\"\\u2212\", \"-\").replace(\"\\u2013\", \"-\")\n",
    "    s = s.replace(\"\\u2234\", \" \").replace(\"\\u2235\", \" \")\n",
    "    s = re.sub(r\"^\\s*(therefore|so|hence|thus)\\b\\s*\", \"\", s)\n",
    "    # Decimal comma -> period (SA/European notation). Do this before tokenising.\n",
    "    s = re.sub(r\"(\\d),(\\d)\", r\"\\1.\\2\", s)\n",
    "    return s\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _tokens(s: str) -> list[str]:\n",
    "    parts = _SEP.split(_norm(s))\n",
    "    return sorted(re.sub(r\"\\s+\", \"\", p) for p in parts if p.strip())\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _line_matches(line: str, forms: list[str], is_final: bool = False) -> bool:\n",
    "    lt = _tokens(line)\n",
    "    if not lt:\n",
    "        return False\n",
    "    lt_set = set(lt)\n",
    "    for form in forms:\n",
    "        ft = _tokens(form)\n",
    "        if not ft:\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "        if is_final:\n",
    "            if set(ft).issubset(lt_set):\n",
    "                return True\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            if ft == lt:\n",
    "                return True\n",
    "    return False\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _grade_group(steps: list[dict[str, Any]], learner_lines: list[str]):\n",
    "    used: set[int] = set()\n",
    "    results = []\n",
    "    awarded = 0\n",
    "    for step in steps:\n",
    "        matched = False\n",
    "        matched_line = None\n",
    "        is_final = step.get(\"is_final\", False)\n",
    "        for i, line in enumerate(learner_lines):\n",
    "            if i in used and not is_final:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            if _line_matches(line, step[\"forms\"], is_final=is_final):\n",
    "                matched = True\n",
    "                matched_line = line\n",
    "                if not is_final:\n",
    "                    used.add(i)\n",
    "                awarded += step[\"marks\"]\n",
    "                break\n",
    "        results.append({\n",
    "            \"index\": step[\"index\"],\n",
    "            \"desc\": step[\"desc\"],\n",
    "            \"marks\": step[\"marks\"],\n",
    "            \"matched\": matched,\n",
    "            \"learner_line\": matched_line,\n",
    "            \"is_final\": is_final,\n",
    "        })\n",
    "    return awarded, results, used\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def grade_steps(question_id: str, learner_lines: list[str], csv_path: Path | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:\n",
    "    steps_map = load_steps(csv_path)\n",
    "    steps = steps_map.get(question_id, [])\n",
    "    if not steps:\n",
    "        return {\n",
    "            \"question_id\": question_id,\n",
    "            \"total_marks\": 0,\n",
    "            \"awarded_marks\": 0,\n",
    "            \"steps\": [],\n",
    "            \"feedback\": \"No step scheme for \" + question_id,\n",
    "        }\n",
    "\n",
    "    groups: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}\n",
    "    for s in steps:\n",
    "        groups.setdefault(s[\"method_group\"], []).append(s)\n",
    "\n",
    "    best_awarded = -1\n",
    "    best_results = None\n",
    "    best_used = None\n",
    "    best_group = None\n",
    "    for g_name, g_steps in groups.items():\n",
    "        awarded, results, used = _grade_group(g_steps, learner_lines)\n",
    "        if awarded > best_awarded:\n",
    "            best_awarded = awarded\n",
    "            best_results = results\n",
    "            best_used = used\n",
    "            best_group = g_steps\n",
    "\n",
    "    results = best_results\n",
    "    used = best_used\n",
    "    awarded = best_awarded\n",
    "    g_steps = best_group\n",
    "\n",
    "    final_matched = any(r[\"matched\"] and r[\"is_final\"] for r in results)\n",
    "    unmatched_lines = [ln for i, ln in enumerate(learner_lines) if i not in used]\n",
    "    has_method_evidence = any(_METHOD_MARKERS.search(ln) for ln in unmatched_lines)\n",
    "\n",
    "    for r in results:\n",
    "        if r[\"matched\"]:\n",
    "            r[\"match_status\"] = \"MATCHED\"\n",
    "        elif final_matched and has_method_evidence:\n",
    "            r[\"match_status\"] = \"UNCERTAIN\"\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            r[\"match_status\"] = \"NOT_MATCHED\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    total = sum(s[\"marks\"] for s in g_steps)\n",
    "    missing = [r for r in results if r[\"match_status\"] == \"NOT_MATCHED\"]\n",
    "    uncertain = [r for r in results if r[\"match_status\"] == \"UNCERTAIN\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "    if not missing and not uncertain:\n",
    "        feedback = \"Full marks: %d/%d\" % (awarded, total)\n",
    "    elif uncertain and not missing:\n",
    "        bits = [\"cannot verify '%s' (alternate method used)\" % u[\"desc\"] for u in uncertain]\n",
    "        feedback = \"%d/%d. \" % (awarded, total) + \"; \".join(bits)\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        bits = [\"missed '%s' (%d mark)\" % (m[\"desc\"], m[\"marks\"]) for m in missing]\n",
    "        if uncertain:\n",
    "            bits.append(\"cannot verify \" + \", \".join(\"'%s'\" % u[\"desc\"] for u in uncertain))\n",
    "        feedback = \"%d/%d. \" % (awarded, total) + \"; \".join(bits)\n",
    "\n",
    "    return {\n",
    "        \"question_id\": question_id,\n",
    "        \"total_marks\": total,\n",
    "        \"awarded_marks\": awarded,\n",
    "        \"steps\": results,\n",
    "        \"feedback\": feedback,\n",
    "    }\n",
    "'''\n",
    "\n",
    "sg_path = ROOT / \"src\" / \"tutor\" / \"step_grader.py\"\n",
    "sg_path.write_text(step_grader_source, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n",
    "\n",
    "line_count = len(sg_path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").splitlines())\n",
    "print(f\"step_grader.py: wrote {line_count} lines\")\n",
    "assert line_count > 130, f\"Too short ({line_count} lines)\"\n",
    "print(\"OK\")"
   ]

    "def run() -> int:\n",
    "    passed = xfailed = failed = 0\n",
    "    out = []\n",
    "\n",
    "    for name, qid, working, exp_awarded, exp_missing, note, xfail in CASES:\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            r = grade_steps(qid, working, CSV)\n",
    "            awarded = r[\"awarded_marks\"]\n",
    "            missing = sorted(s[\"index\"] for s in r[\"steps\"] if s[\"match_status\"] == \"NOT_MATCHED\")\n",
    "            ok = (awarded == exp_awarded) and (missing == sorted(exp_missing))\n",
    "        except Exception as e:\n",
    "            awarded = missing = None\n",
    "            ok = False\n",
    "            note = \"EXCEPTION: \" + str(e) + \" | \" + note\n",
    "\n",
    "        if ok and not xfail:\n",
    "            passed += 1\n",
    "            status = \"PASS \"\n",
    "        elif (not ok) and xfail:\n",
    "            xfailed += 1\n",
    "            status = \"XFAIL\"\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            failed += 1\n",
    "            status = \"FAIL \"\n",
    "\n",
    "        out.append(\"  [\" + status + \"] \" + name)\n",
    "        if note:\n",
    "            out.append(\"           note: \" + note)\n",
    "        if not ok and not xfail:\n",
    "            out.append(\"           expected \" + str(exp_awarded) + \" missing=\" + str(sorted(exp_missing)))\n",
    "            out.append(\"           got      \" + str(awarded) + \" missing=\" + str(missing))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Assertion: Q1.1.1 case 20 -> UNCERTAIN, UNCERTAIN, MATCHED\n",
    "    r20 = grade_steps(\"2023_P1_Q1.1.1\",\n",
    "                      [\"x = (-1 +/- sqrt(49))/2\", \"x = (-1 +/- 7)/2\", \"x = 3 or x = -4\"],\n",
    "                      CSV)\n",
    "    statuses = [s[\"match_status\"] for s in r20[\"steps\"]]\n",
    "    if statuses == [\"UNCERTAIN\", \"UNCERTAIN\", \"MATCHED\"]:\n",
    "        passed += 1\n",
    "        out.append(\"  [PASS ] assertion / Q1.1.1 UNCERTAIN -> \" + str(statuses))\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        failed += 1\n",
    "        out.append(\"  [FAIL ] assertion / Q1.1.1 UNCERTAIN\")\n",
    "        out.append(\"           expected ['UNCERTAIN', 'UNCERTAIN', 'MATCHED']\")\n",
    "        out.append(\"           got      \" + str(statuses))\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(\"\\n\".join(out))\n",
    "    print()\n",
    "    print(\"  \" + str(passed) + \" passed  |  \" + str(xfailed) + \" xfail  |  \"\n",
    "          + str(failed) + \" failed  |  \" + str(len(CASES) + 1) + \" total\")\n",
    "    return failed\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "if __name__ == \"__main__\":\n",
    "    sys.exit(1 if run() else 0)\n",

    "def run() -> int:\n",
    "    passed = failed = 0\n",
    "    out = []\n",
    "    for name, qid, working, exp_awarded, exp_missing, note, _xfail in CASES:\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            r = grade_steps(qid, working, CSV)\n",
    "            awarded = r[\"awarded_marks\"]\n",
    "            missing = sorted(s[\"index\"] for s in r[\"steps\"] if s[\"match_status\"] == \"NOT_MATCHED\")\n",
    "            ok = (awarded == exp_awarded) and (missing == sorted(exp_missing))\n",
    "        except Exception as e:\n",
    "            awarded = missing = None\n",
    "            ok = False\n",
    "            note = \"EXCEPTION: \" + str(e) + \" | \" + note\n",
    "\n",
    "        if ok:\n",
    "            passed += 1\n",
    "            status = \"PASS \"\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            failed += 1\n",
    "            status = \"FAIL \"\n",
    "\n",
    "        out.append(\"  [\" + status + \"] \" + name)\n",
    "        if note:\n",
    "            out.append(\"           note: \" + note)\n",
    "        if not ok:\n",
    "            out.append(\"           expected \" + str(exp_awarded) + \" missing=\" + str(sorted(exp_missing)))\n",
    "            out.append(\"           got      \" + str(awarded) + \" missing=\" + str(missing))\n",
    "\n",
    "    r20 = grade_steps(\"2023_P1_Q1.1.1\",\n",

    "        out.append(\"  [PASS ] assertion / Q1.1.1 UNCERTAIN -> \" + str(statuses))\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        failed += 1\n",
    "        out.append(\"  [FAIL ] assertion / Q1.1.1 UNCERTAIN\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(\"\\n\".join(out))\n",

    "          + str(len(CASES) + 1) + \" total\")\n",

    "    p = start.resolve()\n",
    "    for _ in range(10):\n",
    "        if (p / \".git\").is_dir() or (p / \"data\" / \"processed\").is_dir():\n",
    "            return p\n",
    "        if p.parent == p:\n",
    "            break\n",
    "        p = p.parent\n",
    "    raise RuntimeError(\"project root not found\")\n",

    "            awarded = r[\"awarded_marks\"]\n",
    "            missing = sorted(s[\"index\"] for s in r[\"steps\"] if s[\"match_status\"] == \"NOT_MATCHED\")\n",
    "            ok = (awarded == exp_awarded) and (missing == sorted(exp_missing))\n",
    "        except Exception as e:\n",
    "            awarded = missing = None\n",
    "            ok = False\n",
    "            note = \"EXCEPTION: \" + str(e) + \" | \" + note\n",
    "\n",
    "        if ok:\n",
    "            passed += 1\n",
    "            status = \"PASS \"\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            failed += 1\n",
    "            status = \"FAIL \"\n",
    "\n",
    "        out.append(\"  [\" + status + \"] \" + name)\n",
    "        if note:\n",
    "            out.append(\"           note: \" + note)\n",
    "        if not ok:\n",
    "            out.append(\"           expected \" + str(exp_awarded) + \" missing=\" + str(sorted(exp_missing)))\n",
    "            out.append(\"           got      \" + str(awarded) + \" missing=\" + str(missing))\n",
    "\n",
    "    r20 = grade_steps(\"2023_P1_Q1.1.1\",\n",
    "                      [\"x = (-1 +/- sqrt(49))/2\", \"x = (-1 +/- 7)/2\", \"x = 3 or x = -4\"],\n",
    "                      CSV)\n",
    "    statuses = [s[\"match_status\"] for s in r20[\"steps\"]]\n",
    "    if statuses == [\"UNCERTAIN\", \"UNCERTAIN\", \"MATCHED\"]:\n",
    "        passed += 1\n",
    "        out.append(\"  [PASS ] assertion / Q1.1.1 UNCERTAIN\")\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        failed += 1\n",
    "        out.append(\"  [FAIL ] assertion / Q1.1.1 UNCERTAIN\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(\"\\n\".join(out))\n",
    "    print()\n",
    "    print(\"  \" + str(passed) + \" passed  |  \" + str(failed) + \" failed  |  \"\n",
    "          + str(len(CASES) + 1) + \" total\")\n",
    "    return failed\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "if __name__ == \"__main__\":\n",
    "    sys.exit(1 if run() else 0)\n",
    "'''\n",

   "source": [
    "step_grader_source = r'''from __future__ import annotations\n",
    "\n",
    "import csv\n",
    "import re\n",
    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "from typing import Any\n",
    "\n",
    "ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]\n",
    "DEFAULT_CSV = ROOT / \"data\" / \"processed\" / \"memo_step_marks\" / \"memo_step_marks_2023_P1.csv\"\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def load_steps(csv_path: Path | None = None) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]:\n",
    "    path = csv_path or DEFAULT_CSV\n",
    "    by_q: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}\n",
    "    with open(path, encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n",
    "        for row in csv.DictReader(f):\n",
    "            qid = row[\"question_id\"].strip()\n",
    "            mg = (row.get(\"method_group\") or \"A\").strip() or \"A\"\n",
    "            by_q.setdefault(qid, []).append({\n",
    "                \"index\": int(row[\"step_index\"]),\n",
    "                \"desc\": row[\"step_description\"].strip(),\n",
    "                \"marks\": int(row[\"marks\"]),\n",
    "                \"memo_line\": row[\"memo_line\"].strip(),\n",
    "                \"forms\": [x.strip() for x in row[\"acceptable_forms\"].split(\"|\") if x.strip()],\n",
    "                \"skill_id\": row[\"skill_id\"].strip(),\n",
    "                \"method_tag\": row[\"method_tag\"].strip(),\n",
    "                \"method_group\": mg,\n",
    "                \"is_final\": str(row.get(\"is_final\", \"false\")).strip().lower() == \"true\",\n",
    "            })\n",
    "    for qid in by_q:\n",
    "        by_q[qid].sort(key=lambda s: (s[\"method_group\"], s[\"index\"]))\n",
    "    return by_q\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "_SEP = re.compile(r\"\\s*(?:,|\\bor\\b|;|\\band\\b)\\s*\")\n",
    "_METHOD_MARKERS = re.compile(r\"sqrt|\\u00b1|\\+/-|/2a|b2-4ac|b\\^2|\\\\pm|\\u221a\")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _norm(s: str) -> str:\n",
    "    s = s.lower().strip()\n",
    "    s = s.replace(\"\\u00d7\", \"*\").replace(\"\\u2212\", \"-\").replace(\"\\u2013\", \"-\")\n",
    "    s = s.replace(\"\\u2234\", \" \").replace(\"\\u2235\", \" \")\n",
    "    s = re.sub(r\"^\\s*(therefore|so|hence|thus)\\b\\s*\", \"\", s)\n",
    "    s = re.sub(r\"(\\d),(\\d)\", r\"\\1.\\2\", s)\n",
    "    return s\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _tokens(s: str) -> list[str]:\n",
    "    parts = _SEP.split(_norm(s))\n",
    "    return sorted(re.sub(r\"\\s+\", \"\", p) for p in parts if p.strip())\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _line_matches(line: str, forms: list[str], is_final: bool = False) -> bool:\n",
    "    lt = _tokens(line)\n",
    "    if not lt:\n",
    "        return False\n",
    "    lt_set = set(lt)\n",
    "    for form in forms:\n",
    "        ft = _tokens(form)\n",
    "        if not ft:\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "        if is_final:\n",
    "            if set(ft).issubset(lt_set):\n",
    "                return True\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            if ft == lt:\n",
    "                return True\n",
    "    return False\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _grade_group(steps, learner_lines):\n",
    "    used: set[int] = set()\n",
    "    results = []\n",
    "    awarded = 0\n",
    "    for step in steps:\n",
    "        matched = False\n",
    "        matched_line = None\n",
    "        is_final = step.get(\"is_final\", False)\n",
    "        for i, line in enumerate(learner_lines):\n",
    "            if i in used and not is_final:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            if _line_matches(line, step[\"forms\"], is_final=is_final):\n",
    "                matched = True\n",
    "                matched_line = line\n",
    "                if not is_final:\n",
    "                    used.add(i)\n",
    "                awarded += step[\"marks\"]\n",
    "                break\n",
    "        results.append({\n",
    "            \"index\": step[\"index\"],\n",
    "            \"desc\": step[\"desc\"],\n",
    "            \"marks\": step[\"marks\"],\n",
    "            \"matched\": matched,\n",
    "            \"learner_line\": matched_line,\n",
    "            \"is_final\": is_final,\n",
    "        })\n",
    "    return awarded, results, used\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def grade_steps(question_id: str, learner_lines: list[str], csv_path: Path | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:\n",
    "    steps_map = load_steps(csv_path)\n",
    "    steps = steps_map.get(question_id, [])\n",
    "    if not steps:\n",
    "        return {\n",
    "            \"question_id\": question_id,\n",
    "            \"total_marks\": 0,\n",
    "            \"awarded_marks\": 0,\n",
    "            \"steps\": [],\n",
    "            \"feedback\": \"No step scheme for \" + question_id,\n",
    "        }\n",
    "\n",
    "    groups: dict[str, list] = {}\n",
    "    for s in steps:\n",
    "        groups.setdefault(s[\"method_group\"], []).append(s)\n",
    "\n",
    "    best_awarded = -1\n",
    "    best_results = None\n",
    "    best_group = None\n",
    "    for g_name, g_steps in groups.items():\n",
    "        awarded, results, used = _grade_group(g_steps, learner_lines)\n",
    "        if awarded > best_awarded:\n",
    "            best_awarded = awarded\n",
    "            best_results = results\n",
    "            best_group = g_steps\n",
    "\n",
    "    results = best_results\n",
    "    awarded = best_awarded\n",
    "    g_steps = best_group\n",
    "\n",
    "    # UNCERTAIN heuristic: only look at learner lines that no step matched.\n",
    "    # Uses learner_line values from results, so lines consumed by final steps\n",
    "    # (which don't add to `used`) are still excluded from the \"leftover\" check.\n",
    "    matched_values = {r[\"learner_line\"] for r in results if r[\"matched\"]}\n",
    "    unmatched_lines = [ln for ln in learner_lines if ln not in matched_values]\n",
    "\n",
    "    final_matched = any(r[\"matched\"] and r[\"is_final\"] for r in results)\n",
    "    has_method_evidence = any(_METHOD_MARKERS.search(ln) for ln in unmatched_lines)\n",
    "\n",
    "    for r in results:\n",
    "        if r[\"matched\"]:\n",
    "            r[\"match_status\"] = \"MATCHED\"\n",
    "        elif final_matched and has_method_evidence:\n",
    "            r[\"match_status\"] = \"UNCERTAIN\"\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            r[\"match_status\"] = \"NOT_MATCHED\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    total = sum(s[\"marks\"] for s in g_steps)\n",
    "    missing = [r for r in results if r[\"match_status\"] == \"NOT_MATCHED\"]\n",
    "    uncertain = [r for r in results if r[\"match_status\"] == \"UNCERTAIN\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "    if not missing and not uncertain:\n",
    "        feedback = \"Full marks: %d/%d\" % (awarded, total)\n",
    "    elif uncertain and not missing:\n",
    "        bits = [\"cannot verify '%s' (alternate method used)\" % u[\"desc\"] for u in uncertain]\n",
    "        feedback = \"%d/%d. \" % (awarded, total) + \"; \".join(bits)\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        bits = [\"missed '%s' (%d mark)\" % (m[\"desc\"], m[\"marks\"]) for m in missing]\n",
    "        if uncertain:\n",
    "            bits.append(\"cannot verify \" + \", \".join(\"'%s'\" % u[\"desc\"] for u in uncertain))\n",
    "        feedback = \"%d/%d. \" % (awarded, total) + \"; \".join(bits)\n",
    "\n",
    "    return {\n",
    "        \"question_id\": question_id,\n",
    "        \"total_marks\": total,\n",
    "        \"awarded_marks\": awarded,\n",
    "        \"steps\": results,\n",
    "        \"feedback\": feedback,\n",
    "    }\n",
    "'''\n",
    "\n",
    "sg_path = ROOT / \"src\" / \"tutor\" / \"step_grader.py\"\n",
    "sg_path.write_text(step_grader_source, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"step_grader.py: wrote {len(sg_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines())} lines\")\n",
    "print(\"OK\")"
   ]

    "step_grader_source = r'''from __future__ import annotations\n",
    "\n",
    "import csv\n",
    "import re\n",
    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "from typing import Any\n",
    "\n",
    "ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]\n",
    "CSV_DIR = ROOT / \"data\" / \"processed\" / \"memo_step_marks\"\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _load_one(path: Path, by_q: dict) -> None:\n",
    "    with open(path, encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n",
    "        for row in csv.DictReader(f):\n",
    "            qid = row[\"question_id\"].strip()\n",
    "            if not qid:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            mg = (row.get(\"method_group\") or \"A\").strip() or \"A\"\n",
    "            by_q.setdefault(qid, []).append({\n",
    "                \"index\": int(row[\"step_index\"]),\n",
    "                \"desc\": row[\"step_description\"].strip(),\n",
    "                \"marks\": int(row[\"marks\"]),\n",
    "                \"memo_line\": row[\"memo_line\"].strip(),\n",
    "                \"forms\": [x.strip() for x in row[\"acceptable_forms\"].split(\"|\") if x.strip()],\n",
    "                \"skill_id\": row[\"skill_id\"].strip(),\n",
    "                \"method_tag\": row[\"method_tag\"].strip(),\n",
    "                \"method_group\": mg,\n",
    "                \"is_final\": str(row.get(\"is_final\", \"false\")).strip().lower() == \"true\",\n",
    "            })\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def load_steps(csv_path: Path | None = None) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]:\n",
    "    by_q: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}\n",
    "    if csv_path is not None:\n",
    "        _load_one(csv_path, by_q)\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        for p in sorted(CSV_DIR.glob(\"memo_step_marks_*.csv\")):\n",
    "            _load_one(p, by_q)\n",
    "    for qid in by_q:\n",
    "        by_q[qid].sort(key=lambda s: (s[\"method_group\"], s[\"index\"]))\n",
    "    return by_q\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "_SEP = re.compile(r\"\\s*(?:,|\\bor\\b|;|\\band\\b)\\s*\")\n",
    "_METHOD_MARKERS = re.compile(r\"sqrt|\\u00b1|\\+/-|/2a|b2-4ac|b\\^2|\\\\pm|\\u221a|\\u221a|\\u00b1\")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _norm(s: str) -> str:\n",
    "    s = s.lower().strip()\n",
    "    s = s.replace(\"\\u00d7\", \"*\").replace(\"\\u2212\", \"-\").replace(\"\\u2013\", \"-\")\n",
    "    s = s.replace(\"\\u2234\", \" \").replace(\"\\u2235\", \" \")\n",
    "    s = re.sub(r\"^\\s*(therefore|so|hence|thus)\\b\\s*\", \"\", s)\n",
    "    s = re.sub(r\"(\\d),(\\d)\", r\"\\1.\\2\", s)\n",
    "    return s\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _tokens(s: str) -> list[str]:\n",
    "    parts = _SEP.split(_norm(s))\n",
    "    return sorted(re.sub(r\"\\s+\", \"\", p) for p in parts if p.strip())\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _line_matches(line: str, forms: list[str], is_final: bool = False) -> bool:\n",
    "    lt = _tokens(line)\n",
    "    if not lt:\n",
    "        return False\n",
    "    lt_set = set(lt)\n",
    "    for form in forms:\n",
    "        ft = _tokens(form)\n",
    "        if not ft:\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "        if is_final:\n",
    "            if set(ft).issubset(lt_set):\n",
    "                return True\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            if ft == lt:\n",
    "                return True\n",
    "    return False\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _grade_group(steps, learner_lines):\n",
    "    used: set[int] = set()\n",
    "    results = []\n",
    "    awarded = 0\n",
    "    for step in steps:\n",
    "        matched = False\n",
    "        matched_line = None\n",
    "        is_final = step.get(\"is_final\", False)\n",
    "        for i, line in enumerate(learner_lines):\n",
    "            if i in used and not is_final:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            if _line_matches(line, step[\"forms\"], is_final=is_final):\n",
    "                matched = True\n",
    "                matched_line = line\n",
    "                if not is_final:\n",
    "                    used.add(i)\n",
    "                awarded += step[\"marks\"]\n",
    "                break\n",
    "        results.append({\n",
    "            \"index\": step[\"index\"],\n",
    "            \"desc\": step[\"desc\"],\n",
    "            \"marks\": step[\"marks\"],\n",
    "            \"matched\": matched,\n",
    "            \"learner_line\": matched_line,\n",
    "            \"is_final\": is_final,\n",
    "        })\n",
    "    return awarded, results, used\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def grade_steps(question_id: str, learner_lines: list[str], csv_path: Path | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:\n",
    "    steps_map = load_steps(csv_path)\n",
    "    steps = steps_map.get(question_id, [])\n",
    "    if not steps:\n",
    "        return {\n",
    "            \"question_id\": question_id,\n",
    "            \"total_marks\": 0,\n",
    "            \"awarded_marks\": 0,\n",
    "            \"steps\": [],\n",
    "            \"feedback\": \"No step scheme for \" + question_id,\n",
    "        }\n",
    "\n",
    "    groups: dict[str, list] = {}\n",
    "    for s in steps:\n",
    "        groups.setdefault(s[\"method_group\"], []).append(s)\n",
    "\n",
    "    best_awarded = -1\n",
    "    best_results = None\n",
    "    best_group = None\n",
    "    for g_name, g_steps in groups.items():\n",
    "        awarded, results, used = _grade_group(g_steps, learner_lines)\n",
    "        if awarded > best_awarded:\n",
    "            best_awarded = awarded\n",
    "            best_results = results\n",
    "            best_group = g_steps\n",
    "\n",
    "    results = best_results\n",
    "    awarded = best_awarded\n",
    "    g_steps = best_group\n",
    "\n",
    "    matched_values = {r[\"learner_line\"] for r in results if r[\"matched\"]}\n",
    "    unmatched_lines = [ln for ln in learner_lines if ln not in matched_values]\n",
    "\n",
    "    final_matched = any(r[\"matched\"] and r[\"is_final\"] for r in results)\n",
    "    has_method_evidence = any(_METHOD_MARKERS.search(ln) for ln in unmatched_lines)\n",
    "\n",
    "    for r in results:\n",
    "        if r[\"matched\"]:\n",
    "            r[\"match_status\"] = \"MATCHED\"\n",
    "        elif final_matched and has_method_evidence:\n",
    "            r[\"match_status\"] = \"UNCERTAIN\"\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            r[\"match_status\"] = \"NOT_MATCHED\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    total = sum(s[\"marks\"] for s in g_steps)\n",
    "    missing = [r for r in results if r[\"match_status\"] == \"NOT_MATCHED\"]\n",
    "    uncertain = [r for r in results if r[\"match_status\"] == \"UNCERTAIN\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "    if not missing and not uncertain:\n",
    "        feedback = \"Full marks: %d/%d\" % (awarded, total)\n",
    "    elif uncertain and not missing:\n",
    "        bits = [\"cannot verify '%s' (alternate method used)\" % u[\"desc\"] for u in uncertain]\n",
    "        feedback = \"%d/%d. \" % (awarded, total) + \"; \".join(bits)\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        bits = [\"missed '%s' (%d mark)\" % (m[\"desc\"], m[\"marks\"]) for m in missing]\n",
    "        if uncertain:\n",
    "            bits.append(\"cannot verify \" + \", \".join(\"'%s'\" % u[\"desc\"] for u in uncertain))\n",
    "        feedback = \"%d/%d. \" % (awarded, total) + \"; \".join(bits)\n",
    "\n",
    "    return {\n",
    "        \"question_id\": question_id,\n",
    "        \"total_marks\": total,\n",
    "        \"awarded_marks\": awarded,\n",
    "        \"steps\": results,\n",
    "        \"feedback\": feedback,\n",
    "    }\n",
    "'''\n",
    "\n",
    "sg_path = ROOT / \"src\" / \"tutor\" / \"step_grader.py\"\n",
    "sg_path.write_text(step_grader_source, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n",
    "print(f\"step_grader.py: {len(sg_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines())} lines\")\n",
    "print(\"OK — now loads ALL memo_step_marks_*.csv files in the folder\")"

    "                \"is_final\": str(row.get(\"is_final\", \"false\")).strip().lower() == \"true\",\n",

    "                \"is_final\": str(row.get(\"is_final\", \"false\")).strip().lower() == \"true\",\n",

    "            })'''\n",
    "assert old in src, \"loader patch anchor not found\"\n",
    "src = src.replace(old, new)\n",
    "\n",
    "# 2. _line_matches: accept mode parameter\n",
    "old = '''def _line_matches(line: str, forms: list[str], is_final: bool = False) -> bool:\n",
    "    lt = _tokens(line)\n",
    "    if not lt:\n",
    "        return False\n",
    "    lt_set = set(lt)\n",
    "    for form in forms:\n",
    "        ft = _tokens(form)\n",
    "        if not ft:\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "        if is_final:\n",
    "            if set(ft).issubset(lt_set):\n",
    "                return True\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            if ft == lt:\n",
    "                return True\n",
    "    return False'''\n",
    "new = '''def _line_matches(line: str, forms: list[str], is_final: bool = False, mode: str = \"exact\") -> bool:\n",
    "    if mode == \"keyword\":\n",
    "        nline = _norm(line)\n",
    "        if not nline:\n",
    "            return False\n",
    "        for form in forms:\n",
    "            nf = _norm(form)\n",
    "            if nf and nf in nline:\n",
    "                return True\n",
    "        return False\n",
    "    lt = _tokens(line)\n",
    "    if not lt:\n",
    "        return False\n",
    "    lt_set = set(lt)\n",
    "    for form in forms:\n",
    "        ft = _tokens(form)\n",
    "        if not ft:\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "        if is_final:\n",
    "            if set(ft).issubset(lt_set):\n",
    "                return True\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            if ft == lt:\n",
    "                return True\n",
    "    return False'''\n",
    "assert old in src, \"_line_matches anchor not found\"\n",
    "src = src.replace(old, new)\n",
    "\n",
    "# 3. _grade_group: read mode from step, pass to matcher\n",
    "old = '''        is_final = step.get(\"is_final\", False)\n",
    "        for i, line in enumerate(learner_lines):\n",
    "            if i in used and not is_final:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            if _line_matches(line, step[\"forms\"], is_final=is_final):'''\n",
    "new = '''        is_final = step.get(\"is_final\", False)\n",
    "        mode = step.get(\"match_mode\", \"exact\")\n",
    "        for i, line in enumerate(learner_lines):\n",
    "            if i in used and not is_final:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            if _line_matches(line, step[\"forms\"], is_final=is_final, mode=mode):'''\n",
    "assert old in src, \"_grade_group anchor not found\"\n",
    "src = src.replace(old, new)\n",
    "\n",

    "        if not nline:\n",
    "            return False\n",
    "        # Compact all whitespace: \"X = Y\" must match \"X=Y\"\n",

    "                continue\n",

    "import re\n",
    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "\n",
    "def find_project_root(start):\n",
    "    p = start.resolve()\n",
    "    for _ in range(10):\n",
    "        if (p / \".git\").is_dir() or (p / \"data\" / \"processed\").is_dir():\n",
    "            return p\n",
    "        if p.parent == p:\n",
    "            break\n",
    "        p = p.parent\n",
    "    raise RuntimeError(\"project root not found\")\n",
    "\n",
    "ROOT = find_project_root(Path.cwd())\n",
    "print(\"ROOT:\", ROOT)\n",
    "print()\n",

    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "\n",
    "def find_project_root(start):\n",
    "    p = start.resolve()\n",
    "    for _ in range(10):\n",
    "        if (p / \".git\").is_dir() or (p / \"data\" / \"processed\").is_dir():\n",
    "            return p\n",
    "        if p.parent == p:\n",
    "            break\n",
    "        p = p.parent\n",
    "    raise RuntimeError(\"project root not found\")\n",
    "\n",

    "import csv\n",

    "def patch_csv(csv_path, patches):\n",
    "    \"\"\"patches: dict mapping (question_id, step_index) -> new_acceptable_forms string\"\"\"\n",
    "    lines = csv_path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").splitlines()\n",
    "    header = lines[0].split(\",\")\n",
    "    ncols = len(header)\n",
    "    new_lines = [lines[0]]\n",
    "    applied = set()\n",
    "    for line in lines[1:]:\n",
    "        # Use csv module for proper parsing\n",
    "        row = next(csv.reader([line]))\n",
    "        if len(row) < ncols:\n",
    "            new_lines.append(line)\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "        key = (row[0], row[1])\n",
    "        if key in patches:\n",
    "            row[5] = patches[key]\n",
    "            applied.add(key)\n",
    "            new_lines.append(\",\".join(\n",
    "                f'\"{c}\"' if (\",\" in c or \"|\" in c) and not (c.startswith('\"') and c.endswith('\"')) else c\n",
    "                for c in row\n",
    "            ))\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            new_lines.append(line)\n",
    "    csv_path.write_text(\"\\n\".join(new_lines), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n",
    "    return applied\n",
